description: The Kościan County Grand Prix is a series of five 5 km races, organized by all the municipalities in Kościan County under the patronage of the Kościan County Governor. Its aim is to promote physical activity, healthy competition, and community integration. Residents of the county who turn 16 in 2025 may participate. Each race requires a separate entry fee, and the overall standings are based on the total points earned across the races.
course_highlights: A series of five 5 km races
Organized by all the municipalities in Kościan County
Separate standings for women and men, with no age categories
additional: Participation in the Grand Prix is free; only the entry fee for each individual race, set locally, is payable. The races are scheduled from June to December 2025 in various locations across the county. Points from the individual races are added together, with prizes for the top 6 women and top 6 men, as well as additional special prizes from the organizers of the individual races. The series comprises five 5 km races held from June to December, with overall standings and prizes for the top finishers. The main 10 km race is scheduled for 15 November 2026 in Kościerzyna, with typical autumn weather and possible rain.

Organized by the Odra Consortium Foundation
In partnership with the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland settings of urban parks and forests. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can compare their results on the same course over many years. Races take place regularly during the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete in both local and nationwide rankings.

Start and finish by the city beach at Rusałka, Św. Wawrzyńca Street
Suitable for both run-walking and fast running, and accessible to runners of all abilities

The run is open to both experienced runners and people who want to spend time actively without the pressure of competition. The start traditionally takes place in the clearing behind the Piast Stadium, and participants can look forward to a welcoming atmosphere and an active way to wrap up February. The event is a great opportunity to start a new month with energy and in a good mood.

The route passes through the city’s green spaces
The event combines sport, a friendly atmosphere and recreation

name: Jesienny Ultra Świr
description: Jesienny Ultra Świr is a mountain ultramarathon held in Grybów, offering a challenge for fans of long-distance running in natural terrain. The course runs mainly along forest and gravel paths, with minimal asphalt, providing an authentic trail-running experience. The event offers different competition formats, including timed races and Nordic Walking, catering to various levels of experience. It is organised by experienced enthusiasts who ensure a welcoming atmosphere and participants’ safety.
course_highlights: 98% of the course runs along forest and gravel paths
Minimal asphalt: just 2%
Start and finish at the Winter Sports Centre in Ptaszkowa
additional: The start, finish and race office are at the Winter Sports Centre in Ptaszkowa. On race day, the race office is open from 06:45 to 07:30 for the 6/12/24-hour distances and until 09:30 for Nordic Walking and the one-lap race. In the 6-hour and 12-hour races, the winner is the participant who completes the greatest number of full 17 km laps. Running is prohibited during the Nordic Walking event, and judges on the course monitor proper technique. Participants must check in at the race office with an identity document and have the mandatory equipment. The event is part of the Jesienny Ultra Świr series, which includes various distances and activity formats, with online registration. The course may be changed due to weather conditions.

description: The XXIII Commandos Marathon is a demanding 42.195 km marathon held in Lubliniec. The race takes place on 28 November 2026 and is organised by the Wojskowy Klub Biegacza „Meta” Lubliniec. The course has recently been changed and is available online. Participants can expect professional timekeeping and full technical support for the event.

Marathon distance: 42.195 km
Organiser: Wojskowy Klub Biegacza „Meta” Lubliniec
additional: The race office is open on 28 November from 15:00 to 20:30 and on 29 November from 07:00 to 08:40. The entry fee can only be paid via an individual link to quick online payments through tpay.com, sent by email. After 31 October 2026, entry is possible only with the organiser’s consent and without the full race package. The participant limit has been reached and registration is suspended. New course; participant limit reached; urban and forest terrain; electronic timekeeping.

name: 45 Strzeliński Rogaining
location: Kamiennik, Strzelin County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Polskie Towarzystwo Turystyczno-Krajoznawcze Oddział Ziemi Strzelińskiej
description: Strzeliński Rogaining is a walking orienteering event in which teams of 2–5 plan their own route to visit as many checkpoints as possible within a set time. The checkpoints are spread across the terrain and marked on a map. The event is open to participants of different ages and experience levels, from enthusiasts and recreational participants to families. Rogaining combines tourism and sport, and participants can modify their route at any time during the competition, making it an appealing way to enjoy the outdoors. The event is organised by the Polish Tourist and Sightseeing Society, Strzelin District Branch, which has been holding orienteering competitions in the region for many years.
course_highlights: Teams travel on foot only, using a map and compass to navigate the terrain
Checkpoints have different point values depending on how difficult they are to find
Participants can choose and change their own route, at any length from 5 to 70 km
additional: The competition is open to all age groups and genders. Teams consist of 2–5 people. Rogaining combines tourism and sport and is suitable for both experienced competitors and families. Routes can be changed during the competition. In 2026, four rogaining events are planned around Strzelin, including the 45th edition in November. The events offer distances from 5 km to 70 km and use maps and compasses. They cater to different experience levels and offer both recreational and competitive participation.

The course combines a seaside atmosphere with varied, mountainous terrain, offering runners challenging climbs, valleys, ravines and gorges. It is a great opportunity to end the season amid sporting competition and close contact with nature. The event is part of a nationwide mountain-running series that promotes physical activity and respect for the environment.

Varied terrain with dense forests, valleys, ravines and gorges
Challenging elevation gains and natural climbs characteristic of trail running
additional: Race packs can be collected on 4–5 December 2026 at the race office. description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including the Tricity area in the Gdańsk Forest District and around Mały Kack in Gdynia. The races take place in natural settings among forests and urban parks, promoting outdoor physical activity. The series consists of four races in each location, and participants can compete in both local and overall rankings. The races are open to people aged 16 and over; younger participants may take part with a guardian’s consent. The main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: The 5 km course runs through forests and urban parks
The Tricity location includes the Gdańsk Forest District and the area around Mały Kack in Gdynia
The race takes place in a natural setting and promotes outdoor activity
additional: The race office opens at 8:30. Race numbers and timing chips are collected on race day. The schedule is the same at all locations. Participants can buy a pass for the entire series or enter individual races. The entry fee is higher on race day. There is no participant limit. Participants under 16 may take part with a guardian’s consent. Pass holders can race for free in another city by registering in advance. Online registration is available through the Participant Portal at citytrail.pl/zapisy or on race day at the race office. A pass for four races at one location is available.

name: Bieg po moczkę i makówki
location: Szkoła Podstawowa w Stanowicach, Stanowice, Opole, Poland
description: Bieg po Moczkę i Makówki is an annual, friendly running event held in Stanowice. Since 2012, it has become a fixture on the holiday running calendar. The course is 10 km long, divided into four 2.5 km loops, and runners may finish after any number of loops. After the run, participants receive handmade gingerbread medals and traditional moczka and makówki, and can also enjoy hot coffee and tea. The event has a relaxed, friendly atmosphere, with a prize-winning contest for the most interesting costume and a spectator competition.
course_highlights: A 10 km course divided into four 2.5 km loops
Start and finish at Stanowice Primary School, ul. Szkolna 17A
Runners may finish after any number of loops
additional: After the run, participants receive handmade gingerbread medals and servings of traditional holiday dishes: moczka and makówki. A prize-winning spectator competition is held along the course, as well as a contest for the most interesting individual or group holiday-carnival costume. The event has a relaxed, friendly atmosphere and encourages active spectating. It features costume contests and recreational activities, is based at Stanowice Primary School, and offers the option to take part in the 10 km run. The event is usually held in December during the holiday season.

description: Szczecin New Year's Run 2027 is an annual running event held on January 1 in Szczecin, by the Helena Majdaniec Summer Theatre. The program includes a 5 km Main Run, Nordic Walking, and children's races for different age groups. The Main Run route follows paths in Jan Kasprowicz Park, past Psia Polana and around Jasne Błonia. The start and finish are by the Summer Theatre. The event is a great opportunity to start the new year actively in a family-friendly, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: The 5 km route consists of two 2.5 km loops
The route follows paths in Jan Kasprowicz Park, past Psia Polana and around Jasne Błonia
The start and finish are by the Helena Majdaniec Summer Theatre
additional: The race office is open on December 29 and 30, 2026, from 17:00 to 19:30, where race numbers can be collected. A bag drop is available by the race office. Changing rooms are located in the start area by the Summer Theatre. Capacity: 470 participants for the Main Run and Nordic Walking combined, and 115 for the Children's Races. Every participant receives a commemorative medal. Nordic Walking and the Main Run each consist of two 2.5 km loops. Children's races are divided into three age-group heats, with distances of approximately 100, 200, and 400 m. The program also includes Nordic Walking events over two 2.5 km loops and children's races of approximately 100, 200, and 400 m, depending on age group. Places are limited.

name: Bydgoszcz na Orientację
description: Bydgoszcz Orienteering is a series of orienteering events organized by the Bydgoszcz Orienteering Foundation. They take place in various forests and areas around Bydgoszcz. The activity is for everyone, regardless of age or experience, combining sport with adventure and exploring nature using a map and compass. The foundation promotes accessibility by also creating courses for blind and partially sighted participants. The series includes a variety of courses with different difficulty levels, and participants can earn badges for completing individual rounds.
course_highlights: A variety of forest terrain around Bydgoszcz, changing with each round
Courses for beginners and advanced participants, including courses for blind and partially sighted participants
The opportunity to earn digital badges and collectible stickers for completing rounds
additional: The series consists of six rounds held from November to January in various forests and areas around Bydgoszcz. For each completed round, participants receive a digital badge and a sticker for their collectible card. A special final badge is available upon completing the entire series. Courses are tailored to different ability levels, and the final round features a mass start on the semi-open grounds of a former manor farm. Information about a specific edition on December 31, 2026, is not provided in the available materials.

name: Kresowe Trail #1
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale trail races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in natural surroundings. The races take place on scenic routes in eastern Poland, with respect for nature and local communities. The events are for both beginner and experienced runners, aiming to build a running community based on passion, competition, and friendship. Each race offers carefully marked courses, electronic timekeeping, and a generous race package.
course_highlights: Trail courses ranging from approximately 5 km to over 18 km
Carefully marked trails with colored arrows (green, red, purple)
Aid stations along the course and at the finish; time limit of approximately 2 hours
additional: Registration is available on race day until 08:40 and on-site from 8:00. New race numbers are in use starting with the 2026 season; the first race number is free of charge. The race package includes a hot recovery meal (vegetarian option also available), electronic timekeeping, medical support, aid stations along the course and at the finish, a commemorative medal (for early registration), photography service, and points toward the series’ overall standings. Littering on the course is strictly prohibited. Online registration and race-day on-site registration are available.

name: Lekkoatletyczne Halowe Mistrzostwa Europ... Bieg Uliczny 5 km
description: The 15th European Masters Athletics Indoor Championships will take place in Toruń from 27 March to 2 April 2026. As part of the event, a 5 km road race will be held, giving masters runners an excellent opportunity to compete on the city's scenic routes. The competition combines sporting rivalry with a chance for the athletics community to come together. We invite all running enthusiasts to take part in this prestigious event.
course_highlights: A 5 km road race in the centre of Toruń
Scenic city routes suited to fast times
An event accompanying the 15th European Masters Athletics Indoor Championships
additional: Details of the date and event may change.

name: XVII Noworoczny Bieg z Ochotą
description: The New Year's Run is an annual running event held in Warsaw, giving participants the chance to run into the New Year full of energy. The course passes through the capital's scenic spots, offering both amateur and more experienced runners a unique sporting experience. The organizers provide professional support and a friendly atmosphere, encouraging everyone to celebrate together and start the new year actively.

name: XX Jubileuszowy Śląski Maraton Noworoczn...
distance_verbose: Maraton, 35 km, 28 km, Półmaraton, 14 km, 7 km
description: The 20th Anniversary Silesian New Year’s Cyborg Marathon takes place in Silesian Park in Chorzów and invites participants to start the year actively. Participants can choose a distance from 7 km to the marathon, covering one to six 7 km loops. The program also includes a Nordic Walking half marathon. The start is scheduled by the Silesian Park administration building.
course_highlights: A 7 km loop in Silesian Park
Choose from one to six loops, up to the marathon distance
Nordic Walking half marathon over three loops
additional: The start is at 12:00 by the Silesian Park administration building. Participants could change the number of loops during the race; the time limit for the marathon was 360 minutes.

name: Wbiegnij z Nami w Nowy Rok
Warta Challenge
location: Leśny parking Łysy Młyn, ul. Poznańska 4, Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter tournament consisting of a series of four races and Nordic Walking events, offering both amateur and professional athletes the opportunity to compete over half-marathon and marathon distances. The races take place on forest tracks and trails in the Warta River forests near Biedrusko, with the event hub at the Łysy Młyn forest car park. The courses are challenging, running through natural woodland with varied surfaces, and each race has its own theme. Races start on Saturdays, and race packs can be collected on race morning. Additional races and walks are also held over 5 km and 10 km distances.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course is one 21.3 km loop, while the marathon is two loops totalling 42.6 km.
The course follows forest tracks and trails along the Warta River, with sections of asphalt and natural surfaces that are often slippery.
The marathon has 220 m of total ascent, with the biggest climb gaining 35 m over a 1 km stretch.
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30 at the race office. Themed outfits and accessories are encouraged for the individual races. The course is marked with red-and-white tape and “Łysy Młyn” running trail signs. The 21.3 km Nordic Walking event starts together with the half-marathon runners. The New Year’s Run is event no. 2 in the series. The event hub and race office are at the Łysy Młyn forest car park, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko. Race-pack collection is scheduled for 7:45–9:30 on race day, with the start at 10:00. Free parking is available by the event hub.

description: Ełcka Zmarzlina 2027 is a walking orienteering marathon held in Ełk, offering two routes of 50 km and 25 km. The event takes place on January 9, 2027, and is funded from the budget of the City of Ełk. Participants can expect professional organization, registration at the marathon office, and a celebratory closing with a feast. It is a unique opportunity to spend an active winter day on routes of varying difficulty.
course_highlights: 50 km walking orienteering route
Alternative 25 km route
Time limits: 12 hours for 50 km and 9 hours for 25 km
additional: Participant registration takes place on January 8, 2027, from 16:00 to 20:00, and on January 9 from 6:00 to 9:30 at the race office. The time limit is 12 hours for the 50 km route and 9 hours for the 25 km route. A celebratory closing and a feast for participants are planned for 21:00 after the event. Registration is conducted through Timekeeper. According to the 2027 event page, TP 50 km starts at 08:00, and TP 25 km at 10:00. The event is funded from the budget of the City of Ełk, and KOMA EŁK is a partner.

name: 5 Wieluński Bieg Noworoczny
description: The 5th Wieluń New Year’s Run is an annual running event organized by the Atelier Sport Association in Wieluń. The race takes place in early January and attracts runners from various regions. The race is scheduled to start at 12:00, and timing is provided using modern electronic systems. The organizers ensure a high standard of event management and sport, providing professional support and an atmosphere conducive to competition.
additional: Timing is provided using a state-of-the-art electronic system based on RFID chips and mats at the start and finish lines. The organizer provides phone support from 8:00 to 16:00, as well as assistance on race day. The event is organized by the Atelier Sport Association. Available information concerns the fifth edition, held on January 4, 2026; there are no confirmed details about the 2027 edition.

name: Bieg Noworoczny
description: The New Year’s Run is an annual running event organized by the Wroniecki Running Club. It takes place on scenic routes near Rzecińska Street in Wronki. The event promotes an active, healthy lifestyle among residents of the Wronki municipality and brings the local community together. The route passes through the beautiful forests and landscapes of the Noteć Forest, offering participants a distinctive sporting challenge and the chance to start the new year together. The event is open to runners and Nordic walkers, with chip timing and prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: A route of approximately 5.5 km for runners and Nordic walkers
Scenic forests and landscapes of the Noteć Forest
Start and finish near Rzecińska Street in Wronki
additional: Chip timing (a reusable chip attached to the shoelace). The race office is open from 11:30 to 12:45 on Rzecińska Street. Participant limit: 200. The awards ceremony will be held at the Zamość estate community center on Topolowa Street. A refreshment area at the finish will serve hot tea and coffee. Participants under 18 must have written parental consent. The organizer does not allow anyone under 15 to take part. The 2026 edition regulations provided for electronic chip timing and participation from age 15; details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Noworoczny Bydgoszcz FAN Maraton od 2014...
description: Bydgoszcz Fan Marathon is a unique long-distance event held in Bydgoszcz since 2014, mainly at the KS Gwiazda stadium and along the Old Bydgoszcz Canal. The course consists of multiple loops of approximately 4.22 km, following park paths with a gravel-and-asphalt surface and little elevation change. The event is small-scale and friendly, promoting recreational exercise and active leisure while continuing the tradition of similar races in other European cities. Participants time themselves and report their times to the organizers. Both runners and Nordic walkers are welcome. The start is usually in the morning, and the atmosphere is informal and friendly.
course_highlights: The course follows park paths around the Old Bydgoszcz Canal, with 4.22 km loops
Gravel-and-asphalt surface, mostly gravel
Start and finish at the KS Gwiazda stadium; little elevation change (approximately 53 m above sea level at the start and 45.95 m above sea level at the turnaround)
additional: There is no time limit; participants time themselves and report their times by email. People over 18 may take part, including Nordic walkers and walkers. The race office is located on the park path by the KS Gwiazda stadium. No entry fee is planned, except in special circumstances. Participants provide their own drinks and nutrition. The start is usually at 8:00 or 9:00. The course requires completing a multiple of the loop, up to a maximum of 10 loops. Participants arriving after the scheduled start time start together with the first participant. The event has no entry fee and no medals.

name: Zamczyska Winter Trail
location: Drewniane altany nad Czarnym Potokiem, Rymanów-Zdrój, Poland
description: Zamczyska Winter Trail is a mountain race held in the scenic area of Rymanów-Zdrój. The course runs along both marked and unmarked hiking trails. The 12.5 km course has a total elevation gain of +650 m and is additionally marked by the organizer to make navigation easier during the race. The start and finish are by the wooden shelters above the Czarny Potok. The race requires good physical fitness and experience in mountain running. The participant limit is 200.
course_highlights: 12.5 km course with +650 m elevation gain
Two checkpoints and water stations along the course
The course follows marked and unmarked hiking trails
additional: The participant limit is 200. The start and finish are by the wooden shelters above the Czarny Potok. The race office is open from 8:00 to 9:45. The time limit is 2 hours 30 minutes. After registering, participants have 48 hours to pay the entry fee. If withdrawing, the entry fee is refundable until 30.11.2026. The participant limit is 200, and the time limit is 2 hr 30 min. Entry is open to adults with experience running on difficult terrain. Registration is available through raatiming.pl.

name: 10 Bieg Trzech Króli
description: The Three Kings Run is a 5 km street race in Łódź, held to celebrate Epiphany. Participants start and finish at Manufaktura Market Square, and the route runs through the city streets, including Piotrkowska Street. It’s an opportunity to start the year actively and run in a festive atmosphere. Information about the 2027 edition has not been confirmed in the available sources.
course_highlights: A 5-kilometre route through the streets of Łódź
Start and finish at Manufaktura Market Square
The route includes Piotrkowska Street
additional: The sources refer to the 10th edition, held on 6 January 2026; they do not confirm a date of 5 January 2027.

name: Ultra CK Maraton
location: Hala Legionów, ul. Leszka Drogosza, Kielce, Poland
description: Ultra CK Marathon is a demanding ultra race of approximately 51 km with around 1,520 m of elevation gain, held in Kielce. The event also offers shorter races: Czarci Oddech, 15 km with 422 m of elevation gain, and the MTB cycling route Upiorna Trzydziestka, 30 km with 828 m of elevation gain. The event is aimed at enthusiasts of challenges and varied forms of sporting suffering, and is organized by the Świętokrzyskie Mountain Biking Association MTBCross Kielce. The start and race office are located at Hala Legionów in Kielce. Participants in the longest-distance race must carry mandatory safety equipment.
course_highlights: Piekielna Pętla: 51 km ultra race with around 1,520 m of elevation gain
Czarci Oddech: 15 km race with around 422 m of elevation gain
Upiorna Trzydziestka: 30 km MTB route with around 828 m of elevation gain
additional: The race office is open on 5.01.2026 at Hala Legionów Kielce from 17:00 to 20:00, and on race day from 6:00. The cutoff for all distances is 18:00/18:30. Mandatory equipment for ultra-race participants: a headlamp, an NRC emergency blanket, a charged mobile phone, identification, and clothing suitable for the weather. The race office is located at Hala Legionów, ul. Leszka Drogosza, Kielce. Participants in Piekielna Pętla are required to carry safety equipment, including a headlamp, an NRC emergency blanket, and a charged phone. Details of the 2027 edition are not confirmed in the available information.

name: Grand Prix Trójmiasta 1/3
description: The Three Kings Run is the first stage of the 2027 Grand Prix of the Tri-City series, held on the beach in Brzeźno. Participants can take part in a 6 km cross-country run or 6 km Nordic walking. The event is open to various age and gender categories and also features a three-person team competition, with at least one woman on each team. The participant limit is 500, and the run is scheduled to start at 9:00.
course_highlights: The course is 100% on the beach
6 km cross-country run and Nordic walking
Three-person teams may enter, with at least one woman on each team
additional: Race office opens at 07:30. Nordic walking starts at 10:00. Winners’ awards ceremony at 11:30. The participant limit is 500. Three-person teams (including at least one woman) can register at the race office. Choose between the cross-country run and Nordic walking. The limit is 500 participants. A three-person team may be entered, and it must include at least one woman.

description: Trail!ON Stawiguda is a series of four 5 km trail races held monthly on the same scenic route near the forests and the Łyna River, close to Ruś. The winter scenery, forest route and varied terrain create unique running conditions, allowing runners to test their fitness and enjoy the excitement of competition throughout the season. This event is for everyone who wants to spend winter Saturdays actively, regardless of experience level. The organisers ensure participants’ comfort by offering passes for the entire series as well as the option to take part in a single race.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the beautiful forests of Ruś
Start and finish by the beach at the bend in the Łyna River in the Stawiguda Municipality
Winter forest scenery with natural, varied terrain
additional: Mini Trail!ON children’s races are held over distances from 300 m to 1,000 m, with age-group divisions. Children’s races take place from 9:45 to 10:15. The race office closes at 10:30. At the final race in the series, an awards ceremony and a campfire gathering with the Mayor of the Municipality are planned. On race day, single-race entries can be purchased at the race office. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:00. The programme also includes children’s races over distances of approximately 300 m, 500 m and 1,000 m. Online registration is open until 6 January 2027 at 23:59.

description: Backyard Ultra Warszawa - Bemowo is the first edition of a backyard-format race, held on the grounds of the Military University of Technology’s training area in Warsaw. The course is 6.706 km long, in accordance with the international backyard rules. The race lasts a maximum of 24 hours, during which runners complete successive loops. The participant limit is 80, and the winner receives cash prizes, a trophy, and gifts from partners. All participants receive a commemorative medal and certificate.
course_highlights: A 6.706 km course in accordance with the backyard rules
The race takes place on the grounds of the Military University of Technology’s training area in Warsaw
A 24-hour time limit (24 loops)
additional: The participant limit is 80, with the possibility of an increase by the organizer. The winner receives a cash prize, a trophy, and prizes from partners. The winner of the Polish Uniformed Services Open Championships receives a trophy and prizes. The best resident of the Bemowo district receives a statuette and prizes. All participants receive a medal and certificate. The participant limit is 80, with the possibility of an increase. All participants receive a medal and certificate. The registration and fee information provided relates to the October 2026 Warszawa - Bemowo edition; it does not confirm details of the edition on 9 January 2027.

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including Wrocław in Osobowicki Forest. The events combine recreation and sport, promote physical activity outdoors, and offer the chance to compete in a friendly atmosphere. The series runs from October to April, and each race starts at 11:00. Participants can enter individually or buy a season pass for the entire series in their city.
course_highlights: The course runs through Osobowicki Forest, a natural woodland area
A 5 km cross-country route through an urban forest
The race is part of a four-event series in the 2026/2027 season
additional: The race office opens at 8:30, and race numbers and chips can be collected on race day. The schedule is the same for all locations. Participants can buy a pass for the entire series or enter individual races. The entry fee is higher on race day. A charity entry option is available, supporting the Siepomaga Foundation. There is no participant limit. The main race starts at 11:00, and the event ends at around 12:15. Cars cannot access the area near the start and race office; parking along Osobowicka Street is subject to traffic staff instructions. The official website’s schedule lists the Wrocław races in the 2026/2027 season on October 24, December 5, February 13, and March 13, so it does not confirm the date January 9, 2027.

description: The Dziewicza Góra Grand Prix Mountain Running Series consists of six races on a scenic course in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park. The route follows a 5.15 km loop through forest, climbing the highest hill, Dziewicza Góra, twice. The races bring together runners of different ages and abilities across various distances, and also offer Nordic walking and races for children and young people. The organizers provide professional timing and a welcoming atmosphere, creating a unique “Dziewicza Family.”
course_highlights: A 5.15 km loop through the forest
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra
The course passes through the event centre, where spectators can cheer on participants
additional: Electronic timing using an ankle-mounted chip band. Race office open from 8:15 to 10:30. Participant limit: 500. The races are held as a series of six stages. Children’s and youth races over 200 m, 500 m, 1,000 m and 1,500 m. The course is marked with orange ribbons and directional arrows. Participants in the 10 km race complete two loops; after the first loop, they cross the finish line and continue onto the second loop. The 2026–2027 season consists of six stages; passes for the whole series were also available.

name: Viva Las Natalin
description: Viva Las Natalin is the 3rd Carnival Run, held in the picturesque forests of Natalin and attracting running and Nordic walking enthusiasts from across the Mazovia region. The event takes place in a wintry setting, and participants start in colorful costumes, creating a unique, lively atmosphere. It is organized by the “Z Biegiem Dwóch Rzek” Association in cooperation with Wyszków Municipality, WOSiR, and the Wyszków Forest District. The event offers several distances, including 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as 5 km Nordic walking, with separate classifications for women and men.
course_highlights: The route runs through the forests of Natalin
Picturesque winter scenery
Carnival atmosphere with participants in colorful costumes
additional: The event is organized by the “Z Biegiem Dwóch Rzek” Association in cooperation with Wyszków Municipality, WOSiR, and the Wyszków Forest District. Participants can take part in 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as 5 km Nordic walking. Prizes are presented by the authorities of Wyszków Municipality. The event has a carnival theme, with participants wearing colorful costumes.

name: Zimowa Strzyżewska Piątka
description: Zimowa Strzyżewska Piątka is a 10 km race held in Strzyżewo on January 9, 2027. The event has a winter theme and takes place at the Strzyżewo 46A football pitch. It is organized by the Powiatowe Centrum Sportu w Nowym Tomyślu together with local partners, and attracts both recreational and more experienced runners.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Winter weather and running conditions
Start and finish at the Strzyżewo 46A football pitch
additional: The race office and start are at the Strzyżewo 46A football pitch. Participant registration is open from 8:00 to 8:45. The event is organized by local sports and community institutions.

description: The Kraków Mountain Running Grand Prix is a series of mountain races held in Kraków’s scenic terrain. Participants can choose from a variety of distances, from short children’s races to challenging mountain routes, including the Vertical. The event attracts both recreational and experienced runners, offering exciting competition and beautiful views. The organizers ensure professional race management and a rich program of additional events, including team classifications and relays. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and take on a sporting challenge.
course_highlights: Routes of varying lengths: 3.7 km, 5.7 km, 11.6 km, 23.2 km, and the 1.5 km Vertical
Scenic mountain terrain in Kraków with varied courses
Special races for children, as well as team competitions and relays
additional: Races start at various times on Sunday, including 9:00 (Harda Dwudziestka Trójka), 9:10 and 9:20 (children’s races), 9:40 (Przyjazna Trójka), 10:45 (Tradycyjna Piątka), and 11:00 (Ambitna Jedenastka). The Vertical GPK competition takes place on Saturday from 10:00 to 12:00. Team classifications, relays, and additional competitions such as GPK4Business and Iron GPK are also organized. The series also includes races for children. The date given falls on the 15th edition of the New Year’s Run, although the event name indicates the 14th Kraków Grand Prix.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Zajazd Szmaragd, ul. Kopalniana, Szczecin, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Szczecin. The Szczecin course runs through beautiful woodland around Emerald Lake, with the start and finish behind the Szmaragd Inn. The race is open to participants aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with parental permission. The event aims to promote running and outdoor physical activity, and to offer the opportunity to compete on a permanent course.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Emerald Lake
Start and finish behind the Szmaragd Inn at ul. Kopalniana
Varied course profile with uphill and downhill sections
additional: The race office opens at 8:30; race bibs and chips can be collected on race day. Participants can purchase a pass for the entire series or enter a single race. The pass allows one free start in another city, provided the participant registers by email in advance. There is no participant limit. The main race starts at 11:00, with a group warm-up at 10:45. The race-day entry fee is higher (60 zł). The start is at 11:00. Registration is available online through the CITY TRAIL website or at the race office on race day.

name: XVIII Jelczańsko-Oławski Zimowy Maraton
location: Chwałowice, Oława County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 19th Jelczańsko-Oławski Toyota Winter Stage Marathon is a winter running event held in Chwałowice and nearby towns. It consists of seven stages, each approximately 7 km long, held on Sundays from January to February 2027. The event includes both running and Nordic walking. Race packs can be collected the day before the first stage. The organizers provide a mass start for all categories and allow race bibs to be collected by an authorized person.
course_highlights: Seven stages, each approximately 7 km long
The route passes through Chwałowice, Oława, Jelcz-Laskowice, Janików and Miłoszyce
A mass start for runners and Nordic walkers
additional: The race office will be open on 09.01.2027 in Oława (Termy Jakuba) from 17:00 to 18:00 and in Jelcz-Laskowice (City Hall) from 19:00 to 20:00. On race day, race packs can be collected from 9:00 to 10:30 before the first stage, and from 10:00 to 10:30 before subsequent stages. Race bibs may be collected by an authorized person with a printed and signed form. The joint start for the run and Nordic walking is scheduled for 11:00. Race packs can be collected on the day of each stage at the start location from 9:00 to 10:30.

description: The 13th Winter Run, held as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP), will take place on 10 January 2027 in Krajkowo at the Riding Center IDMAR. The main race, approximately 10 km long, starts at 12:00. There will also be races for children and young people over various shorter distances. The start, finish and race village are located inside the hall, ensuring comfortable conditions whatever the weather. A public collection will be held in support of WOŚP, and challenges and competitions will be organised for spectators, so there will be something for everyone.
course_highlights: Main race: approximately 10 km
Start and finish inside the Riding Center IDMAR hall in Krajkowo
Races for children and young people over distances from 150 m to 1,000 m
additional: Race Office opening hours: 8 January 2027 in Mosina (17:00–20:00) and 10 January 2027 in Krajkowo (09:30–11:55). The start, finish and race village are inside the hall. Participants can support WOŚP with voluntary donations when collecting their race packs. Challenges and competitions for spectators will also be organised, along with the HARPAGANA challenge. The main race starts at 12:00. The event includes a collection for WOŚP.

name: 9 Świdnicki Bieg Noworoczny Zupbadura
description: The 9th Świdnicki Bieg Noworoczny Zupbadura is an annual running event organized by the Świdnicka Grupa Biegowa Association. The race takes place in Świdnica, with the start and finish at Zawiszów Sports Hall. It is a New Year’s race that attracts runners of varying ability levels, who train from the time they register until race day. The event takes place in a friendly atmosphere, promoting physical activity and bringing the local community together.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Zawiszów Sports Hall, ul. Galla Anonim 1, Świdnica
The race takes place in central Świdnica
Training from registration until race day is taken into account
additional: The race office is open at Zawiszów Sports Hall on race day from 8:00 to 11:30. Training from registration until race day is taken into account. The race office and race-pack collection were at Zawiszów Sports Hall, ul. Galla Anonima 1; on race day, they were open from 8:00 to 11:30.

name: Bieg do Herbacianego Domku #332
description: Tea with Tadek, or the Run to the Tea House, is a social run held in Bródno Park in Warsaw. The event attracts runners who want to spend time actively outdoors in a friendly atmosphere. The run is recreational and brings people together, encouraging socializing and having fun with fellow running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The route passes through scenic Bródno Park
A social, recreational run
An atmosphere that encourages socializing and having fun
additional: The run takes place in Bródno Park in Warsaw. The event is social and recreational, with no details provided about distances, start waves, or entry fees.

name: Bieszczadzki Bieg Lotników
location: Trasy biegowe im. Stanisława Nahajowskiego, Ustjanowa Górna, Poland
description: The Bieszczady Aviators’ Run is an annual race held on the Stanisław Nahajowski cross-country trails in Ustjanowa Górna. The event attracts runners seeking mountain challenges and beautiful views. The Górskie Loty half-marathon course is demanding, with significant elevation gain, making the race an unforgettable experience for participants. The race has a long tradition and is an important sporting event in the Bieszczady region.
course_highlights: The 21 km Górskie Loty half-marathon course
Mountain elevation gain and steep sections
Beautiful views of the Bieszczady Mountains
additional: The race takes place on the Stanisław Nahajowski cross-country trails in Ustjanowa. The half-marathon course is new for 2025 and features significant elevation gain. The event is held under the patronage and with the support of the Regional Directorate of State Forests in Krosno. In the past, summer and winter editions have been held, as well as Nordic walking events. The available information relates to previous editions; details of the edition scheduled for 10 January 2027 are not provided.

name: Górski Bieg Nawoja
location: Nawojowa Góra, Krzeszowice, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Górski Bieg Nawoja is a mountain race held in Nawojowa Góra, showcasing the natural attractions and surroundings of Górzanka. The race takes place on 3 km and 7 km courses marked with arrows and tape, with distance-to-finish markers. The event is held regularly and is supported by local institutions and sponsors. Participants can use the on-site refreshment point, changing rooms, and toilets.
course_highlights: Mountain courses of 3 km and 7 km
Marked with arrows and white-and-red tape on more difficult sections
Distance-to-finish markers every kilometre
additional: Race office located at the LKS Górzanka sports field in Nawojowa Góra, with parking for participants. Changing rooms, toilets, and a refreshment point are available at the office. Race materials will be distributed from 10:00 to 10:50. The 7 km race starts at 11:00 and the 3 km race at 11:01. The race ends at 12:30.

name: VII Żniński Bieg Powstańczy
description: The 7th Żnin Insurrectionist Run is a 5 km race taking place on January 11, 2026, in Żnin. The course is flat and paved, with one small incline and a turnaround halfway through the distance. The start and finish are on Szkolna Street, near the tennis court. The race is organized by the Jedynka Association and has a participant limit of 200.
course_highlights: 5 km course with GPS tracking
Flat paved course with one small incline
Turnaround 2.5 km from the start
additional: The participant limit is 200. The start and finish are on Szkolna Street in Żnin, near the tennis court (property no. 14). The payment reference must include the runner’s first name, last name, and year of birth.

name: X Zimowe Grand Prix Zadyszki
location: ul. Kamieniec, near the animal shelter, Oświęcim, Poland
description: The X Zadyszka Winter Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Oświęcim Running Club “Zadyszka,” which promotes running as part of a healthy, active lifestyle. The club brings together recreational runners who value community and the joy of movement, regardless of their experience level. The events take place in the scenic surroundings of Oświęcim, where participants can expect a welcoming atmosphere and support from the local running community. The club also organizes social gatherings and events that help build a strong running community.
course_highlights: Routes in the area of Kamieniec Street, near the animal shelter in Oświęcim
Scenic surroundings ideal for recreation and active leisure
A sense of community and support among local runners
additional: The club holds meetings on the first Wednesday of each month at 17:00 at MOSiR, ul. Legionów 15, Oświęcim. An up-to-date events calendar is available on the website. The club promotes recreational running and brings the local running community together. For the 2025/2026 edition, race-day registration was open from 10:00 to 10:45, and races began at 11:00. These details have not been confirmed for the date of 10 January 2027.

name: XIII Bieg Zimowego Dziadka
description: The 13th Winter Grandpa Run is a friendly 10 km race held on the Kuchary Forest District running route. The route is fully marked and has restricted vehicle traffic, helping ensure participants’ safety. The time limit is 90 minutes. The event begins with a warm-up, followed by an awards ceremony and refreshments for participants after the race.
course_highlights: Kuchary Forest District running route
Fully marked 10 km course
Restricted vehicle traffic on the route
additional: Registration takes place from 10:00 to 10:30 on race day. There is a warm-up before the 10:30 start. The participant limit is 120. The awards ceremony and refreshments take place after the race, at around 12:30. Information available for the 13th edition relates to the race held on 11 January 2026; the entry fee was PLN 40 during registration and PLN 50 on the day of the event, and the participant limit was 120. It has not been confirmed whether these conditions will apply in 2027.

name: Zimowa Piątka
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Suwałkach
description: Zimowa Piątka is an annual race organized by the Suwałki Sports and Recreation Centre, held by Arkadia Reservoir. It is a unique opportunity to kick off the winter season with an active outing in the picturesque surroundings of Suwałki, known for its harsh climate and beautiful landscapes. The event attracts both recreational and experienced runners, promoting a healthy lifestyle and sporting competition among residents and visitors. For years, OSiR Suwałki has ensured the professional organization of sporting events, providing participants with comfort and safety.
course_highlights: The race route follows a picturesque course around Arkadia Reservoir
The winter scenery of Suwałki, with its characteristic cold climate
A well-prepared and marked route suited to runners of different abilities
additional: In previous editions, the race was part of Stacja Pogodne Suwałki, whose program also included a Nordic walking event and a children's race. Participants in Zimowa Piątka could take part in carnival costumes.

name: Zimowy Bieg Niedzwiedzia
location: Nowy Dębiec, Kościan County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Kościanie
description: The Winter Bear Run in Nowy Dębiec is an annual running event organized by the Kościan Municipality Sports and Recreation Centre. The race takes place at the holiday resort in Nowy Dębiec, offering participants the opportunity to compete in a scenic setting. The event is part of the Kościan Municipality Running Grand Prix, promoting active recreation and bringing the local community together.
course_highlights: The route runs through the holiday resort in Nowy Dębiec
Scenic areas by the lake
Organized as part of the Kościan Municipality Running Grand Prix
additional: The event is organized by the Kościan Municipality Sports and Recreation Centre. The race is part of the Kościan Municipality Running Grand Prix series. The resort has a swimming area, a beach and sports courts in Nowy Dębiec. Information about distances and routes is from the 2026 edition; details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Zimowy Maraton Świętokrzyski
description: The Świętokrzyski Winter Marathon is a mountain challenge held in the heart of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains, in the town of Chęciny. The event brings together runs, hikes and run-walks, giving participants the opportunity to discover the region’s beautiful, scenic landscapes. For years, the organizers have promoted outdoor activity and mountain tourism by creating and restoring hiking trails. This event is for those who enjoy long-distance challenges and being close to nature.
course_highlights: Mountain routes in the heart of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains
Scenic landscapes and natural hiking trails
Routes suitable for running, hiking and run-walks
additional: The organizers also restore and promote hiking trails in the region. The event is part of a broader range of outdoor activities in the Świętokrzyskie Mountains. Aid and checkpoint stations are available to participants, as is the option to download a GPX file with the routes. The event is aimed at runners and hikers taking on challenging winter conditions.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in beautiful, wooded settings in city parks, including Młociński Park in Warsaw. The races are open to participants aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with the required permission. The event is recreational and competitive in nature, promoting outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The start and finish in Warsaw are in Młociny Forest, and the course stays the same, allowing results to be compared over the years.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the wooded setting of Młociński Park
The start is about 1.5 km from the finish, which is on a clearing in Młociny Forest
The course is suitable for both beginner and experienced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. In Warsaw, the warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place at 10:30. The course stays the same throughout the season. Parking nearby is limited, so using public transport is recommended. Register online at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day. A pass for four races at one location is also available.

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Górskich
XI Eko Cross po Ziemi Pietrowickiej
Gdynia ULTRA WAY - Winter Race Stary Wilk
description: Gdynia ULTRA WAY - Winter Race is a winter running festival held in Gdynia, offering six distances from 5 km to over 76 km. The courses pass through scenic areas with significant elevation gains, combining sporting competition with natural beauty and a unique atmosphere. The event is organized by the ULTRA WAY Foundation and features courses with checkpoints and aid stations, as well as professional timing and participant safety measures. It is an event for runners of varying experience levels who want to take on challenging courses and winter conditions.
course_highlights: Nocny Jeleń course – 76.6 km with +2309 m / -2313 m elevation change
Tropem Rysia course – 50 km with +1501 m / -1575 m elevation change
Courses with checkpoints and aid stations, and professional chip timing
additional: The start and finish of all races are located at the Gdynia Sports Centre – National Rugby Stadium, ul. Kazimierza Górskiego 10. Buses take participants to the start of the longest distances from outside the Gdynia Sports Centre (paid transport; advance registration required). The time limit for completing the longest distance is 15 hours, and for the 50 km distance it is 11 hours. The DZIKI DUET race is run in pairs. Aid and hydration stations are available on the course (except on the shortest distances). The race has an ITRA 4 classification, UTMB 100K status, and 3 Mountain points.

name: 17 Chrustowski Bieg Zimowy
location: Szkoła Podstawowa im. Bronisława Malinowskiego, Chrustowo, Gmina Oborniki, Poland
description: The Chrustowo Winter Run is the oldest running event in the Oborniki municipality, organized since 2007. The 12 km main race passes through the picturesque villages of Chrustowo, Żukowo, Górka, and Ślepuchowo, while accompanying races for primary school pupils take place on routes adapted to their age. The event promotes physical activity and community spirit, and every participant receives a commemorative medal and a recovery meal. The organizers also provide prizes for the top finishers in the OPEN and age categories.
course_highlights: The 12 km main race route passes through Chrustowo, Żukowo, Górka, and Ślepuchowo
Accompanying races for children and young people on routes adapted to their age categories
Picturesque surroundings and a winter atmosphere make for an active start to the year
additional: The main race is limited to 200 participants. The race pack includes a commemorative medal, a recovery meal, a doughnut, and water. The top finishers receive statuettes or trophies. The accompanying children’s races start at 11:05, immediately after the main race begins. In the 2026 edition, the main race was scheduled to start at the Bronisław Malinowski Primary School in Chrustowo; the limit was 200 participants. The race pack included a medal, a recovery meal, a doughnut, and water. This information refers to the previous edition.

name: Botaniczna Piątka
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Łodzi, Łódź, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka is a series of cross-country races organized since 2014 by a group of running enthusiasts. The events take place in scenic locations, with a particular focus on the visual appeal of the courses, often in botanical gardens and green spaces. The Łódź race is held in the Botanical Garden, offering participants a unique experience surrounded by nature. The organizers promote running and create a welcoming atmosphere for runners of different ability levels.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Botanical Garden in Łódź
Scenic, attractive green surroundings
Courses suited to runners of different ability levels
additional: The organizer is Stowarzyszenie Biegiem w Las from Poznań. The events are cross-country races held in various locations in Wielkopolska and other cities. In summer 2026, Botaniczna Piątka celebrates its 10th anniversary. The organizers encourage people to sign up for the newsletter to stay up to date with events. The Łódź editions also include children's races. The cited sources concern previous editions and do not confirm details of the event on January 16, 2027.

description: Dziki w Ogniu & Firemaster’s Relay is a winter cross-country race held in Spręcowo, in the Dywity municipality. The approximately 6 km course runs entirely along forest roads and tracks. It is highly challenging, with numerous climbs and natural terrain obstacles. The event includes an individual race and relays for members of volunteer and state fire services (OSP/PSP). The start and finish are by the OSP fire station in Spręcowo. The races take place in January and are recreational and sporting in nature, with manual timekeeping and a commemorative medal for participants.
course_highlights: An approximately 6 km course running entirely along forest roads and tracks
A challenging cross-country course with numerous climbs and natural obstacles
Start and finish by the OSP fire station in Spręcowo
additional: Race office open from 9:00 to 10:30 by the OSP fire station in Spręcowo. The individual race is limited to 100 participants, with additional on-site registration available for 20 runners. Timekeeping is manual; start chips must be returned at the finish. Proceeds from additional registrations support the 34th WOŚP Grand Finale. Information about the distance, course and fees comes from the 2026 edition and may differ from the conditions for the 2027 edition. In previous editions, the relay was for teams of six firefighters.

description: Run in Sopot - Stage 1 is the first race in the #RUNinSOPOT 2026 series, taking place on January 17, 2026, on Sopot beach. It’s a unique opportunity to tackle a course on the seaside sand and experience the atmosphere of a sporting celebration in one of the most beautiful resorts on the Baltic Sea. The race series also includes further editions on the beach and a race near the Forest Opera, with participants competing for cash prizes in the overall standings. The organizers invite both recreational and experienced runners to take part in this modern, dynamic running event.
course_highlights: Course on Sopot beach
A race in a seaside resort with a unique microclimate
Overall standings competition with cash prizes
additional: The #RUNinSOPOT 2026 series includes four races: three on the beach and one near the Forest Opera. Participants compete in the overall standings for cash prizes. Sopot residents can receive a discount on the entry fee by using the Sopot Card.

name: WOŚPowa 5
description: WOŚPowa 5 is a 5 km race held in the picturesque town of Dąbki during the Grand Finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP). The start and finish are at the Water Sports Centre. The event combines sporting competition with a good cause, encouraging participants to support WOŚP through voluntary donations. Shorter races of 200, 400 and 800 metres are planned for children, making the event appealing to the whole family. Everyone is welcome to take part and celebrate sport and helping others together.
course_highlights: Main 5 km race starting and finishing at the Water Sports Centre
Children’s races over 200 m, 400 m and 800 m
Picturesque route in the spa town of Dąbki
additional: The entry fee is a voluntary donation to the WOŚP collection box. The event takes place during the WOŚP Grand Finale, combining sport with charitable support. Shorter races over 200, 400 and 800 metres are planned for children. The start and finish are at the Water Sports Centre in Dąbki. In the previous edition, the donations collected were given to the 33rd WOŚP Grand Finale. Details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed in the available sources.

location: Nowy Targ Airport, Nowy Targ, Poland
