description: Valentine’s Day Run - Grand Prix of the Tri-City 2/3 - Run in Sopot II is a cross-country race held on the beach in Sopot, starting by the pier. Participants run towards Gdańsk and back, enjoying scenic coastal views. The event is part of the Winter Grand Prix of Cross-Country Races in Sopot and includes age categories for runners and Nordic walking. The race office is located in the concert shell at Skwer Kuracyjny, and the race is scheduled to start at 10:00.
course_highlights: Cross-country beach route with sea views
Start and finish by the pier in Sopot
Run towards Gdańsk and back
additional: The participant limit is 600. The race office is located in the concert shell at Skwer Kuracyjny, before the entrance to the pier. The Nordic walking start is 5 minutes after the race start. The event is part of the Winter Grand Prix of Cross-Country Races in Sopot. Information about the distance, fees, and schedule from the previous edition may not apply in 2027.

name: Bieg Zdobywców Modyni
description: The Bieg Zdobywców Modyni is an annual mountain race held in the Beskid Wyspowy, attracting runners from across Poland and Europe. The event offers a range of running and Nordic walking courses for different ability levels, as well as children’s races. It combines sporting competition with a family-friendly atmosphere and promotes the scenic Modyń mountain and the Beskid Wyspowy region. The organizers support local community engagement and an active lifestyle, and also offer additional activities and attractions for participants.
course_highlights: Mountain courses of 8.5 km and 17 km through the scenic Beskid Wyspowy
The longest course is 36 km and has ITRA certification (Bieg 6 Szczytów)
Courses are available as GPS files
additional: The event features races for adults and children, Nordic walking, and additional family attractions, such as sweets dropped from a light aircraft and sensory activities for children. The organizers provide GPS files for the courses. The Bieg 6 Szczytów (36 km) is certified by ITRA and included in the international trail-running rankings.

name: Wrocławska Dycha
description: Wrocławska Dycha is an annual running event held in Wrocław, offering 5 km and 10 km distances. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, with an appealing route through the urban surroundings. The event is open and welcoming to participants, promoting an active lifestyle and sporting competition in the heart of the city.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances
Urban route in Wrocław
A race for recreational and experienced runners

name: XVI Bieg Górski
description: The 16th Leszno–Grzybowo Mountain Run is a forest trail race organized by the “Aktywna Trz” Physical Culture Association. The race takes place in the scenic area around Leszno and Grzybowo, offering participants a demanding route through forest terrain. The event is held regularly and is popular with mountain runners. It is a great opportunity to test your abilities on natural trails and spend time outdoors.
course_highlights: A forest route with a mountain-running character
Scenic areas around Leszno and Grzybowo
A demanding race through natural terrain
additional: The edition scheduled for 13 February 2027 is listed as the 17th Leszno–Grzybowo Mountain Run; the 16th edition took place on 14 February 2026.

name: XXVI Bieg Grzmią Pod Stoczkiem Armaty
description: The 26th “The Cannons Thunder at Stoczek” Race is an annual road race held in Stoczek Łukowski. The event attracts runners from various regions, offering a unique atmosphere and sporting excitement. The route passes through the town’s scenic areas, bringing together elements of history and local culture. The organizers ensure professional event management and participant safety.
course_highlights: Road race route through the center of Stoczek Łukowski
Scenic views and historic sites along the route
A local community atmosphere and a celebration of sport
additional: Available sources describe the 26th edition, which took place on February 14, 2026; they do not confirm an event scheduled for February 13, 2027.

name: Zimowy Bieg Piasta
description: The Piast Winter Run is an annual winter race, now in its 22nd edition, organized by WKB Piast Wrocław and held in Miękinia. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in a friendly atmosphere, welcoming both fast and more leisurely runners. Participants can also take part in the Valentine’s Day distance, giving the event a special character and encouraging people to celebrate Valentine’s Day together. The race takes place on routes near the Oder, and the organizers focus on fun and bringing runners together.
course_highlights: A winter route around Miękinia and along the Oder embankments
A welcoming atmosphere for both fast and recreational runners
A special Valentine’s Day distance for couples and loved ones
additional: Participants are encouraged to dress up for Valentine’s Day. Runners can take part in the Valentine’s Day distance with a partner. The race is held in changeable winter weather, and the route may sometimes be changed due to terrain conditions. Volunteers and sponsors support the event. Previous editions have also featured a Valentine’s Day distance. The race calendar gives an approximate date of February 14 for 2027, which differs from the stated date of February 13.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in beautiful woodland settings. In Katowice, the course runs through the State Forests of the Katowice Forest District, with the start about 700 meters from the finish near the “Rybaczówka” center by Janina Pond. The event is open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can regularly compare their results on the same course. The event promotes outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, with races held throughout the 2026/2027 season.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the woodland of the State Forests’ Katowice Forest District
The start is about 700 m from the finish, near the “Rybaczówka” center by Janina Pond
The course is suitable for both beginner and advanced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30, and the main race starts at 11:00. It is not possible to drive directly to the start; parking is available on Karolinki Street, about 1 km from the race office. The course remains the same, allowing runners to compare results over the months and years. The event also includes races for children in different age categories. Katowice series dates for the 2026/2027 season: October 25, 2026; December 6, 2026; February 14, 2027; and March 14, 2027.

name: XVIII Jelczańsko-Oławski Zimowy Maraton
description: The 19th Jelczańsko-Oławski Toyota Winter Marathon in Stages is a series of seven races, each 7.033 km long, held in different towns in the region, including Janików. The event combines running and Nordic walking in a winter setting, and participants can collect their race packs the day before the first stage. The organizers provide electronic timing and allow authorized persons to collect race numbers. The staged format offers competition and fun throughout February 2027.
course_highlights: Seven stages, each 7.033 km long
Routes pass through Chwałowice, Oława, Jelcz-Laskowice, Janików, and Miłoszyce
Nordic walking and running start together, with the running races starting at 11:00
additional: Race packs can be collected the day before the first stage at Termy Jakuba in Oława and at the Jelcz-Laskowice Municipal and District Office. The organizer allows an authorized person to collect a race pack with a signed form. Nordic walking starts at 10:30 and running races at 11:00. On race day, the race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30 (or from 10:00 starting with the second stage). The Nordic walking start is scheduled for 10:30 and the running race for 11:00.

name: 10 Krakowski Bieg Walentynkowy
location: Błonia Krakowskie and Park Jordana, Kraków, Poland
description: The Kraków Valentine’s Run is Poland’s largest running event dedicated to everyone in love, including couples, married couples, and singles. The 5 km course runs through the heart of Kraków, including the scenic paths of Jordan Park, laid out in the shape of a heart. Participants receive a race pack with a bib and timing chip, as well as a unique item bearing the slogan “all you need is RUN!”. After the run, they can enjoy a traditional wuzetka cake and a commemorative medal designed especially for the occasion. The run is a great opportunity to celebrate Valentine’s Day actively and connect with fellow runners.
course_highlights: A heart-shaped course in Jordan Park, Kraków
Scenic lanes and paths in the heart of the city
Run in pairs, with a category for singles called “Up for grabs”
additional: The race pack includes a race bib with a chip and a unique item bearing the slogan “all you need is RUN!”. After the run, participants receive a traditional wuzetka cake and a commemorative medal. The run is held in pairs or in the singles category “Up for grabs”. In the previous edition, the race pack included a race bib with a chip and an item, and participants received a medal and a sweet treat after the run. Details of the 2027 edition are not confirmed in the sources provided.

name: 13. Walentynkowy Bieg pod Najstarszą Sosną
description: The Valentine’s Run by the Oldest Pine is a special running event held in Mińsk Mazowiecki. It is not a race, but a run for people who love running and want to spend time actively and celebrate their passion for sport. The atmosphere is friendly and full of positive energy, and participants run for the love of movement and nature.
course_highlights: The run takes place near the Oldest Pine in Poland.
The event is recreational, with no emphasis on competition.
The Valentine’s Day timing gives the gathering a special atmosphere.

name: Bieg Walentynkowy
description: The Valentine’s Day Run, organized by Radio Wrocław, is an annual running event held in Skowroni Park in Wrocław. It’s a great opportunity to fall in love with running and enjoy an active day in a pleasant atmosphere. The event is open to runners of different ages and abilities, promoting a healthy lifestyle and shared sporting experiences.
course_highlights: A route through scenic Skowroni Park in Wrocław
A welcoming atmosphere for recreational runners and families
Organized by Radio Wrocław, with a long-running tradition
additional: The Valentine’s Day Run takes place in Skowroni Park and is organized by Radio Wrocław. The website offers expert advice on preparing for the run and information about other runs organized by Radio Wrocław. No detailed information is available about entry fees or the start time. Previous editions have included a contest for the most creative Valentine’s Day costume. Distances, fees, and rules for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Botaniczna Piątka
location: Ogród Dendrologiczny w Przelewicach, Przelewice, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice is the winter edition of a popular cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts from Wielkopolska. The event takes place in the picturesque Przelewice Dendrological Garden, where participants can enjoy the beauty of nature and the scenic course. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on promoting cross-country running and exceptional locations, offering runners unforgettable sporting experiences. The event attracts both recreational and more experienced runners who want to spend time actively in a winter setting.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Przelewice Dendrological Garden
Picturesque natural surroundings
Winter race edition with a unique atmosphere
additional: Registration for the main distance and children’s race has closed. The organizers emphasize the scenic appeal of the locations they choose and the promotion of cross-country running. The 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka is planned for summer 2026. The previous edition featured a main distance and children’s races.

name: Górski Bieg Nawoja
location: Nawojowa Góra, Krzeszowice, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Górski Bieg Nawoja is a mountain race held in Nawojowa Góra, showcasing the terrain of Górzanka and its surroundings. The course is marked with arrows and tape, with distance markers to the finish every kilometre. The event is held regularly and attracts runners who enjoy mountain challenges and beautiful scenery. The race office is located at the LKS Górzanka sports field, where changing rooms, restrooms and a refreshment point are available.
course_highlights: Mountain course with markers every kilometre
Marked with arrows and red-and-white tape on more difficult sections
Start and finish near the LKS Górzanka sports field
additional: The race office is open from 10:00 to 10:50 at the LKS Górzanka sports field. The 7 km race starts at 11:00, and the 3 km race starts at 11:01. Participant parking is available by the sports field. The race concludes at 12:30. There is a refreshment point on the course, along with distance markers to the finish.

name: Pięćsetny Maraton Drago Boroji
description: The Five Hundredth Marathon of Drago Boroji and the Hundredth Marathon of Piotr Kopec is a special running event held in Tychy. The marathon is organized by Piotr and Drago together with the 40-latek Running Club, offering participants a premium sporting experience. The event combines athletic competition with a rich program of discussions and workshops about running, led by well-known experts and athletes. It is an excellent opportunity for amateur and professional runners to develop their skills and enjoy the race atmosphere.
course_highlights: Road race in Tychy
Marathon distance
The calendar also lists distances of 35, 28, and 21 km
additional: The event includes lectures, workshops, and panel discussions about different forms of running, led by experts and well-known athletes. The program includes, among other things, an opening panel, an expert debate, and a warm-up with athletics stars.

name: Turbacz Winter Trail
description: Turbacz Winter Trail is a winter mountain race held in the magical Gorce Mountains, offering seven different distances so every participant can find a suitable route. The event takes place on 13–14 February 2027 in Nowy Targ, with the start and finish at the Kowaniec municipal car park, and in Waksmund for selected distances. The race is known for challenging winter conditions, beautiful views and a unique atmosphere. Participants receive unique medals and a generous race pack. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Ministry of Sport and Tourism and is an important event in the Mountain Running League.
course_highlights: Routes through the Gorce Mountains in winter conditions, with beautiful views
Start and finish in Nowy Targ and Waksmund
Seven distances with varying levels of difficulty
additional: The start and finish for the 12, 22 and 48 km distances are at the Kowaniec municipal car park in Nowy Targ. The Turbaczowe Love distance starts at the Primary School in Waksmund, with transport to the start provided. Participants receive a personalized race bib, electronic timekeeping, a commemorative medal and a generous race pack. Refreshment points are available along the route, depending on the distance. Participants can choose from various race formats, including Mizuno Nocna zaDycha, Zimna Połówka, Bez Barier, TWT na 6 Łap and AK-47. The organizer reserves the right to possible discrepancies in route elevation measurements. The 2027 edition is scheduled for 13–14 February; details of the distances and routes may be finalized by the organizer.

name: X Zimowe Grand Prix Zadyszki
location: ul. Kamieniec, near the animal shelter, Oświęcim, Poland
description: The X Zadyszka Winter Grand Prix is a series of winter road races organized by the Oświęcim Running Club “Zadyszka.” The races cover a distance of 7 km in the area of Kamieniec Street, next to the animal shelter in Oświęcim. It is one of the most popular winter running events in the Oświęcim region, attracting both local competitors and runners from across Małopolska. Registration is available only on race day, and each race is scheduled to start at 11:00.
course_highlights: 7 km road race
Course in the area of Kamieniec Street, next to the animal shelter
Popular winter running event in the Oświęcim region
additional: Participant registration is available only on race day from 10:00 to 10:45. In the previous edition, registration was available only on race day, from 10:00 to 10:45, and the start was scheduled for 11:00. Details for this edition may differ.

name: XI Oleszyce Trail Półmaraton
description: The XI Oleszyce Trail Half Marathon is a winter running event held in the picturesque forests of the Oleszyce Forest District. The 21.09 km half-marathon course follows challenging forest trails with natural obstacles and varied terrain, making it a true test for participants. The event is organised by the Czas na Las Association, which has promoted sport, recreation and environmental protection for years. Alongside the race, there is a Nordic Walking event of approximately 9 km, and all participants receive race packs and commemorative medals.
course_highlights: The route runs through the forests of the Oleszyce Forest District, with natural obstacles and challenging terrain
Passes through the historic grounds of the former village of Miłków, including a replica cottage and the Miłkowskie Ponds
The winter setting and forest trails create a distinctive atmosphere and a challenge for runners
additional: Participants receive race packs and medals. The Nordic Walking route is approximately 8.92 km and calls for maintaining rhythm and technique on slippery sections. The event is organised in close cooperation with the Oleszyce Forest District and local authorities. The forest trails are available to athletes throughout the year as a natural training space. The date of 15 February 2027 is marked as tentative in the running calendar; available sources do not confirm 14 February 2027.

name: XIX Grand Prix Tychów w Biegach Długodystansowych
organizer: MOSiR Tychy i Stowarzyszenie Promocji Lekkiej Atletyki w Tychach
price_range: 30 zł za bieg; 150 zł za cały cykl

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa - płatna w dniu imprezy

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Opłata startowa za 6 biegów - płatna przed pierwszym biegiem

description: The 19th Tychy Grand Prix is a series of long-distance races organized in Tychy by the Athletics Promotion Association. Six races are scheduled for the 2026 season, taking place from February to December. The event includes women’s and men’s classifications over 5 km and 10 km. The entry fee can be paid on the day of the event or in advance for the entire series.
course_highlights: Races over 5 km and 10 km
A series of six races held throughout the year
Separate classifications for women and men
additional: Classifications after three races for women and men over 5 km and 10 km. The fee for the entire race series must be paid before the first race. The 2026 schedule includes six races. The series consists of six races. Participants who complete at least four receive a commemorative gift.

name: Zamieć 24h
description: ZAMIEĆ 2027 is an extreme winter mountain ultramarathon held in the Beskids, starting and finishing at the Amphitheatre in Szczyrk. Participants take on a demanding route leading to the summit of Skrzyczne (1,257 m above sea level), completing it repeatedly over 6, 12 or 24 hours. It is a solitary battle against the winter elements—snow, wind and frost—and their own limits. The event attracts an elite community of runners ready for extreme challenges in the mountains.
course_highlights: A 14.12 km route with significant elevation gain to Skrzyczne (1,257 m above sea level)
Start and finish at the Amphitheatre in Szczyrk
Warm refreshment points along the route, including at the highest point
additional: All distances take place simultaneously. Participants receive a commemorative medal and accident insurance. Warm refreshment points are available along the route. Places are limited. The 2027 edition is scheduled for 22–23 January; in the previous edition, the start and event location were associated with the amphitheatre in Szczyrk.

name: 41 Bieg Gąsieniców
location: COS OPO, pod Średnią Krokwią, Zakopane, Poland
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Zakopanem
description: The 41st Gąsieniców National Run is an annual running event organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Zakopane. The competition takes place at COS OPO beneath Średnia Krokiew, offering participants a unique sporting atmosphere amid the picturesque Tatra Mountains. The race attracts both recreational and experienced runners looking to take on a challenging winter course. It is a great opportunity to enjoy an active day and compete in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Course at COS OPO beneath Średnia Krokiew in Zakopane
Winter conditions and a mountain atmosphere
Picturesque views of the Tatra Mountains
additional: Details about distances and the program come from a report on the 2026 edition; they do not confirm the program for the 2027 edition.

name: Bieg ku Korzeniom Miłości
organizer: Atelier Sportu, GCKiS Konopiska i Park Korzonek
description: The Run to the Roots of Love is held in the picturesque Korzonek Park in the village of Korzonek. The event uses professional timing provided by Atelier Sportu, ensuring high-quality organization and timekeeping. The race starts at 12:00, and participants can expect smooth organization and a friendly atmosphere. It is a great opportunity for sporting competition and socializing in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: The course runs through Korzonek Park
Professional timing using RFID chips
Start and finish in the park’s picturesque surroundings
additional: The event is organized by Atelier Sportu together with GCKiS Konopiska. Timing is provided by Atelier Sportu using state-of-the-art systems based on RFID chips and start/finish mats. Telephone contact is available from 8:00 to 16:00 and on race day after 16:00. The sources described refer to the edition held on February 21, 2026, not the event dated February 20, 2027. Registration for the 2026 edition was online, and places were limited.

name: Bieg Pamięci Sybiru
location: Boisko w Lesie Osobowickim, Wrocław, Poland
description: The Siberian Deportations Memorial Run is an annual sporting event commemorating the mass deportations of Polish citizens to Siberia in February 1940. In 2027, the 5 km race will take place in Wrocław, in Osobowicki Forest. The event combines sporting competition with historical remembrance, offering participants a unique atmosphere and an opportunity to honor the memory of the Sybiraks. The race starts in waves based on participants’ estimated finish times, making it comfortable for runners of all abilities to take part.
course_highlights: The course runs through scenic Osobowicki Forest in Wrocław
Wave starts for the 5 km race, with groups starting every 2–3 minutes according to estimated finish time
The course is prepared for winter conditions, with no icy patches
additional: The 5 km race in Wrocław starts at 18:00. Runners start in waves, grouped according to their estimated finish times, with waves every 2–3 minutes. Participants should report to the start 30 minutes before their scheduled start. The start line closes 10 minutes after the last wave starts. Participants born in 1961 or earlier receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. No confirmed details were found for the 20 February 2027 edition. Information about the 2026 Wrocław edition indicates that the race office was located by the sports field in Osobowicki Forest; the regulations required advance online registration and payment of the entry fee.

name: Bieg Powstania Styczniowego
description: The January Uprising Run is an annual running event organized by the Stryków Municipality to commemorate the historical events of the January Uprising. The run and walk take place within the municipality, engaging the local community and enthusiasts of physical activity. The event has a patriotic and sporting character, promoting a healthy lifestyle and historical remembrance.
course_highlights: 10 km run
6.5 km Nordic walking event
Route near Dobra, associated with a skirmish in 1863
additional: Available sources give February 21 as the date in some editions; they do not confirm February 20, 2027.

name: Bieg Wyzwolenia
organizer: Miejsko-Gminne Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Choroszczy oraz Burmistrz Choroszczy
description: The Municipal and Communal Centre of Culture and Sport in Choroszcz and the Mayor of Choroszcz invite you to the Run marking the 107th anniversary of the Liberation of Choroszcz, an important sporting and promotional event for the town. The programme includes a 10 km Main Run to determine the top runners, as well as an inclusive 1,700 m Nordic walking event for seniors, families with children and anyone else who wishes to take part. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity and social integration. The run and walk start at 12:00 on 21 February at 11 Listopada Market Square in Choroszcz. After the competition, participants are invited to light candles together at the Monument to Independence.
course_highlights: 10 km Main Run on a certified course
Inclusive 1,700 m Nordic walking event for families and seniors
Start and finish at 11 Listopada Market Square in Choroszcz
additional: A group warm-up led by a fitness instructor will take place before the start. After the run and walk, participants are expected to light candles in the colours of the Choroszcz flag at the Monument to Independence. Entry fees may be paid only by online bank transfer or in cash on race day, if places are still available. The Main Run course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA). The available information relates to the 2026 edition and does not confirm the date or fees for 2027. The previous edition also included an inclusive Nordic walking event.

name: Botaniczna Piątka
location: Ogród Botaniczny Uniwersytetu Zielonogórskiego, Zielona Góra, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka is a series of cross-country races organized since 2014 by running enthusiasts who focus on the aesthetic qualities of their routes. The event takes place in scenic locations, such as the University of Zielona Góra Botanical Garden in Zielona Góra. It attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a unique atmosphere and the chance to spend time actively outdoors. The organizers promote running and make cross-country routes appealing.
course_highlights: Cross-country route through the University of Zielona Góra Botanical Garden
Scenic, attractive surroundings along the route
The autumn route follows a two-lap course
additional: The race takes place on a two-lap course. The organizers celebrate the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka in 2026. The event is part of a series of cross-country races held at various locations in Wielkopolska and beyond.

name: 5. Pietrasze Cross Country 4/5

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Upłynął termin. 2026.02.23 - 2026.03.08 Nordic walking - 7 830 m 30.00 PLN

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Upłynął termin. 2026.03.09 - 2026.03.14 Nordic walking - 7 830 m 35.00 PLN

description: Pietrasze Cross Country is a series of five cross-country races and Nordic walking events held in Białystok. Each race is approximately 7.8 km long and attracts runners who enjoy outdoor activity in scenic surroundings. The participant limit is 135, ensuring an intimate atmosphere and a comfortable racing experience. The event is organized by Podlaskie Centrum Biegowe Pędziwiatr and takes place on various dates from November to March.
course_highlights: Race and walk distance: 7.83 km
Cross-country course in Białystok
Participant limit: 135
additional: The participant limit is 135. Registration is open from 23 February to 14 March 2026. The entry fee is 30 PLN for the first registration period, 35 PLN for the second period and on the day. The cross-country course is 7.83 km long. The event is organized by Podlaskie Centrum Biegowe Pędziwiatr. Cross-country running and Nordic walking; participant limit of 135; registration from 23 February to 14 March 2026.

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
description: The Olęder Double Marathon is a recurring race organized by the Nowy Tomyśl Chyży Running Club, held on scenic routes around Jastrzębsko Stare. The event is part of an autumn-winter race series that passes through various towns, offering participants varied and challenging courses. It attracts both recreational and more experienced runners looking to test their endurance over the marathon distance. The organizers foster a welcoming atmosphere and support runners at every stage of preparation and competition.
course_highlights: Scenic routes around Jastrzębsko Stare
Varied and challenging running sections
Part of a regional autumn-winter race series
additional: The Olęder Double Marathon is co-financed by the Nowy Tomyśl County. Registration for the races usually opens several months before the event. The event takes place on weekends, and the routes change as the series moves to different locations. It is part of a series held in the autumn-winter period; the available information about the format comes from the 2025/2026 edition.

name: XI Bieg Zaślubinowy
description: The 11th Betrothal Run “From Haller to Haller” is a much-loved race linking the two monuments to Józef Haller in Władysławowo and Puck, and kicking off the running season in the region. Set against a picturesque seaside backdrop, the event offers participants a unique atmosphere and professional organization. It’s a race for everyone who wants to start the season actively, without unnecessary pressure, in a friendly atmosphere. The course is well prepared and accurately measured, as confirmed by numerous positive participant reviews.
course_highlights: A course linking the two monuments to Józef Haller in Władysławowo and Puck
Picturesque seaside scenery
Accurately measured and professionally prepared courses
additional: The event is part of the Puck Running Triad and the STONE TRI & RUN series. Enjoy a relaxed, pressure-free atmosphere, with prizes and additional attractions such as massages and refreshments. This event is for runners of all abilities.

name: 46 Półmaraton Wiązowski
description: The 46th Wiązowna Half Marathon is a traditional 21.0975 km race held in Wiązowna. In 2027, the event will take place in a new, two-day format, with children’s and youth races on Saturday and the main half marathon and accompanying Wiązowna Five on Sunday. It opens the running season and attracts runners of different ages and abilities. The organizers foster a family-friendly atmosphere and a sporting spirit.
course_highlights: Half marathon distance: 21.0975 km
Wiązowna Five — a 5 km race
Children’s and youth races over distances from 100 m to 2,000 m
additional: The 47th Wiązowna Half Marathon will take place in a new, two-day format: Saturday is for children’s and youth races, while Sunday is for the half marathon and the Wiązowna Five. Youth race distances range from 200 to 2,000 m, and the Little Gnomes race is approximately 100 m. The event is supported by partners including Decathlon and Majaland by Episodia. The available information concerns the 46th edition in 2026; the stated date of 21 February 2027 does not match the official schedule for the 47th edition, which is planned for 28 February 2027.

name: 14 Cross Trzebnicki
description: Cross Trzebnicki is a challenging trail race held in the scenic surroundings of a beech forest and green areas by the Trzebnica Ponds. Competitors cover a distance of 10 km, divided into three laps of approximately 3.333 metres each, on a hilly course with numerous climbs and descents. The race is popular with fans of mountain and trail running, offering beautiful views and varied terrain, mainly forest paths, gravel, and sections of asphalt. Participants receive a race pack with practical items and a commemorative medal.
course_highlights: A 10 km cross-country course divided into 3 laps of approximately 3,333 m each
Hilly terrain with numerous climbs and descents of varying gradients
Surface: 90% forest paths and gravel, 10% asphalt and paving stones
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 on race day by the Trzebnica Ponds. The start and finish are in the same place. The race pack includes sports socks. Timing is measured using chips in the race bibs. A refreshment point is located at the start/finish. Parking is available by Aqua-Zdrój Trzebnica and Trzebnica Sports Hall. The winners’ ceremony begins at 12:30. A baggage drop and changing rooms are available by the race office. Information published for the 14th edition applies to the race scheduled for 22 February 2026; it does not confirm the date of 21 February 2027. In the 2026 edition, the race pack included sports socks.

name: Bieg Piastów
description: Bieg Piastów is one of the largest and most prestigious cross-country skiing races in the world, held on trails in the Jizera Mountains, with the start and finish in Jakuszyce. The event offers a variety of distances from 6 to 50 km, in both classic and freestyle, as well as night, family, and children’s races. It is a major sporting tradition and a cross-country skiing festival that attracts thousands of participants from Poland and abroad. Bieg Piastów is not only a competition, but also a unique atmosphere and an opportunity to enjoy the beauty of winter nature.
course_highlights: Trails in the picturesque Jizera Mountains
Distances from 6 km to 50 km in classic and freestyle
A long-standing tradition and international reputation
additional: Bieg Piastów also includes night, family, children’s, and retro races. The event is part of the Cross-Country Skiing Festival and features different start dates for the various distances. The organizer provides a packed schedule of accompanying events and opportunities to take part in other races and sporting events in the region. The start and finish are in Jakuszyce; the other festival races take place from 13 - 20 February 2027.

name: Bieg Zimowy Jarocin
location: Forest near the intersection of al. Niepodległości and ul. Przemysłowej, Jarocin, Poland
description: The Jarocin Winter Run is a unique race of approximately 8 km, held in a picturesque forest in Jarocin. Runners start at 15-second intervals, ensuring safety and an exciting race against the clock. The course is a fast, marked forest loop, ideal for fans of winter running and woodland scenery. The race pack includes a bib with a chip, a commemorative medal, and a hot recovery meal. The participant limit is 300, and the race is open to everyone who enjoys physical activity.
course_highlights: Approx. 8 km fast, marked forest loop
Starts at 15-second intervals — an individual race against the clock
The course winds among snow-covered trees in Jarocin’s picturesque forest
additional: Participant limit: 300. Course time limit: 90 minutes. The race office and Finisher Zone, where a hot recovery meal is served, are open from 11:30 to 15:00 at the Social Schools Complex in Jarocin, ul. Przemysłowa 1. Participant limit: 300; time limit: 90 minutes. The race pack includes a bib with a chip, a medal, water, and a recovery meal. The race office is located at the Social Schools Complex in Jarocin, ul. Przemysłowa 1. Available sources give the date as 28 February 2027, not 21 February.

name: Sztafeta Pomocy

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa wynosi: 219 PLN od sztafety.

description: The Sztafeta Pomocy is a charity running event organized by the Sportplus Foundation to support children’s rehabilitation. The race takes place in the scenic Marcelin Forest in Poznań, on a forest route approximately 3.3 km long. Participants compete in teams of four, and the event promotes physical activity and social integration. It is a unique opportunity to combine sport with helping those in need.
course_highlights: A route approximately 3.3 km long along the paths of Marcelin Forest
100% forest surface
Start and finish on the clearing on the side of Strzegomska Street
additional: The limit is 125 teams of four. Participants must be at least 15 years old; those under 18 need parental consent. The time limit for completing the route is 2 hours. The route remains open to pedestrians, and medical staff are on hand to ensure safety. The fundraiser supports the rehabilitation of Oliwier Jabłoński. The route map is available on AllTrails.

name: XI Bieg Zaślubin Polski z Morzem
description: The 11th Run of Poland’s Marriage to the Sea is a historic race connecting the two Józef Haller monuments in Władysławowo and Puck, inspired by events from 1920. The race route runs from Władysławowo to Puck and opens the Puck Running Triad. STONE TRI & RUN has taken over the organization of the race, bringing it new energy while continuing the tradition of this iconic event. Participants can expect a clearly marked route, a route map, and organizational support during the event.
course_highlights: Historic route from Władysławowo to Puck
A race connecting two Józef Haller monuments
Opens the Puck Running Triad
additional: A personal race guide is available, featuring the current route, a map, rules, information about bus departures and parking, the event schedule, and start lists. The 2026 edition also offered an 11.5 km Nordic Walking event. The information provided about the distance and organization refers to the previous edition.

name: Poznań Malta #62
description: Poznań Malta is a recurring running event organized by Kiprun Poznań Runners, held in the picturesque area around Lake Malta in Poznań. The event brings together runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts, offering a friendly atmosphere and an opportunity to spend time outdoors. The route runs along the lake, providing beautiful views and comfortable conditions for both competition and recreation. It is a great opportunity to connect the local running community and promote a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: Route around Lake Malta
Picturesque views of the lake and greenery
Friendly atmosphere for runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts
additional: The event is organized by Kiprun Poznań Runners, a group that holds regular running and Nordic walking meetups in Poznań. The event is recurring and community-oriented, promoting physical activity and having fun.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Koszt udziału w jednym biegu to w podstawowym wariancie 52,99 zł.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Przy zakupie karnetu na 4 biegi, pojedynczy start kosztuje niecałe 39 zł.

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including Wrocław’s Osobowicki Forest. Races take place from October to April, and participants can compete in four races at each location, contributing to overall and local rankings. The series promotes outdoor physical activity and running as a form of recreation and a healthy lifestyle. The event welcomes runners of all ages, with separate races for children and young people.
course_highlights: The 5 km course runs through Osobowicki Forest in Wrocław
A cross-country race on natural forest terrain
A series of four races during the autumn and winter season
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. The main race starts at 11:00. Participants can choose a single-race package or a pass for the full series of 4 races, which offers additional benefits, including one race number for the entire season, a commemorative medal for taking part in at least three races, and the option to race for free at another location. Online registration closes at 23:59 on the Wednesday before the race. Register online through the Competitor Portal at citytrail.pl/zapisy or on race day at the race office. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:00. It is not possible to drive directly to the start area; parking is available along Osobowicka Street.

name: Gorce Ultra-Trail Winter
description: Gorce Ultra-Trail is a mountain running festival held in the heart of the Gorce Mountains, in Ochotnica Dolna. It offers seven varied running routes, from a short 5 km sprint to a 102 km ultramarathon, all finishing in Ochotnica Dolna. The routes carry ITRA points, reflecting their high standard and appeal to mountain runners. The event combines sporting competition with the chance to discover the beauty of Gorce’s trails and local culture and traditions.
course_highlights: Seven routes ranging from 5 km to 102 km
Routes awarded points by the international organization ITRA
All routes finish in scenic Ochotnica Dolna
additional: Mandatory equipment: visible race bib; timing chip attached to your shoe or ankle; a charged phone with the GUT emergency number +48 533 826 321; and your own cup or drink container (GUT ECO-CODE: no disposable cups). Race packs can only be collected in person. The race office is open from 31.07 to 02.08.2026, with different opening hours for each distance. Information about the distances and organizer comes from registration details for the 2026 edition; details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: XII Zimowy Ultramaraton Karkonoski
description: The Winter Karkonosze Ultramarathon is a demanding winter mountain race of approximately 47.5 km, running along the entire Karkonosze ridge. Runners will face challenging winter conditions, passing, among other places, Szrenica, the Snowy Cirques, Karkonoska Pass and the summit of Śnieżka. The race commemorates Tomek Kowalski, an ultramarathon runner and mountaineer whose passion for the mountains inspires participants. The time limit is 10.5 hours, and aid stations are positioned along the route. The finish is on the promenade in Karpacz, where runners can look forward to a hot meal and prizes.
course_highlights: The route runs along the entire Karkonosze ridge and is approximately 47.5 km long
Passes Szrenica, the Snowy Cirques, Karkonoska Pass and the summit of Śnieżka
Winter mountain conditions, with aid stations every 10–15 km
additional: The race starts in Szklarska Poręba (Kamieńczyk car park). Transport for runners from Karpacz to the start includes a check of mandatory equipment. Toilets, showers and bag drop are available at the finish. The time limit is 10.5 hours. Race packs can be collected at the race office in Karpacz on the day before the start (15:00–22:00). After the race, there will be an awards ceremony, a concert and a gathering at Chata Karkonoska. The event is scheduled for 27 February 2027. Registration is due to run from 27 October to 3 November 2026; the start list following the draw is to be published on 10 November.

name: 11 Bieg Pamięci Żołnierzy Wyklętych
location: ul. Droga Leśna - Przylesie, Oborniki, Poland
description: The 11th Captain Witold Pilecki Memorial Run for the Cursed Soldiers is an annual running event held in Oborniki. Runners start on Droga Leśna - Przylesie Street and run a loop of approximately 2 km, which they can complete as many times as they like, with a minimum of two loops. The race lasts a maximum of 1.5 hours, and a fire siren signals its end. The event combines athletic competition with commemorating the Cursed Soldiers.
course_highlights: Start on Droga Leśna - Przylesie Street
Approximately 2 km loop with a turnaround on Juliana Kubiaka Street
1.5-hour time limit; a fire siren signals the end
additional: Runners may complete as many loops as they like, with a minimum of two. The race has a time limit of 1.5 hours. A fire siren signals the end of the race. In the previous edition, the time limit was 1.5 hours, and a fire siren signaled its end. The date of the 2027 edition is given as approximate.

name: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa
description: The Gliwice Park Provocation Run is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events taking place in Gliwice in 2026, organised by the Amateur Running Enthusiasts Club “Pędziwiatr”. The events aim to promote healthy, active outdoor recreation and are held once a month on Saturdays in a municipal forest. The course is 4,219.5 metres per lap and runs mainly along forest and gravel tracks, with some paved sections. Participants can choose from 1 to 5 laps, covering approximately 4.2 km to a half marathon, and compete in running or Nordic Walking.
course_highlights: 4,219.5 m per lap
Runs mainly along forest and gravel tracks, with some paved sections
Start and finish in the municipal forest near Piast Stadium
additional: Events are held once a month on Saturdays. Participants can enter the running or Nordic Walking events, as well as the e-Provocation with any activity. The time limit for completing the distance is 3 hours. There is a refreshment point with drinks after each lap. Race numbers are valid for the whole year and must be returned after the event. After the run, participants receive a drink and a snack (sausage or banana), as well as a chocolate bar in a prize draw, if sanitary regulations permit. The official website confirms running and Nordic Walking, but does not provide details about the edition on 27 February 2027.

description: The Biskupiec Grand Prix is a series of four races held on different dates and at different locations in Biskupiec and the surrounding area. The races cover distances from approximately 2 km to 10 km, with routes through scenic areas by Lake Dadaj and Lake Kraksy, as well as the Municipal Park. Each race is electronically timed, and the overall standings are based on gun times. The organizers set a participant limit and offer registration both online and on race day. The event is open to individual runners and relay teams, and the courses are clearly marked and lit.
course_highlights: The Mors Run course is approximately 10 km, on asphalt and cobblestones
The Morning Run is approximately 5 km around Lake Kraksy Małe and the allotment gardens
The Night Run is approximately 8 km along paths, cycling routes, and through the Municipal Park
additional: Each race has a participant limit of 200. The race office is open on race day from 1 to 1.5 hours before the start. Participants receive a timing chip, which must be returned after the race. Bibs must be pinned to the front at chest or waist height. Courses are marked every 1 km and have hydration points. The Midday Run is an individual race over approximately 5 km. The Night Run starts at 19:53 and lasts about an hour.

description: The Grand Prix Dziewicza Góra Mountain Running Series consists of six races on a scenic route in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park. The course follows a 5.15 km loop entirely through the forest, with two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra. The races attract both recreational and experienced runners, bringing together a unique running community known as the “Dziewicza Family.”
course_highlights: A 5.15 km loop through the forest
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra
Passes through the event center, where spectators can cheer on runners
additional: Electronic timing using an ankle-mounted CHIP. The race office is open from 8:15 to 10:30. Participant limit: 500. The event takes place as a series of six stages. Runners in the 10 km race complete two laps of the course. Children’s and youth races are held over 200 m, 500 m, 1,000 m, and 1,500 m. Registration at the race office is available until 10:00 only for adult races and the Nordic Walking event. The 2026–2027 edition program also includes children’s races. The organizer’s website states that registration for individual stages opens successively; a limited number of passes for the whole series are also available.

name: Mistrzowski Bieg
location: Park przy ulicy Bema, Toruń, Poland
description: The Mistrzowski Run in Toruń is a recreational family run held in the park on Bema Street. Participants compete over 800 metres for the youngest runners and 4 kilometres for older participants. Every participant receives a commemorative T-shirt and a medal modelled on the medal of the Kujawy Pomorze 26 World Athletics Indoor Championships. The event promotes physical activity and integration within the local community.
course_highlights: The course runs through the city park on Bema Street
Two distances: 800 m for children and 4 km for adults
Commemorative T-shirts and medals for participants
additional: Every participant receives a T-shirt and a commemorative medal modelled on the medal of the Kujawy Pomorze 26 World Athletics Indoor Championships. The run is a family-friendly recreational event held in the city park. Participants receive a commemorative T-shirt and a medal modelled on the medal of the Kujawy Pomorze 26 World Athletics Indoor Championships.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The Grand Prix Truchtacza in Mysłowice is a series of cross-country races that combine a passion for running with an active lifestyle. The organizers promote health, community and the joy of physical activity, creating a supportive community that inspires people to get moving. The events are open to everyone, regardless of age or experience, and participation in the Grand Prix races is free. The races take place at different times of year, offering the chance to experience changing conditions and landscapes.
course_highlights: Cross-country routes in Mysłowice
Varied terrain conditions and seasons
A welcoming atmosphere and support from the running community
additional: Registration for the Grand Prix series is available only at the Race Office on race day. Participation is free. The events are open to all age groups and experience levels. The organizer provides the series rules on its website.

name: Łemkowyna Winter Trail
description: Łemkowyna Winter Trail is a winter edition of a mountain race through the picturesque Low Beskids, held at the end of February. The course takes runners through new corners of the region, not included in the autumn edition, featuring scenic ridges and unique places. The race base is in Iwonicz-Zdrój, while the longest distances start in Jaśliska; transport is arranged for participants. It is a unique opportunity to experience the beauty of the Low Beskids in a winter setting and enjoy unforgettable moments on the course.
course_highlights: Scenic ridges of the Low Beskids
Unique places along the course
The route passes through new, winter corners of the region
additional: Race office and start of the shortest distance in Iwonicz-Zdrój. The 33 km and 50 km distances start in Jaśliska. Bus transport from Iwonicz-Zdrój to Jaśliska is available in the morning on race day. Participants may switch between routes until 1 October 2027. Participant limits for individual routes range from 150 to 550. Technical briefing on the day before the race in Iwonicz-Zdrój. Available information about the 50 km, 35 km and 18 km distances applies to the 2026 edition; these distances have not been confirmed for the 2027 edition.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in picturesque forests and urban parks. In Bydgoszcz, the course runs through Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation and the Żołędowo Forest District, giving participants the chance to compete on a regular, well-established route. The races are open to anyone aged 16 and over and aim to promote running and outdoor physical activity. The start and finish are at Polana Różopole, and the organizers provide professional event support and a recurring race series.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the woodland setting of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District
Start and finish at Polana Różopole
The course is suitable for both beginner and experienced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the start at 10:45. Parking is not available at Polana Różopole; parking lots approximately 1–1.5 km from the start are recommended. Races take place regularly during the 2026/2027 season across 7 locations. Four races are scheduled in Bydgoszcz: November 7, 2026; December 12, 2026; January 23, 2027; and March 6, 2027. During the 2026/2027 season, the Bydgoszcz races take place in Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation and the Żołędowo Forest District. Registration is available online through the Participant Panel or at the race office on race day.

name: Tropem Wilczym
description: The Tropem Wilczym Run in Zalesie is an annual running event commemorating the Cursed Soldiers, Polish heroes of the anti-communist underground from 1944 to 1963. Organized by the Ryki Municipality, the World Association of Home Army Soldiers, and the biegusiem.pl group, the event offers two distances: 1,963 meters and 5 kilometers. The run starts at 11:00, giving participants the opportunity to honor the soldiers’ memory while running along a scenic route near Zalesie. The event is open to runners of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Two distances to choose from: 1,963 m and 5 km
Route near Zalesie, close to Ryki
A run commemorating the Cursed Soldiers and their historical legacy
additional: The run is organized by the Ryki Municipality, the Ryki branch of the World Association of Home Army Soldiers named after Marian Bernaciak “Orlik,” and the biegusiem.pl group. The event is commemorative and patriotic in nature. A sample consent form for minors is available. Information about the run is published on its Facebook event page. The start and finish are in Zalesie, near Ryki. Information about the 2027 edition in Zalesie, including local distances and registration, has not been confirmed in available sources.

name: Bieg Niezłomnych
description: The Bieg Niezłomnych in memory of Major Zenon Wechmann is an annual running event held in the Babki Forest District in Luboń, in the so-called Lasek Majoński. The event is open to different age groups, from young children to adults, with distances ranging from 250 m for the youngest participants to 5 km for older runners, as well as a Nordic walking event. It has a family-friendly, inclusive atmosphere and promotes physical activity and remembrance of heroes. Participant numbers are limited to ensure comfort and safety during the event.
course_highlights: Routes run through the scenic Babki Forest District (Lasek Majoński)
Distances for different age groups range from 250 m to 5 km
Separate children’s races, as well as races and a Nordic walking event for adults
additional: Participant limits: 100 children in the children’s races and 200 participants in total across the 1963 m race, 5 km race and Nordic walking event. Starts are scheduled from 10:30 to 12:30, divided by age category and distance. The minimum age for the 1963 m race is 14; for the 5 km race and Nordic walking event, it is 16. Fees depend on the distance and registration date.

name: Bieg Pamięci Żołnierzy Wyklętych
location: Stadion Miejski, ul. Sportowa 3, Kamieńsk, Poland
organizer: Gmina Kamieńsk i Stowarzyszenie Aktywni Kamieńsk
description: The Tropem Wilczym Run is an annual sports and patriotic event commemorating the Cursed Soldiers, held in Kamieńsk. The route starts at the Municipal Stadium at 3 Sportowa Street. The event brings families together and offers an opportunity to pay tribute to KWP soldiers who fought for Poland’s independence. Before the 14:30 start of the ceremony, flowers are laid and candles are lit at the monument to Stanisław Sojczyński, nom de guerre Warszyc. The race is scheduled to start at 15:00.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Kamieńsk
Patriotic run commemorating the Cursed Soldiers
Pre-race ceremony at the monument to Stanisław Sojczyński, nom de guerre Warszyc
additional: The race is limited to 100 participants. The event is organized jointly with the Aktywni Kamieńsk Association. At 14:30, flowers are laid and candles are lit at the monument before the race. The organizer’s information concerns the 2026 edition, so the program, registration, and route details for February 28, 2027, have not been confirmed. In 2026, the race was scheduled to start at 15:00, preceded by a ceremony in which flowers were laid and candles were lit at the monument to Stanisław Sojczyński, nom de guerre Warszyc.

name: Biegi Hrabiego
location: Kosina, Łańcut County, Podkarpackie Voivodeship, Poland
description: Biegi Hrabiego is a series of mountain races held in the scenic surroundings of Kosina and Łańcut. Participants can choose from distances ranging from 10 km to over 70 km, running along well-marked hiking trails with numerous aid stations. The courses feature varied elevation and beautiful views, and the organizers provide transport to the start and professional timing. The event is for runners seeking adventure and a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: The courses follow well-marked hiking trails
Beautiful views and varied elevation, from approximately 290 m to 664 m
Several aid stations along the route with food in sealed packaging
additional: Participants are transported by bus from the MOSiR parking lot to the start of each race. Mandatory equipment includes a race number, timing chip, charged phone with the coordinator’s number, a cup or bottle for drinks (no disposable cups are provided at aid stations), a bottle or soft flask with a minimum capacity of 0.5 l, and an NRC emergency blanket. The participant limit for most distances is 140. Time limits depend on the distance—for example, 4 hours for 20 km, 6 hours for 35 km, and 8 hours for 50 km. Bus transport to the start is organized for the Mały Panicz race; participants should bring their own cup or bottle. This information applies to the 10 km distance.

name: I Uliczny Bieg i Marsz Pamięci Żołnierzy...
Kołobrzeska Odysea
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Nadmorscy Biegacze oraz Seaside Park Hotel Kołobrzeg
description: Kołobrzeska Odysea is a new race series in Kołobrzeg, bringing together three races held by the Baltic Sea over the course of a year. Participants can take part in a half marathon, a marathon or a 10 km race, earning three unique medals that form a single design. The event offers not only sporting excitement, but also beautiful coastal views and a unique atmosphere. The organizers provide full sanitary facilities, professional timing, attractive prizes and refreshments for finishers. Kołobrzeska Odysea is an event for runners who appreciate sport and the atmosphere of a seaside town.
course_highlights: Half marathon along the Baltic coast — 21.0975 km
Marathon or 10 km race — 42.195 km or 10 km
Beautiful views of coastal Kołobrzeg
additional: Participants receive three unique medals that form a single design. After the races, a finisher zone is available with a hot meal, snacks, isotonic drinks and water. An awards gala is held at Seaside Park Hotel* and includes a quiz and prizes. Full sanitary facilities are provided: bag drop, changing rooms, showers and toilets. Special accommodation discounts at Seaside Park Hotel* are available during the event. The organizers promise professional timing, food and drinks in the finisher zone, prizes and a gala at Seaside Park Hotel. Available sources describe the 2026 edition and do not confirm a race on the stated date of February 28, 2027.

name: Prusice biegają
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Prusicach
description: Prusice Biegają is a series of races organized by the Municipal Cultural and Sports Centre in Prusice, bringing together residents of all ages—from the youngest to adults. In the 14th edition, runners compete across four stages of the overall standings and receive a medal at the end for completing the entire series. Children can take part in the special “Prusice Biegają od Małego” category, combining sporting fun with their first race-day excitement and a medal at the finish. The event is about more than running: it also offers shared cheering and a great atmosphere in Prusice.
course_highlights: Four stages in the overall standings
Special category for the youngest participants: “Prusice Biegają od Małego”
Medal for completing the entire series
additional: The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and encourages participation with family and friends. It is about more than competition, with shared cheering and a friendly atmosphere. Participants who complete the entire series and children in the younger category receive medals. In the previous edition, medals were planned for completing the entire series, including for children.

name: Sielska Piątka
description: Sielska Piątka is a 5 km race held in Lublin. The event is part of the wide range of running events organized by the Sports Development Foundation in Lublin, which promotes physical activity and social integration through sport. The race takes place in the picturesque setting of the Lublin Village Museum, allowing participants to enjoy both sporting competition and the beauty of their surroundings. It’s a great opportunity for runners of all abilities to test themselves and experience the spirit of the running community.
course_highlights: 5 km distance
The course runs through the grounds of the Lublin Village Museum
Picturesque, peaceful surroundings ideal for recreation
additional: The race is organized by the Sports Development Foundation in Lublin, which has promoted physical culture and the development of sport in the Lublin region since 2011. Lublin is one of Poland’s most running-friendly cities, and Sielska Piątka is one of many races held there. The race starts at 09:00.

name: Sopocki Bieg Inki
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie (MOSiR)
description: The Sopot “Inka” Run commemorates Danuta Siedzikówna “Inka” and is organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Sopot under the patronage of the Mayor of Sopot. The event takes place as part of the National Day of Remembrance of the “Cursed Soldiers” and is symbolic, with no timing. Participants complete a running distance of their choice, and each receives a commemorative medal. After the run, attendees sing soldiers’ songs together and share food from a field kitchen, creating a unique atmosphere of remembrance and fellowship.
course_highlights: A run commemorating Danuta Siedzikówna “Inka”
No timing—the tribute is more important than the result
Group singing of soldiers’ songs and food from a field kitchen
additional: The run is not timed. Every participant receives a commemorative medal. After the run, there is group singing of soldiers’ songs and food served from a field kitchen. In previous editions, participants received a commemorative medal; after the run, there was group singing of soldiers’ songs and food from a field kitchen. Details of the edition on 28 February 2027 are not confirmed by available sources.

name: VIII Tropem Wilczym
location: Leśna Altana, Osiedle Bór, Skarżysko-Kamienna, Poland
description: The 8th Skarżysko edition of the nationwide Tropem Wilczym Run is an annual event held on the first Sunday of March in Skarżysko-Kamienna. The run pays tribute to the Cursed Soldiers and combines athletic competition with historical remembrance. Organized by the Aktywisko and Kultura Sportu associations, the event takes place at the City Gazebo in the Bór district. It is a special opportunity to honor the heroes and spend time actively outdoors.
course_highlights: The run takes place at the City Gazebo in the Bór district of Skarżysko-Kamienna
The event combines athletic competition with a tribute to the Cursed Soldiers
An annual edition held on the first Sunday of March
additional: The Tropem Wilczym Run is organized by the Aktywisko and Kultura Sportu associations. The event runs from 08:30 to 13:15. The start and finish are at the City Gazebo in the Bór district of Skarżysko-Kamienna. The source describes the 8th edition as a 2026 event; details about the edition on February 28, 2027, have not been confirmed.

name: XIV Bieg Pamięci Żołnierzy Wyklętych
description: The “Tropem Wilczym” Run in Memory of the Cursed Soldiers in Kluczbork combines running with commemorating the Cursed Soldiers. The 14th edition was announced at the Provincial Training Centre. The running calendar lists a distance of 10 km, but the date of this edition and event details require confirmation from the organizer.
course_highlights: Start at the Provincial Training Centre
10 km distance according to the running calendar
A run commemorating the Cursed Soldiers, organized as part of the Tropem Wilczym initiative
additional: Available information about the 14th edition concerns the run announced for March 1, 2026; the calendar gives March 1, 2027 as an approximate date, not February 28.

name: XIV Bieg Tropem Wilczym
location: MOSiR przy Parku Miejskim, ul. Parkowa, Lubartów, Poland
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Lubartowie we współpracy ze Stowarzyszeniem „Aktywny Lubartów” (poprzednia edycja)
description: The Tropem Wilczym Run is an annual sports and educational event commemorating the Cursed Soldiers, held since 2013. Its 15th edition will take place in 2027, bringing together sport, history, and local communities across Poland and beyond. A distinctive feature of the run is the symbolic distance of 1,963 metres, referring to the year of the death of Józef Franczak, known by the alias “Lalek.” The event is open to everyone, regardless of age or running experience. Many locations also host additional runs, Nordic Walking marches, and family activities.
course_highlights: A symbolic 1,963-metre distance commemorating the year of Józef Franczak, known as “Lalek,” died
An event combining sport with historical education and local community involvement
Additional runs, Nordic Walking marches, and family activities in many locations
additional: The event takes place on 28 February 2027. Local organisers decide the scale of the event, additional distances, and accompanying activities. Schools hold a separate edition of the “Tropem Wilczym at School” project on 1 March 2027; it is free and intended for students. Previous editions have featured history meetings, historical reenactment groups, exhibitions, and family activities. In the previous edition, the start and finish were on Parkowa Street, by MOSiR. The local programme and registration for 2027 have not been confirmed in the available sources.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo # 73
location: Bolechowo, Czerwonak, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo Na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night #73, is a free sporting event held in Bolechowo. It is an active gathering for the local community, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in a friendly atmosphere. The event takes place in the evening and is part of a series of gatherings organized by the Centre for the Development of Physical Culture in Czerwonak. It’s a great opportunity to spend time together outdoors and connect with others.
course_highlights: Choose between 5 km and 10 km distances
An evening edition of the Active Czerwonak at Night series
Located in Bolechowo
additional: The event is free and takes place from 19:30 to 22:00. This is the 73rd edition of the Active Czerwonak at Night gathering. The event is part of the Grand Prix of Czerwonak series. No information is available about participant limits, start waves, or fees.

name: KoKaIno nr 34 Tysiącznik (2) Północny
description: KoKaIno No. 34 Tysiącznik (2) Północny is a 10 km night race taking place in Częstochowa. It is a moderately challenging road course, ideal for runners looking for a challenge in a nighttime atmosphere. Participants can use training plans tailored to different ability levels, allowing them to prepare optimally for the start. The event is part of Poland’s night-race calendar, attracting runners from across the country.
course_highlights: Moderately challenging road course
10 km night race
Held in Częstochowa, Silesian Voivodeship
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and accompanied by training instructions and expert support. The date in the available calendar is marked as tentative and listed as 6 March 2027, the day after the date given for the event.

description: Trail!ON Stawiguda is a series of four 5 km trail races held monthly on the same scenic route near the forests and the Łyna River, close to Ruś. Winter weather is no obstacle to staying active—the crisp air and forest paths create a unique atmosphere for running. It’s a great opportunity to regularly test your fitness, enjoy the excitement of competition, and spend time outdoors. The organizers make things comfortable for participants by offering passes for the whole series as well as the option to enter a single race.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the beautiful forests of Ruś
Start and finish on the beach at a bend in the Łyna River in Stawiguda municipality
Varied forest terrain and natural winter conditions
additional: Children’s Mini Trail!ON races over distances from 300 m to 1,000 m, depending on age. Participants can buy a pass for all four races or enter a single race. Single-race entry can also be purchased at the race office on race day. At the final race, winners will be presented with awards, followed by a communal bonfire with the Mayor. Pass holders use the same race number throughout the series and must bring it to every race. The programme also includes children’s races over distances of approximately 300 m, 500 m, and 1,000 m. Online registration is open until 3 March 2027; cold-water immersion is also planned.

name: Warta Challenge
location: Łysy Młyn Forest Parking, Łyse Lake, Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter running tournament consisting of a series of four running events and Nordic Walking walks, held on forest tracks and trails in the forests along the Warta River. The events offer half-marathon (21.3 km) and marathon (42.6 km) distances, as well as Nordic Walking walks over the half-marathon distance. This is a small-scale event for both recreational and professional athletes, featuring themed races and seasonal touches. The start and race office are located by Lake Łyse, next to the Łysy Młyn forest car park in Biedrusko. The gun start for each race is at 10:00.
course_highlights: The course follows forest tracks and trails along the Warta River, with some paved sections and slippery surfaces depending on the weather.
The half-marathon is one 21.3 km loop with 110 m of total elevation gain; the marathon is two loops, covering 42.6 km in total.
The course is marked with red-and-white tape and signs for the “Łysy Młyn” running trail, and passes, among other places, a landmark oak and stream cascades.
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30 at the race office. During the 2026/2027 winter season, races and walks over 5 km and 10 km distances are also held. Each race has a theme, with suggested outfits and touches. The course is not officially certified; it is measured using bicycle computers and a Garmin. The start and event centre are by the Łysy Młyn forest car park, beside Lake Łyse, ul. Poznańska 4, Biedrusko. The start is scheduled for 10:00; race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30. Free parking is available, and the venue can also be reached by bus.

name: IX Chwaszczyńska 10
location: Szkoła Podstawowa im. A. Mickiewicza, Chwaszczyno, Poland
organizer: Kaszubskie Stowarzyszenie Kultury Fizycznej, Fundacja Aktywne Kaszuby oraz Sołectwo Chwaszczyno
description: The 9th Chwaszczyno 10 is a 10 km race and the prologue to the Kaszuby Biegają series. The event takes place in Chwaszczyno. In 2026, due to snowy conditions, the course was changed to a temporary 5 km loop with a hard surface of asphalt and jombo slabs. The event also includes shorter races for children and young people, which are free and do not require advance registration. After the main races, the winners are presented with their awards and prizes are drawn. The organizers prioritize participants’ safety and comfort by adapting the course to current conditions.
course_highlights: The 10 km race consists of two laps of a 5 km loop
Hard surface: asphalt and jombo slabs
Additional races for children and young people over 100 m, 300 m and 600 m
additional: The race office and bag drop open at 08:30 in the sports hall. The children’s races start by the blue inflatable arch. A post-race recovery snack is provided after the 10 km race. The winners’ presentation takes place at 12:40 in the sports hall. Prizes are drawn at 13:10; participants must be present with their race number. The entry package limit for the main races has been reached, and registration is closed. The available details concern the 2026 edition, not a confirmed 9th edition scheduled for 2027. Previous editions also included 5 km races and children’s races.

name: XIV Grand Prix Krakowa
organizer: Grand Prix Krakowa w Biegach Górskich
description: The Kraków Mountain Running Grand Prix is a series of mountain races held in Kraków, offering a range of distances from 3.7 km to 23.2 km, as well as a Vertical race. The event attracts runners of varying abilities, including children and seniors, and also features team and additional classifications. The courses have varied profiles and are suitable for training outside the racing season. This is the 15th anniversary edition, combining sporting competition with the beauty of Kraków’s natural areas.
course_highlights: Distances: 3.7 km, 5.7 km, 11.6 km, 23.2 km, and a 1.5 km Vertical race
Varied mountain-running terrain in Kraków
Special races for children, plus team and additional classifications
additional: The entry limit for each individual race is 100 people per distance. Discounts are available for children, young people up to 18 years old, and seniors aged 65+. The series includes team classifications, a uniformed services competition, relays, and special passes for 5 races. Races start at different times on Sundays, with the first start at 09:00. The materials provided do not confirm that the date 7 March 2027 is for the 14th edition; information about the 2026–2027 series refers to the 15th edition.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including the Tricity, on Spokojna Street in Gdynia. The races take place in forests and urban parks, combining a city atmosphere with contact with nature. The series includes four races in each location, and participants can compete in the overall and local standings. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, and also offers races for children and young people.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through forests and urban parks
Location in the Gdańsk Forest District and around the Mały Kack estate in Gdynia
Races take place in the natural setting of the Tricity Landscape Park
additional: The race office opens at 8:30, and race bibs and chips can be collected on race day. The schedule includes the main race starting at 11:00 and CITY TRAIL Junior races for children in different age categories. A pass for the entire series also includes one free race in a city other than the main location, provided participants notify the organizers by email in advance. Register online at citytrail.pl/zapisy or on race day at the race office. The race starts at 11:00.

name: 12 Nocna Recordowa Piątka
description: Nocna Recordowa Piątka is a 5 km race held after dark in Poznań. The fast course encourages runners to go for personal bests, while the evening setting and city illuminations create a unique atmosphere. It is an event for both ambitious amateur runners and experienced athletes.
course_highlights: 5 km distance
A fast course suited to achieving good times
An evening race amid the city’s illuminations

name: 3 Krakowski Bieg Kobiet
location: Plac Wielkiej Armii Napoleona, Kraków, Poland
description: The Kraków Women’s Run is an annual running event dedicated to women, held in central Kraków since 2024. Participants can choose between two distances, 5 km and 10 km, on scenic routes around Plac Wielkiej Armii Napoleona and Wawel. The run promotes women’s solidarity and physical activity, offering participants race shirts and commemorative medals. The event attracts an increasing number of women runners, creating a unique atmosphere of sporting competition and support.
course_highlights: The route runs through central Kraków, around Plac Wielkiej Armii Napoleona and Wawel
Two distances to choose from: 5 km and 10 km
Scenic urban surroundings with historic views
additional: The start and finish are on ul. Podzamcze, next to Plac Wielkiej Armii Napoleona. In addition to the overall standings, age categories and a “Team Matka - Córka” (Mother-Daughter Team) classification are planned for pairs running the 5 km. Every participant receives a race shirt and a commemorative medal after finishing within the time limit. Route and location information refers to the previous edition; details of the 2027 race have not yet been confirmed.

description: SANPROBI Women’s Run is an annual sporting event held in Szczecin, dedicated to active women and girls. The race takes place on a scenic route in Kasprowicza Park, with the start and finish at Jasne Błonia. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity and women’s strength, while bringing participants together in an atmosphere of joy and support. It includes a 5 km main race, a Nordic walking event and mini-races for younger participants. The organizers provide a varied program of accompanying activities, partner zones and attractions for the whole family.
course_highlights: The main race route consists of two 2.5 km loops along paths in Kasprowicza Park
Start and finish at Jasne Błonia, a beautiful green space in Szczecin
No time limit for the 5 km distance; Nordic walking is also available
additional: The race office is open on 7 March 2026 (10:00–18:00) at the Szczecin Philharmonic and on 8 March 2026 (09:00–10:30) at the Institute of Pedagogy of the University of Szczecin. Mini-races for girls up to 11 years old are held over 200 m and 1 km. The mini-race participant limit is 300; once the limit is reached, registration is possible only at the race office (limited to 20 race numbers). Official race T-shirts are available for both races. There is no time limit for the main race. The running and Nordic walking routes follow paths through Kasprowicza Park. The 2026 edition offered a 5 km race, 5 km Nordic walking and mini-races. The organizers announced that registration for the next edition would open on 12 December 2026 at 12:00.
