description: The 12th Ostrów Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Ostrów Wielkopolski, attracting both amateur and professional runners. The 21 km half-marathon course is certified by PZLA and consists of three fast laps that are conducive to setting personal bests. The event also includes a 7 km fun run. It is organized by the ICE MAT Team Sports Club, which promotes running and brings the local running community together.
course_highlights: Course certified by PZLA
Fast, flat course conducive to setting personal bests
Three laps totaling 21 km
additional: The race pack includes a commemorative mug, a cap, and a trophy medal made of stone and metal. The half marathon is part of the Grand Prix of Greater Poland Half Marathon, where participants can earn the crown. The course is flat and certified, making it ideal for setting personal bests. The available registration page and results are for the edition held on March 22, 2026, not the stated date of March 21, 2027.

name: XLIII Perła Paprocan
description: Perła Paprocan is a marathon held on a 7 km loop around Paprocany Lake in Tychy. Participants can run any number of laps, from one up to a full marathon, without having to declare their distance in advance. The event is recreational and community-oriented, promoting a healthy lifestyle and a friendly atmosphere among participants. Tychy is the only city in Poland where a marathon is held twice a year, and Perła Paprocan is one of those editions.
course_highlights: A 7 km loop around Paprocany Lake
Paved sections (over 50%), along with compacted paths and forest trails
A refreshment point with drinks, fruit and sweets after each lap
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the Irysy restaurant by Paprocany Lake in Tychy on October 23 and 24, and on race day before the start. A race number may be collected on another person’s behalf with written authorization. Participants under 18 must have written consent from a parent or legal guardian. On the course, runners and walkers must use only half of the paths, leaving the other half clear for overtaking. The course is marked every 1 km. Nordic walking is also permitted. Information about the 43rd edition indicates that it supported the PSONI Therapeutic Day Centre in Tychy.

name: Poznań Malta #63
description: Poznań Malta #63 is a 10 km race in Poznań, held on 17 March 2026 as part of the Kiprun Poznań Malta series. 27 runners took part, and Robert Walczak was the fastest, finishing in 37:57. It is a small-scale edition of the running series organized in Poznań.
course_highlights: 10 km distance
Race in Poznań
Small-scale edition with 27 participants
additional: Robert Walczak won with a time of 37:57.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night, is a recurring, free sporting event organized by the Centre for the Development of Physical Culture in Czerwonak. The event takes place in the evening and encourages residents and visitors to spend time actively outdoors. It is recreational and community-building in nature, promoting a healthy lifestyle and sports activity in the local community.
course_highlights: A 5 km race in the previous edition
The event takes place in the evening
The route is in Bolechowo, in the Czerwonak municipality
additional: The event is free and takes place from 19:30 to 22:00. This evening activity is recreational and community-building in nature.

name: Ekstremalna Droga Krzyżowa
description: The Extreme Way of the Cross is a spiritual, nighttime hike of approximately 40 km, undertaken in silence and contemplation. Participants follow the route alone or in small groups, focusing on prayer and reflection rather than sports competition. This unique event aims to inspire inner transformation and take participants beyond their comfort zones, offering a profound spiritual and personal experience. The route may be approximately 30 km if the elevation gain exceeds 500 m. EDK is a way of life and a path to changing yourself, not just covering the distance.
course_highlights: 40 km at night in silence and contemplation
A route of approximately 30 km when the elevation gain exceeds 500 m
The Way of the Cross with spiritual reflections, without sporting or social elements
additional: Participants set out at their own risk. It is recommended that they download the official EDK app, which includes route maps, GPS navigation, and the Way of the Cross reflections in text and audio, and also works offline. Silence and contemplation are observed along the route; picnics and social stops are not part of the event. Participants should be prepared for varying weather conditions and bring suitable clothing, food and drink, and a phone with a power bank. EDK takes place at participants’ own risk. Registration and route selection are available through the EDK service.

name: Lake run

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startowa 69 zł kończy się za

description: Lake Run is a unique trail race held on the shores of Lake Strzeszyńskie in Poznań. The approximately 5 km and 10 km routes, as well as the Nordic Walking course, follow natural paths around the lake, offering a light trail feel with uphill sections and a short off-road stretch. The start and finish are right by the water, providing beautiful views and an intimate atmosphere that’s ideal for both beginners and experienced runners. Organized by the EVsport Foundation, the race combines a passion for sport with closeness to nature and a welcoming community.
course_highlights: The routes loop around Lake Strzeszyńskie, with views of the lake
Natural paths and a light trail feel, including a short off-road stretch
Start and finish right by the water, with no streets or traffic jams
additional: One entry fee applies to all distances: 5 km, 10 km and Nordic Walking. Souvenirs from the “Feel the Rhythm of the Lake” collection can be purchased separately (T-shirt, mug, bandana, premium bag or set). Participants under 18 must have a consent form signed by a parent or guardian. The routes have a light trail feel, with natural surfaces and gentle uphill sections. The organizer recommends shoes with good grip. The available options are 5 km, 10 km and Nordic Walking. The organizer recommends shoes with good grip; a detailed route map will be published later. Participants under 18 need a consent form signed by a parent or guardian when collecting their race pack.

name: 12 Górska Pętla UBS 12:12
location: Hotel Kotarz Spa & Wellness, Brenna, Poland
description: The 12th Górska Pętla UBS 12:12 is a 12-hour mountain race held on a varied loop of approximately 16 km in the Stary Groń area of the Silesian Beskids. Runners aim to complete as many loops as possible within 12 hours, and at least one loop is required to be classified. The course starts at Hotel Kotarz Spa & Wellness in Brenna and passes through scenic terrain, with approximately 800 m of elevation gain per loop. A new distance has also been introduced: a single 16 km loop for beginner mountain runners who want to test themselves before taking on an ultra-distance race.
course_highlights: A loop of approximately 16 km with around 800 m of elevation gain
The course passes through the Silesian Beskids, including Hala Jaworowa and the summit of Kotarz
Scenic, fast descents to the Brennica River and the transition area
additional: To be classified, runners must complete at least one loop. The course is identical to previous years. The start and finish are at Hotel Kotarz Spa & Wellness in Brenna. The course includes one difficult section that requires particular attention for safety. The start and finish are at Hotel Kotarz Spa & Wellness in Brenna. The previous edition described on the organizer’s website took place on 28 March 2026; details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Charytatywny II Fenomenalny Bieg Kolorowy
price_range: Bezpłatnie dla dzieci i młodzieży; 50 zł dla dorosłych
description: The Charity 2nd Phenomenal Color Run is an event in Łupstych near Olsztyn, combining recreational running with support for people with Down syndrome. The routes follow forest roads in the Kudypy Forest District and are designed for children, teenagers, and adults. Participants can choose a distance of 600 m, 2 km, or 3.5 km, and commemorative medals await them at the finish. The run is informal and does not include timekeeping.
course_highlights: Forest routes in the Kudypy Forest District
Three distances: 600 m, 2 km, and 3.5 km
Routes for children, teenagers, and adults
additional: Adult entry fees go toward the charitable cause. Participants receive commemorative medals; the run is not timed.

name: Dzikie Ultra dla Lenki
description: Dzikie Ultra is a six-hour race organized by the BDB Team crew, held in the scenic Valley of Three Ponds in Katowice. This unique event for long-distance running enthusiasts combines sporting competition with the beauty of nature. The course follows natural trails, offering participants an unforgettable experience and a chance to test their endurance.
course_highlights: A six-hour race through the Valley of Three Ponds
The course follows natural trails and green areas
Organized by the experienced BDB Team crew
additional: Running calendars list the date as March 28, 2027, one day later than the date indicated in the metadata; the calendar date is marked as tentative.

name: Ekstremalna Droga Krzyżowa
location: Kościół przy ul. Kościelnej 2, Bezrzecze, Poland
description: The Extreme Way of the Cross is a demanding route from the church at 2 Kościelna Street in Bezrzecze to the cross by the church in Bezrzecze. The route is interesting and varied, passing partly through woodland and partly through urban areas. Most of the route is on paved surfaces, so soft-soled footwear is recommended. It is a spiritual and physical challenge for participants, combining reflection with outdoor activity.
course_highlights: Partly woodland and partly urban route
Most of the route is paved
Start and finish by the church in Bezrzecze
additional: Soft-soled footwear is recommended because of the varied terrain. The route description recommends soft-soled footwear. The Extreme Way of the Cross takes place in silence and contemplation, with reflections on the Stations of the Cross.

name: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa
location: Las Komunalny przy ul. Chorzowskiej, Gliwice, Poland
description: Gliwice Park Prowocation Run is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice, in the municipal forest. The 4219.5 m course runs mainly along forest and gravel paths, with some asphalt sections, and is open to runners and Nordic Walking enthusiasts. The events are amateur in nature and promote a healthy, active outdoor lifestyle. Participants can choose to complete 1 to 5 laps, covering distances from approximately 4.2 km to a half marathon. A refreshment point with drinks is available after each lap, and participants receive a drink and a snack after the event.
course_highlights: A 4219.5 m course along forest, gravel, and asphalt paths
Start and finish on a clearing near the Piast Stadium in the Municipal Forest
A refreshment point is available after each lap
additional: Events are held once a month on Saturdays. Participants can take part in the run or Nordic Walking, as well as the e-Prowocation (any activity). The time limit for completing the course is 3 hours. Race numbers are valid for the whole year and must be returned after each race. After the event, participants receive a drink and a snack (sausage or banana), as well as a chocolate bar in a prize draw, if sanitary regulations allow. Events are held once a month on Saturdays. According to information about the series from 2026, the race office opens at 9:00, and the run starts at 10:00.

name: Grand Prix Cross Polska cz.1
location: ReMi fish fry, ul. Lipowa 31, Stegna, Poland
organizer: Gmina Stegna i Valdano Organizacja Imprez Sportowych
description: Grand Prix Cross Polska Part 1 is a prestigious running event held in the picturesque coastal municipality of Stegna. The event opens the Grand Prix Cross Polska 2027 series and offers participants a unique atmosphere of sporting competition against the beauty of the amber coast. The organizers look after runners’ comfort by providing a race office and a post-race meal at the Municipal Cultural Centre. The event promotes physical activity, a healthy lifestyle, and fair play, bringing together the local community and athletes from across Poland.
course_highlights: A route through the coastal scenery of the Municipality of Stegna
Start and finish near the “ReMi” fish bar at 31 Lipowa Street
The event is organized and concludes at the Stegna Municipal Cultural Centre
additional: The race office, post-race meal, and awards ceremony take place at the Stegna Municipal Cultural Centre. The event is held under the patronage of the Municipality of Stegna and the Polish Olympic Committee. The route passes near beach access No. 69 from Lipowa Street. The organizers provide comfortable conditions and opportunities for participants to connect. In the 2026 edition, the start and finish were at the “ReMi” fish bar, 31 Lipowa Street, while the race office and closing events were at the Municipal Cultural Centre at 60 Gdańska Street. These details do not confirm the organization or program of the 2027 edition.

description: The Jura Wild Dog Run is a unique event for people and their dogs, offering three routes of 5 km, 13 km and 28 km. The routes suit different ability levels, from a family-friendly walk to more demanding running and dogtrekking challenges. The dogtrekking format ensures comfort and safety, with a marked route, checkpoints and a GPX file to eliminate the stress of navigating the terrain. Starts are arranged in pace-based sectors, and the atmosphere is friendly and relaxed, with a quiet start and dogs creating a distinctive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes of 5 km, 13 km and 28 km to suit different ability levels
Marked route with checkpoints and a GPX file
A dogtrekking format that removes the stress of navigating the terrain
additional: Starts are arranged in pace-based sectors: ELITE (under 5:00 min/km), RUNNERS (5:01–6:00 min/km), OTHERS (over 6:01 min/km, walkers, families and first-timers). The start is quiet, with no gunshots or countdown; a designated person at the start line gives the signal to start. Race packs are handed out on Friday evening before the race, with priority given by distance. The event website lists the date as 28 March 2026, not 27 March 2027. In the edition described on the website, starts were in sectors, without a gunshot or countdown.

name: Prymulek-Dąbrowska Górka skansen forteczny
description: Prymulek-Dąbrowska Górka Fortified Open-Air Museum is a 10 km race held in the picturesque surroundings of Karczew. Runners can prepare for the start with training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is intended for runners seeking a challenge on a moderately difficult course. It is a great opportunity to test your fitness and enjoy outdoor activity amid the historic fortified open-air museum.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Moderate difficulty
Picturesque surroundings of the fortified open-air museum in Karczew
additional: Training plans ranging from 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and including instructions and expert support. The organizer encourages using the platform to manage the race listing and for marketing collaboration. The date in the race calendar is marked as tentative and differs by one day from the stated event date.

name: Skoczów biega

description: Join the 9th edition of the “Skoczów Runs” cross-country race, held at the Pod Dębem ski lift in Skoczów. This sporting event is organized by Skoczów Municipal Office and the Skoczów Sports and Recreation Centre, and attracts runners of different ages and ability levels. The course runs through scenic areas, giving participants the chance to enjoy some active time outdoors. The event is open to all and promotes a healthy lifestyle and a sense of community.
course_highlights: Course at the Pod Dębem ski lift
Cross-country races in the scenic surroundings of Skoczów
Organized by the local sports and recreation centre
additional: Information about distances and the course route comes from the 2026 edition and may differ in the next edition.

name: Stęszewski Bieg Przełajowy
description: The Stęszew Cross-Country Run is an annual running event organized by the Stęszew Municipality, bringing the local community together through active recreation. The races take place on scenic routes in Wielkopolski National Park, mainly along forest trails and field tracks. The main race offers 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking event and children’s races tailored to younger participants’ ages. The start and finish are on the beach by Lake Lipno, and the time limit is 1.5 hours.
course_highlights: The route is 95% forest trails, field tracks, and unpaved roads
The 5 km race is one forest loop by Lake Lipno and in Trzebaw forest
The 10 km race is two loops of the same route
additional: The race office is open on Friday, 27.03.2026, from 19:00 to 20:00, and on Saturday, 28.03.2026, from 8:30 to 11:30 (for the main race and Nordic Walking) and from 8:00 to 10:30 (for the children’s races). The start and finish are on the beach by Lake Lipno. The participant limit is 300. Net timing is measured using a chip. The route is not certified by the PZLA. The Nordic Walking event starts at 13:15. Parking is available at the Sports and Entertainment Hall and along Trzebawska Street. Previous editions have included children’s races at distances tailored to age and a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The official website lists the contact details: +48 698 050 150, bieg@steszew.pl.

The race takes place at the municipal stadium on Olsztyńska Street and consists of two events: an individual 1.963 km run and an 8 km relay held on the stadium’s tartan track. The event is both sporting and patriotic, and participants can expect commemorative medals and T-shirts. The organizers provide timekeeping and professional race-office services.

The 8 km relay consists of 20 laps of the stadium
Time limit for the individual race: 20 minutes
additional: The race office is open from 10:30 to 12:30 at the Municipal Stadium. The relay starts at approximately 13:00. Each participant collects their race number and race pack in person. The team captain receives a relay baton with a timing chip. Timing chips are returned at the finish. Participant limit: 150 people (70 individual runners + 20 four-person relay teams). In the previous edition, relay teams consisted of 4–6 people; each participant had to cover at least 400 m. Information about distances, fees, and registration for the 2027 edition has not been confirmed.

name: VIII Otwarte Górskie Mistrzostwa Polski
description: The 8th Open Polish Mountain Nordic Walking Half Marathon Championships is a prestigious competition held in the picturesque area of Prudnik and its surroundings. The 21.1 km mountain half-marathon course runs through forests and hilly terrain, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The event is open to all age categories from 18 years old and also includes a shorter, 5-kilometre mountain walk for children, young people and people with disabilities. The competition is held in accordance with the regulations of the Polish Nordic Walking Association and aims to popularize Nordic walking and bring the sporting community together.
course_highlights: A 21.1 km mountain half-marathon course through forested and hilly terrain
A 5 km mountain walk for children, young people and people with disabilities
Start and finish by the Shrine of St. Joseph in Prudnik
additional: Time limits apply to both the 21.0975 km and 5 km distances. The official opening of the competition is at 9:45, with a group warm-up at 9:30. The awards ceremony and prize draw are at 15:05. The competition is held in accordance with the regulations of the Polish Nordic Walking Association. Organizers can be contacted and administrative matters handled via the registration form. Materials from previous editions indicate the location was Prudnik-Las, near the Shrine of St. Joseph. Confirmed distances from the 9th edition are 21.0975 km and 5 km; details of the 8th edition may differ.

name: Wiosenna Lwówecka 5

description: Wiosenna Lwówecka 5 is a race held in Lwówek, and its name indicates a distance of 5 km. The 2025 edition took place on March 22, while available calendars list only an approximate date for the next edition, in March 2027. It’s a way to kick off the spring running season with some sport.
additional: The race office and race-pack pickup on March 22, 2025, were scheduled from 7:30 to 8:30 at Parkowa 2, 64-310 Lwówek. The 2025 edition had its race office at 2 Parkowa Street in Lwówek.

name: WRC Waligóra Run Cross
description: WRC - Waligóra Run Cross is a mountain running festival held in Głuszyca, featuring three distances: an 82 km ultra, a 53 km mountain half marathon, and a 28 km race. The event is part of the Sudetes Mountain Running Festival and is included in the international ITRA and UTMB Index rankings. The course winds through scenic mountain terrain, with challenging climbs and varied surfaces. It is an excellent choice for mountain runners seeking long-distance challenges.
course_highlights: Mountain courses of 82 km (ultra), 53 km (half marathon), and 28 km
Scenic landscapes of the Sudetes
Challenging climbs and varied terrain
additional: The races are listed in the international ITRA and UTMB Index rankings. Results are available on the RaceResult platform. The organizer is Stowarzyszenie Walim Na Żądanie. Registration is handled through Race Result. Information about distances and elevation gains comes from previous editions; details for the 2027 edition may differ.

name: XI Maraton Gocki

description: The 11th Gothic Marathon is an annual running event held in Wojtal, in the heart of the Tuchola Forest, near the Stone Circles Nature Reserve in Odry. The event features three distances: a marathon, a half marathon and a 10 km race, attracting running and outdoor recreation enthusiasts. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and exceptional location, combining sport with the region’s unique natural surroundings and landscapes. It is organized by the Sandry Brdy Local Action Group and the Municipality of Czersk, and is part of the region’s sporting calendar.
course_highlights: The course runs through the heart of the Tuchola Forest
Near the Stone Circles Nature Reserve in Odry, associated with Gothic culture
Picturesque landscapes and the unique natural surroundings of the Tuchola Forest
additional: The event is organized as part of the implementation of the Local Development Strategy (LDS) and the LEADER/Community-Led Local Development component. There are three distances: the marathon, half marathon and 10 km. The event takes place in a picturesque location with a unique atmosphere and a friendly spirit. The 11th edition described here took place on March 28, 2026, with half-marathon and 10 km distances. The Municipality of Czersk was a co-organizer.

description: The 17th Jastrowie Marathon is an annual running event organized by the Municipality and Town of Jastrowie, held at the end of March. Competitors can choose from three distances: the marathon (42.195 km), the half marathon, and a 10.55 km Nordic Walking event. The marathon course is a cross-country route consisting of four loops, passing through forest tracks in the forest district and built-up areas just after the start. Participants who finish receive a commemorative medal and a race package. The event is small-scale, with a limited field of 50 participants, highlighting its distinctive character and local atmosphere.

The marathon consists of four loops
The start and finish are near the Sports and Entertainment Hall and Jastrowie-Miasto railway stop
additional: The race office is located in the Sports and Entertainment Hall and will be open on race day from 7:00 to 9:45. The field is limited to 50 participants, with places allocated in order of registration. Registration will close once the limit is reached, and any overpayments will be refunded. Every participant who finishes will receive a commemorative medal and a race package. The organizer’s information concerns the 17th edition, scheduled for 28 March 2026; it does not confirm a race on 27 March 2027. In 2026, the limit was 50 places, and registration was open until 20 March or until the limit was reached.

name: 20 Półmaraton Warszawski LET’S RUN THIS PARTY!
description: The 21st Warsaw Half Marathon is a prestigious running event held in the heart of Warsaw, attracting both professionals and amateurs. The 21.0975 km course is fast and flat, certified by the PZLA and World Athletics, and passes some of the capital’s most beautiful sights, including views of the Vistula, PGE Narodowy, and the Presidential Palace. The event also features a 5 km race and a rich programme of activities, including the Running&Lifestyle Expo and musical entertainment. The organizers also promote the #BiegamDobrze charity initiative, combining sport with support for those in need.
course_highlights: A 21.0975 km course certified by the PZLA and World Athletics
A very fast, flat course suited to setting personal records
Views of the Vistula, PGE Narodowy, and the Presidential Palace
additional: The start and finish are in central Warsaw, by the Palace of Culture and Science. Participants start in start corrals marked on their race bibs. On race day, baggage storage, changing rooms, and toilets are available. The event also features the 5 km New Balance Bieg na Piątkę and the Running&Lifestyle Expo. The organizers encourage spectators to cheer along the course, with attractions for fans of all ages. The sources provided relate to the 20th edition on 22 March 2026, not the event listed for 4 April 2027. The 2026 half-marathon entry limit has been reached.

name: 25. PKO Półmaraton dookoła Jeziora Żywie...
description: The PKO Half Marathon around Lake Żywieckie is an annual running event traditionally starting and finishing at Żywiec Market Square. The event attracts runners from across Poland, offering a unique course around picturesque Lake Żywieckie. The race atmosphere is enhanced by numerous cheering zones and the support of the local community and volunteers. It is a true celebration of running and cheering in the heart of the Beskids.
course_highlights: Course around Lake Żywieckie
Start and finish at Żywiec Market Square
Support from numerous cheering zones and local residents
additional: The event is organized with the help of more than 100 volunteers. The race course is part of the PKO Crown of Silesian Half Marathons series and the Beskids Euroregion Cup in road running. The event takes place on Sunday, March 14, 2027.

name: 6 Biegam z Czystą Przyjemnością
organizer: Polska Agencja Antydopingowa (POLADA); współorganizator: Fundacja Wychowanie przez Sport
description: Run with Pure Pleasure is a charity hybrid race organized by the Polish Anti-Doping Agency in cooperation with the Sport Through Education Foundation. The event promotes clean sport and fair competition, drawing attention to the harmful effects of doping and unverified supplements. Participants can choose a distance of 5 km or 10 km, completed in person on designated courses in four Polish cities or virtually. The race also welcomes people with disabilities, and proceeds from entry packages go to charitable causes supporting athletes in need.
course_highlights: Distances of 4,999 m and 9,999 m on in-person courses in Chorzów, Warsaw, Kielce and Wrocław
Chip timing on all in-person courses
Option to take part virtually from anywhere in Poland during the designated period
additional: In-person entry packages can be collected at the courses between 8:40 and 9:30 upon presentation of an ID card. Medals are awarded at the finish. Participants taking part virtually receive an entry package and a medal sent by InPost courier within 7 days of the race ending. The participant limit is 1,300. The start location can be changed until 22.03.2026 at 10:00 by contacting the organizers by email. Proof of completing the virtual distance must be submitted by 8 April 2026 at 23:59. The sources refer to the 6th edition, scheduled for 29 March 2026, not the stated date of 28 March 2027. The regulations for the 2026 edition specify a limit of 1,300 participants.

It’s a great opportunity to check your fitness after the winter break, get some fresh air, and spend active time with family or friends. The program includes races for children and young people in different age categories, as well as the Spring Flowers Parade for the youngest participants. Participants can look forward to beautiful medals, prizes, and a special, family-friendly atmosphere on a morning of sport.
course_highlights: Cross-country races at the Municipal Stadium in Mińsk Mazowiecki
Age categories for children and young people
Spring Flowers Parade for children born in 2021 or later
additional: The event is part of the Powiatowa Trzynastka series. Participants can look forward to medals, prizes, and special awards. The races take place at the Municipal Stadium, ul. Sportowa 1, Mińsk Mazowiecki. Detailed information applies to the 2026 edition; the program and fees for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed. In 2026, the event took place at the Municipal Stadium at ul. Sportowa 1.

name: Biegowa Niegowa
description: Biegowa Niegowa - ExtremeJura is a race held in the picturesque village of Niegowa, attracting running enthusiasts and people who enjoy active recreation. The race route runs through the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland, offering participants exceptional views and challenging climbs. The organizers, Grupa ExtremeJura, ensure professional timekeeping and high-quality event organization, guaranteeing a satisfying race experience. The race starts at 10:30 by the amphitheater on Sportowa Street.
course_highlights: The race route runs through the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland
Picturesque views and natural landscapes
Start and finish by the amphitheater in Niegowa

The races include Diabelska Trzynastka, Duszek, Duch, Upiór, and Ultra Demon.

The races include both the shorter Diabelska Trzynastka and the 350-kilometre Ultra Demon.

The final registration deadline for most distances is 20.03.2027; for Ultra Demon 350 km, it is 17.03.2027. You can contact the organizer via the registration form on the website. The registration page lists the distances and provides participant lists. The 2027 edition dates listed there differ from the date 2027-03-28 in the metadata.

description: The Tychy Grand Prix is a series of six long-distance races organized by the SPLA Tychy Athletics Promotion Association. The races are held over 5 km and 10 km distances for women and men, promoting an active and healthy lifestyle among residents of Tychy and the surrounding area. The event is open and welcoming to runners of different ability levels, and participants can compete in individual races or in the overall standings across all six events. The races start at the Paprocany Sports Complex, and the entry fee can be paid on race day or in advance for the entire series.

Held at the Paprocany Sports Complex in Tychy
A series of six races spread throughout the season

Completing at least four races qualified participants to receive a commemorative gift.

name: IX Cartusia Półmaraton
location: Stadion Miejski w Kartuzach, Kartuzy, Poland
organizer: Kaszubskie Stowarzyszenie Kultury Fizycznej / Fundacja Aktywne Kaszuby
description: Cartusia Half Marathon is a prestigious race in the heart of Kashubia, held on a certified, fast half-marathon course (21.0975 km). The route passes through the picturesque landscapes of the Kartuzy region, including lakes, forests and glacial hills, combining sporting competition with the region’s rich historical heritage. The start and finish are at the Municipal Stadium in Kartuzy, and participants can expect extensive facilities and regional Kashubian cuisine. The event is a celebration of running for the whole family, with accompanying races and attractive prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: Certified, fast half-marathon course (21.0975 km)
Picturesque landscapes of the Kartuzy region: lakes, forests and glacial hills
Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Kartuzy, with full facilities
additional: Race packs include commemorative items and access to a recovery area at the finish. The organizers provide support from emergency services (firefighters, police, municipal police and medical services), as well as volunteers. Valuable prizes are raffled among participants in the main race. Tasting regional Kashubian cuisine is an integral part of the event. The start and finish of all races are at the Municipal Stadium, and facilities are available at the nearby Primary School No. 1. The 2026 edition’s program included accompanying races, including children’s races. The information provided relates to the 9th edition planned for 2026; details of the race dated March 28, 2027, have not yet been confirmed.

name: Kibolska Dycha
description: Kibolska Dycha is the fourth edition of the Kolejorz supporters’ race, which will take place at the Malta Regatta Course in Poznań. Participants will cover a 10-kilometre route that includes almost two laps around the lake. The race is open to everyone, with a maximum time limit of 120 minutes, making it accessible to less experienced runners too. The event also includes Children’s Races, which will start earlier, at 10:00. The main race is scheduled to start at 12:00, preceded by a commemorative group photo.
course_highlights: The route includes almost two laps around Lake Malta
Distance: 10 kilometres
Maximum time to complete the route: 120 minutes
additional: The event is organised by the Kolejorz Supporters’ Association. Before the main race starts, all participants will take a commemorative group photo. The event also includes Children’s Races starting at 10:00. The maximum time to complete the route is 120 minutes, allowing people with lower fitness levels to take part too. Information about the route, schedule and time limit comes from the 2026 edition; it does not confirm the details of the 2027 event.

description: Niebieska Fala is a charity run held in Poznań, combining a passion for running with helping people in need, particularly by raising awareness of autism and purchasing therapeutic equipment. The main race route follows the scenic paths of Marceliński Forest and Węgorka Street, with distances of 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic walking event. The youngest participants can take part in the Niebieska miniFala family run, a 1 km route around ENEA Stadium. The event is family-oriented and inclusive, promoting a healthy lifestyle and counteracting the social exclusion of people with disabilities.
course_highlights: The main route is a 5 km loop in Marceliński Forest, with 30% paved and 70% forest surface
New on the route: a section along Węgorka Street, adding variety and improving running comfort
The Niebieska miniFala family run is a 1 km route around ENEA Stadium, with a paved surface that is safe for children
additional: The time limit for completing the main race (5, 10 or 15 km) is 120 minutes. The route is marked with blue-and-white tape, and volunteers assist participants along the way. There is a refreshment station on the route. The MiniFala family run starts at 11:30, the main race at 13:00, and Nordic walking at 12:30. Participation can be transferred to another runner until 10 March 2026. The start and finish are by ENEA Stadium’s Stand No. 2. Information about the route, distances and fees comes from materials for the 2026 edition; details of the 2027 edition may differ. The 2026 edition started by ENEA Stadium’s Stand No. 2, at ul. Bułgarska 17.

name: V Bieg Strażaka
description: The 5th Firefighter Run is an annual race organized by the Dąbrowa Volunteer Fire Department (OSP Dąbrowa) and held in the picturesque village of Dąbrowa. The event attracts runners looking to test themselves on a running course. Timing is professionally provided by Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu, ensuring accurate results and a high standard of organization. The race is scheduled to start at 3:00 p.m., and participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and sporting competition.
course_highlights: Main race: 5 km in the 2026 edition
5 km Nordic walking event
Children’s races and a firefighter competition in full protective gear
additional: The 2026 edition’s program also included a 998 m race for Youth Fire Brigades. Children’s race distances ranged from 300 m to nearly 1,000 m. The information about the program and distances applies to the 2026 edition.

name: V Bieg W samo południe
location: Kompleks sportowy Zespołu Szkół im. Mikołaja Kopernika, Samborowo, Poland
description: The 5th “At High Noon” Run is an annual running event held at the sports complex of the Nicolaus Copernicus School Complex in Samborowo. The race attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, offering an opportunity to compete and spend time actively outdoors. This local event brings the community together and promotes a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: An approximately 10-kilometre loop around Samborowo
A cross-country route running mainly along field tracks
Start and finish at the sports complex of the Nicolaus Copernicus School Complex
additional: Participant limit: 250 people. The time limit is 2 hours. The route is not certified by the PZLA.

name: VIII Półmaraton Świebody i Sulecha
organizer: OSiR „Sulechowianka” w Sulechowie, Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Świebodzinie, Sulechowski Klub Sportowy oraz Wierzbicki Running Project
description: The 8th Świebodzin and Sulechów Half Marathon is a race connecting Sulechów and Świebodzin, organized to promote running and outdoor physical activity. The course runs through the scenic streets of both towns and the localities of Kalsk and Rosin, giving participants the chance to test themselves in a sporting competition. The participant limit is 300. The organizers provide transport from the race office in Świebodzin to the start in Sulechów. The race starts at 11:00 at Town Hall Square in Sulechów.
course_highlights: The course runs from Sulechów to Świebodzin through town streets and along Road No. 276
Passes through the localities of Kalsk and Rosin
Start and finish at town squares: Town Hall Square in Sulechów and John Paul II Square in Świebodzin
additional: The participant limit is 300. The organizers provide transport by bus from the race office in Świebodzin to the start in Sulechów. The bus departs at 9:40 from the car park by Primary School No. 2. The time limit for completing the course is 2 hours 30 minutes; participants must finish by 13:30. The race office is open on race day from 7:30 to 9:30 at the Town Hall in Świebodzin. The participant limit was 300, and the time limit for finishing the race was 2 hours 30 minutes. The organizers provided bus transport for participants from the race office in Świebodzin to the start in Sulechów.

name: Wrocławska Dycha Cztery Pory Roku
description: Wrocławska Dycha Four Seasons is a series of four park runs held in Wrocław at different times of the year. Each race covers a distance of 10 km and follows scenic paths through Wrocław’s parks, giving both amateur and experienced runners the chance to compete and get to know the city. Participants can earn points toward the overall series standings, and generous refreshment stations and commemorative medals await them at the finish. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively amid the unique atmosphere of sporting competition and beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: The routes pass through four different parks in Wrocław
Scenic park paths and forest trails
Each race covers a distance of 10 km
additional: The series consists of four races: the Valentine’s Day Run (February), Wrocławska Dycha Spring (April), Wrocławska Dycha Summer – St. John’s Eve (June), and Wrocławska Dycha Autumn (September). Each race also includes a Great KIDS children’s run, with medals and safe race conditions. Participants can compete in the overall series standings. Generous refreshment stations are available on the course and after the race. The 2027 spring edition is listed for April 4, not March 28. The website schedule also includes the summer race on June 20 and the autumn race on September 26.

name: Cytadela by Night # 113
description: Cytadela by Night is a series of free, timed 5 km runs held in Poznań. The event takes place in the Citadel, offering participants a unique opportunity to run at night. The run is open to everyone who wants to spend time actively and take on the course in the scenic surroundings of the park.
course_highlights: 5 km course
The run takes place in the Citadel in Poznań
Night-time atmosphere
additional: The run is free and timed.

name: Halowe Mistrzostwa Europy Masters - 5 km
location: Ulica Generała Józefa Bema, Toruń, Poland
description: The European Masters Indoor Championships are a prestigious athletics competition for masters athletes, taking place in Toruń on Bema Street. The event is held indoors, and the 5 km is one of the running events. It brings together experienced athletes from across Europe, offering high-level competition and a unique sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: An indoor 5 km race
Events for masters age categories
Location in central Toruń, on Bema Street
additional: The competition takes place from 27 March to 2 April 2026. The event programme is available as a PDF on the organiser’s website. No information about entry fees or online registration is available on the pages reviewed. The available information concerns the 15th edition of the championships, scheduled to take place in Toruń from 27 March to 2 April 2026, not the stated date of 31 March 2027.

name: 18. PANAS Półmaraton Ślężański Piątka Ślężysława
organizer: Miasto i Gmina Sobótka, Ślężański Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sobótce, Klub Biegacza Sobótka, Zespół Szkolno-Przedszkolny im. Janusza Korczaka w Sobótce oraz Centrum Szkolenia Wojsk Inżynieryjnych i Chemicznych
description: Piątka Ślężysława is a 5 km race held as part of the 19th Ślęża Half Marathon, which starts on 20 March 2027 in Sobótka. The course was designed by local runners and has a unique route with no equivalent in Poland. The start and finish are in the centre of Sobótka, and the finish is inside a sports hall, providing comfort for participants. The event promotes physical activity and the tourist attractions of the Ślęża region.
course_highlights: Course designed by runners from Sobótka, unique in Poland
Start and finish in the centre of Sobótka; finish inside a sports hall
Scenic surroundings at the foot of Mount Ślęża
additional: The race finish is inside a sports hall, providing comfort for participants. The course is available to download in .gpx format. The event is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown and the Lower Silesian Half Marathon classification for the Sudeten Mouflon statuette. The race will take place on 20 March 2027. Detailed information about the start time of Piątka Ślężysława was not provided in the available materials.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Zajazd Szmaragd, ul. Kopalniana, Szczecin, Poland
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Szczecin. The course runs through beautiful woodland around Lake Szmaragdowe, with varied uphill and downhill sections, making the event appealing to both beginner and experienced runners. The races aim to promote running and outdoor physical activity, while providing an opportunity for friendly sporting competition. The start and finish are located at Zajazd Szmaragd, and races take place regularly during the season from October to April.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Szmaragdowe
Varied uphill and downhill sections, including the most challenging section about 1.7 km from the start
Start and finish behind Zajazd Szmaragd on Kopalniana Street
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the start, at 10:45. The event also includes races for children in various age categories. The course is permanent, making it possible to compare results over the months and years. The race is scheduled for 4 April 2027, with the start at 11:00. CITY TRAIL Junior races are also held as part of the series.

name: 6 BMWielkanocny
description: The 6th BMWielkanocny is a 10 km race held in Kraków. Participants can prepare with training plans tailored to different experience levels. The organizers offer detailed training instructions and expert support to help runners prepare optimally for race day. The race is part of the running calendar and is aimed at people looking to improve their fitness and achieve good results over 10 km.
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to each runner’s VDOT level. The organizer provides expert support and detailed training instructions. The race listing can be managed and marketing collaboration arranged through the TreningBiegacza platform.

name: Cross maraton u Ryśka vol 82
location: Wieluń-Ruda, Wieluń County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: XII Bieg do Pustego Grobu
organizer: Parafia Rzymsko-Katolicka pw. Świętego Antoniego w Nowej Soli
description: The 12th Bieg do Pustego Grobu is a 10 km race held in Nowa Sól on Easter Monday at 14:00. The course passes important churches in the city, including St. Anthony’s, St. Barbara’s, St. Joseph’s, the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary, and St. Michael’s, as well as the cemetery on Wandy Street. The race has a spiritual and symbolic character, recalling the footsteps of St. Peter and St. John as they ran to the Tomb of the Lord to confirm the Resurrection of Jesus.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through churches in Nowa Sól: St. Anthony’s, St. Barbara’s, St. Joseph’s, the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary, and St. Michael’s
Passes through the cemetery on Wandy Street
Held on Easter Monday at 14:00
additional: The organizer is the Roman Catholic Parish of St. Anthony in Nowa Sól. The race has a spiritual and symbolic meaning, referring to the Easter tradition. No information was found about entry fees or participant limits. The start is scheduled for Easter Monday at 14:00. The 12th edition took place in 2026; available sources do not confirm details of the 2027 edition.

name: 23 Bieg Europejski Mistrzostwa Polski Ciepłowników
organizer: Klub Sportowy Altom Gniezno oraz Przedsiębiorstwo Energetyki Cieplnej w Gnieźnie Sp. z o.o.
description: The 23rd European Run is an annual running event held in Gniezno to commemorate Poland’s accession to the European Union. The 10 km main race follows city streets, with the start and finish at Gniezno’s Market Square. The course is certified by PZLA and consists of a single loop on asphalt and cobblestones. The event attracts runners from many countries, creating an international sporting celebration. After the race, participants can enjoy a recovery meal at the Market Square and attend the winners’ award ceremony.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through Gniezno, on asphalt and cobblestones (5%)
Start and finish at Gniezno’s Market Square
PZLA-certified, single-loop course
additional: The race office is open on Friday, 10.04.2027, from 17:00 to 20:30, and on race day, 11.04.2027, from 11:00 to 15:00 (the location has changed to the sports hall at Primary School No. 2 in Gniezno). The time limit for completing the race is 1 hour 30 minutes. Timing is recorded using chips in the race bibs. After the race, a recovery meal is available at the Market Square (for runners only). The winners’ award ceremony takes place at 18:00 on the stage at the Market Square. The event also includes a Preschoolers’ Run, divided into age groups, with wristbands and T-shirts required. The Polish Heating Engineers’ Championships are intended for employees of the heating industry. Available sources describe the 23rd edition, scheduled for 11 April 2026; details of the 2027 edition have not yet been confirmed.

name: 9 Półaraton Leśny Na Żarcie
location: Leśna polana przy ul. Zakopiańskiej, Legionowo, Poland

description: The 9th "Na Żarcie" Forest Half Marathon is a cross-country race of approximately 21 km, held in a forest clearing on Zakopiańska Street in Legionowo. The course consists of two loops and runs exclusively along forest roads, giving the event a trail-running character. The event is open to adults and also includes free cross-country races for children and young people. Participants receive a race pack with a bib, a sports gift, a meal and a commemorative medal. The race takes place regardless of weather conditions in April, with a 12:00 start.
course_highlights: A cross-country course of approximately 21.1 km over two loops
Runs exclusively along forest roads
Start and finish in a forest clearing on Zakopiańska Street
additional: The race office will be open on 10 April 2026 from 8:00 to 18:00 at Arena Legionowo, and on 11 April from 8:30 in the forest clearing. A baggage drop is available to participants in the main race. The race pack includes a returnable race bib, a baggage-drop bag, a sports gift, a "Na Żarcie" meal and a commemorative medal. Prizes and trophies will be awarded to the top finishers in the overall and age categories, as well as to the top competitors from Legionowo. The race takes place regardless of weather conditions. The main race course is not officially certified. Information about the entry fee and organisation applies to the 2026 edition; details for the 2027 edition may differ.

name: Arm Race Wrocław
price_range: Karnet na 3 starty w 2027 roku: 699 zł; karnet Selection na 2 starty: 699 zł
description: Arm Race is an extreme obstacle race offering a range of formats suited to different experience levels. Participants can choose classic 5 km and 10 km distances in PRO, OPEN and FUN categories, take on multi-hour challenges in the Selection format, or try the fast-paced OCR100. This event is for those looking for sporting competition, technical obstacles and genuine excitement on the course, as well as for families and younger athletes. Arm Race combines movement, endurance and the satisfaction of overcoming one challenge after another.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses with approximately 25 and 40 obstacles
Selection format with 12- and 24-hour challenges
Family course of approximately 1 km, with no competitive pressure
additional: A 2027 season pass is available, covering 3 ARM RACE entries (5 km or 10 km, PRO/ELITE with no extra charge) or 2 entries in the SELECTION format for 699 zł, with an ARM RACE technical cap as a gift. The pass can be purchased by bank transfer to the account of Stowarzyszenie Rajsport Active. Family formats and options for young athletes, with timing and rankings, are also available. The 2027 price list gives season-pass prices but does not confirm the price of a single entry in Wrocław.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. It aims to promote the sport and showcase the scenic appeal of its courses. Held in the picturesque surroundings of the Wielkopolska region, the event offers participants a unique running experience amid beautiful natural scenery. The organizers place particular emphasis on the courses’ visual appeal and the event’s atmosphere, attracting runners of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes in the Wielkopolska region
Courses with strong visual appeal
Organized since 2014 with experience and passion
additional: The event is organized by Stowarzyszenie Biegiem w Las, based in Poznań. It is a recurring event that also includes races for children and young people. In summer 2026, Botaniczna Piątka will celebrate its 10th anniversary. The series has organized running events since 2014. Details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed in available sources.

name: I Charytatywny Otwarty Bieg i Marsz Nord...
Leśny Zryw w Starych Jabłonkach
location: Hotel Anders Beach, ul. Spacerowa 2, Stare Jabłonki, Poland
description: Leśny Zryw in Stare Jabłonki is a race held on the beach at Hotel Anders and in the forest managed by the Stare Jabłonki Forest District. The event combines sport with an ecological initiative to plant a forest, offering two distances: a 10 km individual run and a 5 km family run or walk with tree planting. The event is family-oriented and brings people together, with additional culinary and educational activities for participants and their families. The start and finish are on the beach at Hotel Anders, and the 5 km course runs on gravel and asphalt. Online registration has closed, but registration and payment are available at the Race Office.
course_highlights: 5 km course: 4 km on gravel and 1 km on asphalt
Planting pine saplings along the 5 km course (1 tree per person)
Start and finish on the beach at Hotel Anders; the course passes through the Stare Jabłonki Forest District forest
additional: The Race Office and the start/finish are on the beach at Hotel Anders. Parking is available on the municipal sports field opposite the hotel. The time limit for the 5 km course is 2 hours. Participants receive a timing chip, which must be returned after the race. After the race, there are culinary and educational activities, as well as attractions for children. In the 2025 and 2026 editions, the start/finish and Race Office were on the beach at Hotel Anders, ul. Spacerowa 2. Entry fees from those editions were allocated to charitable causes; details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Mistrzostwa Gminy Kąty Wrocławskie w Bie...
location: Zachowice, Kąty Wrocławskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Niebieska 5-ka
description: Niebieska 5-ka is a race organized in Słupsk by the Foundation for Supporting Unconventional Initiatives “Sub ventum.” The event invites participants to run together and spend time actively. The available information confirms that the race takes place in Słupsk, but does not provide details about the course or distance for the 2027 edition.

name: Towarzyskie Mistrzostwa Polski w 12-godz...
location: Stadion Miejski w Morągu, Morąg, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa jest równa 150 PLN płatne przelewem do 9 kwietnia 2026 r.

description: The Polish Social 12-Hour Cross-Country Running Championships, “Parkowy Ultra Kros #STOPdepresji,” is a unique running event held at the Municipal Stadium in Morąg. Competitors run a loop approximately 1.46 km long for 12 hours. To be classified, they must spend at least 3 hours on the course. The event offers electronic timekeeping, a marked course, and a generous race pack that includes a commemorative medal and refreshments. The race is social in nature and promotes physical activity and support for mental health.
course_highlights: The course follows a loop approximately 1.46 km long
Electronic timekeeping using reusable chips
Medical support on the course and at the Event Base
additional: The race pack includes an original race bib, a marked course, electronic timekeeping, hot and cold drinks, and a cold buffet available throughout the event. Participants receive a commemorative medal. Medical support is provided on the course and at the Event Base. The participant limit is 150. Runners must spend at least 3 hours on the course to be classified. Classification requires at least 3 hours of activity on the course. Details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed in the available materials.

name: Ultra miles of Beskid Wyspowy
location: Łącko, Nowy Sącz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Ultra Miles of Beskid Wyspowy is a recurring running event held in the picturesque Beskid Wyspowy region, in Łącko. The event offers a range of distances, allowing participants to discover the charms of mountain trails and beautiful landscapes. Race packages for all distances include bandanas, and the organizers provide an efficient way to get in touch through the registration form. It’s a great opportunity for mountain-running enthusiasts who want to take on challenging routes and enjoy the atmosphere of a sporting event.
course_highlights: Mountain trails in Beskid Wyspowy
Picturesque landscapes and natural scenery
A range of distances suited to different experience levels
additional: Race packages for all distances include bandanas. You can contact the organizer via the registration form on the website. Race packages for all distances include bandanas.

name: V Bieg na Kokocińcu
description: The 5th edition of the Kokociniec Run is a family running event held in the picturesque Panewnicki Forest in Katowice. The routes follow forest paths with varied surfaces, offering a chance to connect with nature and enjoy outdoor activities. The event brings people together and welcomes both adults and children, who can take part in the family run. All participants receive a commemorative medal reflecting the event’s woodland character. Radio Katowice is the event’s media patron, highlighting the local importance of this sporting initiative.
course_highlights: Routes pass through picturesque parts of Panewnicki Forest
Varied surfaces and natural terrain
A family-friendly run with routes for children
additional: All participants who finish the run receive a commemorative medal featuring leaf motifs and green accents symbolising closeness to nature. The event is family-oriented, with routes suited to children and adults. Radio Katowice is the event’s media patron. Available information concerns the 5th edition, scheduled for 11 April 2026, and describes it as the final edition; it does not confirm an event in 2027.

name: VIII Festiwal Pieszo-Biegowy Przedwiośni...
location: Ciekoty, Masovian? No — Ciekoty, Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 8th Przedwiośnie Hiking and Running Festival is a unique event bringing together lovers of long-distance challenges and mountain scenery in the picturesque village of Ciekoty, at the foot of Łysica. Participants can choose from several distances: Mini Przedwiośnie (25 km), Maraton Przedwiośnie (44 km), Ultra Przedwiośnie (76 km), Giga Przedwiośnie (101 km), and the family-friendly Przedwiośniaczek (7 km). The routes pass through some of the most interesting and picturesque parts of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains, offering challenges for experienced runners as well as options for beginners. The festive sporting atmosphere and close contact with nature make it an ideal way to kick off spring activities.
course_highlights: Routes pass through picturesque parts of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains
Distances from 7 km to 101 km, for runners and hikers
Start and finish by the symbolic manor house of Stefan Żeromski in Ciekoty
additional: The event brings together hikers and runners. The routes are challenging but also accessible to beginners. The start is in front of Stefan Żeromski’s manor house in Ciekoty. Each year, the organizers prepare new routes that visit some of the most interesting parts of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains. The festival is a hybrid event combining walking and running. In 2027, a lower entry fee applies through 31 October (fee details not provided). The edition announced for 2026 had a limit of 500 participants, and finishers were to receive a glass medal.

name: X Rajd Wilczy
description: Rajd Wilczy is an Adventure Race-style sporting challenge combining trail running, cycling, and special stages and tasks. The event takes place in Żory, with participants competing on different routes suited to various skill levels and team or individual formats. It engages whole families and promotes outdoor activity, bringing sport together with adventure and nature. The organizers provide professional event management and attractive routes that require fitness, navigation skills, and teamwork.
course_highlights: PROFI route: 130–150 km, midnight start, running, cycling, water stages, and special tasks; 16-hour time limit
OPEN route: 60–80 km, two-person teams, running and cycling with technical challenges; 6-hour time limit
BIEG route: approximately 20 km orienteering run in forest areas; 5-hour time limit
additional: Routes for different categories: PROFI (two-person teams, 130–150 km, 16-hour limit), OPEN (two-person teams, 60–80 km, 6-hour limit), ROWER (individual competition, 40–50 km, 5-hour limit), BIEG (individual 20 km orienteering run, 5-hour limit), RODZINNA (recreational 5–8 km route, no classification, free entry). The event is organized in cooperation with MOSiR Żory and Hufiec ZHP Żory. Participants must demonstrate navigation skills and physical fitness. The PROFI route starts at midnight. The event has a family-friendly, adventurous character. Details of the 2027 edition, including routes and fees, have not been confirmed in available sources. The 2025 edition was based at the MOSiR Sports and Entertainment Hall in Żory.

name: XI Kuźniański Półmaraton Leśny
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Kultury, Sportu i Rekreacji w Kuźni Raciborskiej

price_tiers.distance: Kuźniańska Leśna Zadyszka - bieg na 10 km
Dyszka z kija - marsz nordic walking

description: The 11th Kuźniański »Rafamet« Forest Half Marathon is an annual sporting event held at the municipal stadium in Kuźnia Raciborska. The main race, a half marathon (21.0975 km), follows scenic forest trails, giving participants a chance to enjoy nature and fresh air. The event also includes a 10 km race and a 10 km Nordic walking event, creating a unique sporting atmosphere. It is organized by the Municipal Centre for Culture, Sport and Recreation in Kuźnia Raciborska, which invites everyone to share in this special event.
course_highlights: The route follows forest trails
Enjoy nature and fresh air
Scenic natural surroundings
additional: The event includes three activities: a half marathon, a 10 km race, and a 10 km Nordic walking event. It is organized by the Municipal Centre for Culture, Sport and Recreation in Kuźnia Raciborska. The event takes place at the municipal stadium in Kuźnia Raciborska. Registration is conducted separately for each activity. The start is scheduled at the municipal stadium in Kuźnia Raciborska. An available source for the 11th edition gives the date as 11 April, which does not match the stated event date of 10 April 2027.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The Grand Prix Truchtacza in Mysłowice is a series of cross-country races organised by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association. The event combines a passion for running with an active lifestyle, promoting health, integration and the joy of physical activity. The races are open to all age groups and ability levels, and participation in the Grand Prix series is free. The organisers foster a supportive community that inspires people to get moving, making the event welcoming and accessible to everyone.
course_highlights: A series of cross-country races in Mysłowice
Several races make up the Grand Prix edition
Results and standings for each race are published by the organiser
additional: Registration for the Grand Prix series is available only at the Race Office on race day. Participation is free. The event is open to all age groups and ability levels. The race regulations are available on the organiser’s website.

name: XVIII Wiszeńska (za)Dyszka
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury Sportu i Rekreacji w Wiszni Małej
description: The 18th Wiszeńska (za)Dyszka is a 10 km race held in Ligota Piękna, in the municipality of Wisznia Mała. The event takes place annually and attracts runners from various places, offering a sporting competition on a scenic route. The start and finish are near Ligota Piękna, and the event is organized by the Culture, Sport and Recreation Centre in Wisznia Mała. The race takes place in April and is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together.
course_highlights: 10 km route
Scenic surroundings of Ligota Piękna
Organized by the local Culture, Sport and Recreation Centre
additional: Registration for the 18th edition closed on April 7, 2026.

name: Zorientowane Kozy
description: “Zorientowane Kozy” is an orienteering race held at the Quarry in Kozy, combining a sporting challenge with active exploration of the area. Previous editions featured competitive courses A, B and C, as well as the recreational R course, designed for people with different levels of experience and for families. The courses run through the former quarry and surrounding forests, where significant elevation changes, steep slopes and variable runnability make careful map reading just as important as pace. Details of the 2027 edition have not yet been confirmed; this description is based on previous editions of the event.
course_highlights: Terrain of the former quarry and surrounding forests
Forest trails, significant elevation changes and steep slopes
Competitive courses and a recreational option for families and beginners
additional: In the 2026 edition, the recreational R course was approximately 2 - 2.5 km long and had no timed classification. The competitive courses had a 75-minute time limit; timing was conducted using the SportIdent system. Details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: 14 Bieg o Złote Gacie

price_tiers.distance: Bieg o Złote Gacie 10 km i Prawie 5-ka

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 65 zł - przelew przez stronę zapisów do dnia 8 marca 2026 roku

tiers.label: tier_2

description: The 14th Run for the Golden Trousers is an annual road race held in Brzeszcze, scheduled for April 11, 2027. The traditional route is 10 km long and runs along Nosala Street. The event also includes a 5 km children’s race and Nordic walking. It is a family-friendly sporting event that promotes physical activity among residents and visitors.
course_highlights: 10 km main race route
5 km children’s race
Start and finish on Nosala Street in Brzeszcze
additional: The race office is open on race day from 7:30 to 11:00. The children’s race starts at 10:00 at the KS “Górnik” Brzeszcze Stadium. The main race and Nordic walking start at 11:30 from Nosala Street. Available source information concerns the 14th edition on April 12, 2026, not a confirmed edition on April 11, 2027. In 2026, the main race and “Almost 5K” were scheduled to start at 11:30 on Nosala Street; the entry fee was 65 zł until March 8 and 75 zł from March 9 to April 8.

name: 14 Półmaraton Jeleniogórski
location: Plac Piastowski, Cieplice, Jelenia Góra, Poland
description: The 14th Jelenia Góra Half Marathon is a unique race set in the picturesque landscape of the Karkonosze Mountains, with views of the mountains. The half-marathon course is certified by the PZLA and passes through charming parts of Jelenia Góra and Cieplice. The event is a great opportunity to enjoy the excitement of sport and spend time actively outdoors. The organizers invite runners to take part in several distances, including the half marathon, 10 km, Cieplicka Piątka, Uzdrowiskowa Mila, and races for children.
course_highlights: A 21.097 km half-marathon course certified by the PZLA
Scenic views of the Karkonosze and Izera Mountains
Start and finish at Piastowski Square in Cieplice
additional: The race office is located in Zdrojowy Park by the Animation Theatre. The event takes place on 11–12 April 2027 (in 2026, it took place on 11–12 April). Available distances include the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1.6 km, and races for children. The half-marathon course is certified by the PZLA. The 2026 program also included 10 km, 5 km, and 1.6 km races, as well as junior races. The race office was located in Zdrojowy Park by the Animation Theatre, and the Sunday races were scheduled to start at Piastowski Square in Cieplice. Free changing rooms and baggage storage, as well as a post-race meal at the finish, were to be available.

name: 18 Półmaraton Dąbrowski
organizer: Centrum Sportu i Rekreacji w Dąbrowie Górniczej
description: The 18th Dąbrowski ArcelorMittal Poland Half Marathon is an annual running celebration in Dąbrowa Górnicza, attracting both elite athletes and amateur runners from across Poland and abroad. The 21.097 km course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association. It is fast and relatively flat, while also scenic, taking runners through some of the city’s most beautiful spots. The event offers substantial cash prizes and professional organization, with refreshment stations, medical support, and pacemakers. The race has a unique atmosphere, and the participant limit of 2,000 reflects the event’s popularity.
course_highlights: Certified 21.097 km course
Fast and relatively flat, ideal for personal bests
Scenic route through some of the most beautiful spots in Dąbrowa Górnicza
additional: Refreshment stations with water and isotonic drinks, medical support, and pacemakers to help runners maintain their pace are available on the course. The participant limit is 2,000. A course map showing refreshment stations and notable locations is available. The organizer provides free parking in designated areas, except for the parking lot in front of CENTRUM Hall and Aqua Park Nemo. Source information for the 18th edition refers to the race held on 12 April 2026. The race office was located at the CENTRUM Sports and Entertainment Hall; the participant limit was 2,000.

name: 40 Bieg Sokoła
description: Bieg Sokoła is an annual running event organized by the Sokół Gymnastics Society in Bukówiec Górny, promoting physical activity and the Włoszakowice Municipality region. The event includes races over various distances, including 15 km, 5 km, 2 km, and 1 km, as well as the Polish Doctors’ Championships over 15 km. The start and finish are located at the Village Cultural Centre in Bukówiec Górny. The event is known for its professional organization, electronic timing, and friendly sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Courses of 15 km, 5 km, 2 km, and 1 km
Start and finish at the Village Cultural Centre in Bukówiec Górny
Electronic chip timing
additional: Participant check-in and race-number collection take place on Saturday from 16:00 to 19:00 and on race day from 8:00 to 10:15. Each participant receives a timing chip, which must be attached correctly to be included in the results. Participants must bring identification for check-in. Runners who start under the influence of alcohol or intoxicating substances are disqualified. Available information concerns the 40th edition, scheduled for 12 April 2026; it does not confirm a date of 11 April 2027.

name: 41 Biegi o Puchar Kocich Gór
location: Kobyla Góra, Ostrzeszów County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The National Races for the Kocie Góry Cup are an annual running event held in the picturesque town of Kobyla Góra. The competition attracts runners from all over Poland, offering the chance to compete on courses of varying difficulty. It is a great opportunity to spend time outdoors and discover the charms of the region. Registration is via an online form, and the organizers warmly welcome both amateur and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Cross-country courses in Kobyla Góra
A nationwide competition
The event includes cross-country championships for people with disabilities
additional: In the previous edition, registration was handled through the UltimaSport online form.

name: 42 Bieg Szpęgawski
location: Stadion Miejski im. Kazimierza Deyny, Starogard Gdański, Poland
organizer: Miasto Starogard oraz Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Starogardzie Gdańskim
description: The 42nd Bieg Szpęgawski z AQ is one of the oldest road races in Pomerania, held since 1983. The race is intended for both amateur and professional runners, as well as young people. The certified 5 km course is historic and symbolic, leading from Szpęgawsk to Starogard Gdański. The organizers provide coach transport to the start and a baggage drop for participants. This event has a rich tradition and attracts runners aiming for records and personal bests.
course_highlights: Certified, fast 5 km course
Historic and symbolic course from Szpęgawsk to Starogard Gdański
Coach transport to the start provided by the organizer
additional: The organizer provides coach transport to the start between 10:40 and 11:20. Transport is not guaranteed after 11:20. Road traffic is completely stopped at 11:45. A mobile baggage drop and a baggage drop under a tent at the start are available. Bags can be collected after the race, at approximately 13:15, at the Deyna Center. The organizer provides free coach transport to the start. A one-mile race is also available. The information provided relates to the 42nd edition in 2026; the date April 11, 2027, has not been confirmed by sources.

name: Bieg Mestwina
description: Bieg Mestwina is a running event held in Przywidz and part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The race offers two main routes, 5 km and 10 km, through the scenic landscapes of Kashubia. It attracts runners of different age groups and ability levels, promoting an active lifestyle and local running culture. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and professional organization, continuing the tradition of the largest running event in northern Poland.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes through the scenic landscapes of Kashubia
The race takes place in Przywidz, surrounded by Kashubian nature
The event is part of the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland
additional: Bieg Mestwina is one of many events in the Kaszuby Biegają series, which includes various distances and locations across Kashubia. The event promotes physical activity and brings the local community together. The series also features children’s and youth races, as well as other accompanying events. In the edition described in the sources, the children’s races are free and require no registration. Open, age-group, and Przywidz municipality resident classifications are listed.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Warszawa
description: Botaniczna Piątka is a series of cross-country races organized by a group of running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place in scenic locations, with an emphasis on the visual appeal of the courses, making it attractive to nature lovers and people who enjoy outdoor activities. It has a friendly, inclusive atmosphere and promotes a healthy lifestyle and the popularity of running in Poland. In 2026, Botaniczna Piątka celebrates 10 years of activity, underscoring its established place in the running calendar.
course_highlights: Cross-country races in scenic gardens and green spaces
Courses on natural terrain with two loops
Organization that emphasizes the visual appeal of the locations
additional: The organizers place particular emphasis on cross-country running and course aesthetics. Events take place in various locations, including the University of Zielona Góra Botanical Garden. In summer 2026, Botaniczna Piątka celebrates its 10th birthday. The series includes 5 km runs and walks; children’s races are also held in Warsaw.

name: Cross Śrem Grand Prix
location: Orlik w Psarskiem, Psarskie, Śrem County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Śremski Sport, Gmina Śrem i Nadleśnictwo Konstantynowo
price_range: 40 zł za jeden bieg online; 120 zł za pakiet czterech biegów; 50 zł w dniu startu

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 40 zł – przy zapisie online na jeden bieg

description: Cross Śrem Grand Prix is a series of trail races held in the scenic forests around Psarskie, near Śrem. The approximately 5.4 km course follows forest paths and paved cobblestones, giving runners a chance to enjoy nature and a sporting atmosphere. The start and finish are at the Orlik sports complex in Psarskie, which also houses the race office and is the venue for the warm-up and official opening. Participants can expect a medal, a recovery meal, and prizes in the age-group classifications. The event is organized by Śremski Sport together with the Śrem Municipality and Konstantynowo Forest District.
course_highlights: Approximately 5.4 km over forest paths and paved cobblestones
Start and finish at the Orlik sports complex in Psarskie, with a modern building and changing rooms
A run through scenic woodland close to the centre of Śrem
additional: The race office, warm-up, and official opening take place at the Orlik sports complex in Psarskie at around 11:45. Participants have access to water, hot tea, and coffee in the new building with changing rooms. The event is funded from the Śrem Municipality budget as part of its programme for preventing and addressing alcohol-related problems and drug addiction. Information about fees and the series is from the 2025–2026 edition. In this edition, the start was scheduled for 12:00; participation in at least three of the four races was required for the final classification.

name: DOZ Maraton Łódź 10K Run
description: The DOZ Maraton Łódź 10K Run is a 10 km race held as part of the DOZ Maraton Łódź. For the 2026 edition, the start is scheduled for 9:00 near Atlas Arena, with the course running through the city streets. It is suitable both for runners taking on this distance for the first time and for those looking to test their fitness at a large city running event. Details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed in the available sources.
course_highlights: 10 km distance through the streets of Łódź
Start near Atlas Arena, according to information about the 2026 edition
The race takes place during the DOZ Maraton Łódź weekend
additional: Information about registration and race-pack collection in the available sources relates to the 2026 edition; race packs were collected at Atlas Arena.

name: Ekonomiczna Piątka
description: Ekonomiczna Piątka is an annual race organized by the Poznań University of Economics and Business, held in the area around Lake Malta. The 5 km course runs on asphalt, making it appealing to both beginner and experienced runners. The event combines sport and socializing, offering a chance to spend time actively in a friendly atmosphere. The race is scheduled to start at 12:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km course around Lake Malta
Asphalt surface
Scenic recreational areas of Poznań

name: IX Bieg Wiosny
description: The 9th Spring Run is an annual running event held at the Tustań Forester’s Lodge in the Naruszewo municipality. Participants can choose between 2.5 km and 10 km runs along forest roads, or a 5 km Nordic walking event. The event combines sport and recreation, attracting runners from across Poland. Commemorative medals, trophies and gifts for the top finishers await participants at the finish. The organizers also provide recovery meals and music, creating a friendly atmosphere for everyone taking part.
course_highlights: The running routes follow forest roads in the Tustań Forest District
Available distances: 2.5 km, 10 km and a 5 km Nordic walking event
The scenic area of the Naruszewo municipality makes for an enjoyable sporting challenge
additional: The main race starts at 11:00. Every participant receives a commemorative medal at the finish, while the top finishers receive trophies and gifts. Recovery meals and music are provided.
