Around 157 runners from across Poland took part. In the 2026 edition, the 10 km race followed two 5 km loops. This information relates to earlier editions and does not confirm details of the 2027 edition.

name: IX Mazurski Bieg na Kulke
description: The 9th Mazury Kulka Run is an annual running event held at the scenic Kulka Holiday Resort near Szczytno. The course has been slightly modified and passes through the beautiful Mazury region, with the start and finish located on the resort grounds. The event is open to runners of various ability levels, and participants can look forward to a positive atmosphere, a medal, and a post-race recovery meal. The event also has a charitable purpose, supporting Kornelia through fairs and auctions. The organizers provide activities for children and young people, as well as the option to stay overnight at the resort.
course_highlights: A scenic course starting and finishing on the grounds of the Kulka Holiday Resort
A slightly modified course through the heart of the Mazury region
An atmosphere full of positive energy and sporting adventure
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 08:30 to 10:30 at the Race Office. Race-day registration is available until the limit of 250 participants is reached (16 places currently available). After the race, a recovery meal prepared by the resort’s cooks will be served. Children and young people can enjoy the resort’s activities under the supervision of instructors, depending on weather conditions. Overnight accommodation is available in 4- and 5-person rooms with bathrooms at Kulka Resort; book by 2 April 2026 at m.bolkowski@szarpie.pl. The event is charitable, with fairs and auctions in aid of Kornelia. For the 2026 edition, the time limit is 105 minutes and the participant limit is 250. The event also features activities for children and a recovery meal.

name: Leśna Pętla Niepołomice
description: Leśna Pętla Niepołomice is a family running and cycling event held amid the forests of Niepołomice Forest. In the previous edition, runners could choose 5 or 10 km, while cyclists competed over 20 km; an easier route was also prepared for children. The information available in the sources concerns the 2026 edition and does not confirm details of the edition planned for 11 April 2027.
course_highlights: Forest routes in Niepołomice Forest
A 5 km loop, with the option to enter the 5 or 10 km race in the previous edition
A 20 km cycling distance and an easier route for children in the previous edition
additional: The available information describes the edition held on 12 April 2026, not a confirmed edition on 11 April 2027. In 2026, a combined classification for the cycling race and 10 km run was also planned.

name: Międzyzdrojska Liga Biegowa
description: The Międzyzdroje Running League is an annual, friendly, family-oriented sporting competition held in Międzyzdroje. In the 2026/2027 season, participants can take part in runs of approximately 5 and 10 km, as well as Nordic walking events of approximately 5 and 7 km. The league is known for its healthy competition and friendly atmosphere, welcoming both regular participants and newcomers who enjoy active recreation. To qualify for the overall standings, participants must complete the required distances in at least four events. Participation is free, and people aged over 14 may take part.
course_highlights: Running routes of approximately 5 and 10 km
Nordic walking routes of approximately 5 and 7 km
Scenic routes in the Międzyzdroje Municipality
additional: Participation is free. To qualify for the league’s overall standings, participants must take part in at least four events and complete the required distances: two 5 km and two 10 km runs, or two 5 km and two 7 km Nordic walking events. Participants must be at least 14 years old. Minors need written consent from a parent or guardian and must be under their supervision. The league final is scheduled for 11 April 2027. Registration is available at protiming24.pl.

name: Perły Małopolski Skała
location: Skała, Kraków County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Perły Małopolski Skała is a trail race held in the area around Skała and Ojców, as part of the Perły Małopolski mountain running series. Participants can choose from three distances: approximately 5, 10, and 20 km, making the event accessible to runners with varying levels of experience. The routes pass through scenic corners of Małopolska, near or within national parks. The Skała edition is scheduled for April 11, 2027.
course_highlights: Three distances: approximately 5, 10, and 20 km
Trail routes in the area around Skała and Ojców
Part of a series that takes runners through scenic corners of Małopolska, often near or within national parks

name: Podkowa Biega
location: Szkoła Podstawowa im. Bohaterów Warszawy, ul. Jana Pawła II 20, Podkowa Leśna, Poland
description: Podkowa Biega is an annual race held in Podkowa Leśna, promoting sport and physical activity among residents of the town and surrounding area. The main 10 km race runs through the town centre and along the scenic paths of Młochowski Forest, showcasing the diverse character of this garden city and its historic landmarks. The event brings the local community together, encourages a healthy lifestyle, and supports the promotion of the town and local businesses. Alongside the main race, shorter races for children and young people are also held, with distances suited to participants’ ages. All running and physical activity enthusiasts are welcome to take part.
course_highlights: A 10-kilometre route through the centre of Podkowa Leśna and Młochowski Forest
A mixed-surface route on asphalt and forest paths
Views of some of the garden city’s most beautiful spots and historic landmarks
additional: The main race has a time limit of 2 hours. The course is not certified by the PZLA and is marked with tape and markers. Timing is electronic, using chips. Children’s and youth races cover distances from approximately 100 m to 1 km, depending on participants’ ages. The start and finish are at Bohaterów Warszawy Primary School, ul. Jana Pawła II 20. In the edition described in the regulations, the children’s and youth races are free of charge, and the main race has a time limit of 2 hours. The start and finish are at Bohaterów Warszawy Primary School, ul. Jana Pawła II 20. These details come from materials for the 2026 edition and may change in 2027.

name: Suwałki Miss Run & Suwalski Bieg z Wąsem
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Suwałkach
description: Suwałki Miss Run & Suwalski Bieg z Wąsem is a colorful and joyful sporting event held in Suwałki, combining sport, fun and a unique atmosphere. The event is aimed at runners of varying abilities, as well as families and groups of friends who want to spend time actively. The programme includes a variety of competitions, including the High Heels Run, the Egg Run, and main races over 3.5 km for women and 5 km for men. The event is also an opportunity for creative fun and shared excitement, with numerous contests for the most interesting outfits and Miss titles.
course_highlights: The High Heels Run combines a sporting challenge with elegance
The Egg Run calls for concentration and precision
Main races over 3.5 km (women) and 5 km (men)
additional: The event also includes the Little Lady and Little Gentleman Run for children. Participants receive commemorative medals. Men are required to have a moustache, natural or artificial. The event promotes creativity and fun, and includes the Suwałki Miss Fashion, Miss Photo and Miss Audience Choice contests. The programme also features children’s races and contests and pageants, including Miss Fashion, Miss Photo and Miss Audience Choice. A moustache, including an artificial one, is required for the Bieg z Wąsem (Moustache Run). The available information concerns the 2026 edition, so details of the 2027 edition may differ.

name: V Bieg Hazoka
description: The 5th Hazok Run is an annual running event organized by MK Team Events and held in Siemianowice Śląskie. The race is part of the MK Team Grand Prix series and attracts runners from the region, promoting an active and healthy lifestyle. Participants can expect professional organization and a unique sports-festival atmosphere. The event also includes children’s races, making it appealing to the whole family.
course_highlights: Running distances of 5 and 10 km, plus 5 km Nordic Walking
Around 75% of the course follows forest trails
Children’s races over distances from 50 to 800 m
additional: The event also includes children’s races and a Nordic Walking event. Participants receive commemorative medals. The event is part of the MK Team Grand Prix series. The courses are not certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA). Price information applies to registration for the 2026 edition.

name: Wiosenna Dycha
description: Wiosenna Dycha is an annual road race held in Lublin, attracting both recreational and experienced runners. The event takes place in spring and is a great opportunity to spend time actively and test your fitness over the 10 km distance. Lublin, one of Poland’s most running-friendly cities, offers participants an appealing course and a sporting atmosphere. The event’s organizer, the Lublin Sports Development Foundation, promotes a healthy lifestyle and a sense of community among runners.
course_highlights: A 10 km road course
The race takes place in central Lublin
An atmosphere that brings recreational and professional runners together
additional: The race is organized by the Lublin Sports Development Foundation, which works to promote physical activity and develop sport in the region. Wiosenna Dycha is one of many running events held in Lublin, with races over different distances and for different age groups. In 2026, the race was scheduled to start at 09:00; information about the 2027 edition has not been confirmed.

name: XIV Bieg Wojciechowy
description: The 14th Wojciech Run is an annual running event held in Serock, attracting runners of different ages. The race takes place on scenic urban routes, with timing provided by Time-Sport. The event also includes children’s races, making it appealing to families and the local community. Serock offers a rich range of recreational and sporting activities, further highlighting the character of the event.
course_highlights: The running routes pass through the center of Serock
Scenic views of the lake and green spaces
Professional timing provided by Time-Sport
additional: The event includes children’s races. Timing is provided by Time-Sport. The event takes place at the Market Square in Serock. No information is available about start waves, participant limits, or race packages. Timing is provided by Time-Sport. Registration for the 14th edition closed on April 6, 2026.

name: XRUN Szczyrk Run
description: Mercure SZCZYRK RUN is a mountain trail race held in picturesque Szczyrk, with its base at Mercure Szczyrk Resort. Runners can choose from a variety of distances, from short courses for children to demanding ultra-distance routes with significant elevation gain. The courses follow atmospheric Beskid trails, offering beautiful views and a classic mountain-running experience. The event is well organized, with clear time limits and starts spread over two days, making participation more comfortable. It is an ideal choice for mountain-running enthusiasts who value a challenge and the beauty of nature.
course_highlights: 45 km course with 2,400 m of elevation gain; 9-hour time limit
15 km course passing Klimczok, Trzy Kopce, and Przełęcz Karkoszczonka
Distances range from 150 m for children to 45 km for experienced runners
additional: The start and finish for all distances are located at Mercure Szczyrk Resort. The time limits are 9 hours for the 45 km course, 7 hours for 25 km, 5 hours for 15 km, and 5 hours for 6 km. Starts are spread over two days: Saturday (7 km and children's distances) and Sunday (longer distances). Children's age categories are for ages 3 to 15. Detailed course maps and descriptions are available on the website. The program also includes a children's race. The official website lists the date as 20 June 2027, not 11 April 2027.

name: XVI Bieg Raszyński
description: The 16th Raszyn National Run is an annual 10 km road race held in Raszyn. The course consists of three laps of approximately 3.33 km, running through the streets of Raszyn amid detached houses. The race is certified by PZLA and takes place on flat asphalt, making it suitable for fast times. The participant limit is 600, and the event attracts runners from across Poland.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified course
Three laps of approximately 3.33 km through the streets of Raszyn
Flat asphalt surface
additional: The participant limit is 600. The start and finish are in Raszyn: the start is on Szkolna Street and the finish is at 1 Unii Europejskiej Street. The race office is open from 17:00 to 20:00 on 7–9 April and from 8:00 to 10:30 on race day. The time limit is 2 hours. Nordic Walking over 5 km is also organized for residents of Raszyn Municipality, with a separate classification and a 10:45 start. Children can take part in the accompanying races free of charge. For the 2026 edition, the participant limit is listed as 600 and the time limit as 2 hours. The program also includes children’s races and Nordic Walking.

name: Bieg Kreta
location: Kletno, Stronie Śląskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Bieg Kreta is an elite mountain ultramarathon held in the Sudetes, offering two routes: the classic 148 km and the extreme 377 km Hardcore. The route follows the famous Sudetes Triangle, covering the three highest peaks of the Sudetes, across varied terrain, mud, snow, and ice. The race runs day and night without long breaks. It is a challenge for experienced runners who want to take on a legendary route and the history of this ultramarathon. The race traditionally starts in Sobótka, and participants are provided with aid stations and mobile support.
course_highlights: The route covers the Sudetes Triangle: Ślęża, Śnieżka, and Śnieżnik
Varied terrain: asphalt, cobblestones, forest trails, rocky sections, and muddy sections
Extreme elevation gain of up to 12,000 m over the 377 km distance
additional: The race traditionally starts on Wednesday at 17:00 from Winiarnia Celtica in Sobótka (ul. Czysta 1). Participants can leave their cars in the parking lot and book accommodation. Mandatory gear for the route: a charged phone, a flashlight with spare batteries, a water container with a capacity of at least 1 l, a hooded rain/windproof jacket, a route map, and a GPS tracker. The organizer plans gear checks and aid stations where participants can access their own drop bags, as well as mobile support. The Classic route is open to people aged 18 and over who have no medical contraindications to long-distance running; the limit includes 80 places for participants who register and pay the entry fee by the required deadline, plus 25 places allocated by the organizer. Candidates for the Hardcore option are vetted by the organizer.

name: Szczyt Wytrzymałości
description: Szczyt Wytrzymałości is an extreme mountain race held on a loop of approximately 4.5 km around Mount Równica in Ustroń. The course features significant elevation gain of around 420 metres per loop, making it physically and mentally demanding. Competitors can choose one of two categories: the 12-hour category, where the number of completed loops counts, or the 24-hour 8848 Everest category, symbolising a climb of Mount Everest. The race is for warriors who want to test their endurance, character and determination on a challenging, technical course.
course_highlights: A loop of approximately 4.5 km with +/- 420 m of elevation gain per lap
Narrow trails, steep climbs and technical descents
A course described as one of the most demanding loops in Polish mountain running
additional: Two race categories: 12H (12 hours to complete as many loops as possible) and 8848 Everest (21 laps, approximately 95 km, a 24-hour limit, symbolising a climb of Mount Everest). The race takes place on a loop around Mount Równica, known for its difficult conditions and significant elevation gain. The course demands great endurance and determination, and the race is a rite of passage and a test of character. Source information describes the 2026 editions, so details about the date of 16 April 2027 are unconfirmed. At the December edition, the start, finish and race office were located at Gościniec Równica.

name: 19 Mini Cracovia Maraton im. Piotra Gład...
description: The Cracovia Marathon is the most important running event in Kraków and Poland’s largest spring marathon. It has been held since 2002. The 42 km and 195 m course passes through historic and modern parts of the city, including the Main Market Square, Wawel Royal Castle and Nowa Huta. The event attracts runners from around the world and is held under the slogan “with history in the background.” The marathon weekend also features accompanying races, including the Piotr Gładki Mini Cracovia Marathon, the 10 km Night Run, roller-skating events and Nordic walking.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Kraków’s Main Market Square
The course passes Wawel Royal Castle and the Cloth Hall
The route passes modern venues such as TAURON Arena Kraków and the ICE Kraków Congress Centre
additional: The marathon weekend also includes the Piotr Gładki Mini Cracovia Marathon (4.2 km), the 10 km Night Run, the Cracovia Marathon on Roller Skates (the full marathon distance, to be completed in a maximum of 3 hours) and a 4.2 km Nordic walking event. Athletes with disabilities compete in wheelchairs in the handbike, rim-push and active-wheelchair categories. In the edition described in the source, registration was open until 10 April or until the entry limit was reached; a “School in the Run” classification for students was also planned. Information about fees and registration applies to the edition described, and not necessarily to the 2027 edition.

name: II Leśny Lament
location: Ośrodek Sportowo-Rekreacyjny „Grzybówka”, ul. Podgórna 50, Rybnik, Poland
description: II Leśny Lament is a trail run in Rybnik, based at the “Grzybówka” Sports and Recreation Centre. The route follows forest trails, making the event a chance for runners to enjoy off-road running and test themselves on natural terrain. Previous editions featured 4-, 6- and 8-hour formats.
course_highlights: Forest trails and natural terrain
Start and base at the “Grzybówka” Sports and Recreation Centre in Rybnik
Previous editions offered 4-, 6- and 8-hour formats
additional: Previous editions of the event took place at 50 Podgórna Street in Rybnik.

name: 7 Nocna Dycha
description: Nocna Dycha Brzeg is a 10 km road race held in Brzeg, Opole Voivodeship. The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA), guaranteeing official measurement and high quality. The race attracts night-running enthusiasts, offering a unique atmosphere and the chance to compete on a certified course in the city centre.
course_highlights: 10 km road course
PZLA certification guaranteeing official distance measurement
The race takes place at night, creating a unique atmosphere
additional: 1,196 runners took part in the 2026 edition.

name: 7. 6 godzin pełnej MOCY
location: Stadion OSiR Targówek, ul. Łabiszyńska 20, Warsaw, Poland
price_range: Bieg indywidualny: 260 zł; sztafeta: 640 zł (ceny z edycji 2026)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa w biegu indywidualnym wynosi 260 zł (dla członków Stowarzyszenia 230 zł)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa w biegu sztafetowym wynosi dla całej sztafety 640 zł (dla sztafet w 100% z członków Stowarzyszenia 540 zł)

description: The 7th edition of the “6 Hours of Full POWER” race will take place on 17 April 2027 at the OSiR Targówek stadium in Warsaw. The event features individual and relay races lasting 6 hours, run on loops approximately 400 m and 422 m long. Participants compete in two groups simultaneously, with results combined. An official split time is recorded at 50 km. The event also includes the Mazovia Relay Running Championships.
course_highlights: The race takes place on a stadium course with loops measuring 400 m and 422.382 m
Official split time at 50 km
Two groups compete simultaneously, with combined results
additional: Participant limit: 70 individual runners and 16 relay teams. A relay team may consist of 4 women, 4 men, or be mixed (at least one woman). The organizer assigns participants to start groups. The entry fee must be paid to the account of the POLSKIE ULTRA Sports Association after completing the registration form. The 7th edition took place on 18 April 2026 at the OSiR Targówek stadium, ul. Łabiszyńska 20. Information about the edition scheduled for 17 April 2027 has not been confirmed.

name: 9 Dziesiątka Babicka
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji Stare Babice

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Zapisy na biegi dziecięce do 31 marca 2026

description: Skynet Dziesiątka Babicka is the largest running event organized in the Municipality of Stare Babice near Warsaw, aimed at running and healthy-lifestyle enthusiasts. The centerpiece is the main 10 km race on a certified course, following flat asphalt roads with an uphill section in the final 100 meters. The event also includes children’s races over shorter distances, without timing and divided into age categories. Participants receive race packs containing a bib with a chip, a commemorative T-shirt, and a sponsor pack. The start and finish are located at 32 Rynek Street in Stare Babice. The time limit for completing the main race is 1.5 hours.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified 10 km course
Entirely asphalt and flat, with an uphill section in the final 100 meters
Start and finish at Stare Babice Municipal Office, 32 Rynek Street
additional: Race packs can be collected at Stare Babice Primary School, 40 Polna Street, on April 17 (17:00–20:00) and April 18 (7:00–11:30). Each pack contains a race bib with a chip, safety pins, a commemorative T-shirt, and a sponsor pack. The start line will close 10 minutes after the starter’s gun. The time limit for completing the main race is 1.5 hours, with an additional 10-minute allowance for runners who pass the 9 km mark after the cutoff. The children’s races start at 9:45, are untimed, and every participant receives a medal. Awards ceremonies take place on the main stage immediately after each children’s race.

name: Bieg Daniela
description: Daniel’s Run is an annual running event held in Smolarnia, in the Strzeleczki municipality. This is the fifth edition of the event, which combines sporting competition with the joy of movement and good fun. Participants can take on a course full of sporting energy, regardless of their experience level. The run is open to everyone who wants to spend time actively and enjoy the atmosphere of running together.
course_highlights: Previous editions included 5 km and 10 km races.
Juniors and people who practice Nordic walking also took part in the event.
The run takes place in Smolarnia, in the Strzeleczki municipality.
additional: Daniel’s Run takes place in Smolarnia and is a sports and recreation event that promotes the joy of movement and good fun. It is a local event organized by the Strzeleczki Municipal Office. In previous editions, runners competed for personal bests or simply for the satisfaction of finishing the race with a smile. Information about the 2027 edition has not been confirmed on the official website; the running calendar lists an indicative date of 18 April 2027 and a distance of 10 km.

name: Bieg po Zdrowie
organizer: Zespół Szkół nr 1 im. Powstańców Śląskich w Kędzierzynie-Koźlu
description: The 11th Run for Health is an annual running event organized in Kędzierzyn-Koźle by the Powstańcy Śląscy No. 1 School Complex. The race takes place on an urban course with professional RFID timing, ensuring precise results. The race is scheduled to start at 12:00, and participants can expect smooth organization and a sporting atmosphere. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity among local residents.
course_highlights: Urban course in Kędzierzyn-Koźle
Professional RFID timing
Organized by a local school – the Powstańcy Śląscy No. 1 School Complex
additional: The event uses electronic RFID timing provided by Time-Sport.pl. The organizer provides comprehensive technical support and timing. The event is open to all and promotes a healthy lifestyle.

name: II Półmaraton Karolewo - Pruszcz
description: The 2nd Karolewo–Pruszcz Half Marathon is a certified 21.0975 km race taking place on 17 April 2027. The course is entirely paved, flat and marked every kilometre, making it conducive to good results. The race office is open on race day, and participants receive race packs containing, among other things, a bib, a timing chip, a T-shirt and a voucher for a recovery meal. The event is organised by the Agro-Economic School Complex in Karolewo, and timing is provided by STS-Timing.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified course
Entirely paved and flat
Course marked every 1 kilometre
additional: The race office is open on race day from 8:30 to 16:00. Race packs contain a bib, a timing chip, safety pins, a voucher for a recovery meal, running memorabilia and a T-shirt. Participants should indicate their T-shirt size in the registration form. Unclaimed race packs will not be mailed or made available at a later date.

name: II Żelechowska Nocna Piątka
organizer: Żelechów Aktywni Sportowo oraz Miasto i Gmina Żelechów
description: The 2nd Żelechów Night Five is an annual race held in Żelechów that kicks off the running season in the town. The event attracts runners of different age groups and ability levels, offering a sporting atmosphere and an opportunity to spend time actively. The race takes place in the evening, giving it a distinctive character and an added attraction for participants. It is organised by the local authorities of the town and municipality of Żelechów together with the Żelechów Aktywni Sportowo group.
course_highlights: Evening road race in Żelechów
5 km distance
First stage of the 2nd Żelechów Running Triad
additional: The race takes place in the evening and is organised by the Żelechów Aktywni Sportowo group. The event is part of the local sporting calendar and aims to promote physical activity among residents. Registration for the race is open. The stated date, 17 April 2027, does not match the organiser’s account of the edition held on 18 April 2026.

name: III Mistrzostwa Polski Masters
organizer: Koszalińskie Towarzystwo Krzewienia Kultury Fizycznej i Polski Związek Lekkiej Atletyki Masters
description: The 3rd Polish Masters Championships is a race organized by the Koszalin Society for the Promotion of Physical Culture, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The competition takes place on Chełmska Mountain in Koszalin and is aimed at masters-category runners. The event combines recreational and competitive sport, with chip timing and overall classifications for women and men. The organizer provides third-party liability insurance, and participants can expect official award ceremonies.
course_highlights: A race on the natural terrain of Chełmska Mountain
Timing with reusable chips attached to shoes
Overall classifications for women and men, with trophies for places 1–3
additional: Information in the sources describes the event held on April 18, 2026; the date April 17, 2027, has not been confirmed. A license was not required for the 2026 edition.

name: Kresowe Trail #2
description: Kresowe Trail in Mielnik is a small-scale trail race held in the scenic Topolina woodland. The event offers two distances: the shorter Szpurt (7.8 km) and the longer Wertep (15.6 km), along carefully marked routes with natural surfaces and green markings. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, respect for nature, and the local natural and cultural attractions of eastern Poland. Participants can expect professional organization, electronic timing, aid stations along the course and at the finish, and commemorative medals for those who register in advance.
course_highlights: Routes marked with green arrows on a yellow background
Two laps on the Wertep 15.6 km distance
An aid station along the Wertep course
additional: Online registration is available until 08:40 on race day. The first race bib is free; if it is lost or you change distances, you can purchase a replacement for 30 zł. The course time limit is 2 hours 15 minutes. The race package includes a hot recovery meal with a vegetarian option, electronic timing, medical support, aid stations at the finish and along the course, and a photography service. Littering on the course is strictly prohibited. The 2026 edition started at 11:00 and had a time limit of 2 hours 15 minutes. The organizer announced electronic timing, medical support, and a hot recovery meal.

name: Nocna Piątka po Głogowskiej Starówce
description: Nocna Piątka po Głogowskiej Starówce is an annual road race held in Głogów. Its scenic course runs along the Nadodrzański Boulevard and through the city’s Old Town. The race takes place at night, creating a unique atmosphere for participants. It is organized by the ZG RUN Sports Club with the support of the local community and the School of Economics in Głogów. It is a great opportunity to compete and spend time actively in the heart of the city.
course_highlights: The course passes through scenic Głogów Old Town
The race takes place in the evening, giving it a distinctive nighttime character
The start and finish are located on Nadodrzański Boulevard
additional: You can officially and safely purchase a race package from another participant. Races for children are also organized. Event locations listed include Nadodrzański Boulevard and the School of Economics in Głogów.

name: OSHEE Bieg Nocny
description: OSHEE Night Run is an annual 10 km race held in the picturesque heart of Kraków, at the Main Market Square. This unique sporting event attracts runners from all over Poland, offering a nighttime atmosphere and professional organization. The course runs through the city’s historic streets, making the race not only a sporting challenge but also an unforgettable adventure. The organizers ensure participants’ comfort and safety along the course.
course_highlights: 10 km course in the center of Kraków
The race takes place at night, creating a unique atmosphere
The course runs through the historic streets around the Main Market Square
additional: Telephone support is available Monday to Friday, 8:00–15:00, at +48 12 616 63 02. Organizer: Sports Infrastructure Management Board in Kraków.

name: Pobiegnij z Siódemką
location: Park Kultury i Wypoczynku and Lasek Południowy, Słupsk, Poland
organizer: Niepubliczna Szkoła Podstawowa nr 7 im. Marii Skłodowskiej-Curie w Słupsku
description: Pobiegnij z Siódemką is a charity cross-country race organized by the Maria Skłodowska-Curie Non-Public Primary School No. 7 in Słupsk. The event takes place in the Park of Culture and Recreation and the Southern Forest, and aims to support the treatment and rehabilitation of a child with a cleft palate. The race combines sporting competition with helping those in need, engaging the local community and sponsors. This is the event’s fourth edition, and it has developed a charitable and community-building character.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Park of Culture and Recreation and the Southern Forest
Charity race supporting the treatment of a child with a cleft palate
High-quality organization thanks to support from local sponsors
additional: The race is a charity event, and the funds raised support Mateusz Gulbitowicz’s treatment. It is organized by a local school and supported by many regional sponsors. Previous editions raised more than 7,000 złoty for charitable causes. In previous editions, the race supported Mateusz’s treatment and rehabilitation; the funds were transferred to the Siepomaga Foundation’s account.

name: Sportowa Gra Miejska
location: Szkoła Podstawowa nr 4, Osiedle Paderewskiego, Katowice, Poland
description: The Sports City Game in Katowice is an extreme urban adventure taking place on April 18, 2026, in the Paderewski Estate and around the Three Ponds Valley. Participants can choose from three routes, including a family route with special tasks for parents and children. The game combines physical and logic-based challenges, offering a unique way to explore the city by completing a variety of tasks. The event attracts both fans of physical activity and those who want to discover the city in an unusual way.
course_highlights: Three routes to choose from, including a family route with special tasks
Explore the Paderewski Estate and the Three Ponds Valley
Physical and logic-based challenges at checkpoints
additional: Registration will be available on the day of the event. A two-person trip to Prague, Vienna or Budapest will be drawn after the awards ceremony. The event base is at Primary School No. 4 in the Paderewski Estate. Three routes have been announced, including a family route for parents and children. Event base: Primary School No. 4. Registration is set to open on March 9.

name: Wiosenna Hała
description: Wiosenna Hała is a walking orienteering marathon organized by KS Hała in the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship, in the village of Ruda. The event offers courses of varying difficulty, with the event base at Widok 1. Participants tackle challenging routes with numerous checkpoints, making it an event for fans of navigation and endurance. The start takes place in the afternoon, and the time limit for completing the course is 14 hours. Wiosenna Hała is a great opportunity to test your skills in the outdoors and compete with other orienteering enthusiasts.
course_highlights: TP50 course with 40 checkpoints
14-hour time limit to complete the course
Event base in Ruda, Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship
additional: The late-arrival time limit on the course is 14 hours. The TP50 course has 40 checkpoints. The event is organized by Klub Sportowy Hała. The event base is at the primary school in Ruda, Widok 1, 27-230 Ruda. A cycling course is also listed.

name: Kudowska Sztafeta Górska
description: Kudowska Mountain Relay is an international running event held in the scenic areas of Table Mountains National Park and Broumovské Stěny in Kudowa-Zdrój. The event includes a 3x25 km relay for teams of three and a solo run of approximately 75 km. There are also races over 42 km, 21 km, and 10 km, as well as Kids Trail races for children. The start and finish are in Kudowa-Zdrój Spa Park, and the routes follow varied mountain trails, offering exceptional views and challenging climbs.
course_highlights: Routes pass through Table Mountains National Park and Broumovské Stěny
The 3x25 km relay is divided into three different stages
A solo run of approximately 75 km with a challenging mountain profile
additional: The start and finish of all races are in Kudowa-Zdrój Spa Park, by the Teatr pod Blachą. The race office is located in the Mineral Water Pump Room in Kudowa-Zdrój. The event takes place on 10–11 April 2027. Entry-fee waivers are available to athletes with a high ITRA ranking. The organizer does not provide accommodation but recommends Kudowa-Zdrój as a place to stay. There are also races for children in three age categories and over three distances. Volunteering opportunities are available; the coordinator is Sylwia Niezgódka. The event is scheduled for 10–11 April 2027. Online registration is available; the organizer also announces fee waivers and preferential rates for selected athletes with an ITRA ranking.

name: 8. Gdańsk Maraton
description: Energa Gdańsk Marathon is an annual running event held in Gdańsk, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad. The marathon route passes some of the city’s most distinctive landmarks, including the European Solidarity Centre, the retractable footbridge to Ołowianka Island, the Baltic Philharmonic, the Neptune’s Fountain, the Gdańsk Shakespeare Theatre, and ERGO Arena. The start and finish are at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The event uses staggered start waves, and participants can expect a full race pack and extensive support along the course.
course_highlights: The route passes the European Solidarity Centre and the retractable footbridge to Ołowianka Island
Views of the Baltic Philharmonic, Neptune’s Fountain, and the Gdańsk Shakespeare Theatre
The start and finish are at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, with a visit to ERGO Arena
additional: The marathon starts in waves. The start line will close 5 minutes after the final starting signal. Holders of a Gdańsk resident card receive a 10% discount on the entry fee. The race pack includes a bib with a chip, a medal, medical support, course refreshment stations, a hot meal at the finish, and gifts from sponsors. The official marathon T-shirt and backpack are available for purchase. The event is scheduled for 24–25 April 2027; the website lists the marathon, a 5 km race, a relay, and the Junior Marathon. Entry fee details are not provided in the available sources.

name: 15 Półmaraton Henrykowski
description: The 15th Henryków Half Marathon is a trail race that passes through scenic parts of Lower Silesia, including Krzelków, Muszkowice and Muszkowicki Forest. The start and finish are by the historic Cistercian Monastery in Henryków, adding a historical and cultural dimension to the event. The route combines asphalt and gravel surfaces, offering runners varied terrain. The event promotes physical activity, regional culture and local tourism. Participants can expect a commemorative T-shirt, a medal and a recovery meal.
course_highlights: The route passes through Krzelków, Muszkowice and Muszkowicki Forest
Asphalt and gravel surfaces
Start and finish by the historic Cistercian Monastery in Henryków
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:45 on race day. Race numbers with timing chips are issued at the race office upon presentation of a QR code. Participants receive a technical T-shirt, a medal and a recovery meal. Bag drop and toilets are available at the start. Overall and age-group classifications are provided for the 21 km and 10 km races and the 10 km Nordic Walking event. Cash prizes are awarded to the top finishers in the half marathon. The route is not certified by PZLA. A 10 km race and 10 km Nordic Walking event are also available. Information about the 15th edition refers to 19 April 2026; there is no confirmation that the event will take place on 18 April 2027.

name: Bieg Pamięci - wokół Góry Śmierci
location: Ekspozycja Historyczno-Dydaktyczna przy Górze Śmierci, Paszczyna, Poland
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji Gminy Dębica, Gmina Dębica, Akademia Piłkarska Gminy Dębica „Chemik Pustków” i Kępa Sport
description: The Memorial Run around Góra Śmierci is an annual sporting event held in Paszczyna to commemorate the victims of Nazi labor camps and promote a healthy lifestyle and physical activity. The event takes place at the Historical and Educational Exhibition at Góra Śmierci and includes children’s races over short distances, a 5 km Nordic Walking march, and a 10 km main race. Main-race participants receive a race package, and classifications and prizes are provided for both children and adults in various age categories. The main race is scheduled to start at 12:00.
course_highlights: 10 km main-race route around Góra Śmierci
5 km Memorial Nordic Walking march
Children’s and youth races over distances from 50 m to 1,000 m
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 11:30 and closes 15 minutes before the start of each distance. The main-race entry fee includes a race package. Prizes are awarded for places 1–3 in the main race, as well as in the age-group classifications. OPEN category winners are not also awarded in the age groups. The event takes place at the Historical and Educational Exhibition at Góra Śmierci in Paszczyna. Registration is handled by KępaSport.

name: Bydgoski Bieg Urodzinowy
description: The Bydgoszcz Birthday Run is an annual running event held in Bydgoszcz, taking place on April 18, 2027. The race starts at 11:00. The participant limit is 1,500, and the first 1,300 people to register will receive a T-shirt. The route will be announced soon. The event attracts runners of different age groups and experience levels.
additional: Participant limit: 1,500. A T-shirt is available to the first 1,300 people to register. A T-shirt is provided for the first 1,300 registered participants.

name: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński
organizer: Arek Tołłoczko i Rafał Malitkowski, przy wsparciu Stowarzyszenia na rzecz Rozwoju i Integracji Chwałowic
description: The Chwałowice Napoleonic Marathon is a small-scale running event held in the picturesque village of Chwałowice, surrounded by forests and fields. The marathon route follows forest and country roads in a peaceful, uncrowded setting, with an emphasis on camaraderie and the recreational nature of the race. The organizers, including Arek Tołłoczko, invite runners to take part in four editions of the marathon each year, offering varied conditions and beautiful views. The start and finish are on Polna Street, and the route is well marked and prepared for runners.
course_highlights: A 42.195 km route along forest and country roads
Start and finish on Polna Street in Chwałowice
Picturesque views of forests and fields, with a peaceful, uncrowded atmosphere
additional: A 7 km running route laid out and marked by the Harcownik Running Club; the event is not mass-participation, with a relaxed approach to competition and prizes; convenient parking; four marathons held each year (in winter, spring, summer, and autumn). Descriptions of previous races indicate a marathon distance of 42.195 km; the organizers have not provided confirmed details for the edition on 18 April 2027.

name: Cross na sześć łap
description: Uniejów Cross on Six Paws is a unique race for dog-loving sports enthusiasts, held in the picturesque Warta River areas near Uniejów Castle. Participants can choose between 5- and 10-kilometre routes, combining sport, adventure and time in nature. The race ambassador is Jakub Krzemiński, a canicross world champion, who brings his experience and passion to the course. At the finish, medals, trophies for the top finishers and refreshments await both runners and their four-legged companions. The event is open to anyone who wants to spend active time with their dog and enjoy a sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: The route passes through picturesque areas along the Warta River near Uniejów Castle
Distances of 5 and 10 kilometres are available
Run as a duo with your dog, surrounded by nature
additional: At the finish, participants will receive medals, trophies for the top finishers, refreshments and water, as well as treats for dogs. The event takes place by Uniejów Castle. The race ambassador is Jakub Krzemiński, 2025 IFSS Canicross World Champion. Advance registration is required. The previous edition also featured children's races over 100 and 300 m. The event ambassador is Jakub Krzemiński, 2025 IFSS Canicross World Champion.

name: Dziki tor run
description: Dziki Tor Run is the inaugural edition of a race held on the motocross track on Hoża Street in Mieroszów. It’s a unique opportunity to test your endurance on natural, challenging terrain where enduro motorcycles compete every day. The course has no technical obstacles, but its natural slopes and bumps challenge participants. The race is open to both beginners and more experienced runners looking for a thrill.
course_highlights: Motocross/enduro track with natural terrain
No technical obstacles, but challenging slopes and bumps
Course in Mieroszów on Hoża Street
additional: Distances: 4 km (one lap) for beginners and 8 km (two laps) for more experienced runners. Registration is open until 15 April at 23:59. The race starts at 11:30. The event takes place on the motocross track on Hoża Street in Mieroszów. Available calendars list an estimated date of 19 April 2027, one day later than the stated date of 18 April.

name: IV Białołęcki Bieg Leśny
description: The 4th Białołęka Forest Run is an annual running event held in Warsaw’s Białołęka district. The race takes place on a forest course, giving participants the chance to enjoy nature and varied running conditions. The organizer, the Małopolskie Szlaki Foundation, provides professional event services and RFID timekeeping. The participant limit is 500, and the start is scheduled for 10:00.
course_highlights: Forest course in Warsaw’s Białołęka district
Professional RFID timekeeping
Participant limit of 500
additional: The participant limit is 500. The event takes place in Warsaw’s Białołęka district. The organizer provides electronic RFID timekeeping. The start is at 10:00. The participant limit for the 2026 edition was 500. Registration closed on April 13, 2026; timekeeping was provided by Time-Sport.pl.

name: IX Bieg Jelenia
description: Bieg Jelenia is the open Tychy cross-country championships, held in the scenic Paprocany forests. The course is approximately 7–8 km long and consists of two 3.5–4 km loops, following forest tracks and terrain with natural obstacles such as roots, mud, fallen branches and soft sand. The event is co-financed by the City of Tychy and also includes Bieg Jelonka for children and young people. The race starts at the Paprocany Recreation Centre in Tychy.
course_highlights: A 7–8 km cross-country course over two loops
Natural obstacles: roots, mud, fallen branches and soft sand
The scenic Paprocany forests
additional: Bieg Jelonka for children and young people also takes place during the event. The start and finish are at the Paprocany Recreation Centre (Parkowa 17, Tychy). The race is co-financed from the City of Tychy budget. Bieg Jelonka for children and young people accompanies the event. Available information about the ninth edition points to 2026, so details of the specified edition and the 2027 date may not be confirmed.

name: Poznań Półmaraton
location: ul. Roosevelta near Międzynarodowe Targi Poznańskie, Poznań, Poland
description: The PKO Poznań Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Poznań, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad. The half-marathon course runs through the city streets, offering an exciting sporting experience and an opportunity to test your fitness. The organizers make sure the event has a family-friendly atmosphere, also offering an activity zone and races for children and young people. The event is well organized and highly regarded in the running community.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course runs through the streets of Poznań.
In 2026, the race started on Roosevelta Street, near the Poznań International Fair.
The previous edition’s course ran through Łazarz, Grunwald, Junikowo and Ławica.
additional: Registration for the 19th PKO Poznań Half Marathon will open in December. The rules and price list are being finalized and will be announced soon. The organizers are providing an activity zone and races for children and young people as accompanying events. The course and program are being prepared, and participants are encouraged to follow the official information channels. Registration for the 2027 edition is expected to open in December; the entry form is being prepared.

name: Siedlecki Maraton Na Raty
organizer: Fundacja Ultramaratonu Nadbużańskiego, Agencja Rozwoju Miasta Siedlce oraz Triathlon Siedlce Club
description: The Siedlce Stage Marathon is a unique running event held in Siedlce, offering two distances to choose from: a marathon and a half marathon. The race takes place in three stages at three different locations: City Park, Sekulski Forest, and Muchawka Reservoir, making it an exciting challenge spread over three days. The event has a new format that allows participants to tackle the distance in stages, and also includes races for children. The organizers provide professional event support and an awards ceremony at the finish.
course_highlights: Three stages held at three locations: City Park, Sekulski Forest, and Muchawka Reservoir
Choice of distance: marathon or half marathon
Children’s races during the final stage
additional: The race office is open on April 17 from 17:00 to 18:30 at the Rectorate of the University in Siedlce. The awards ceremony will take place on April 19 at around 15:15 by Muchawka Reservoir. Children’s races take place during the final stage, starting at 14:45. Participants may use poles; Nordic Walking is classified only in the half marathon. The combined participant limit for the marathon and half marathon is 200. Information about fees and details of the 2027 edition is not available in the sources provided. Previous editions also featured children’s races and Nordic Walking competition over the half-marathon distance.

name: TAURON 23. Cracovia Maraton
description: The Cracovia Marathon is Kraków’s most important running event and Poland’s largest spring marathon over the 42 km and 195 m distance. Held since 2002, it attracts runners from around the world, representing more than 80 countries. The course passes through historic and modern parts of Kraków, with the start and finish on the Main Market Square, beside landmarks such as Wawel Royal Castle and the Cloth Hall. The event also offers a weekend full of sporting attractions, including the 10 km Night Run, the Mini Cracovia Marathon, roller-skating races and Nordic walking.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Kraków’s Main Market Square
The course passes Wawel Royal Castle and the Cloth Hall
Views of the Old Town at night during the 10 km Night Run
additional: The event also includes the Mini Cracovia Marathon (4.2 km), the Cracovia Marathon on Skates (the full distance around the Błonia, with a maximum time limit of 3 hours), a 4.2 km Nordic walking event and the 10 km Night Run, with a time limit of 1.5 hours. Participants with disabilities compete in wheelchairs in the handbike, rim push and active wheelchair categories. The event is international in character and is held under the slogan “with history in the background”.

name: VI Oleśnicki Bieg Leśny
location: Miodary, Oleśnica County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 6th Oleśnica Forest Run is a trail race held in the picturesque area of Miłowice. The event attracts runners who enjoy natural forest terrain, offering a challenging course with varied surfaces. Open to all, it is a great opportunity to spend time outdoors and compete with runners of varying experience levels.
course_highlights: Forest course with varied surfaces
Picturesque views and natural surroundings
Trail challenges for runners
additional: The available information about the sixth edition concerns an event scheduled for 19 April 2026; it does not confirm a date of 18 April 2027. In the 2026 edition, children’s races were scheduled for 10:00, the half marathon for 10:30, and the 10 km race and Nordic Walking for 11:00.

name: XVIII Bieg Piaśnicki
organizer: Gmina Wejherowo i The North Event
description: The Piaśnica Run commemorates the victims of the German occupation of Poland during World War II. The running and Nordic walking routes pass through places where thousands of innocent people were murdered. The event aims to honor the victims, promote a healthy lifestyle, and bring the local community together. The program also includes cultural events such as exhibitions, lectures, and concerts that shed light on the history of Gdańsk Pomerania.
course_highlights: Running and Nordic walking routes through historic sites of wartime atrocities
Commemoration of the victims of the German occupation of Poland
Cultural events: exhibitions, lectures, concerts, and meetings with historians
additional: The event includes runs and Nordic walking. It promotes a healthy lifestyle and community integration. The event is commemorative and educational. Previous editions have also included races for children and young people. Details of the 2027 edition have not yet been confirmed in available sources.

name: XXXIII Memoriał Uliczny im. Michała Flud...
ITMBWieczorem
location: Bulwar Poleski, near Dębnicki Bridge, Kraków, Poland
description: ITMBWieczorem is a weekly series of free 5 km and 10 km runs along Kraków’s Vistula Boulevards. The runs take place every Thursday at 20:00, starting and finishing on Bulwar Polejski by Dębnicki Bridge. The course follows the Vistula Boulevards to the Field Redoubt on Tyniecka Street, where runners turn around. From March to April and from October to November, the runs are held only over 5 km. Participation is free and open to people over 14 years of age.
course_highlights: Course along the Vistula Boulevards, with a turnaround at the Field Redoubt on Tyniecka Street
Start and finish on Bulwar Polejski by Dębnicki Bridge
5 km and 10 km distances (the 10 km distance is two laps of the 5 km course)
additional: Participation is free. Time limits: 40 minutes for 5 km and 1 hour for 10 km (the latter is recommended for advanced runners). After completing 25, 50, and 100 runs, participants can order a commemorative T-shirt for 25 zł. A small number of belongings can be left at the start area (the organizer is not responsible for items left there). The runs are organized on a friendly, informal basis, with care taken around pedestrians and cyclists. Registration via a form is required. Participants should bring a printed race number or barcode. The runs take place on Thursdays at 20:00; the 2027 season schedule has not been confirmed.

name: 7 Bieg Korczaka
organizer: Specjalny Ośrodek Szkolno-Wychowawczy nr 1 dla Dzieci Niepełnosprawnych Ruchowo w Policach im. Marii Grzegorzewskiej
description: The 7th Korczak Run is an annual running event organized by Special Education Center No. 1 for Children with Physical Disabilities in Police. The event includes a 5 km main race, Nordic walking, and children’s races over various distances, including races for children in wheelchairs. The main race route consists of two loops with an additional section, making for an interesting and varied course. The event promotes inclusion and physical activity among people of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The main race route consists of 2 loops with an extra section
The event includes children’s races over distances from 200 to 600 meters
Nordic walking is available over a distance of 5 km
additional: Medals for race participants. Forms are available to download: transfer of a race entry, guardian’s statement/consent, and authorization to collect a race pack. Recommended parking areas are listed on the website. Numerous photo galleries and videos from previous editions are available. The event website provides registration, regulations, and a course map. Electronic timing by B4SPORT is available.

name: XXXVI Biegi im. Tomasza Hopfera
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Janowcu Wielkopolskim
description: The 36th Tomasz Hopfer Runs is an annual running event held in Janowiec Wielkopolski. The main event is a 10 km race that attracts runners from various regions. The organizers also offer races for children, promoting physical activity among the youngest participants. The course is certified, ensuring it has been accurately measured and professionally prepared.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km race course
Children’s races tailored to different age groups
Scenic areas of Janowiec Wielkopolski
additional: The event is organized by the Sports and Recreation Center in Janowiec Wielkopolski. Phone: +48 452 469 185. The program includes races for children and the main 10 km race. The website includes regulations and results from previous years.

name: PKO Gdynia Półmaraton 35. PZLA Mistrzostwa Polski w Półmaraton
description: PKO Gdynia Half Marathon is one of the largest running events in Poland and will take place on April 24, 2027. The half-marathon course runs through the modern city of Gdynia, showcasing its unique modernist character. The race starts in the evening at 19:30, so runners finish after dark, creating a special atmosphere. The event attracts individual runners, relay teams, and participants in accompanying 5 km and children’s races.
course_highlights: A half-marathon course of over 21 km through Gdynia
Evening start at 19:30, with the finish at City Beach after dark
A PZLA-certified 5 km course, as well as children’s races and relays
additional: The half-marathon participant limit is 15,000. The time limit for completing the half-marathon is 4 hours. The entry fee can be transferred to the next edition up to 14 days before the event. Refunds are available up to 45 days before the race if registration took place within the first 30 days after entries opened. Half-marathon relays consist of teams of 3. The 5 km course is PZLA-certified. The children’s race (Kids Run) takes place on Saturday at midday, with a unique medal at the finish. The event will also include 5 km races, relays, and Kids Run. Early registrants can receive a full refund if they withdraw up to 45 days before the race; the fee can be transferred free of charge to the next edition up to 14 days before the event.

name: 43 Bieg Kujawiaka
location: Stadion Przylesie, ul. Wesoła 16, Włocławek, Poland
organizer: Lekkoatletyczny Klub Sportowy VECTRA we Włocławku
description: The 43rd Bieg Kujawiaka is the oldest sporting event in the region, held in memory of Napoleon Dzwonkowski and Wiesław Wesołowski. The event attracts people who enjoy physical activity and runners from various places, and takes place at Przylesie Stadium in Włocławek. It is a long-standing tradition that brings the local community together and promotes a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: Children’s and youth races over distances from 400 m to 2,000 m
Main race: 10 km
5 km Nordic walking event
additional: The races take place at Przylesie Stadium, 16 Wesoła Street. Information about the program and fees is from the 2026 edition and may not apply to the event on 24 April 2027.

name: 8 Bełchatowski Bieg Nocny
organizer: Miejskie Centrum Sportu w Bełchatowie oraz Bełchatowski Klub Lekkoatletyczny
description: The 8th Bełchatów Night Run is a unique sporting event that combines running competition with the one-of-a-kind atmosphere of an evening run through the streets of Bełchatów. Participants cover a 10-kilometre course certified by PZLA, making it suitable for setting personal bests. The start and finish are at Gabriel Narutowicz Square, and the evening timing adds to the event’s distinctive character. The event promotes an active lifestyle and brings the local running community together.
course_highlights: 10-kilometre certified course through the streets of Bełchatów
Start and finish at Gabriel Narutowicz Square
Evening start at 21:00, with a time limit of 1 hour and 40 minutes
additional: The race office is in the concert hall of the Municipal Cultural Centre at 3 Narutowicz Square and is open from 18:00 to 23:00. A baggage drop is available for participants’ personal belongings. Participants must be over 16; minors must have permission from a parent or guardian. Timing is recorded using chips in the race bibs. The participant limit is approximately 400. Information about the 21:00 start and the 1-hour-40-minute time limit comes from the previous edition. Details of the edition scheduled for 24 April 2027 have not been confirmed in the available sources.

name: Backyard Ultra TRICITY
description: Backyard Ultra TriCity is a unique ultramarathon in a format that originated in the USA. Runners start every hour and must complete a 6.706 km loop. After completing the loop, they can rest until the next full hour, when they begin another round. The race continues until only one runner remains at the start and completes the final loop within the one-hour time limit. This is a demanding and exciting race in which only one winner is crowned.
course_highlights: 6.706 km (4.167 mile) loop
Start every full hour
One-hour time limit to complete each loop
additional: Runners have 15 minutes to rest after completing a loop if they finish it in less than 60 minutes. The race takes place in Gdańsk. The organizer provides the rules for download. The race is for adults. Information for the 2027 edition has not been confirmed; the available registration page is for the 2026 edition.

name: Bieg Zająca
description: Bieg Zająca is one of the Warsaw Grand Prix events, held in the picturesque Kabaty Forest. The event offers running routes of various lengths, suited to runners of different ability levels. Participants can expect professional organization, a race package, a commemorative medal, and a hot meal after the race. The event has a family-friendly, community-oriented atmosphere, with prizes for the top finishers and special recognition for the oldest participant and the funniest costume.
course_highlights: Routes in Kabaty Forest — natural woodland trails
Time limit: 60 minutes for the 5 km race and 80 minutes for the 10 km race
Start and race office on the clearing beside the Kabaty Metro Technical Depot
additional: The race office opens at 09:00. Race bibs are issued only on race day. A special trophy for the oldest male or female participant and recognition for the funniest costume. Prizes in the overall and age-group classifications. Participant limit: 450.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin
description: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin is the spring edition of a popular cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque UMCS Botanical Garden in Lublin, highlighting the scenic qualities of the chosen venue. The race is recreational and athletic in nature and is part of a series of cross-country races in Wielkopolska and other cities. The organizers promote running and a friendly atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the UMCS Botanical Garden
Picturesque and scenic race setting
Organized with passion since 2014
additional: The organizer is a group of running enthusiasts active since 2014 and specializing in cross-country races. In summer 2026, they will celebrate the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka. Trzymsie.pl is a partner of the autumn series. Previous editions included races for children over four shorter distances; details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed in available sources.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice in 2026, organized by the Amateur Running Enthusiasts Club “Pędziwiatr.” The events aim to promote healthy, active outdoor recreation, under the motto “Let yourself be provoked into fighting laziness!” The 4,219.5 m course runs through a municipal forest, mainly along forest and gravel paths, with refreshment points at the finish after each lap. Participants can choose from 1 to 5 laps, covering distances from approximately 4.2 km to a half marathon. The time limit is 3 hours for running and Nordic Walking.
course_highlights: A 4,219.5 m course in Gliwice’s municipal forest
Runs mainly along forest and gravel paths, with some sections on asphalt
A refreshment point at the start/finish line is available after each lap
additional: The events take place once a month on Saturdays. Participants can choose from 1 to 5 laps of the course (from approximately 4.2 km to a half marathon). The time limit is 3 hours for running and Nordic Walking; e-Prowokacja has no time limit. Bib numbers are valid for the whole year and must be returned after each race. After the event, participants receive a drink and a sausage or banana, as well as a chance to win a bar in a prize draw, if permitted by sanitary regulations. Registration is available online and at the race office on the day of the event. The event includes running and Nordic Walking; prior registration and payment of the entry fee are required to be included in the results.

name: III Bieg Pełną Parą dla Dzieciaków
Paratriathlon Kraina Liwca
location: Pałac i Folwark Łochów, Łochów, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Leny Grochowskiej i Stowarzyszenie Arche
description: Paratriathlon Kraina Liwca is a charity team event that brings together people with and without disabilities. It takes place in the picturesque Liwiec Valley at the Łochów Palace and Folwark. The event consists of three stages: a 5.5 km run, a 7 km kayak trip and a 22 km bike race. The running route passes through green spaces and historic buildings, while the kayak trip takes place on the Liwiec River. The event promotes physical activity and social inclusion, and proceeds from entry fees go towards creating supported housing.
course_highlights: 5.5 km run on the grounds of Łochów Palace and Folwark — 3 laps through picturesque green spaces and past historic buildings
7 km kayak trip on the Liwiec River, with equipment provided and life jackets required
22 km bike race through Karczewizna, Twarogi, Matały, Zambrzyniec and Kamionna, returning to Łochów Palace and Folwark
additional: Teams of 3–4 people, with at least 1 person holding a disability certificate. The kayak trip uses equipment provided by the organiser; life jackets are mandatory. Time-trial bikes and road bikes with aerodynamic wheels are prohibited, as is drafting during the bike race. Timing is electronic, using chips. The race office is open on 24 April from 17:00 to 19:00 and on 25 April from 8:30 to 12:30. The organiser provides transport for participants to the kayakers’ start. After the event, there will be an open food area and a concert. The start and event are based at Łochów Palace and Folwark. The 2026 edition’s rules allowed teams without a person holding a disability certificate, but added 30 minutes to their result. Route and organisational information is from the 2026 edition.

name: Pelplin Forest Run
description: Pelplin Forest Run is a running and Nordic walking event held in Rajkowski Mill since 2024. The start, finish, and race office are located at the kayak marina, and the routes pass through the scenic Bukowiec Forest District. The event is co-organized by the Kociewie Sports and Cultural Association and the Pelplin Municipality Sports Club Sprint Kulice, offering participants the chance to enjoy nature and sporting competition in beautiful woodland surroundings.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the Bukowiec Forest District
Start and finish at the kayak marina in Rajkowski Mill
Running and Nordic walking in a natural woodland setting
additional: The co-organizers are the Kociewie Sports and Cultural Association and the Pelplin Municipality Sports Club Sprint Kulice. The distances and location provided are from previous editions; details for the edition on 24 April 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Wiosenny Fesiwal Biegowy
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Żywcu
description: The 33rd Spring Running Festival is an annual event organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Żywiec. It includes a cross-country race up Grojec and accompanying races for children. The event takes place in the picturesque surroundings of the Amphitheatre at the foot of Grojec, giving participants the chance to enjoy the outdoors and stay active. Runners of all ages and abilities are invited to take part in this sporting tradition.
course_highlights: Cross-country race up Grojec
Accompanying races for children
Scenic route around the Amphitheatre at the foot of Grojec
additional: The festival features the 33rd edition of the Cross-Country Race up Grojec, as well as accompanying races for children. The rules are available as an attachment on the organizer’s website. Course and programme information is from the 2026 edition; details for the edition scheduled for 24 April 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: XLIV Uliczny Bieg Bartów
location: Stadion w Barcianach, ul. Sportowa 1a, Barciany, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Przy zgłoszeniach internetowych udział osób niepełnoletnich jest bezpłatny.

description: The 44th Jan Liniewski Bart Street Race is a traditional road race held at the stadium in Barciany. The event has a rich history and welcomes different age groups, from preschoolers to adults, including participants with disabilities. The main race course is approximately 3,800 metres long and runs through the streets of Barciany. Participants can expect electronic timekeeping, medals and prizes, as well as a friendly atmosphere and support from spectators.
course_highlights: The main race course is approximately 3,800 m long and runs through the streets of Barciany
Age categories range from preschoolers to adults, including a race for participants with disabilities
Start and finish at the stadium in Barciany, ul. Sportowa 1a
additional: The race office is open from 8:30. Registration and race-pack collection are available until 45 minutes before the start of each category. Electronic timing uses a returnable chip. Medical care is available on site. Prizes are drawn after the race. Bib numbers must be worn on the chest or on a special belt at the front of the body. The co-organiser of the previous edition was the Warmian-Masurian LZS Association. The available information on distances and fees relates to the 2026 edition and therefore does not confirm the participation terms for 2027.

name: XVIII Złotowski Bieg Zawilca
description: The 18th Złotów Anemone Run is an annual running event held in Złotów, aimed at people who enjoy running, active recreation and a sporting atmosphere. The race takes place on courses suited to different groups of participants, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the local community together. The event is open and welcoming to runners of varying experience levels. The organizers provide professional event management and attractive conditions for starting and competing.
additional: The event is co-organized by the Złotów Municipal Office, Granqvists Manufacturing Sp. z o.o. and the Alfred Sokołowski District Hospital in Złotów.

name: XXIX Bieg o Puchar Dyrektora MOSiR
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Czechowicach-Dziedzicach
description: The 29th Run for the MOSiR Director’s Cup is an annual road race held at the MOSiR Stadium in Czechowice-Dziedzice. The course is 10 km long and clearly marked every 1 km, with a water station at 6.2 km. Runners start with electronic timing, and a commemorative medal, water and a recovery meal await them at the finish. The event is a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy friendly sporting competition.
course_highlights: 10 km course marked every 1 km
Water station at 6.2 km
Electronic chip timing, with the chip attached to the race bib
additional: The race office is open from 10:30 to 12:30 before the start. The time limit is 45 minutes for 5 km and 90 minutes for the full race. The race bib must be pinned to the front of the shirt and is non-transferable. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 15:00. The 29th edition took place on 25 April 2026. Registration for this edition was online only; the organiser did not offer race-day registration.

name: XXXV Biegi Uliczne Wiosna Cekowska
location: Publiczne Przedszkole w Cekowie-Kolonii, Ceków-Kolonia, Poland
description: The 35th Wiosna Cekowska Street Races is an annual running event held in Ceków-Kolonia, attracting runners of different ages and ability levels. The races take place on the town’s streets, giving participants the opportunity to compete in a friendly atmosphere and spend time outdoors. The event is local in scope and an important sporting fixture in the municipality’s calendar.
course_highlights: Street race in Ceków-Kolonia
The course runs along the town’s scenic streets
A local event with a long-standing tradition
additional: The available sources concern the 2026 edition, held on April 25; they do not confirm details of the 2027 edition.

name: Pieniny Ultra Trail Spiski Wędrowiec - 135.7 km
description: Spiski Wędrowiec is a 135.7 km mountain ultramarathon held in the picturesque Pieniny Mountains. The race starts at the dam on the Czorsztyn Reservoir in Niedzica and finishes at Dietl Square in Szczawnica. The course passes nine aid stations and offers exceptional views and challenging climbs. Participants can expect professional organization, transport to the start, and commemorative medals for finishers.
course_highlights: A 135.7 km route through the Pieniny Mountains with 9 aid stations
Start at the dam on the Czorsztyn Reservoir; finish in Szczawnica
Transport from Szczawnica to the start and a drop bag in Tylmanowa
additional: The time limit for finishing the race is 30 hours. Buses to the start depart from Szczawnica at 15:50. Mandatory equipment includes a race bib and shoe-mounted chip, a water container with a capacity of at least 1 liter, and a mobile phone with a working battery. Plastic cups are not provided at aid stations. Participants receive a 30 l drop bag for Tylmanowa and a guide with the event’s key information. Prizes and trophies are provided for the top competitors, and every finisher receives a commemorative medal. The organizer provides transport from Szczawnica to the start in Niedzica. A 30 l drop bag for Tylmanowa is available; required equipment includes, among other things, a fluid container with a capacity of at least 1 l and a mobile phone.

name: Zamczyska Trail
location: Drewniane altany nad Czarnym Potokiem, Rymanów-Zdrój, Poland
description: Zamczyska Trail is a legendary mountain race held in picturesque Rymanów-Zdrój, with its base by the wooden shelters above the Czarny Potok. The event offers three challenging courses: a marathon (42 km), a half marathon (21 km), and a 10 km race, all with substantial elevation gain and aid stations along the route. The courses follow marked and unmarked hiking trails, and the organizer provides additional markings to make navigation easier. The race attracts experienced trail runners, offering a sporting challenge and beautiful views.
course_highlights: Mountain courses with substantial elevation gain: 600 m (10 km), 1,150 m (21 km), 2,300 m (42 km)
The marathon course consists of two half-marathon loops
Aid and hydration stations on the courses: 1–3, depending on the distance
additional: Participant limit: 250 across all courses, with the possibility of an increase at the organizer’s discretion. Full race package guaranteed for participants whose entry fees are paid by 31.03.2027. Start and finish by the wooden shelters above the Czarny Potok. Time limits: 2h15' (10 km), 4h (21 km), 7h (42 km). Participants must be at least 18 years old (16 for the 10 km with consultation and a guardian). ASICS trail shoe testing at the event. Awards ceremony for the top finishers at 13:00. The regulations list the date as 18.04.2027, not 25.04.2027; these dates conflict. The limit is 250 participants across all courses, and online registration is scheduled to remain open until 15.04.2027 or until all places are filled.

name: 16 Cieszyński Bieg
organizer: Miasto Cieszyn, Město Český Těšín, Správa účelových zařízení, Szkolne Schronisko Młodzieżowe w Cieszynie oraz Agencja Sportu i Reklamy Andrzej Filipiak
description: The Cieszyn FORTUNA Run is an international road race held in the historic city of Cieszyn, which stretches across both banks of the Olza River. The approximately 10 km course runs through the streets of Cieszyn and Český Těšín, along the riverside boulevards, offering attractive views and sporting excitement. The event attracts runners from various countries, and participants receive commemorative shirts and medals. Spectators line the course, and musical and dance performances add to the event’s friendly, joyful atmosphere.
course_highlights: The course runs along the Olza River on both the Polish and Czech sides of Cieszyn.
The race consists of two laps, with a total distance of approximately 10 km.
The course passes through the stadium in Český Těšín, between the stands and the field.
additional: The main race is limited to 1,200 participants. Runners must be at least 16 years old; minors must provide a statement from a parent or guardian. The time limit for completing the course is 75 minutes. The race pack includes a race number and a commemorative technical shirt. There is a sprint bonus on the course in Český Těšín. The course has been slightly modified due to renovation work on Božkova Street. After the race, cash and non-cash prizes will be awarded to the top finishers and in age categories. The race office will be open on 25–26 April 2026. The source information refers to the 16th edition, scheduled for 26 April 2026, not to a date of 25 April 2027. For the 2026 edition, the main race is limited to 1,200 participants, and youth races are also listed.

name: 23 Bieg Jakubowy
description: LOTTO 23rd Jakubowy Run is a road race in Olsztyn with a tradition spanning more than twenty years, organized by the HORUS Association. The 10 km course, certified by PZLA, passes through the city’s most beautiful and charming spots, with the start and finish in Olsztyn’s Old Town by the fountain. The event is one of the most popular running events in the Warmia and Masuria region and takes place at the beginning of the running season. In addition to the main race, children’s races and a 10 km Nordic Walking event are also held.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Olsztyn’s Old Town by the fountain
The course passes through Podzamcze Park, along the boulevards by the Łyna River and the avenues by the lake
10 km road course certified by PZLA
additional: Side events: children’s races over distances of 150–200 m, 300 m and 400 m, and a 10 km Nordic Walking event. The start and finish are located in the Old Town by the fountain, and winners are presented with awards after each race. The race office also allows registration and payment of entry fees on race day, if places are still available. The previous edition’s program included children’s races in three age categories and a 10 km Nordic Walking event. Available sources refer to the 23rd edition in 2026; they do not confirm the date of 25 April 2027.

name: 35 Maraton Juranda
description: The 35th Jurand Marathon is a historic race held since 1981 and one of the most important marathons in Poland. The certified course is exceptionally flat and entirely paved, making it ideal for setting personal records. The race passes through the scenic Masuria region, including its villages, forests and the landscapes of the Land of a Thousand Lakes. The event combines competitive running with a picnic atmosphere and is open to all running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Certified, flat marathon course of 42.195 km
Entirely paved course, with no uphill or downhill sections
Scenic Masurian countryside, villages, forests and the landscapes of the Land of a Thousand Lakes
additional: Race packs can be collected at the race office on Saturday, 25.04.2026, from 16:00 to 18:00, and on race day, 26.04.2026, from 6:00 to 8:30. All distances start together at 9:00; wheelchair participants start at 8:55. The marathon time limit is 6 hours. Supporting races: the Knight’s Half Marathon (21.0975 km), Jurand’s Daughter’s 10K (10 km), and children’s and youth races over 800 m, 600 m and 300 m. The available materials concern the 35th edition scheduled for 26 April 2026, not the stated date of 25 April 2027. Start, finish and race office: Świetlica Gminna, Lipowiec 48B. The marathon time limit is 6 hours.
