name: 42 Memoriał Winanda Osińskiego
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Szczecinku
description: The Winand Osiński Memorial Street Run in Szczecinek is an annual running event with a long tradition, organized by the Sports and Recreation Centre in Szczecinek. The main 10 km street race runs through the city on roads closed to vehicle traffic. The course is marked every kilometre and has a refreshment point. The event also includes youth races over various distances to promote physical activity among children and young people. The main race is scheduled to start at 13:00, and participants can expect professional timing and a unique sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through the streets of Szczecinek, closed to vehicle traffic
Course markings every kilometre and a water refreshment point
Electronic timing using chips in race bibs
additional: The time limit for the main race is 2 hours. The start and finish are on Piłsudskiego Street (the start is near “Mała Poczta”; the finish is at the Czesław Kazimierz Lis Municipal Stadium). Race bibs must be attached to the front of the shirt and remain visible throughout the race, or the runner may be disqualified. Youth races start at 8:55, with age groups and distances ranging from 400 m to 1,000 m. The organizer also invites organizations to set up stands during the event. Registration is through the Datasport service. The time limit for the main race is 2 hours.

name: 66 Biegi Ulicami Sieradza
description: The 66th Biegi Ulicami Sieradza is an annual road race held at the Market Square in Sieradz. The event features 5 km and 10 km races, and the PZLA-certified course runs along the city’s asphalt streets. The event promotes physical activity among different social groups and families, encouraging a healthy lifestyle. The race office opens at 9:00, and the main races start at 11:30.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified asphalt course
Two 5 km laps for the 10 km distance
Start and finish at the Market Square in Sieradz
additional: The participant limit is 250 paid entries. The time limit is 90 minutes for the 10 km and 50 minutes for the 5 km. After the time limit, participants must leave the course and will not be classified. The program also includes children’s races and a corporate relay. The race office opens at 9:00, the corporate relay starts at 10:00, the children’s race starts at 11:00, and the warm-up is at 11:15. The race office opens at 9:00. The 400 m family run is free.

name: Bieg Twierdzy Kraków
description: Bieg Twierdzy Kraków is a cross-country race held in Park Reduta in Kraków, with 5 km and 10 km routes. The course runs mainly along paths and forest tracks, with one significant climb, combining sport with the chance to discover the history of the former Kraków Fortress. After the race, participants can tour forts, ramparts, casemates and other historic sites with a guide, making the event a unique combination of physical activity and historical education. The organizers aim to promote running in the city’s green spaces and offer unique trophies made from 100-year-old bricks.
course_highlights: Cross-country route along paths and forest tracks
One substantial climb on the course
Tour of historic Kraków Fortress sites after the race
additional: After the race, participants and accompanying guests can tour historic sites of the former Kraków Fortress with a professional guide. The top finishers receive handmade trophies made from 100-year-old bricks. The running routes are off-road and green, with history in the background. Available distances are 5 km and 10 km. After the race, participants can join a guided tour of historic Kraków Fortress sites.

name: Chorzowska Dycha
location: Boisko przy ul. Społecznej, Maciejkowice, Chorzów, Poland
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Rekreacji i Sportu w Chorzowie (MORiS)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 60 zł – przy zapisie od 16.03.2026 r. do 20.04.2026 r.

description: Chorzowska Dycha is an annual road race organized by the Municipal Recreation and Sports Centre in Chorzów. The race starts on the sports field on Społeczna Street in the Maciejkowice district. It attracts both local runners and people from the surrounding area who enjoy physical activity, offering the chance to compete over a distance of 10 km. The course will be published at a later date, and participants can expect professional organization and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the sports field on Społeczna Street in Chorzów–Maciejkowice
10 km distance on the streets of Chorzów
Course details to be announced later
additional: Entry fee payments are processed via Przelewy24.pl. On race day, registration is available until 09:15 at the Race Office, provided places are still available. The organizer manages a dozen or so sports facilities in Chorzów and is involved in numerous sporting and cultural events in the city. OPEN classifications for women and men, as well as classifications for female and male residents of Chorzów, have been announced. A commemorative medal will be awarded to participants who finish the race.

name: DG24h Ultramaraton
description: DG24h Ultramarathon is a 24-hour ultramarathon held in Zielona Park in Dąbrowa Górnicza. Competitors aim to cover the greatest possible distance in 24 hours on a certified 1,175.96 m loop. The event has a rich history and is organised by the “W pogoni za duchem” Association, promoting a healthy lifestyle and a passion for sport. This unique event attracts runners from across the country, offering a comfortable course surrounded by greenery and a lake, as well as the opportunity to set official records.
course_highlights: A 1,175.96 m loop certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)
The course runs through scenic Zielona Park in Dąbrowa Górnicza, amid greenery and alongside a lake
Round-the-clock competition on a loop, providing comfort for runners and spectators
additional: The race starts at 12:00. The course is officially certified, allowing results to be recognised in official statistics and records. The organiser provides a comfortable event base in Zielona Park. The event is a 24-hour test of willpower with no distance limit, in which the aim is to cover as many kilometres as possible. The 2027 edition is scheduled for 24–25 April, starting on 24 April at 12:00. In addition to the individual 24-hour race, a 24-hour relay and 12- and 6-hour races are available. Entry fees for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Festiwal Biegów Górskich 3xKopa
description: The 3xKopa Mountain Running Festival is a running event held in the Opawskie Mountains, featuring a variety of mountain routes with different elevation gains and distances. The routes follow hiking trails, roads, and paths through the Polish-Czech mountains, with organizer-provided signage and aid stations along the way. Participants can expect professional organization, including marked routes, stations with drinks and snacks, and the option to collect race packets at convenient locations. The event promotes a healthy, active lifestyle and encourages running as a form of recreation.
course_highlights: Routes follow hiking trails and paths through the Polish-Czech Opawskie Mountains
Aid stations along the route with drinks, snacks, and a hot meal for ultramarathon runners
Routes marked with tape, washable chalk, and arrows, with officials stationed at key points
additional: The race office is located at Karczma Raj in Pokrzywna and on the grounds of Muszla Leśna in Głuchołazy. Race bibs can be collected at various locations and times. Routes have different distances and elevation gains, including Vertical (3.7 km, +530 m), blue loop (10 km, +/-450 m), green loop (20 km, +/-1150 m), yellow loop (22 km, +/-1150 m), red loop (21 km, +/-900 m), and black loop (40 km, +/-1700 m). The official website lists the festival dates in 2027 as 15–17 October, which differs from the date of 25 April given in the metadata.

name: II Charytatywny Bieg
description: The 2nd Charity Run of St. Ursula Ledóchowska in Koszalin brings runners and the local community together around sport and helping others. Organized by the Sport, Recreation and Volunteering Association “SFX,” the run is open to everyone and promotes physical activity and volunteering. The route passes through scenic areas of Koszalin, and participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and support from the organizers. It is a great opportunity to combine sport with a good cause and spend time together outdoors.
course_highlights: A route in Koszalin with views of the surrounding area
An inclusive run open to participants of different ages and fitness levels
Organized by a local association promoting sport and volunteering
additional: The organizer is the Sport, Recreation and Volunteering Association “SFX,” based in Koszalin. The event is charitable and inclusive. There is no entry fee; participation is free. A map of the route is available on the website. For telephone inquiries, contact Michał Bieliński at +48 696 137 257 (no SMS). The event includes a family picnic. Proceeds will support the establishment of the Zakład Aktywności Zawodowej z Miłością in Koszalin. The available information concerns the edition scheduled for 26 April 2026; it does not confirm a date of 25 April 2027.

name: IV Siemianowicki Bieg i Nordic Walking
location: Pomnik Wojciecha Korfantego, Siemianowice Śląskie, Poland
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji „Pszczelnik”, Urząd Miasta Siemianowice Śląskie oraz Stowarzyszenie Sportowe Siemianowice i Przyjaciele Biegają

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa zawodnika startującego w Nordic Walking wynosi: – 30 zł – uiszczona do dnia 10 kwietnia

description: The 4th Siemianowice Śląskie Run and Nordic Walking “In the Footsteps of Wojciech Korfanty” is an annual sporting event held in Siemianowice Śląskie to commemorate the 153rd anniversary of Wojciech Korfanty’s birth. The event takes place by the Wojciech Korfanty monument and includes a 10 km run and a 6.8 km Nordic walking event. The routes run through the city streets, giving participants a chance to spend time actively and honour an important historical figure. The start is scheduled for 9:45 a.m., and everyone over the age of 16 is warmly invited to take part.
course_highlights: A 10 km run through the streets of Siemianowice Śląskie, starting and finishing by the Wojciech Korfanty monument
A 6.8 km Nordic walking route including Aleja Sportowców, Stara Szosa, Chopina and other streets
The run route passes through a variety of city streets and cycling paths
additional: Registration and payments are accepted only until 10 April 2026 at 24:00; registration is not available on race day. Participants must be at least 16 years old. Payments must be made through the DOTPAY system after completing the registration form. The information concerns the 26 April 2026 edition; available sources do not confirm details of the event scheduled for 25 April 2027. In 2026, participants were required to be at least 16 years old.

name: IV Wielkoocki Bieg
location: Zespół Szkolno-Przedszkolny, ul. Leśna 13, Wielkie Oczy, Poland
organizer: Gmina Wielkie Oczy, Stowarzyszenie Centrum Inicjatyw Społecznych „Terra Nostra” oraz Centrum Kultury w Wielkich Oczach

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa: 50 zł, płatność wyłącznie online

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa: 50 zł, płatność wyłącznie online

description: The 4th Wielkie Oczy Run and Nordic Walking event promotes an active, healthy lifestyle and brings participants together. It is organized by the Wielkie Oczy Municipality in cooperation with the “Terra Nostra” Social Initiatives Centre Association and the Cultural Centre in Wielkie Oczy. The courses run mainly on paved roads and forest roads, and may be changed depending on weather conditions. After the races, the organizers invite participants to a social bonfire with food and drinks. Participants can expect electronic timing, a chip-equipped race bib, a medal, and a hot meal after the race.
course_highlights: 10 km running course — one loop, mainly paved roads and forest roads
6 km Nordic Walking course — one loop
Water stations on the running and Nordic Walking courses
additional: Field limit: 100 runners and 50 Nordic Walking participants. Start and finish at the School and Preschool Complex in Wielkie Oczy, ul. Leśna 13. The time limit for completing the running course is 2 hours (until 12:00). Participants must sign a declaration that they are taking part at their own risk. The chip-equipped race bib must be worn in a visible place, and the chip must be returned after finishing. A social bonfire with food and drinks will follow the event. Overall and age-group classifications for women and men, as well as a Nordic Walking classification. Awards: a commemorative medal for every participant who finishes, and trophies for the top finishers in the classifications. Organizational information on the municipality’s website relates to the edition scheduled for 20 September 2026; the earlier edition planned for 26 April 2026 was canceled. Online registration for the September edition was scheduled to run from 10 August to 10 September 2026, with limits of 100 runners and 50 Nordic Walking participants.

name: Knurowska Dycha
location: Hala sportowa przy ul. Górniczej, Knurów, Poland
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Knurowie
description: Knurowska Dycha is the first race in the Knurów Running Grand Prix series, held in the picturesque town of Knurów. The race starts outside the sports hall on Górnicza Street, and the 10 km course offers participants an attractive setting for competition and recreation. The event draws runners from a range of backgrounds, creating a sporting atmosphere and an opportunity to spend time actively outdoors. Registration is open until 15 April or until the entry limit is reached, and the start is scheduled for 11:00.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Start outside the sports hall on Górnicza Street
The race is part of the Knurów Grand Prix
additional: There is a limit on the number of race entries. The race starts outside the sports hall on Górnicza Street. It is part of the Knurów Grand Prix series. In previous editions, the start was scheduled for 11:00. Details about registration and the entry fee for the 2027 edition were not available in the sources.

name: Kresowe Trail #3
description: Kresowe Trail is an intimate trail-running event organized by the Kresowe Maratony Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity amid the natural surroundings of eastern Poland. The event brings together passion, competition, and friendship, offering routes of varying lengths for both beginners and experienced runners. The races are held with respect for local communities and the natural environment, and participants can expect professional organization, medical cover, and a comprehensive race pack. The route in Tykocin passes through scenic areas, and the time limit for completing the distances is 2 hours and 15 minutes.
course_highlights: Trail routes marked with colored arrows (green on a yellow background for Szpurt, red and purple for Wertep)
Aid stations along the Wertep route
Scenic areas of eastern Poland, with respect for nature and local communities
additional: The race pack includes a hot recovery meal with a vegetarian option, electronic timekeeping, a free race number with a chip valid for the entire season, Medival medical cover, an aid station at the finish and on the route (for Wertep), a carefully marked route, awards for the top athletes in age categories, points toward the series’ overall standings, a commemorative medal (for online registration at least 10 days before the race), and photography services. Littering is strictly prohibited, and gel and bar wrappers may be left in the aid-station area. A fee of PLN 30 applies if a race number is lost or changed. The 2026 edition also featured Nordic Walking and competitions for children and cyclists. Information about distances and organization refers to the previous edition and may not apply in 2027.

name: Ksawerowska Piątka
description: Join the first-ever Ksawerowska Piątka Run, taking place on April 25, 2027, in Ksawerów. The certified course runs along the streets of the Ksawerów Municipality, offering a great opportunity to set personal records. The event is organized by Fitness Klub Shape from Ksawerów, which will provide a unique atmosphere, plenty of attractions, activities for children, and a family gathering picnic. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Head of the Ksawerów Municipality, and participants can look forward to attractive race packages and prizes.
course_highlights: The course is certified
The run takes place along the streets of the Ksawerów Municipality
The organizer will provide activities for children and a community picnic
additional: The first 100 people to register will receive a ticket to Helios cinema in Pabianice. Plans include coaching and nutrition advice, as well as prizes for the winners and the two fastest residents of Ksawerów. The event also includes children's races.

name: Nasza Dycha

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 75 zł – dla zapisanych na bieg i wszystkich zawodników Nordic Walking, wpłacone na konto organizatora poprzez formularz zgłoszeniowy

description: Nasza Dycha is a certified road race held in Gostyń, offering two distances: 10 km and 5 km. The start and finish are at the stadium, and the race course is marked every kilometer and certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA). The event attracts both local runners and running enthusiasts from other towns, offering sporting excitement and a chance to improve your personal best on a fast course.
course_highlights: Certified road course, with 10 km and 5 km distances
Course marked every 1 km
Start and finish at the stadium in Gostyń
additional: Registration is available on race days (April 25 and 26) for a higher fee, without a guaranteed race pack. The race course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA) and marked every 1 km. The event is organized by Gostyńskie Towarzystwo Sportowe CITIUS. The registration price starting at 75 zł applies to the 2026 edition.

name: Potrójna Korona Orlicka
description: The Orlicka Triple Crown is a spring mountain adventure held in Duszniki-Zdrój, ideal for warming up before the season’s next challenges. The route passes through scenic countryside, where nature coming back to life makes up for the cooler days of April. Participants can expect well-stocked aid stations, professional photography and video coverage, and unique gifts in the race pack. The event counts toward the large and small gold badges of the Triple Crown.
course_highlights: The long route starts at the foot of Jagodna at 22:00; the short route and Intro start in Duszniki in the morning
The Intro distance is 23 km and includes two peaks, making it suitable for families with children
Well-stocked aid stations and recovery surprises at selected checkpoints
additional: The race pack includes a limited-edition metal finisher pin, a set of laminated maps, a commemorative bib with the participant’s name, a race gift with a commemorative print, and a booklet-certificate for collecting route confirmations. Registration and race-pack collection take place from 16:00 to 20:30. After the race, a relaxation area with sun loungers and beer is available. The organizer offers help with transport to the finish if participants withdraw. There are numerous hotels, including the recommended “Zimowit” Health Resort Sanatorium. This is a walk, not a race; participants complete the route at their own pace within the time limit. The race pack includes, among other things, laminated maps, a bib with the participant’s name, aid stations, and commemorative gifts.

name: Półmaraton Koło
description: Koło Half Marathon is the fifth edition of the race, taking place on April 25, 2027, at Park 600-lecia in Koło. The course is exceptionally flat and fast, with just 19 metres of elevation gain over the full distance, making it ideal for setting new personal bests. Alongside the half marathon, the 4 km Debutant Run is also held, for both beginners and anyone looking for a short, fast race. Every participant will receive a commemorative medal, and the organizers provide well-stocked race packs.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course with 19 metres of elevation gain
PZLA-certified course, certification valid until 2029
Start and finish at Park 600-lecia in Koło
additional: The race office is open on April 24 from 16:00 to 18:00 and on April 25 from 08:30 to 10:00 at the MOSiR Stadium in Koło, ul. Sportowa 12. The Debutant Run starts at 11:05, and the Half Marathon starts at 11:00. The winners’ awards ceremony is at 14:00. Entry limits: 700 for the half marathon and 150 for the Debutant Run. Every participant will receive a medal and a race pack. The half marathon has a 3-hour time limit; water stations are located along the course. The event is co-organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Koło. The Debutant Run has a separate entry limit of 150.

name: Stop Smog Go Run
description: Toyota Nowakowski Stop Smog Go Run is a road race held in Bielany Wrocławskie, combining a passion for running with an important message about environmental protection and air quality. The event is family-friendly and includes adult races over 5 km and 10 km, as well as children’s races over shorter distances from 50 to 700 metres. The race aims to promote physical activity and environmental awareness among participants and local residents. The course is suitable for runners of different ability levels, and the atmosphere encourages both sporting competition and community participation.
course_highlights: Road race in Bielany Wrocławskie
5 km and 10 km distances for adults
Children’s races from 50 to 700 metres
additional: The event is family-friendly, with children’s races over short distances. The slogan “Stop Smog” highlights concern for air quality and the environment. The road course is suitable for runners of different ability levels. Separate registration is available for the main race and the children’s races. The published information relates to the 26 April 2026 edition; it does not confirm a date of 25 April 2027.

name: V ATT RUN FUN Półmaraton Polkowicki
location: Stadion Lekkoatletyczny, ul. 3 Maja 51, Polkowice, Poland
description: The V ATT RUN FUN - Polkowice Half Marathon is a race held at the Athletics Stadium in Polkowice. The event is both sporting and recreational, offering participants the opportunity to compete in the half marathon, 10 km race, and Nordic Walking. It is organized by ATT Sport Krzysztof Augustyniak, and timing is provided by STS-Timing, ensuring high precision and reliability. The main start is scheduled for 11:30, and the atmosphere welcomes both experienced runners and amateurs.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Athletics Stadium in Polkowice
Three events available: half marathon, 10 km race, and Nordic Walking
Professional timing using active Chronotrack chips
additional: Timing is 99.8% reliable thanks to active Chronotrack chips. The organizer also supports registration and payments. The event takes place on Sunday, and runs from 11:30 to 15:00. Information available for the fifth edition lists the main start at 11:30 and the location as 51 3 Maja Street, Polkowice. However, this information refers to April 26, 2026, not the stated date in 2027.

name: V Półmaraton Doliny Baryczy
description: The 5th Barycz Valley Half Marathon is a 21.097 km race held in Żmigród, in the heart of the picturesque Barycz Valley. The course runs through the town and its green surroundings, offering participants a sporting challenge amid nature. It is suitable both for experienced half-marathon runners and for those looking to take on the distance in a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Half-marathon distance: 21.097 km
The course starts in Żmigród’s park and runs along the town’s streets and cycle paths
The final section of the course follows the Barycz River
additional: The course for the inaugural edition was certified by the Polish Athletics Association.

name: VI Bieg Charytatywny
description: The 6th Charity Run in Kartuzy is a sporting event held as part of the “Fields of Hope” campaign, aimed at supporting the Kartuzy DOM NADZIEI Hospice. The run takes place on April 26 and is part of a family fair packed with attractions for participants of all ages. Proceeds from the run will go toward the hospice’s operations, underscoring the charitable nature of the event. It brings together sport, fun, and support for those in need, engaging the local community.
course_highlights: A charity run supporting the Kartuzy DOM NADZIEI Hospice
A family fair with attractions for all age groups
The event takes place on the sports field at ZSO No. 2 in Kartuzy
additional: The run is part of the larger “Fields of Hope” event, which also includes a concert by the band GIS, a raffle, activities for children, a bicycle rally, and a motorcycle gathering with a blessing. An NFZ mammobus offering mammography screenings and an NFZ educational stand will be available on site. Proceeds from the run will support the Kartuzy DOM NADZIEI Hospice. Running calendars list April 26, 2027, as an approximate date, one day later than the date in the metadata.

name: XI Bieg Papieski
organizer: Regionalne Centrum Sportowe Sp. z o.o.
description: The 11th Papal Run is an annual running event held at the stadium in Lubin, attracting local runners and enthusiasts from across the region. The main race, approximately 5 kilometres long, follows the city streets and offers participants an appealing urban route. The event is family-friendly, with races for children and young people held earlier at the stadium. Participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt and a bib with a timing chip, and the atmosphere encourages community spirit and sports competition.
course_highlights: An approximately 5 km route through the streets of Lubin
Start and finish at the athletics stadium
Youth races of 200 and 300 metres at the stadium
additional: The race pack includes a T-shirt, a race bib with a chip, and safety pins. A race pack can be collected by an authorised person after the relevant authorisation form has been completed. The youth races take place in seven heats starting at 15:00. The race office is located at Cuprum Arena Gallery, 20 Sikorskiego Street. Information about the 80 zł fee and a pack containing a T-shirt, medal, and race bib refers to the 11th edition scheduled for 2026, not to a confirmed 2027 edition.

name: XI Cross Szalonego Kurpsia
location: Błonia nad Narwią, ul. Obozowa, Ostrołęka, Poland
description: The 11th Cross Szalonego Kurpsia is an open running event and Nordic walking march held on the scenic Błonia nad Narwią in Ostrołęka. The event offers a variety of routes for different age groups and ability levels, including 5 km and 10 km runs, a 5 km Nordic walking march, and races for children and young people. It stands out for its regional character, with a performance by the folk dance group and refreshments for participants. It is organized by the “Arkadia” Association for the Promotion of Health and Sobriety and takes place under the honorary patronage of the city authorities, with support from the local government of the Mazowieckie Voivodeship.
course_highlights: Running and Nordic walking routes on Błonia nad Narwią
Regional character with the “Lelisioki” folk dance group
Routes suited to different ability levels and age groups
additional: Starts in several categories: children (500 m), young people (2 km), main races (5 km and 10 km), and Nordic walking (5 km). Start schedule: 10:45 official welcome, 11:15 children’s start, 11:30 young people’s start, 12:00 start of the main races and Nordic walking, 13:15–13:30 awards ceremony and closing. Race packs can be collected before the start. Refreshments to help participants recover. In the previous edition, registration was handled online via dostartu.pl. The announced date for this edition is 25 April 2027; the available race calendar gives 26 April 2027 as an approximate date.

name: XII Bieg nad Tanwią
description: The 12th edition of the Run by the Tanew is an annual running event organized by the Municipal Cultural Centre in Susiec. The race takes place in the scenic area around Susiec, giving participants the opportunity to spend time actively outdoors. The event is local in nature and offers a chance to bring the community together and promote a healthy lifestyle.
additional: Information about the 12th edition relates to the 2026 event; no confirmation of a 2027 edition was found.

name: XX Wojewódzki Bieg Przełajowy
location: Stadion Gminny, ul. Sportowa 37, Linia, Poland
description: The 20th Provincial Cross-Country Run through the Kashubian Landscape Park in Linia is a jubilee edition of the event, held at the municipal stadium at 37 Sportowa Street. The program includes races for children and young people, a local government officials’ race, competition for people with disabilities, and a 10 km open race. Participants can also take part in the “Na Szlaku Kaszëb” Nordic walking event.
course_highlights: A cross-country run through the Kashubian Landscape Park
A 10 km open race
Various distances for children and young people, from 200 m to 3,200 m
additional: The event takes place at the municipal stadium at 37 Sportowa Street in Linia. The published information concerns the 20th edition, scheduled for 26 April 2026, not 25 April 2027.

name: XXX Biegi Lewarta
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Lubartowie we współpracy ze Stowarzyszeniem Aktywny Lubartów
description: Join us for the anniversary 30th edition of the International Lewart Runs in Lubartów, one of the region’s most important sporting events. The program includes races for different age groups, including the Little One’s Run and the 5 km main race on a certified course through the city streets. The event combines sporting competition with bringing the local community together, promoting an active lifestyle and running as a healthy form of physical activity. It’s a great opportunity to spend time together and share the excitement of sport.
course_highlights: Certified course through the streets of Lubartów
5 km main race
Races for different age groups, including the Little One’s Run
additional: The event includes races for different age groups, including the Little One’s Run for the youngest participants. The main race follows a certified course through the city streets. The event is international in scope and brings the local community together. In the previous edition, the opening ceremony took place at the MOSiR square by the swimming pool.

name: Cytadela by Night # 114
description: Cytadela by Night 2.0 is a series of free, timed 5 km runs held in Cytadela Park in Poznań. The event attracts runners who want to spend time outdoors and enjoy the charm of the park in the evening. The run is recreational and open to a wide range of participants, promoting a healthy lifestyle and friendly sporting competition. It is well known in the local community and popular with Poznań residents.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km distance
The route passes through scenic Cytadela Park
An evening run in a friendly atmosphere
additional: The run is free and takes place regularly. Times are recorded during the run. The run includes timekeeping.

name: Twardziel Świętokrzyski
location: Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Strawczyńku, Strawczynek, Poland
description: The “Twardziel Świętokrzyski” Supermarathon is an extreme hiking marathon of approximately 100 km in the Świętokrzyskie Mountains. The route follows the red Edmund Massalski hiking trail for 90% of its length. The start and finish are at the Centre for Culture and Sport in Strawczynek. Participants need excellent walking fitness and must be prepared to complete the route within 23 hours, with a possible one-hour extension in exceptional circumstances. There are checkpoints where participants can replenish their supplies, and the night section requires lighting and reflective elements. The event is organized by local institutions and hiking communities, emphasizing the challenge and self-reliance required of participants.
course_highlights: 90% of the route follows the red Edmund Massalski hiking trail
Checkpoints with a hot meal and the option to change or replenish gear (including Masłów and Scholasteria)
Lighting and reflective elements are required for the night section
additional: The route must be walked; running is allowed only on easier sections and during the day. Participants must carry a phone, a map at a scale of at least 1:75,000, lighting for the night, and reflective elements. Checkpoints operate during specified hours, and the organizers may stop participants who fail to check in on time. The route passes through the Świętokrzyskie Mountains, with numerous landmarks and organizer-provided route markings. Price and route information comes from the 2026 edition’s regulations; details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed. Participation is restricted to adults, and the event takes place regardless of the weather.

name: 12 Półmaraton Grudziądz-Rulewo
organizer: Gmina Miasto Grudziądz, Miejski Ośrodek Rekreacji i Wypoczynku w Grudziądzu
description: The 12th Grudziądz–Rulewo Half Marathon, following in the footsteps of Bronisław Malinowski, is a race with a unique character, deeply rooted in the history of the city and the life of its namesake, Olympic champion Bronisław Malinowski. The course passes places associated with Bronisław’s life and training, starting at the Olimpia Grudziądz Stadium, crossing the Bronisław Malinowski Bridge, and finishing at Hanza Pałac Hotel in Rulewo. The race combines a passion for sport with remembrance of an outstanding athlete, offering participants an exciting experience and a sporting spirit that brings generations together. The event takes place on the first weekend of May, and participants can look forward to a varied program of accompanying events and organizational support.
course_highlights: The course passes historic places associated with Bronisław Malinowski, including the Bronisław Malinowski Bridge in Grudziądz
Start at the Olimpia Grudziądz Stadium; finish at Hanza Pałac Hotel in Rulewo
A course with varied surfaces, aid stations every 5 km, and markers every 1 km
additional: The race office is open on April 30 (16:00–20:00) at Marina Grudziądz and on May 1 (8:00–10:30) at the Olimpia Stadium. The time limit is 3 hours; the course closes at 14:00. There are at least 3 aid stations on the course, offering water, isotonic drinks, and fruit. After the race, participants receive a medal, diploma, and recovery meal, and can use physiotherapists’ massage services and free MZK bus transport. On race day, warm-ups are led by Fit House instructors. Children can take part in accompanying “Be Like Bronek” races. Information for the 12th edition lists the race office at Marina Grudziądz and at the GKS Olimpia Stadium. Available sources concern the race held on May 1, 2026, not the April 30, 2027 date given in the metadata.

name: 42 Krapkowicki Bieg Uliczny
description: The Krapkowice Street Race is an annual running event held in Krapkowice, with a tradition dating back to the 1980s. The race is certified by the Polish Athletics Association and takes place on a new route through the city streets, starting and finishing at 3 Kilińskiego Street. The event attracts runners of different ages and abilities, offering an exciting atmosphere and the chance to compete on the streets of Krapkowice. The organizers provide a lively program, including a cheering zone and contests for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: A 42 km street course certified by the Polish Athletics Association
Start and finish at 3 Kilińskiego Street in Krapkowice
Route along the city's main streets, including Opolska Street, 1 Maja Street, and Mickiewicza Street
additional: The organizers provide the rules and entry forms in PDF format. The website features photo galleries from previous editions and an archive of results. The event includes a cheering zone with contests for spectators. The race route was recently changed and has official certification. The 42nd edition in 2026 was held over a distance of 10 km; available sources do not yet confirm details of the 2027 edition.

name: Botaniczna Piątka
description: Botaniczna Piątka is a series of cross-country races organized since 2014 by running enthusiasts who emphasize scenic and attractive routes. The spring edition in Mikołów takes place in the beautiful Botanical Garden, offering participants a unique experience surrounded by nature. The event promotes physical activity and running among people of different ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the Botanical Garden in Mikołów
Scenic and attractive natural surroundings
Races organized to promote running and physical activity
additional: The organizer is the Biegiem w Las Association. In summer 2026, Botaniczna Piątka will celebrate its 10th anniversary. The event places particular emphasis on the aesthetic qualities of its chosen locations and on cross-country races.

name: III Aleksandryjska Piątka po Lesie
location: Parking at the end of ul. Sosnowa, Aleksandria Druga, Poland
description: The 3rd Aleksandria Forest Five is a race organized by the Atelier Sport Association, held in the scenic area of Aleksandria Druga. The event is a 5 km forest run, starting at 11:00 from the parking lot at the end of Sosnowa Street. The organizers provide professional timekeeping and a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: A 5 km forest course
Start and finish at the parking lot on Sosnowa Street
Scenic surroundings of Aleksandria Druga
additional: Timekeeping is provided using a modern electronic system based on RFID chips and start/finish mats. The organizer provides telephone support from 8:00 to 16:00 and, on race day, via a special number. The event is held under the patronage of the Atelier Sport Association. Information about the edition described in the available sources gives the race date as May 1, 2026, not April 30, 2027. The time limit is 1 hour 30 minutes; the 5 km race is limited to 200 participants. The start and finish are at the parking lot at the end of Sosnowa Street in Aleksandria.

name: LENART XI Bieg Uliczny o Puchar Starosty Powiatu Kępińskiego
organizer: Powiat Kępiński, przy współudziale Stowarzyszenia Nasz Bezpieczny Powiat Kępiński oraz Spółdzielni Socjalnej Green Service
description: LENART 11th Street Race for the Kępno County Starosta’s Cup is an annual running event held in Kępno. The 10 km main race starts on Dąbrowskiego Street and includes OPEN, uniformed services, team, county championship, and disability categories. The organizers have provided cash prizes for the winners and special awards for the best athletes from Poland. The event also includes a Preschoolers’ Run, which starts before the main race. Registration for the main race is available via maratonypolskie.pl.
course_highlights: 10 km main race on the streets of Kępno
Categories: OPEN, uniformed services, team, county championship, and people with disabilities
Cash prizes for the winners and awards for the best athletes from Poland
additional: The Preschoolers’ Run has race-day registration from 9:00, with the start at 11:40. Awards for the best male and female athletes from Poland in the OPEN category. Organizers: Kępno County, Nasz Bezpieczny Powiat Kępiński Association, and Green Service Social Cooperative. The main race is scheduled to start at 12:00. Registration for the Preschoolers’ Run takes place on race day from 9:00, and its start is scheduled for 11:40. Sources for this edition give the date as May 1, not April 30, 2027.

name: Sianowska Dyszka
organizer: Fundacja Zastopuj Sportowiec.info oraz Gmina i Miasto Sianów

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Wpisowe to wśród dorosłych 40 zł do 02.12.2026 r.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Wpisowe wśród dzieci to 20 zł do 02.12.2026 r.

description: Sianowska Dyszka is a 10-kilometre race and part of a series of five races held in Sianów. The event promotes running as a natural form of physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as the scenic running routes of the Sianów municipality. The races count towards the overall RUNking of Runners standings, which are summed up at the Runners’ Gala. The event is open to adults and children, with separate children’s races over shorter distances.
course_highlights: A 10 km race as part of the Sianowska Dyszka series
Scenic running routes in the Sianów municipality
Children’s races over distances from 100 to 1,000 metres
additional: Race packs can be collected from 9:30 to 10:45. Children’s races start between 11:00 and 11:30 over distances from 100 to 1,000 metres. A total of 120 medals have been prepared for participants. Prizes will be awarded to the three fastest women and men. Participants must register and verify their identity at the Race Office by presenting an identity document, and sign a declaration confirming that they are familiar with the regulations. Results from the Sianowska race series count towards the overall standings, which are summed up at the RUNking Runners’ Gala.

name: VIII Rydzewski przełaj - bieg dla trzeźw...
description: The 8th Rydzewo Cross-Country Run promotes a healthy lifestyle, sobriety, and running as a form of physical recreation. The event takes place on the sports field in Rydzewo and is open to everyone, regardless of age, gender, or place of residence. The organizers emphasize fair play and compliance with PZLA regulations. Participants run a cross-country distance and discover the scenic and tourist attractions of Miastkowo Municipality. The run is co-financed by Miastkowo Municipality from funds allocated to alcohol prevention and also aims to promote local communities.
course_highlights: Cross-country run on the sports field in Rydzewo
Route showcasing the scenic and tourist attractions of Miastkowo Municipality
Open competition for children, young people, and adults, held in the spirit of fair play
additional: Start and finish on the sports field in Rydzewo. Race office opens at 13:00, group warm-up at 14:30, results announcement and awards ceremony at 16:30, and the event ends at 18:00. Participant limit: 100. Registration is by name via the website. Minors need written consent from a parent or guardian and must sign a declaration confirming they have no contraindications to taking part. On-the-day registration is possible from 13:00 to 14:30 if places remain. Information about the 8th edition gives the date as May 1, 2026, while the stated event date is April 30, 2027; details of the latter date are not confirmed in the available materials. For the edition described on the registration page, the event began at 13:00 and the run at 15:00; the participant limit was 100.

name: X Półmaraton Doliną Rospudy
location: Filipów, Suwałki County, Podlaskie Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Aktywni Znad Rospudy, we współpracy z gminami Bakałarzewo i Filipów
description: The 8th Rospuda Valley Half Marathon takes place in the scenic Rospuda Valley and is organized by the Active People of the Rospuda Association. The half-marathon course is 21.0975 km long and 100% paved, providing comfortable running conditions. The start and finish are at the Filipów Municipal Office. Participants can expect refreshment stations and a race packet containing a technical T-shirt and drinks. The event promotes community and a healthy lifestyle, as well as raising awareness about the harmful effects of addiction.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course is 100% paved
Refreshment stations approximately every 4 km (5 stations on the course)
Start and finish at the Filipów Municipal Office, ul. Garbaska 2
additional: The time limit is 3 hours. Participant verification and race-number pickup take place on race day from 9:00 to 11:30 at the Filipów Municipal Office. Participants receive a race packet with a personalized race number, chip, technical T-shirt or another promotional item, and drinks on the course and at the finish. The course is marked every 1 km and has checkpoints. Runners must be over 18. Timing is electronic. The accompanying Filipów Jaćwing Run is 12.5 km long. Information about the course, organizer, and registration comes from previous editions; available sources describe the 10th edition scheduled for May 1, 2026, not an event on April 30, 2027.

name: XI Bieg o Strzałę Widanta
location: Park Miejski w Resku, Resko, Poland

description: The 11th Widant’s Arrow Run is an annual running event held in Resko Municipal Park. The competition includes 5 km and 10 km races, as well as a 5 km Nordic walking event. The course runs through the park and nearby forests along the Rega River, on natural, gravel, and paved surfaces. The event promotes physical activity, a healthy lifestyle, and outdoor recreation for runners and enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Course through Resko Municipal Park and nearby forests along the Rega River
Natural, gravel, and paved surfaces
Two laps for the 10 km race and one lap for the 5 km race and Nordic walking event
additional: Children’s and youth races take place from 10:00 in the Municipal Park area by Górka Borków. A professional warm-up is held by the park stage at 11:45, before the races. Participants over 70 are entitled to free entry after registering. In the previous edition, the start and finish were in Resko Municipal Park; the programme also included children’s and youth races. Wierzbicki Running Project was a co-organizer.

name: XIII Bieg Borków
location: Osieczna, Leszno County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 13th Bieg Borków is an annual running event held in Osieczna, offering a great opportunity to spend the May holiday actively. The event includes main races over 5 km and 10 km, as well as a free 1 km children’s race held on race day. Every participant receives a race pack and a medal, and the top finishers are awarded trophies. The atmosphere encourages families and the local community to enjoy sport together.
course_highlights: Main races over 5 km and 10 km
1 km children’s race with age categories ranging from preschoolers to grades 7–8
Start and finish at the Centre of Culture and Library in Osieczna
additional: The 1 km children’s race is free. Registration takes place on race day at the Centre of Culture and Library in Osieczna from 8:00 to 9:45. The children’s race is limited to 250 participants. Each child receives a medal and a race pack; age categories have trophies, and prizes are awarded by raffle. This information refers to the 13th edition in 2026 and does not confirm details of the 2027 edition. In 2026, participants received a race pack and a medal, and the top finishers received prizes.

name: XIII Bieg Tropami Śląskich Dinozaurów
location: Lisowice, Gmina Pawonków, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 13th National Run in the Footsteps of Silesian Dinosaurs is a running event held in Lisowice, in the Pawonków municipality. The race is open to participants of all ages who want to spend time actively in a family-friendly atmosphere. The course draws on the region’s paleontological history, making it a unique sporting and educational event. Registration is online, and participants can enjoy being active together outdoors.
course_highlights: A course inspired by the region’s paleontological history
A family-friendly event for runners of all ages
The race takes place in the picturesque village of Lisowice
additional: Register online at https://formularz.ultimasport.pl/458. The event is family-friendly and offers an opportunity to enjoy outdoor activity. No information is available about the start time, start waves, participant limits, or race packages.

name: XIII Dycha po Piachu
description: Dycha po Piachu is a race held in Czołpino, in the Smołdzino municipality. The 13th edition is scheduled for April 30, 2027. The event’s name refers to the sandy nature of the course and the local landscape. It is an option for runners looking to race in a coastal area.
course_highlights: Start in Czołpino, in the Smołdzino municipality
The event’s name suggests the race has a sandy character
Course in a coastal area

name: XXII Maraton Jelcz-Laskowice

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Maraton, Półmaraton, 10 km wpisowe do 31.03. - 100 zł

description: You are warmly invited to the 22nd Toyota Jelcz-Laskowice Marathon, which will take place on the streets of Jelcz-Laskowice. The event features three main races: a marathon of 42.195 km, a half marathon of 21.097 km, and a 10 km run and Nordic Walking event. The event is held in memory of Barbara Szlachetka and offers participants a commemorative T-shirt, access to a swimming pool and massages, and a post-race meal. Shorter distances on the school track are planned for children and young people, with a separate online registration system.
course_highlights: Route through the streets of Jelcz-Laskowice
Distances: marathon, half marathon, and 10 km run and Nordic Walking event
Access to a swimming pool and massages after the race
additional: After the race, participants can use the swimming pool, get massages, and have a meal. Children and young people can take part in races from 50 to 600 metres on the track at PSP No. 2, with the start at 11:00. The race package includes a commemorative T-shirt. According to the published information, the marathon starts at 8:00, while the half marathon and the 10 km run and Nordic Walking event start at 9:00. The listing for the 22nd edition gives prices of 100 zł until 31 March and 120 zł in April; however, it does not confirm the date or fees for the 2027 edition.

name: XXII Półmaraton Chełmżyński Chełmżyńska Dziesiątka
description: The XXII Chełmża Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Chełmża, attracting runners from various regions. The half-marathon course passes through scenic areas of the town and its surroundings, offering participants attractive views and sporting challenges. The event is open to all and promotes an active lifestyle and integration within the local community. The organizers provide professional support and an atmosphere conducive to both competition and recreation.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course passes through the centre of Chełmża and the surrounding area
Scenic views and varied terrain
A well-marked and secured course
additional: Available information concerns the XXII edition, scheduled for 1 May 2026; it does not confirm the stated date of 30 April 2027.

name: 12 Wołowski Bieg Flagi Narodowej
location: Hala Widowiskowo-Sportowa, ul. Panieńska 4a, Wołów, Poland
organizer: Wydział Sportu, Turystyki i Rekreacji Urzędu Miejskiego w Wołowie
description: The 12th Wołów National Flag Run is an annual running event held in Wołów at the sports and entertainment hall at 4a Panieńska Street. The race takes place on May 2, 2026, and offers an opportunity to celebrate through sport and bring runners together. The organizers provide a secure start-package exchange and support from the Sports, Tourism and Recreation Department of Wołów Municipal Office. The event attracts both recreational and more experienced runners.
course_highlights: The 10 km race was part of the previous edition.
The start and event are located at the Sports and Entertainment Hall in Wołów.
The May race is associated with National Flag Day celebrations.
additional: The start-package exchange lets participants safely buy a package from another runner or list their own. The race office is open on event day from 15:00 to 17:30 at the Sports and Entertainment Hall in Wołów, 4a Panieńska Street. The registration panel for the 12th edition includes an exchange for reselling packages. The stated date for the 12th edition is May 2, 2026; details for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: 2 Bieg dla Flagi
description: The 2nd Run for the Flag is an annual running event held in the picturesque Silesian Park in Chorzów. It offers a chance to spend time actively outdoors, surrounded by greenery and the park’s many attractions. The course passes through varied parts of the park, offering participants both challenges and beautiful views. The event has a family-friendly and patriotic character, bringing the local community together and promoting a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The course passes through more than 600 hectares of meadows, forests and gardens in Silesian Park
The run takes place on varied terrain, including forest trails and park paths
Picturesque views and proximity to attractions such as the Elka Cableway and the Rosarium
additional: The park offers numerous attractions for participants and their families, including the Elka Cableway and extensive green spaces ideal for recreation. The Silesian Park mobile app is available to help with navigation and planning your visit. The park has parking facilities and house rules available on its website. In previous editions, participants could run or walk with poles; the event was recreational in nature.

name: 42 Chojnickie Biegi Strażackie
description: The Chojnice Firefighters’ Run is a traditional 10 km road race held in Chojnice since 1985. The event is open to all running enthusiasts, not just firefighters. It takes place annually in early May and attracts runners from a variety of backgrounds. The start is scheduled for 11:00, and the event’s atmosphere highlights sporting competition and local community spirit.
course_highlights: A 10 km road race
A tradition dating back to 1985
Open to everyone, not just firefighters
additional: More than 200 people took part in the race in 2026.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Kielce
location: Geonatura Kielce – Botanical Garden, ul. Jagiellońska 78, Kielce, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Kielce is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014, focused on promoting the sport and the scenic appeal of its courses. The event takes place in the picturesque Botanical Garden in Kielce, offering participants a unique experience on a route full of natural charm. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors and stay active in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the Botanical Garden in Kielce
Picturesque natural surroundings
Race organized by experienced running enthusiasts since 2014
additional: Location: Geonatura Kielce - Botanical Garden, ul. Jagiellońska 78, Kielce.

name: Maraton Górski Leśnik
description: Leśnik Mountain Marathon is an ultra-style mountain race held in the scenic area around Szczyrk. The course features challenging climbs and varied terrain, offering participants a unique challenge and beautiful views. The event offers several distances, including a full marathon, a half marathon, and shorter races, welcoming runners of different experience levels. The event is very popular and provides an excellent opportunity to test yourself in a mountain race.
course_highlights: Mountain course with significant elevation gain
Scenic views of the Beskids
Various distances: 49 km, 28 km, 10 km
additional: A GPX file for the 169 km Stumilak course, with 7,736 m of elevation gain, is available to download and use for planning. An unsupported race option is available (without support). Information about the race headquarters by the Skalite amphitheatre and the distances comes from the 2026 edition description; the 2027 edition schedule may differ.

name: Puszcza Festiwal
description: Puszcza Festival is a sports and recreation event held in the Niepołomice Forest, with its base at Sitowiec Clearing. Participants can choose a hiking or cycling event and find checkpoints themselves using a map. The routes follow forest trails and roads, and the festival encourages visitors to actively explore the area.
course_highlights: Routes through the forest setting of the Niepołomice Forest
Map navigation and checkpoint completion
Hiking and cycling options, including night routes in previous editions
additional: Previous editions started and finished at Sitowiec Clearing. Distances listed in promotional materials refer to earlier editions and do not confirm the program for 2027.

name: VII Półmaraton Bitwa pod Gorlicami
location: Cmentarz Wojenny nr 91 na Górze Cmentarnej, Gorlice, Poland
organizer: Akademickie Koło Polskiego Czerwonego Krzyża i Klub Honorowych Dawców Krwi przy Akademii Górniczo-Hutniczej im. Stanisława Staszica w Krakowie oraz Oddział Rejonowy PCK w Gorlicach
description: The 7th International “Battle of Gorlice” Half Marathon is a 21 km road race taking place on 1 May 2027 in Gorlice. The start and finish are located at War Cemetery No. 91 on Cemetery Hill and the Historical Park in Siary, respectively. The route runs through city streets and the scenic surrounding area, with a time limit of 2.5 hours. The event is sporting, historical and promotional in nature, commemorating the significance of the Battle of Gorlice in World War I and promoting international participation.
course_highlights: A 21 km road route with a time limit of 2.5 hours
Start at War Cemetery No. 91 on Cemetery Hill in Gorlice
Finish at the Historical Park in Siary; the route passes through scenic localities and along cycle paths
additional: The race office and race-pack collection will be open on race day from 8:00 to 10:30 at the Historical Park in Siary. The race time limit is 2.5 hours. The event is sporting, historical and promotional in nature, with international participants. The organizer provides electronic timing. Materials for the 7th edition list an 11:00 start and a limit of 250 paid entries. The race pack includes a bib number, medal, finish-line meal and gifts from sponsors. Available information about the 7th edition gives the date as 2 May, so it does not confirm the stated date of 1 May 2027.

name: X Dębiński Bieg po Flagę
location: Publiczna Szkoła Podstawowa w Woli Dębińskiej, Wola Dębińska, Poland
description: The 10th Dębiński Run for the Flag is an annual sporting event held at the sports field by the Public Primary School in Wola Dębińska. The event takes place on May 1 and includes races over various distances, including 2.5 km and 10 km, as well as a 4.5 km Nordic walking event and shorter races for children. This family-friendly event is full of sporting excitement and offers activities for children and a food zone, encouraging active recreation and bringing the local community together. The race is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Dębno Municipality and is an opportunity to celebrate the May holiday together.
course_highlights: Races over 2.5 km and 10 km
Nordic walking over 4.5 km
Children’s races over 150 m, 300 m and 600 m
additional: The event offers free activities for children and a food zone. It is family-friendly and held under the honorary patronage of Dębno Municipality Mayor Wiesław Kozłowski. In the previous, anniversary edition, the start and accompanying events took place at the sports field by the Public Primary School in Wola Dębińska. Participants received a commemorative medal and flag.

name: XII Bieg Flagi
location: Park Kępa Potocka, Żoliborz, Warsaw, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za udział w XII Biegu Flagi na dystansie 5 lub 10 km to 50 złotych.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Biegi dla dzieci 0-12 lat na dystansach 200, 400 i 800 metrów są bezpłatne.

description: The 12th Flag Run is an annual race held in Kępa Potocka Park in Warsaw to commemorate the Day of the Flag of the Republic of Poland. The route winds through the scenic park, giving participants the opportunity to celebrate Polish identity and national symbols through sport. The event includes 5 km and 10 km races, as well as shorter races for children, creating a family-friendly and patriotic atmosphere.
course_highlights: Route through Kępa Potocka Park in Warsaw
One lap for 5 km; two laps for 10 km
Children’s races over 200, 400 and 800 metres in the central part of the park
additional: The adult race route is a 5 km loop through the park; the 10 km race consists of two laps. The children’s races cover shorter distances in the central part of the park. The organiser is the Żoliborz District Office of the Capital City of Warsaw. Information about the routes and children’s races is for the 2026 edition. The race traditionally takes place on 2 May, so the stated date of 1 May 2027 needs confirmation.

name: XIX Półmaraton Węgorza
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Węgorzewie
description: The 19th Węgorzewo Half Marathon is one of the most important sporting events promoting the Masurian Lake District and active recreation. The race follows a scenic route, much of it along the most beautiful Masurian lakes. The start and finish are at Freedom Square in Węgorzewo, where numerous accompanying events are also held. The event attracts around 1,500 participants and spectators, combining sporting competition with an appealing cultural and tourism programme.
course_highlights: The route runs alongside the most beautiful Masurian lakes
Views of the Węgorzewo Canal and the Ekomarina marina
Passes through Ruska Wieś, with views of the Węgorapa Valley, and includes gravel sections along Lake Mamry

name: Ultra Wysoczyzna
description: Ultra Wysoczyzna is a unique trail race held in the picturesque Elbląg Upland, featuring five distances of varying difficulty. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as the region’s natural attractions. The start and finish for most distances are in Elbląg, except for the 54 km distance, which starts in Tolkmicko. The event takes place on 16–18 April 2027 and attracts runners from all over Poland.

The 54 km Wolf’s Howl starts in Tolkmicko and finishes in Elbląg. Time limits for the distances range from 1.5 hours (6 km) to 17 hours (103 km). The technical briefing takes place online on Facebook the day before the start. Transport by coach to the 54 km start is available to registered runners who have paid their entry fee. Award ceremonies take place after each distance. The races are held on 16–18 April 2027; the event programme also includes junior races. The time limit ranges from 1.5 hours for 6 km to 17 hours for 103 km. The 54 km race starts in Tolkmicko.

The run is part of the Warsaw Running Triad, “Run for Remembrance,” commemorating important moments in Polish history. In addition to the run, a Nordic walking option is available, allowing people who prefer a more leisurely pace to take part. It is a great opportunity to enjoy an active May holiday in a spirit of community and sporting competition.

description: The 5th Jedlina-Zdrój Mountain Festival is a mountain running event taking place on 10 May 2026 in Jedlina-Zdrój. Participants can choose from three distances: 10 km, 23.5 km and 50 km. The start and finish are at Jedlinka Palace. The route runs through the scenic Wałbrzych Mountains, including Borowa Mountain, which has a newly built observation tower, and features challenging climbs and varied terrain. The event is a great opportunity to enjoy an active break and discover the charms of the region.
course_highlights: The route passes over Borowa Mountain, with its new observation tower
Varied terrain: gravel roads, asphalt roads, forest trails and mountain paths
Distances of 10 km, 23.5 km and an ultra 50 km, with refreshment and timing checkpoints
additional: The total participant limit is 600. Festival T-shirts can be ordered until 19.04.2026 for 90 zł; they are made from high-quality Attiq technical fabric. The 50 km ultra route has 7 refreshment stations and 5 timing checkpoints. The start and finish are at Jedlinka Palace, ul. Zamkowa 4. The organizer reserves the right to modify the route up to one week before the start. The mountain route is demanding and features varied terrain. There is a limit of 600 participants, online registration, possible date changes in the event of sanitary restrictions, accommodation options and festival T-shirts for participants.

name: Wings for Life 2026 Gdańsk Południe
description: The Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race held simultaneously around the world. Instead of a traditional finish line, participants race against a virtual Catcher Car, which starts 30 minutes after the runners and gradually increases its speed until it catches the last participant. In Gdańsk Południe, the race will take place on May 10, 2026, starting at 13:00 near the Parkrun Gdańsk-Poludnie finish area. The course is an approximately 3 km loop on a paved surface, with a slight uphill section on the connecting path. All entry fees support spinal cord research.

name: 13. PKO Białystok Półmaraton
description: The 13th PKO Białystok Half Marathon is the largest running event in eastern Poland. Organized since 2013, it is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown. Runners cover the half-marathon distance of 21.097 km in the picturesque city of Białystok. The event also includes the PKO Night Run over 5 km, which can be a great warm-up before the half marathon, as well as races for children. It is a true celebration of running, attracting participants from across Poland and abroad.

name: Wings for Life World Run 2026 Poznań
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race in which all participants start simultaneously around the world, running away from the Catcher Car. The race has no traditional finish line—participants run until they are caught by the car. All entry fees go toward research into treatments for spinal cord injuries, making this not only a sporting challenge but also a charity event. You can take part locally or via the app, which lets you run from anywhere in the world.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes in Bydgoszcz, with an emphasis on the aesthetic appeal of the locations. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy the beauty of nature during a spring race.

name: Charytatywna Dycha
description: Charytatywna Dycha is a sports and charity running festival held in Miechów to benefit Caritas Hospice. The event brings the local community together to support hospice patients by raising funds for essential medical equipment. The race takes place around the park, and participants, donors, and organizers come together to create an atmosphere of empathy and solidarity. This unique initiative not only promotes physical activity but also raises public awareness of hospice care.

name: II JBL Run Katowice
description: The II JBL Run Katowice is a charity street race taking place on May 10, 2026, in Katowice, with 3 km (family walk&run), 5 km, and 10 km routes. All proceeds from entry fees will be donated to the Dla Ludzi Potrzebujących Pomocy „Gniazdo” Foundation. The start and finish are located at Sławik and Antall Square, and the route passes iconic Katowice landmarks such as Spodek, MCK, NOSPR, the Silesian Museum, and the Silesian Insurgents’ Monument. The race promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Participants will receive commemorative medals and can enter a prize draw.

name: II Olkuski Test Coopera
description: The 2nd Olkusz Cooper Test is an annual sporting event held at the MOSIR stadium in Olkusz. The competition consists of a 12-minute Cooper Test, a popular measure of running endurance. The event is open to everyone, with participation limited to 100 people. Starts begin at 9:00, and participants can choose a convenient start time between 9:00 and 13:30. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness and compete in a friendly atmosphere.

name: IX Bieg Pilicy
description: The 9th Pilica Run is a small-scale running event held in the charming town of Białobrzegi on the Pilica River. The start and finish are located in the centrally situated, revitalized Zygmunt Stary Square, and the route runs along the town’s main streets. The event combines sport, passion, and a family-friendly atmosphere, offering distances for different ability levels: a 10 km main race, a 3 km recreational run, and a 3 km Nordic walking event. Colorful races tailored to participants’ ages are organized for children and teenagers. Every participant can enjoy a hot meal, drinks, and a voucher for local ice cream.

name: Wings for life world run App
description: The Wings for Life World Run App is a unique race held simultaneously around the world on May 10, 2026. Participants start at the same time wherever they choose, with the goal of outrunning a virtual Catcher Car that starts chasing them 30 minutes after the start. All entry fees go toward research into spinal cord injuries, and the mobile app provides motivation and a unique audio experience during the race. It’s a race for everyone—from beginners to professionals, runners, wheelchair users, and amateurs.

name: XV Działoszyńska Dziesiątka
description: The 15th Działoszyńska Dziesiątka is a road race held in Działoszyn on May 10, 2026. The event is organized by Stowarzyszenie Atelier Sportu, which specializes in professional timing and running-event organization. The race is scheduled to start at 16:00. The event attracts runners who value well-organized races with electronic timing.

name: XXIX Górski Bieg Magurki
description: The 29th National Magurka Mountain Run is an annual running event organized since 1997 by the “Groniczek” People’s Student Sports Club in Bielsko-Biała. The event is open to the public and promotes mountain running and an active lifestyle. The 8.8 km course, with 509 m of elevation gain, leads from the Straconka district to the summit of Magurka, passing through the scenic area of Mała Straconka and forest trails. The race attracts leading Polish mountain runners as well as competitors from abroad, and the course is professionally secured and clearly marked.

name: XXXIII Biegi Żnińskie
description: The 33rd Żnińskie Runs is an annual running event held in Żnin, scheduled for May 10, 2026. The event includes road races over 10 km, 5 km, and 2.5 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The start and finish are located at Freedom Square. The 10 km race counts toward the Pałuki Grand Prix. Participants receive a race pack containing a commemorative medal from the “Great People of Żnin” series, a recovery meal, and souvenirs from Pałuki. The race office is open on race day from 9:00 to 11:45 at Primary School No. 1 in Żnin.

name: V Nocny Bieg Parami ze Świetlikami
description: The 5th Night Run in Pairs with Fireflies is a unique nighttime running event held in Reda by the retention reservoir. The runners’ headlamps and the illuminated course create a spectacular visual effect. Participants run in pairs, highlighting the event’s inclusive spirit and setting it apart from other sporting events in the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The run takes place after dark, giving it a distinctive atmosphere and adding to the excitement.

name: 12. Dynowska ZaDyszka
description: The 12th Dynowska ZaDyszka is a 10 km race organized by the Jarosławska Grupa Biegowa “Sokół” Association. The event will take place on May 16, 2026, at the Błękitny San Tourist Center in Dynów. The evening race follows a scenic route, promoting physical activity and the region’s tourist attractions. The event is part of the Piona Cup 2026 series, which brings together the local running community.

name: Bieg Iskier - IFMSA Poland Oddział Rzeszów
XVII Bieg Piastowski - półmaraton Piastowski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The 17th Piast Run is a traditional half marathon held in Inowrocław as part of the Piast Running Festival. The event attracts runners from various regions, offering an appealing course and a sporting atmosphere. It is an excellent opportunity to spend time actively and compete over the 21 km distance. The organizers ensure professional event management and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.

name: Rudawy Wiosenny Festiwal Biegowy
description: The Rudawy Spring Running Festival is a mountain running event held in the picturesque Rudawy Janowickie Mountains in Miedzianka. Participants can choose from several distances: 15, 25, 45, and 65 kilometers, as well as a 9 km family run. The event brings the mountain running community together, emphasizing the team spirit of the sport and offering unique routes along forest paths and rocky trails. The festival has been held since 2013 and is known for its beautiful views and challenging routes.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Stradomia – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Stradomia – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts. It takes place in the picturesque Prof. Stefan Białobok Forest Arboretum in the Syców Forest District. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which emphasizes scenic routes and natural surroundings. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a unique atmosphere and beautiful views. The organizers promote running and ensure a friendly, sporting atmosphere.

name: 12 Ćwierćmaraton Komandosa
description: The 12th Commandos Quarter Marathon is a uniformed-services race organized by the “Sub ventum” Foundation in Słupsk. The 10.55 km course runs through the grounds of the 650th Anniversary Stadium and the Northern Wood, offering extreme racing conditions for uniformed services and running enthusiasts. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, competition, and the training of uniformed services. The race is scheduled to start on May 16, 2026, at 12:00, with a participant limit of 999.

name: 3 Mile Dwunastki
organizer: Klub Biegowy Dzik, Wojskowe Centrum Sportu DORSZ, 12 Brygada Zmechanizowana
description: 3 Mile Dwunastki is an extreme trail race organized by the “Dzik” Running Club Association in Szczecin, at the Krzekowo Shooting Range. The 3-mile (4 km and 828 metres) course runs along dirt roads, sand, uphill and downhill sections, concrete and sandy stretches, and forest roads, offering challenging running conditions. The race is free in 2026 and is open to people over 16, with a limited number of places. The start and finish are at the Krzekowo Shooting Range. The event brings people together and promotes outdoor physical activity.

name: 4 Lędzińska Piwna Mila
description: The 4th Lędziny Beer Mile is an annual running event held in Lędziny, combining sporting competition with good fun and a local atmosphere. The race covers a distance of one mile, making it appealing to both amateur and more experienced runners. The event is organized by EMJOT Tri Team and attracts participants from across the region. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and get to know the local community.

name: 53 Cross Mysłowicki w biegach przełajowych
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mysłowicach
description: The 53rd Mysłowice Cross is a traditional cross-country race held in the scenic Słupna Park in Mysłowice. Participants run a loop of nearly 5.5 kilometres along challenging forest trails, featuring both climbs and a charming natural setting. The event is very popular, attracting nearly 300 runners, and is supported by UKS Chromik Mysłowice and the Central Museum of Firefighting. Participants can look forward to a unique medal with a moving element, legendary doughnuts, and attractive sports prizes.

name: 8 Okonińska Pętla
description: The 8th Okonińska Pętla is an annual running event held in the picturesque village of Okoniny Nadjeziorne. The race will take place on May 16, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. It attracts outdoor enthusiasts with an appealing course surrounded by the Tuchola Forests and lakes. The organizers promise a friendly atmosphere and welcome both runners and spectators.

name: Bieg Krokodyla
description: Bieg Krokodyla is an annual running event held by Lake Rusałka in Poznań. The event is scheduled for May 16, 2026, and includes 10 km and 5 km races, a 5 km Nordic Walking event, and children’s and youth races over shorter distances. The main races and walk are scheduled to start at 12:00, while the children’s events begin at 9:00. Participants can choose a basic or extended package with a technical T-shirt. The course follows scenic terrain by the lake, offering attractive views and a pleasant atmosphere.

name: Mariuszowa 5-tka
organizer: Fundacja Mocni na starcie, Biegaj Leszno, Wojewódzki Szpital Wielospecjalistyczny w Lesznie
description: Mariuszowa 5-ka is a race taking place on May 16, 2026, in Leszno, in the Nowy Świat forest district. The course follows unpaved roads and forest tracks, offering distances of 5.3 km (one loop) and 10.3 km (two loops). In addition to the main races, there is a 4 km Nordic walking event, as well as youth and children’s races over shorter distances. The race office is located in the administrative building of the Regional Multi-Specialist Hospital in Leszno, while the start and finish are on Jana Kiepury Street. The event is small-scale, with participant limits for each event.

name: V Szczeciniecka 5-tka
description: The V Szczecinecka 5K is a running event held in Szczecinek, in the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event is part of a duathlon and is scheduled for May 16, 2026, at 11:30. Participants can expect professional organization and timekeeping. The event is open to a range of runners and offers a great opportunity for sporting competition and active recreation.

name: VIII Chrzanowski Bieg Uliczny
description: The 8th Chrzanów Street Race, known as Pociąg do biegania, is a popular sporting event in Chrzanów, taking place on May 16, 2026. The event offers three distances: a 5 km race for beginners and recreational runners, a 10 km race for more experienced runners, and a 5 km Nordic walking event. The organizers provide professional race management, course safety, and commemorative medals for all participants. It’s a great opportunity to join the sporting community of Chrzanów County and enjoy outdoor exercise.

name: XIII Olecka Trzynastka
description: The 13th Olecka Thirteen is an annual race held at the Municipal Stadium in Olecko. The event includes a main race and Nordic walking, attracting both runners and outdoor enthusiasts. It is open and welcoming to participants, with clearly specified entry fees and professional organization. The start is scheduled for 08:30, and the event runs until 14:20.

name: XVII Bieg Piastowski - półmaraton z Kruszwicy
description: The 17th Piast Run is a traditional half-marathon held in Inowrocław, attracting runners from across the region. The half-marathon course runs through the city's scenic areas, offering participants both a sporting challenge and the chance to admire local attractions. The event is part of the Piast Running Festival, which also includes other distances, fostering a running tradition and a sense of community.

name: XXVIII Oleskie Uliczne Biegi Pokoju
description: The 28th Olesno Street Peace Runs is an annual running event organized by the Olesno Municipality, attracting runners from various categories. The races take place on the streets of Olesno, with professional timing provided by Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu.
