The race is scheduled to start at 16:50, and online registration is open until May 14, 2026. This sporting event brings together a passion for running, local tradition, and a competitive atmosphere.

name: POKONAJ LUCYFERA - Półmaraton
description: POKONAJ LUCYFERA – The Half Marathon is a mountain race in Nasielsk, taking place on May 17, 2026. The course consists of a 7 km loop through scenic but challenging forest terrain, with numerous uphill climbs and technical descents. The event offers four challenges to choose from: Lucyfer 21 km (3 loops), Boruta 14 km (2 loops), Rokita 7 km (1 loop), and 7 km Nordic Walking. This race is for people who value endurance, strength, and determination, and features professional timekeeping and commemorative medals for participants.

name: 24h Rawicki Festiwal Sportu
description: The 24-hour Rawicz Sports Festival is a unique sporting event held in Rawicz, bringing amateurs and professionals together for a competition that lasts all day and night. Since 2011, the festival has continued to grow, offering a range of sports, with the 24-hour relay race as its main event. It is the largest sporting initiative in the Rawicz municipality and is organized through the cooperation of numerous institutions and volunteers. Participants can also enjoy a range of non-sporting attractions during the festival weekend.

name: 19. Bieg Wiosny - 5 km
organizer: Biegowe Grand Prix Rybnika, MOSiR Rybnik
description: Bieg Wiosny is an annual running event held in Rybnik and part of the Rybnik Running Grand Prix. The event features races for children and young people over various distances, as well as a 5 km cross-country race for adults and young people aged 16 and over. The 19th edition of Bieg Wiosny will take place on May 17, 2026, offering participants the chance to compete and spend time actively outdoors.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Olsztyn - edycja wiosenna 2026
location: Arboretum Leśne Warmii i Mazur, Olsztyn, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Olsztyn – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque Warmia and Mazury Forest Arboretum, highlighting the scenic beauty of the course. The race is participant-friendly, and the organizers emphasize the beauty of the locations and promoting running among different groups. It is a great opportunity to combine sport with time in nature and earn a unique medal featuring a hyacinth motif.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – Spring Edition is a recurring race held in the picturesque Dendrological Garden in Przelewice, an ideal place for nature lovers and those seeking active recreation. The event aims to promote running and physical activity, and participation is open to all ages. Participants can look forward to a unique atmosphere and commemorative medals, awarded after completing the main race or the children’s races. The event is co-organized by the West Pomeranian Voivodeship and is held under the honorary patronage of the Voivodeship Marshal.

name: VIII Charytatywny Bieg Nadziei
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Żorach
description: The 8th Charity Run of Hope is an annual sporting event held at Cegielnia Park in Żory, taking place on May 17, 2026. The event is charitable and supports the John Paul II Hospice in Żory. Participants can run, walk with Nordic walking poles, skate, or ride a scooter, and all proceeds from entry packages go to support the hospice. The run is open to everyone, regardless of athletic ability, and promotes physical activity combined with helping those in need.

name: 32 Bieg Fiata
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Bielsku-Białej, Agencja Sportu i Reklamy Andrzej Filipiak
description: The 32nd Fiat Run is an annual road race held in Bielsko-Biała, taking place on May 17, 2026. The 10 km course runs through the city streets, including Warszawska, 3 Maja and Zamkowa, and finishes at Town Hall Square. The race is open to participants over the age of 16, with a limit of 1,800 participants. It is organized by the Municipal Office in Bielsko-Biała and Agencja Sportu i Reklamy Andrzej Filipiak. The event is a certified PZLA road race with a rich regional tradition.

name: Bieg Po Puszczy
description: Bieg po Puszczy is a unique running event held in the scenic Niepołomice Forest, taking place for the twelfth time in 2026. Participants can choose from three running distances: a half marathon, the Forest 15K, and the Forest 7K. They can also take part in the 40 km Gravel in the Forest cycling race. The course runs along forest trails, gravel roads, and asphalt, offering beautiful views and a chance to connect with nature. Every participant will receive a commemorative medal, and refreshments and professional medical support will be available along the route. The event is also an opportunity to enjoy time together as a family, with recreational cycling events for children.

name: Ekiden Pragmatiq
description: Ekiden PragmatIQ is a team marathon relay held in Poznań by Lake Malta. Teams of six cover the marathon distance (42.195 km), with each runner completing a designated leg. The course is paved and follows a 5.4 km loop, except for the first leg. The event combines sporting competition with teamwork and support for local charitable organizations. Ekiden Junior is also held as part of the event for the youngest runners.

name: III Półmaraton Brzegiem Bałtyku
organizer: Kołobrzeskie Stowarzyszenie Biegów Ulicznych Nadmorscy Biegacze
description: The 3rd Kołobrzeg Baltic Coast Half Marathon is a flat road race set in the picturesque seaside surroundings of Kołobrzeg. The course follows a granite-paved promenade, a cycle path and asphalt roads, with five refreshment stations along the route. The start and finish are located at Seaside Park Hotel. The race is part of the Kołobrzeg Odyssey series, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the running community together. The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours, and timing is electronic, using disposable chips.

name: IX Bieszczadzki Bieg Lotników - Lato
description: Bieszczady Aviators’ Run – Summer is a mountain race taking place on May 17, 2026, in Ustrzyki Dolne, on the running trails beneath Żuków in the Żuków range, within the Ustrzyki Dolne Forest District. The course follows forest roads with varied surfaces, featuring climbs and descents, and the start and finish are at the same location. The event aims to promote outdoor physical activity, bring runners together, and celebrate aviation traditions in Ustjanowa Górna. The program includes two running distances and a Nordic Walking event. The time limit for completing the half-marathon is 4 hours.

name: Lone Willow Marathon
description: The Lone Willow Marathon is a marathon held in Jelcz-Laskowice, Poland, organized by Maraton Chwałowice and Arkadiusz Tołłoczko. The race is listed in marathon calendars for the areas around Tyniec Mały and Namysłów, as well as in the sports events directory for the Żórawina region. The marathon course is 42.195 km long and takes place in May, offering participants typical spring weather with temperatures of around 20°C. This sporting event attracts runners from various regions, providing professional organization and an attractive course.

name: Marszobieg Trzech Dzielnic
location: VIII Liceum Ogólnokształcące, ul. Grzegórzecka 24, Kraków, Poland
description: The Three Districts Run-Walk is a sporting event promoting physical activity, a healthy lifestyle, and integration among the residents of Kraków. It will take place on May 17, 2026, on the track at Stanisław Wyspiański 8th Secondary School, at 24 Grzegórzecka Street. The programme includes runs and walks for various age groups, including 4 km runs with timing, a 4 km walk without timing, and shorter runs for children. The Run-Walk is not only a sporting competition, but also an opportunity to spend time together and promote an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: 4 km run and walk on the track at 8th Secondary School in Kraków
Children’s runs over 200 m and 500 m
An event bringing together residents of three Kraków districts
additional: The event is organised by the Instructional Team of the Kraków-Śródmieście Scout District, with support from the Councils and Boards of Districts I Stare Miasto, II Grzegórzki, and III Prądnik Czerwony, the “Dom Harcerza” Youth Cultural Centre, and 8th Secondary School. Registration is online. The Run-Walk offers various activities suited to participants’ ages and abilities. The event includes 4 km and 500 m runs for children, as well as a 10 km run. Participants can register online, and the event is supported by local institutions and the community. The programme includes attractions and a hot meal.

name: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Biegowy
description: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Run is the second edition of a trail running event taking place on May 17, 2026, in Modrze, Poland. Participants can choose from a 5 km run, a 10 km run, or a 5 km Nordic walking event. The route runs through fields and forests between the villages of Modrze and Drożdżyce, offering a chance to connect with nature and enjoy outdoor recreation. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and bring the local community together.

name: Półmaraton...Chce Ci się?
description: “Half marathon… Are you up for it?” is a cross-country race covering 21 km, with an additional 32 km race, held on forest trails in the Herby and Kłobuck Forest Districts near Blachownia. Participants can run or walk the course with Nordic walking poles. The event also includes races for children and young people. This is the fifth edition of the event, combining sport and recreation in a picturesque forest setting.

name: Run Toruń Plaza
description: The May edition of the Toruń Legends Trilogy – Run Toruń Plaza, taking place on May 17, 2026, offers two race distances: 5 km and 10 km. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness in the spring edition of the series and experience the unique atmosphere of running in Toruń. The organizers provide professional event management for a competition with nationwide reach while ensuring a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere. The event is part of a running series promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity.

name: Sierakowicka Piętnastka
description: Sierakowicka Piętnastka is an annual race held in Sierakowice as part of the Northern Poland Running Festival. The event takes place at the sports stadium at 7 Kubusia Puchatka Street and attracts runners of all ages, offering a 15 km main race as well as numerous children’s and youth races. The event features electronic timekeeping, an extensive program and prizes for the top competitors. Participants can expect professional organization, including medical and police support, as well as amenities such as a bag drop, showers and a café.

name: V Bieg Ratownika
description: The 5th Rescuer Run is a milestone fifth edition of an event that combines athletic competition with an educational and community-building mission. Participants can compete on professionally prepared 5 km and 10 km courses, or take part recreationally, including Nordic walking and a 5 km run with a pet. A safe and fun 200 m race is prepared for the youngest participants. After the race, a family and educational picnic with numerous attractions celebrates the anniversary edition. The event takes place in Katowice at 180 Francuska Street and promotes first aid and responsibility for others.

name: VII Bieg im. Rektora Stanisława Komornic...
description: The 7th Stanisław Komornicz Rector’s Run is a 10 km road race taking place in Tarnów. This sporting event is aimed at runners of varying ability levels and offers the opportunity to prepare with dedicated training plans. The race takes place on the streets of the picturesque city of Tarnów, giving participants an appealing course and sporting excitement.

name: XI Półmaraton Szelkowski
description: The 11th Szelków Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Szelków that attracts runners from various regions. The event includes a half marathon and additional races, such as the 1st Szelków Five and Nordic Walking. The competition is organized by the Maków Mazowiecki Athletics Sports Club, offering a sporting atmosphere and the chance to compete on scenic routes. All running enthusiasts are invited to take part and celebrate sport together.

name: XII Bieg Kwitnących Ogrodów
organizer: Klub Biegacza Im. P. Sękowskiego w Płońsku
description: The 12th Blooming Gardens Run is an annual running event held in Kuchary Królewskie. The event features various distances for different age groups, including races for preschoolers and schoolchildren, a 10 km main race, a 3 km accompanying race, and a 6 km Nordic Walking event. The start and finish are by the forester’s lodge, and participants can look forward to an awards ceremony and a prize drawing after the event. The participant limit is 300, ensuring an intimate atmosphere.

name: XXIII Bieg Skawiński XIV Bieg Skawiński na Rolkach
description: The 23rd Skawina Run is an annual sporting event with a tradition spanning more than 20 years, held in Skawina. The event combines professional competition with a family-friendly atmosphere and promotes an active lifestyle. The program includes races for children and teenagers, the 9th Tomasz Staszczak Memorial, the 17th Polish Energy Workers’ Championships, the 4th Skawina Nordic Walking event over 10 km, and the 14th Skawina Rollerblading Race over 9 km. The race course runs on a resurfaced, even surface, ensuring comfort and safety for participants.

name: Sezon Ogórkowy/Monte Cassino
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Backyard Ultra Jabłonna
description: Backyard Ultra Jabłonna is a unique ultra-running event created in the USA. Runners start every hour and have to complete a 6.706 km loop. After completing the loop, they have time to rest until the next full hour. The competition continues until only one runner remains, and they complete the final loop within the one-hour time limit. This is an endurance race where not only speed matters, but also strategy and perseverance.

name: Cytadela by Night # 115 - Wartostrada
description: Cytadela by Night is a series of free, timed races held in Poznań over 5 km and 10 km distances. The races take place in the scenic surroundings of the Citadel, offering participants a unique atmosphere of night racing. The event attracts runners of different age groups and experience levels, promoting physical activity and bringing the local community together.

name: Leśna Piątka Na Dychę
description: Leśna Piątka Na Dychę is a series of cross-country races held in Koszalin, offering participants a unique 5 km route. The race is recreational and sporting in nature, organized by the local group BIEGNIJMY.pl, which has promoted physical activity and sport in the region for years. The route runs through picturesque forest areas, making the race appealing to nature lovers and trail runners. The event has a well-established tradition and is popular with runners of different age groups and experience levels.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through forest areas
A cross-country race in picturesque surroundings
Organized by the local group BIEGNIJMY.pl

name: XIII Bieg 5 Mil
organizer: Gdyński Dywizjon Okrętów Bojowych, Gdyńskie Centrum Sportu, Stowarzyszenie Oficerów Marynarki Wojennej
description: The 13th 5 MILE Run is a race over 5 nautical miles (9,260 m), organised in Gdynia by the Gdynia Combat Ship Squadron and the Association of Polish Navy Officers, in cooperation with the Gdynia Sports Centre. The course consists of two 4,630 m loops and runs along the waterfront. The start and finish are in front of the ORP “Gen. K. Pułaski”. The race is open to active-duty professional soldiers, civilian military employees and civilian runners who have been verified in advance. The event takes place in a friendly atmosphere, promoting physical activity and sportsmanship.

name: Ultra-Trail® Malopolska
description: Ultra-Trail® Małopolska is a festival of challenging mountain races held in the Małopolska region, in the Gorce and Beskid Mountains. The event offers a range of distances from 16 to 240 km, taking runners along scenic and demanding mountain trails. It is organized by the 4 Alternatywy Foundation and attracts runners who value a challenge and the beauty of mountain nature. Ultra-Trail® Małopolska is a great opportunity to test your abilities on routes of varying difficulty and experience the unique atmosphere of ultrarunning.

name: Ultramaraton Jaga-Kora
description: The Jaga-Kora Ultramarathon is a mountain ultrarun held in the picturesque Low Beskids, with routes of varying difficulty. The event draws inspiration from the historic “Jaga-Kora” Courier Route from World War II, giving the race a distinctive character and historical significance. Participants can choose from five distances, ranging from 19 km to 101 km, passing through the areas of Jaśliska and Rymanów-Zdrój. The race is certified by ITRA and UTMB, underscoring its standing in the mountain running community.

name: Maraton Zagłębiowski
organizer: Centrum Sportu i Rekreacji w Dąbrowie Górniczej
description: The Zagłębie Marathon is a prestigious marathon held at ArcelorMittal Park - ZPS Sosnowiec. The course is officially certified by the Polish Athletics Association, guaranteeing an accurately measured distance and reliable results. The event is for runners of varying ability levels and combines sporting competition with the satisfaction of overcoming personal challenges. The organizers provide professional organization and extensive support for participants.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Marszewo Forest Botanical Garden in Gdynia. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which has been promoting running and the beauty of natural routes in Poland since 2014. The race attracts running enthusiasts who value being close to nature and the beauty of their surroundings. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors among the greenery and enjoy a unique atmosphere.

name: I Górski Pólmaraton Szczytniański
description: The 1st Szczytniański Mountain Half Marathon is a unique running event held in picturesque Szczytna, on a 21.1 km course featuring numerous mountain climbs. The race offers beautiful views of this charming town in the Kłodzko region and a chance to connect with nature, creating unforgettable experiences for every participant. The event also includes a 10 km Nordic walking race, an excellent option for those who enjoy being active without time pressure. The event organizer, the Szczytna Biega Association, promotes a healthy lifestyle and brings the local running community together.

name: Pancerna Piątka
organizer: Zarząd Wojewódzki NSZZ Policjantów województwa podkarpackiego
description: Pancerna Piątka is the Podkarpackie Police Championships in a 5 km road race, held in Żurawica. The event is held under the Honorary Patronage of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship Police Commander in Rzeszów. More than 400 participants take part, and the route runs along roads through Żurawica. The organizer is the Regional Board of the Police Officers’ Independent Trade Union of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship.

name: 23. Półmaraton Hajnowski
description: The 23rd Hajnówka Half Marathon is a unique and unforgettable race held in the picturesque area of Białowieża, near Hajnówka. The half-marathon course runs through the charming grounds of Hajnówka Municipal Park, giving participants a chance to enjoy nature and beautiful views. The event is very popular and is organized by the Hajnówka Sports and Recreation Centre, which ensures runners’ comfort and safety. The race office is open the day before the race and on race day. Participants can expect race packs and a coffee buffet.

name: 48 Zdrojowy Bieg Zwycięstwa
description: The 48th Zdrojowy Victory Run is an annual running event organized by the Sports and Recreation Center in Gołdap. The race takes place on May 23, 2026, and attracts runners from various regions. Temporary traffic disruptions occur during the race, reflecting the strong involvement of the local community. The event combines sport and recreation and is an important fixture in Gołdap’s sporting calendar.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the scenic surroundings of Gołdap
The course runs through the area around the Sports and Recreation Center
Temporary traffic disruptions during the race underscore the event’s significance
additional: Temporary traffic disruptions related to the race organization will occur on race day, May 23, 2026.

name: Bieg Lwa
description: The Lion Run is an annual half marathon held in Tarnowo Podgórne, attracting both elite runners and amateurs. The event is known for its excellent organization, appealing course, and enthusiastic crowds. The festival also features children’s races and a variety of accompanying events, such as cheering competitions and concerts. The Lion Run is a great opportunity for sporting competition and family fun in beautiful surroundings.

name: Bieg Poznaniaka
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na Rzecz Edukacji Dzieci i Młodzieży z Autyzmem „Aperio”
description: Bieg Poznaniaka dla Przedszkolaka is a family running event taking place on May 23, 2026, in the scenic Wielkopolski National Park and on the grounds of the Museum of Agriculture in Szreniawa. The program includes main races of 11 km and 5.5 km, a Nordic Walking march, and children’s and youth races over various distances. The event is charitable, with all proceeds going to support children with autism. Organizers provide electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals, and numerous activities for participants and their families, including free museum admission and outdoor games for children.

name: Maraton Sztafet Ekiden
description: The 20th Onet Marathon Relay is Poland’s largest team running event. It will take place on May 23, 2026, at the Main Campus of the Józef Piłsudski University of Physical Education in Warsaw. This unique event brings together runners of all ability levels, with teams of six covering the marathon distance together in the Japanese ekiden relay format. The event promotes team spirit and cooperation, offering relay legs of different distances to make it easier for beginner runners to take part. It’s a great opportunity for friendly competition and for friends, families, and coworkers to come together.

name: Nowomiejska Dycha
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Nowym Mieście Lubawskim
description: Nowomiejska Dycha is a special night-time street race taking place on 23 May 2026 in Nowe Miasto Lubawskie. The course runs along the town’s atmospheric, historic streets, offering participants a unique experience and the chance to compete for attractive prizes. The programme includes two races: a 5 km race at 18:00 and a 10 km race at 20:00. Both start and finish at Nowomiejski Market Square. Participants can look forward to generous race packs, post-race meals and a great time in charming surroundings.

name: Phoenix RUN
organizer: Klub Biegowy Phoenix Contact Wielkopolska i Opalenicki Klub Biegacza
description: Phoenix RUN is a unique sporting event held in a picturesque forest near the Smolarnia forester’s lodge, close to Nowy Tomyśl. It is the second edition of the race, organized by the Phoenix Contact Wielkopolska Running Club, bringing together running and Nordic walking enthusiasts. The event offers a range of distances for adults and children, encouraging active time with family and friends. Participants can look forward to generous race packs, commemorative medals and attractive prizes, as well as a chance to socialize and enjoy the chillout zone.

name: Sieprawska Piątka
description: Sieprawska Piątka is an annual race held in Siepraw, attracting runners of different age groups and ability levels. The event takes place in a picturesque area, and the course runs through Słoneczny Park and the Orlik sports complex, offering participants comfortable conditions for competition and recreation. The race brings people together and promotes physical activity among residents and visitors. The organizers provide extensive sports facilities and support during the event.

name: Ultramaraton Jaga-Kora
description: The Jaga-Kora Ultramarathon is a mountain ultrarun held in the scenic Low Beskids, near Rymanów-Zdrój. The course follows the historic Beskid Courier Route “Jaga-Kora,” which was used during World War II. The event features five races of varying difficulty and distance, from 19 km to 101 km. The races are certified by ITRA and UTMB, underscoring their prestige and high standard of organization. Join us for the 10th edition, taking place on May 23, 2026.

name: VII Skaryszewski Bieg Konia
description: The 7th Skaryszew Horse Run is an annual running event held at the Hubertus Stud Farm in Skaryszew. The main event is the 10 km Horse Ten, which follows field, unpaved and forest roads, offering participants a chance to connect with nature and enjoy sporting competition. The event aims to promote running as a form of active recreation and a healthy lifestyle, as well as to bring the local community together. In addition to the main race, children’s races are also held, making the event appealing to the whole family.

name: X Leśne Bieganie dla Zdrowia
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Miedźnej, Szkoła Podstawowa we Frydku, Nadleśnictwo Kobiór
description: The 10th Forest Run for Health is an annual running event organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Miedźna, based in Wola. The race takes place on forest trails measuring 5.5 km and 10 km, which can be downloaded in GPX format to a smartwatch or smartphone. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and outdoor activity, encouraging runners of different ages and ability levels to take part. Registration is online, and the rules are available on the organizer’s website.

name: XV Biegiem po Wichrowskich Lasach
description: The 15th Run Through the Wichrowo Forests is an annual running event organized by the Wichrowo Forest District, attracting people who enjoy spending active time outdoors in nature. The main event is a 10 km race through scenic forest areas. There are also races for children and young people, people with intellectual disabilities, and a Nordic walking event. The start and finish are located at the Wichrowo Forest District office, and participants can take part in a familiarization run on the course.

name: XVI Bieg Koziołków
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Kędzierzynie-Koźlu
description: The 16th Koziołki Run is an annual running event held in Kędzierzyn-Koźle, aimed mainly at children and young people. The event takes place on May 23, 2026, and features professional RFID timing to ensure accurate results. It is organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Kędzierzyn-Koźle. A family-friendly sporting event, it promotes physical activity among the youngest participants. The race starts at 4:00 p.m., and registration is open until May 18, 2026.

name: XX Bieg Lupusa
description: The 20th edition of the Lupus Run will take place on May 23, 2026, in Bartkowo, Dobroszyce. This race is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA) and offers professional timekeeping, a medal, a meal, and excellent organization and atmosphere. The event attracts athletes from across the country, creating a unique atmosphere of competition and camaraderie. Registration is now open on the dedicated website.

name: XXI Cross Maraton przez Piekło do Nieba
description: The 21st Cross Marathon “From Hell to Heaven” is a unique running event organized by the PTTK Branch in Końskie. The event will take place on May 23, 2026, and attracts both runners and recreational running enthusiasts, offering a challenging course in a picturesque area. The marathon is known for its interesting and demanding route, which passes through places called Piekło and Niebo, highlighting its character and challenge. The organizers provide professional service and support for participants.

name: XXVIII Bieg Święców
description: The 28th Święców Run in Sławno is an annual running event taking place on May 23, 2026. The 10 km main race follows city streets, including asphalt roads, basalt paving and asphalt bike paths. The course is secured and marked, with water stations along the route. The event also includes races for children and young people at the athletics stadium, over distances from 50 to 600 metres. The organisers promote community togetherness and a healthy lifestyle.

name: XXXIV Bieg Uliczny po Ziemi Makowskiej
II Podgórski Bieg i Marsz Leśnymi Ścieżkami
V Ultra Nordic Walking World Records
Biegi Śnieżnickie
description: The Śnieżnickie Runs are legendary mountain races held in picturesque Międzygórze, in the heart of the Śnieżnik Massif. The routes feature challenging climbs and technical descents, taking runners along beautiful forest trails and gravel roads, as well as to the very summit of Śnieżnik. This event has a rich tradition dating back to the 1990s and attracts both recreational runners and elite athletes from across Europe. Participants can choose between the classic 9.6 km alpine race and the Śnieżnik Half Marathon, approximately 21 km long, which loops around the Crown of Śnieżnik.

name: 14. Bieg Firmowy Wrocław
description: Bieg Firmowy is Poland’s largest charity relay, taking place on May 24, 2026, in Wrocław. Corporate teams of 5 cover a total distance of 25 km, with each participant running or walking 5 km. The event brings together sport, team building, and support for the beneficiaries of the Everest Foundation, who are facing serious health challenges. Participants can choose the in-person format at the University of Physical Education and the Olympic Stadium in Wrocław, or take part online from anywhere in the world. Bieg Firmowy is not only a sporting event but also an important social and charitable initiative.

name: 12 Bieg Elegant na 5
description: The 12th Elegant na 5 Run is an annual running event held in Mosina, scheduled for May 24 in 2026. The event offers a variety of distances for children, young people and people with disabilities, as well as a 5 km main race that runs through the streets of the Mosina municipality. The start and finish are at Plac 20 Października, and the main race begins at 11:15. Participants can choose a basic or extended package with a T-shirt, making the event appealing to a wide range of runners.

name: Bieg o rogatywkę rotmistrza Witolda Pile...
description: The Witold Pilecki Cavalry Captain’s Cap Race is organized by the “Zielone Światło Dla Wrząsowic” Association in Wrząsowice. The race takes place on June 8, 2025, at 10:00. Timing is provided electronically and professionally by Time-Sport.pl, a leader in timing at sporting events in Poland. This sporting event combines the spirit of competition with a tribute to Cavalry Captain Witold Pilecki, giving it a distinctive character.

name: Biegamy, nie klikamy!
organizer: Biegamy, nie klikamy i Rotary Club Warszawa Konstancin
description: We Run, We Don’t Click! is a charity 5 km run taking place on May 24, 2026, in the picturesque Chojnowski Landscape Park in Konstancin-Jeziorna. The course consists of two 2.5 km loops through pine and mixed forests, with gentle terrain suitable for runners of all experience levels. The start and finish are located at the forest car park on Od Lasu Street, offering easy access and convenient conditions for spectators. The event is inclusive and charitable, and all proceeds will be donated to the Special Needs School Complex in Pęchery. Participation is free for primary and secondary school students.

name: BoryRun
description: BoryRun 2026 is the largest running festival in the Lower Silesian Forests, taking place on May 24, 2026, in Osiecznica. The event combines sport, health, and mindful time offline, promoting intergenerational connection and the joy of movement without the pressure of competition. The routes pass through the scenic Lower Silesian Forests and the historic setting of Kliczków Castle, offering a chance to connect with the region’s nature and history. Children can take part in the special Boryrun Active race, featuring activities that build fitness and self-confidence.

name: Gontyniec Ultra Trail
description: Gontyniec Ultra Trail is a mountain trail race held on the picturesque Gontyniec Hill in Chodzież, the highest elevation in the Greater Poland Lake District. The courses run mainly along forest trails marked with red and yellow signs, offering runners a variety of distances and elevation gains. Organized by the Gontyniec Ultra Trail Foundation, the event attracts cross-country and ultrarunning enthusiasts from across Poland, offering unique challenges over distances from 12 to 52 km. This iconic event combines sporting competition with the beauty of nature and the history of the region.

name: IV Honorowy Bieg Kadecki
description: The 4th Honorary Cadet Run is a special sporting event organized by I LO PUL Kutno – Uniformed Services High School, held to mark the Regimental Day of the 37th Infantry Regiment. The run pays tribute to local history and uniformed-services traditions. Participants tackle a 5.5 km obstacle course at the military training ground in Kutno. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Kutno, Mariusz Sikora, and welcomes everyone who enjoys physical activity to compete and have fun. The run is scheduled to start on May 24, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. at the AMZ S.A. Training Ground in Kutno, on Metalowa Street.

name: Kęcka Piątka
description: Kęcka Piątka is a 5 km road race held in the picturesque town of Kęty. The certified course runs through the town streets, with key turns and junctions secured to ensure participants’ safety. The race is a local sporting celebration that promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity among residents and visitors. It is organized by the Kęty Sports and Recreation Centre under the patronage of the Mayor of the Kęty Municipality. Runners aged 14 and over are invited to take part in this energetic event.

name: Mucharskie Pętle
description: Mucharskie Pętle Run is a unique running event held in the picturesque setting of Lake Mucharskie and the hills of the Little Beskids. The course is suitable both for beginner runners and for those looking for a more challenging trail run. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts to join this event and enjoy its great sporting atmosphere. It will take place on May 24, 2026, in Mucharz. Places are limited, and registration is online.

name: Prusice Biegają - etap 2
description: The 13th edition of Prusice Biegają is a sporting event held on Żmigrodzka Street, next to the Prusice Fitness Center in Prusice. The course runs along the streets of Prusice and through Pietrowice Małe, offering participants scenic and runner-friendly conditions. The event is a great opportunity to spend time actively and compete within the local running community.

name: VI Niechanowska Dyszka i Piątka
description: The 6th Niechanowo 10K and 5K is an annual race held in the picturesque Planty Park in Niechanowo. The event offers two popular race distances: 10 km and 5 km, attracting both recreational and more experienced runners. It is an athletics event and a great opportunity to spend time outdoors in a friendly atmosphere. The organizers provide professional timekeeping and technical support.

name: XII Bieg z książką
description: The 12th Run with a Book, ON THE TRAIL TO THE FINISH, is an open running event organized by the Nicolaus Copernicus University Alumni Program and the NCUM Marathon Club. It is dedicated to the Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń community and to fans of running and reading. The race takes place on the university campus in Bielany, Toruń, and its route follows forest paths and lanes through the campus woodland. Participants must complete the course while holding a book weighing at least 100 grams, highlighting the event’s unique combination of sport and the promotion of reading. The race is sponsored by Robert Małecki, a crime fiction author and NCUM alumnus, who takes part in the race and meets participants after the competition.

name: XIV Panewnicki Bieg Dzika (5)
organizer: Akademia Wychowania Fizycznego im. Jerzego Kukuczki w Katowicach
description: The 14th Panewnicki Bieg Dzika is a 10 km road race taking place on May 24, 2026, in Katowice. It is an excellent opportunity for runners of all levels to test their fitness on a scenic course. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using dedicated training plans tailored to their individual level. The event is open and runner-friendly, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle.

name: XVII Bieg Uliczny o Łaziskie Liście
organizer: Miasto Łaziska Górne, MOSiR Łaziska Górne
description: The 17th A. Kaleja “Łaziskie Liście” Street Race is an annual running event held in Łaziska Górne. In 2026, it will take place on May 24 at the municipal stadium. Runners can compete over 5 km and 10 km distances; the 10 km course consists of two laps of the 5 km course. The event also includes races for children, young people and seniors, held the day before, bringing generations together through sport. Registration for the main races and Nordic walking is online only. The event is organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Łaziska Górne, which works to ensure accessibility and support for all participants.

name: XXII Bieg Sanguszków
organizer: Uczniowski Klub Sportowy „OGRODNIK” i Zespół Szkół Ekonomiczno-Ogrodniczych w Tarnowie
description: The 22nd Sanguszko Run is an annual running event taking place on May 24, 2026, in Sanguszko Park in Tarnów. The event is organized by Kępa Sport, LKS Burzyn, and the “OGRODNIK” School Sports Club. The aim of the run is to promote running and bring the running community together. Participants can expect electronic timekeeping and professional event organization.

name: IX Bieg Uliczny Z Siódemką na 7-kę
XXII Bieg Patrona Miasta św. Andrzeja Boboli
Myślenicki Półmaraton
description:
As part of the First Myślenice Running Festival, the organizers are planning four race formats: a PZLA-certified half marathon, the 4×5 km Business Relay, the 5 km Saturday Night Rave Run, and children’s races.
The event will also feature a Runner’s Village with an EXPO zone and space for families.
The organizers are especially keen to welcome people who will run their first half marathon in Myślenice.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo Sporty, or Active Czerwonak at Night, is a recurring, free sporting event organized by the Centre for the Development of Physical Culture in Czerwonak. The event takes place in the evening and combines physical activity with bringing the local community together. It is a long-standing tradition that attracts participants who want to spend time outdoors, running or walking in a friendly atmosphere.
additional: The event is free and takes place from 19:30 to 22:00. This evening sporting event is part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix series. There is no information about participant limits, fees, or start waves. Previous events have taken place in the evening; available results from one edition indicate a distance of 5 km.

name: Leśna Piątka Pikuś
description: Leśna Piątka Pikuś is a cross-country race held in the picturesque forest of the Karnieszewice Forest District in Koszalin. The 10 km route passes through charming woodland, with numerous uphill and downhill sections and a stretch alongside a deep ravine, making the race challenging and full of excitement. Every participant who completes the distance will receive a commemorative medal. The start and finish are at the car park by the educational trail, providing easy access and convenient logistics.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Warszawa – edycja nocna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Warszawa - Night Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place in picturesque locations, and the night edition stands out for its unique medals for participants. The race is ideal for runners who value scenic routes and a sense of community.

name: XXVII Bieg na Groń Jana Pawła II
location: Ponikiew, Wadowice County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: XIII Smolecka (za)Dyszka
location: Smolec, Kąty Wrocławskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The XIII Smolec (za)Dyszka is a 10 km road race around the village of Smolec, taking place on May 30, 2026, at 6:00 PM. The race follows a certified course and is organized by running enthusiasts and volunteers who ensure plenty of fun and sporting excitement. The event attracts recreational runners, families, and residents of the Kąty Wrocławskie Municipality and Lower Silesia. The organizers provide professional event management and a friendly atmosphere.

name: Bieg na Sleze
description: The Bieg na Ślężę is one of the oldest mountain races in Poland, held in Sobótka on the slopes of the Ślęża Massif. The approximately 5 km course, with over 500 metres of elevation gain, follows scenic, challenging mountain trails and finishes at the summit of Ślęża, next to the mountain shelter. The race attracts both top competitors and amateurs who want to take on the legendary climb to the “Ślężański Olympus.”

name: Ultraroztocze
description: Roztocze Ultra Race is a unique running event taking place on May 30, 2026, in Józefów, in the Roztocze region. Participants can choose from a variety of courses, from short night runs to ultra distances of 60 km and 120 km, which lead through the picturesque Roztocze countryside. The event is organized by the Janosik Race Series Foundation, which has promoted an active and mindful lifestyle through sport since 2014. The race attracts both recreational and experienced runners, offering unforgettable experiences and a chance to connect with nature.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Zielona Góra – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Zielona Góra – Spring 2026 edition is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Botanical Garden of the University of Zielona Góra. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which has been promoting running and the beauty of natural routes in Greater Poland and other regions since 2014. The route in Zielona Góra consists of two loops, allowing participants to enjoy the charms of nature and a challenging yet attractive terrain profile. The organizers are running enthusiasts who emphasize the aesthetics and character of cross-country routes.

name: RockRun Jarocin
description: Rock Run Jarocin is a unique running event taking place on May 30, 2026, combining sport, music, and the atmosphere of Jarocin, a city known as the heart of Polish rock. The race attracts both experienced runners and first-timers, offering a route through the most interesting parts of the Jarocin municipality. It is not only a sporting competition, but also a community of enthusiasts and a great sporting adventure that stays with you for a long time. The event is part of the Greater Poland Half Marathon Grand Prix and emphasizes good organization and enthusiastic support from spectators.

name: 13 Bieg Konopielki
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury w Gminie Juchnowiec Kościelny
description: The 13th Konopielka Run is an annual running event held in Juchnowiec Dolny, scheduled for May 30 in 2026. The main 10 km race starts at noon, preceded by the traditional Family Run. After the competition, participants are invited to a social gathering in Frampol, the birthplace of Edward Redliński, author of the novel “Konopielka.” The race pack includes a soft blanket that can be used for a picnic after the race. The event’s family-friendly and literary atmosphere makes it unique.

name: 8 Borowiacka Dycha
description: Borowiacka Dycha is an annual 10 km race held in the picturesque surroundings of the Tuchola Forest. The event attracts runners who enjoy being close to nature and competing on a moderately challenging course. The organizers, Stowarzyszenie Biegające Śliwice, ensure professional organization and a welcoming atmosphere for participants. The race is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich, highlighting its importance in the local running calendar.

name: Bieg o Złotą Kaczkę
description: The Golden Duck Run is an annual running event held in Toszek. Its aim is to promote running and Nordic walking as recreational activities, encourage a healthy lifestyle, and foster social integration, including for people with disabilities. The main race course is approximately 10 km long and runs over mixed terrain, including cobblestones, asphalt, country roads, and park paths, with soft surfaces predominating. The start and finish are at Toszek Castle. The organizers offer numerous age and special categories, as well as trophies for the top competitors.

name: Bieg Tropem Kaszubskiego Stolema
description: The Tropem Kaszubskiego Stolema Run is a 10 km road race taking place on May 30, 2026, in Żelkowo, Kashubia. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for race day with training plans tailored to different experience levels. The organizers encourage runners to use the training plans and expert support to prepare for the race as effectively as possible. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl race calendar, a platform supporting runners across Poland.

name: Biegowe Grand Prix Mazur
organizer: Silent Hill Resort Sp. z o.o.
description: The Masurian Running Grand Prix is a series of races held in the picturesque Masuria region, promoting running close to nature. The routes pass through forests and along lakes, giving participants the chance to enjoy the beauty of nature. The event attracts runners who value outdoor activity and the charm of Masurian landscapes.

name: Dolska Dycha
organizer: Centrum Promocji, Kultury i Sportu w Dolsku
description: Dolska Dycha is a 10 km road race taking place on May 30, 2026, in Dolsk. The course is certified by the PZLA and marked every kilometer. It runs through the Dolsk municipality with traffic closed to vehicles. The event also includes a 3 km race, “Kozia Trójka.” Runners can expect aid stations, medical care, and a post-race recovery meal. The event aims to promote running and a healthy lifestyle, as well as the town and municipality of Dolsk.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: The 146th Gliwice Park Running Challenge is an annual running event held in the scenic park behind Piast Stadium in Gliwice. The event combines sport, a great atmosphere, and time in the city’s green spaces, making it suitable both for experienced runners and for anyone looking to spend time actively without the pressure of competition. The race traditionally starts in the clearing behind Piast Stadium. The race office opens at 9:00, and the start is at 10:00. Advance registration and an entry fee are required. It’s a great opportunity to start the new month actively.

name: Kresowe Trail #6
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale trail races held amid the scenic natural surroundings of Eastern Poland and the Vilnius Region. The routes are marked according to cycling standards to make navigation easier. Distances include the shorter Szpurt (approx. 7 km) and the longer Wertep (approx. 17–21 km), which features elements of ultra trail. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, respect for nature and local communities, and builds a community of runners in the spirit of passion, competition, and friendship. The competition runs throughout the season and concludes with overall and team standings.

name: Patrol Graniczny 7
description: Border Patrol 2026 is a race held in Opava that attracts outdoor enthusiasts and fans of off-road sports. The event is an endurance challenge, taking place on routes with varied terrain. The organizers invite both experienced runners and amateurs to take part, offering unforgettable sporting experiences in scenic surroundings.

name: Roztocze Ultra Race
description: Roztocze Ultra Race is a unique ultrarunning event held in the picturesque Roztocze National Park in Józefów. The race offers a variety of courses, from shorter distances to challenging 60 km and 120 km ultras, taking runners through the charming landscapes of Roztocze. It’s an event for running enthusiasts who want to discover lesser-known natural areas and take on off-road challenges. The organizers, the Janosik Race Series Foundation, ensure professional organization and a welcoming atmosphere.

name: Run4aSmile
description: Run4aSmile is a 10 km race taking place on May 30, 2026, in Nowy Sącz. Participants can use training plans tailored to different experience levels to prepare optimally for the race. The event is a road race and offers a great opportunity to test your fitness and spend time actively in the picturesque surroundings of Małopolska. The organizers encourage both beginners and experienced runners to take part.

name: Wadowicka Dycha
description: Wadowicka Dycha is a 10 km road race held in the picturesque town of Wadowice and the surrounding areas, including Zawadka and Chocznia. The asphalt course has approximately 100 m of elevation gain and runs through the town center, starting and finishing at the Market Square in Wadowice. Before the main race, events for children and young people are also held over 200 m and 400 m, with separate classifications for girls and boys. The race is an excellent opportunity to spend time actively and connect with the local running community.

name: XI Bieg Memoriałowy
description: The 11th Adam Lewandowski Memorial Run in Orchowo is an annual running event organized by the Orchowo Municipality. The run commemorates Adam Lewandowski and attracts runners from various age categories. The event takes place in Orchowo and offers an opportunity for sporting competition and bringing the local community together. The organizers warmly invite all running enthusiasts to take part.

name: XI Bieg Pamięci Grupy Kampinos Żołnierzy...
location: Zespół Sportowo-Rekreacyjny, Leszno, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 11th Kampinos Group Home Army Soldiers Memorial Run is a race commemorating the soldiers of the Kampinos Group of the Home Army. The event takes place in Leszno, and the start and finish of the main race and the Children’s Races are on the track at the Sports and Recreation Complex. The main race is 11 km long and is held in a spirit of historical remembrance.

name: XV Kwidzyński Bieg Papiernika
organizer: MM Kwidzyn sp. z o.o. oraz Fundacja Opiekuńcza MM Kwidzyn
description: The 15th Kwidzyn Paperworkers’ Run is an annual running event established in 2010 out of a passion for running and promoting physical activity for health and fun. The 10 km race runs through the center of Kwidzyn and brings together the local community and runners from all over Poland. The event accompanies Paperworkers’ Day, a celebration for MM Kwidzyn employees, and participation in the race and other attractions is free. It is organized by MM Kwidzyn sp. z o.o. and the MM Kwidzyn Care Foundation.

name: XV Żmigrodzki Bieg Smoka
description: The 15th Żmigród Dragon Run is an annual running event taking place on May 30, 2026, in Żmigród. Participants cover a 10-kilometer route through the town streets, enjoying the sporting excitement and unique atmosphere of the event. The race attracts both experienced runners and people looking to spend time actively and test their abilities. It is also an opportunity to promote a healthy lifestyle and celebrate sport together as a local community.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The 17th Grand Prix of Mysłowice is a series of running events organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy, active lifestyle and bringing runners of all ability levels together. The event takes place in Mysłowice and is open to all age groups and running abilities. The races are free, and registration is available only at the Race Office on race day. Truchtacz Mysłowice is a community that motivates and supports participants as they discover the joy of running.

name: 1. Zielony Półmaraton
location: Konstancin-Jeziorna (Park Zdrojowy im. hrabiego Witolda Skórzewskiego)
description: “We Run, We Don’t Click! – Konstancin-Jeziorna 2026” is a charity 5 km race taking place on May 24, 2026, in the scenic Chojnów Landscape Park. The course consists of two 2.5 km loops through pine and mixed forests, with gentle terrain suitable for runners of all abilities. The start and finish are at the forest car park on Od Lasu Street, offering easy access and convenient conditions for spectators. The event combines sporting competition with community engagement and support, and all proceeds will go to the Special Education School Complex in Pęchery.

name: 13. Bieg 10km Szpot Swarzędz
description: The 13th Szpot Swarzędz 10 km Run is one of the most important 10 km running events in Wielkopolska, held since 2012. It attracts leading Polish athletes as well as runners from abroad, creating a unique atmosphere filled with sporting excitement and energy. The course is interesting and varied, with wooded sections and a route through the streets of Swarzędz. The event also includes a Family Run and a start for athletes using active wheelchairs. In 2026, the Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon returns, adding even more excitement to the running festival.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Szpot
description: The Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival is a special running event taking place on May 31, 2026. The festival features three races: the 5th Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon, the 13th Szpot Swarzędz 10K, and the 6th Szpot Swarzędz Family Run. The half-marathon course follows two loops around scenic Lake Swarzędz, while the 10K offers a dynamic route with forest sections and urban stretches. The event brings together sport, education, and charity. Participants can enjoy a well-stocked food zone, a partner expo, a post-race meal, massages, and a charity auction. The festival is open to everyone, including athletes using active wheelchairs and seniors over 70, who can take part free of charge.

name: 2. Uliczna Mila / 3. Parkowa Piątka
description: Uliczna Mila (1,609 m) and Parkowa Piątka (5 km) are road races held entirely on the paths of TAURON Park Śląski in Chorzów. The courses are certified by PZLA and World Athletics, ensuring their high quality and the opportunity to achieve official results. The races are designed to help athletes achieve their best performances. The next edition will take place on May 31, 2026, and you are warmly invited to take part.

name: 5. Półmaraton Szpot Swarzędz
description: The 5th Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon is a special running event taking place on May 31, 2026, in Swarzędz. The course consists of two loops, covering a total distance of 21.097 km, and runs along a scenic route around Lake Swarzędz. The race combines sporting excitement with professional organization, a unique atmosphere, and support from spectators, creating an unforgettable celebration of running. The Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival also features 10 km races and a Family Run, making the event appealing to different age groups and ability levels.

name: Bieg z okazji Dni Ziemi Ropczyckiej 2026
description: The Run to Celebrate the Ropczyce Region Days is a 10 km race taking place on May 31, 2026, in Ropczyce. Organized to mark a local celebration, this running event attracts runners looking to spend time actively on a moderate-distance course. The route passes through the scenic area of Ropczyce, and participants can expect typical May weather, with temperatures around 20 degrees Celsius. All running enthusiasts are welcome to take part.

name: Marceliński Bieg Wiosenny 2026
description: Marceliński Spring Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the beauty of the location. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on popularizing cross-country running in Greater Poland, offering participants a unique running experience surrounded by beautiful natural scenery.

name: Szybka Piątka 5K FAST RUN Kupienino 31.05.2026
description: Szybka Piątka 5K FAST RUN is a new running event taking place for the first time on May 31, 2026, in Kupienin near Świebodzin. The race offers a fast 5-kilometre distance, ideal for runners looking for a dynamic challenge. The event is organised for running enthusiasts who want to test their speed on a scenic course.

name: 16 Kogeneracja Biegaj w Siechnicach
description: The 16th Kogeneracja Biegaj w Siechnicach is a road race over 5 km and 10 km, taking place on May 31, 2026. The course runs along the streets of Siechnice, with participants completing a 5 km loop; runners in the 10 km race complete it twice. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity, and the recreational attractions of the Siechnice municipality. In addition to the main races, races for children and young people are also held. The start and finish are on Kościelna Street, at its intersection with Jana Pawła II Street, and the race is scheduled to start at 9:00.

name: 3 Zduńskowolski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The 3rd Zduńska Wola Running Festival is a celebratory road race through the city of Zduńska Wola, organized to mark the 200th anniversary of the city being granted municipal rights. Races are held over 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon (21 km) distances, with the start and finish at the Municipal Stadium on Łaska Street. The route runs through the city streets and the municipality of Zapolice to the village of Brzeski in the municipality of Sędziejowice, where the half-marathon turnaround point is located. Several hundred runners take part in this urban road race.

name: 4 Bieg Zawierciański
organizer: Klub Sportowy „Warto Biegać” i Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Zawierciu
description: The 4th Zawiercie Run is a running event organized by the “Warto Biegać” Sports Club and the Sports and Recreation Centre in Zawiercie. The event takes place at the OSIR Stadium in Zawiercie and features two distances: a main 10 km race and an accompanying 5 km race. The course runs along the streets of Zawiercie, is properly secured and closed to traffic, and is marked at every kilometre. The event aims to promote running and bring runners from across the country together.

name: Bieg o Koronę Księżnej Dąbrówki
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Dopiewie
description: The Run for the Crown of Princess Dąbrówka is the 15th-anniversary edition of a running event traditionally held on the last Sunday of May. The main 10 km race follows forest trails surrounded by greenery, offering pleasant conditions for running on soft ground. Nordic walking enthusiasts can take on a 7.5 km route, while the youngest participants can compete over shorter distances ranging from 200 to 1,000 metres. The start and finish are located at the edge of the Palędzie–Zakrzewo forest, on Parkowa Street in Dąbrówka. The event is family-friendly and inclusive, promoting physical activity among residents of the Dopiewo Municipality.

name: Bieg Rodzinny Radia Wrocław
description: The Radio Wrocław Family Run is a special event held to celebrate Children’s Day, bringing children and adults together in running teams. Each child runs with a guardian, highlighting the family-friendly nature of the event and the experience of covering the course together. It is not only a sporting competition but also a great opportunity to spend time together and promote physical activity among families. The event takes place in Wrocław and is organized by Radio Wrocław, which invites everyone to join this joyful run.
course_highlights: A family run with child-and-adult teams
A course suited to the family-friendly nature of the run
Organized by Radio Wrocław to celebrate Children’s Day

name: Krakowski Bieg Swoszowicki
description: The Kraków Swoszowice Run is a family-friendly running event held in the beautiful Spa Park in Swoszowice, in southern Kraków. It offers a variety of races: a 10 km main race, a 5 km race, a family mile, and races for children aged 1 to 11. The event brings generations together, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle while connecting residents of Kraków and the surrounding area. In addition to the sporting competition, participants can look forward to attractive race packs and a family picnic.

name: LoveLasTrail
description: Love'Las Trail Przystań is a unique forest race held in the picturesque forests of the Mazovia region, in the heart of the Ostrołęka Forest District. This sporting and recreational event combines competition with a love of nature, promoting a healthy lifestyle and social integration. Routes of varying difficulty are available to runners of different ability levels, as well as to families and Nordic walking enthusiasts. The race has an atmosphere full of positive energy and respect for nature, as participants in previous editions can attest.

name: Mazowiecka Piętnastka
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mińsku Mazowieckim
description: Mazowiecka Piętnastka is the 30th-anniversary edition of a nationwide road race organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Center in Mińsk Mazowiecki. The event will take place on May 31, 2026, and is a great opportunity to celebrate through sport in this picturesque town. The road race attracts runners from all over Poland, offering an appealing course and professional organization.

name: Mokotowski Bieg SGH
description: The SGH Mokotów Run is the largest charity run organized by students in Poland, combining sport with support for those in need. The event takes place in the heart of Mokotów, Warsaw, and attracts hundreds of participants—students, alumni, local residents, and running enthusiasts. The route runs through the streets of Mokotów and finishes in the SGH Rector’s Gardens. Every step makes a real difference in the lives of those in need, thanks to the support of the “Akogo?” Foundation. It’s not just about sport, but also community, solidarity, and the energy of student engagement.

name: Rio de Janeiro Virtual Challange
description: Rio de Janeiro Virtual Challenge is a virtual challenge that takes you along a route through the vibrant streets and breathtaking landscapes of Rio de Janeiro, known as the Marvelous City. Participants can track their progress using a mobile app by logging different physical activities, which are automatically converted into distance covered. The challenge lets you choose your own pace and timeframe, and take part individually or as a team. In addition, for every milestone in the challenge, the organizers plant trees or prevent plastic bottles from reaching the ocean, supporting environmental protection.

name: Stryszów w Biegu
description: The Stryszów Municipality invites you to the sporting event “Stryszów on the Run,” which will take place on May 31, 2026. The course runs through the municipality’s scenic countryside, including fields and forests, with views of Lake Mucharskie and the surrounding hills. The event offers three distances to suit different experience levels: 6 km for families and beginners, 10 km for runners seeking a challenge, and a 21 km mountain half marathon for experienced athletes. The event aims to promote physical activity, bring residents together, and showcase the region’s natural attractions.

name: UltraPark Weekend
description: UltraPark Weekend is an ultra-running festival held in Pabianice from May 29 to 31, 2026. The event features three main competitions: UltraPark 48h, UltraPark 24h, and UltraPark 100 km, which are also the Polish Championships in their respective categories. The races attract long-distance runners with challenging courses and a unique competitive atmosphere. The organizer is the "O Co Biega" Sports Club from Pabianice.

name: V Półmaraton Po Kolei
organizer: Powiatowe Centrum Sportu, Turystyki i Rekreacji w Szczytnie
description: The 5th Po Kolei Half Marathon is a race covering approximately 21.1 km, taking place on May 31, 2026, in Lemany near Szczytno. The route follows a cycling path along a former railway line and local roads, offering scenic views and well-prepared hydration and refreshment stations. The event is organized by the Szczytno County Sports, Tourism and Recreation Centre and the Szczytno County Local Tourism Organization. In addition to the half marathon, there are children’s races and a 5 km race, making the event appealing to different age groups and ability levels.

name: X Charytatywny Gminny Bieg Między Wiatra...
description: The 10th Municipal Charity Run Between the Windmills is an annual running event held in Łukaszów, aimed at promoting running, sports, and a healthy lifestyle. The event is charitable, and all funds raised are donated to support people in need. The course follows a scenic loop around the windmills in Łukaszów, and participants can choose from several distances, including a children’s race, 5 km, 10 km, and Nordic walking. Organizers provide electronic timing, as well as a hot meal and drinks for participants.

name: XI Sieradzki Cross Towarzyski
description: Sieradz Cross Social Run is an annual running event organized by the Sieradz Biega Sports Club, which promotes running and brings together the running community in the city of Sieradz. The race takes place in A. Mickiewicz Municipal Park on a 2 km loop covered with gravel, with markers every 500 m. The run lasts 6 hours, during which participants compete to complete as many laps as possible, with the option to take breaks and return to the course. The event is social and aimed at popularizing running, and participants receive electronic lap and time tracking.

name: XII Biegnij Dla Aniołów
description: TAURON Run for the Angels is a charity race held in Katowice in support of the children cared for by Dom Aniołów Stróżów. The event takes place in Kościuszko Park and combines sport with helping children in need. Participants can choose the 5 km main race, races for children in various age categories, or a virtual race. All entry fees go towards educational, therapeutic, and academic support for nearly 600 children from disadvantaged backgrounds. The event is also a family picnic packed with attractions, and every participant receives a commemorative medal and a gift.

name: XIV Kurdeszowa (Za)Dyszka
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu, Turystyki i Rekreacji w Kostrzynie
description: The 14th Kurdeszowa (Za)Dyszka in Kostrzyn is an annual race organized by the Municipal Sports, Tourism and Recreation Centre in Kostrzyn. The event offers 10 km and 5 km running races, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking march, with overall, age-group, and municipality residents’ classifications. The start and finish are on Powstańców Wielkopolskich Street, by Primary School No. 2 in Kostrzyn. The organizer plans a prize draw for participants, and the race office is open for several hours before the start.

name: XXXIX Bieg Stolemów
organizer: Kaszubskie Stowarzyszenie Kultury Fizycznej Żukowo oraz Gminny Ośrodek Turystyki i Sportu w Gniewinie
description: The 39th Stolemów Run is an annual 10 km race held at the “Arena Mistrzów” Sports Stadium in Gniewino. The event also includes races for children and young people, a 5 km Nordic walking event, and a recreational run-walk. Participants can expect electronic timing, medals for everyone, and prizes for the top finishers. For those who want to take part virtually, a virtual race option is available from May 27 to June 4, 2026.

name: Świętokrzyski Bieg Europejski
description: The Świętokrzyski European Run is a 5-kilometer road race held in Kielce, promoting physical activity and the spirit of European community. The route runs through the city streets, offering participants a sporting challenge in a friendly atmosphere. The event is part of the Funduszowy Maj 2026 activities in the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship, encouraging exercise and bringing the local community together.

name: IV Marszobieg Politechniki Częstochowskiej
location: Olsztyn, Częstochowa County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Wydminy Night Run 5K
description: Wydminy Night Run 5K is a night race held on Wydmińska Island in Wydminy. The event attracts runners who want to take on a 5-kilometer course in picturesque surroundings. The race combines recreation and sport, offering a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together. The organizers promise a unique atmosphere and unforgettable experiences during the night run.

name: III Ryszewkowy Bieg o Puchar Strażaka
Ultramaraton Babia Góra
description: Ultramaraton Babia Góra is a prestigious mountain race taking place on June 6, 2026, in Lipnica Wielka. The event features various distances, including multi-lap ultramarathons around Babia Góra and shorter races such as SkyRace®. The course runs through the scenic landscapes of Babia Góra National Park, offering challenging climbs and spectacular views. The event promotes an active lifestyle and supports the charitable work of the Rak’n’Roll Foundation. The organizer provides aid stations, medical support, and the option to have drop bags delivered to the course for the longest distances.

name: 12. Tarczyński Nocny Wrocław Półmaraton
description: The 12th Tarczyński Night Wrocław Half Marathon is one of Wrocław’s most important sporting events and will take place on June 6, 2026. Runners will follow a new, wide and safe course starting and finishing at Tarczyński Arena Wrocław. The half marathon symbolizes activity, health and the city’s openness, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad, as well as numerous spectators. The event aims to join the ranks of Europe’s largest half marathons, offering a record 21,975 race packages—a number that references the race distance.

name: II Półmaraton Miasteczkowskich Lasów
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Góra Jerzego w Miasteczku Śląskim
description: The 2nd Miasteczko Forests Half Marathon is organized by the Góra Jerzego Association in Miasteczko Śląskie and will take place on June 6, 2026. The half-marathon course is approximately 21.5 km long and runs through the town’s streets, the Świerklaniec Forest District, and the Tarnowskie Góry municipality. The start and finish are at the stadium by the Sports and Recreation Centre, making it easy for spectators to follow the race. The event will also include a 5 km run and races for children over various distances, promoting physical activity in the local community.

name: Poznańska Piwna Mila #19
description: Poznań Beer Mile is an annual cross-country race held in Poznań, attracting runners who value scenic routes and a sporty atmosphere. The event is part of a series of races organized by enthusiasts from the Greater Poland region, who have been promoting running and the beauty of local areas since 2014. The race is divided into start groups with participant limits, ensuring a comfortable experience and smooth organization. Special emphasis is placed on the scenic qualities of the route and bringing runners together.

name: Półmaraton Kurpiowski Pśejåk Bieg Szlakiem Schronów Bojowych SGO "Narew"
description: The Kurpie Pśejåk Half Marathon is a run along the route of the SGO “Narew” combat bunkers in Nowogród. The half-marathon course passes through historic areas dotted with combat bunkers, giving the race a distinctive character and combining sport with history. The event attracts runners who appreciate both off-road challenges and the atmosphere of the Kurpie region. It’s an excellent opportunity to spend time actively and learn about local history.

name: Cross Maraton u Ryśka vol 84
description: Cross Maraton u Ryśka vol 84 is a race held in Wieluń and part of the Running League, a platform promoting physical activity and running competition in Poland. The event is open to runners competing at various distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and marathon. The Running League allows participants to earn points and compete in numerous rankings throughout the year, encouraging regular running and athletic development. The race is open and inclusive, welcoming both recreational and more experienced runners.

name: Kwietny Bieg
description: The Flower Run in Lisowice is a unique 24-hour relay race that commemorates the spirit of freedom awakened by the Holy Father John Paul II during his first pilgrimage to Poland. The race takes place on a certified 1,352-meter loop, which is clearly marked and illuminated after dark. The event is open to everyone and is growing in popularity, attracting a record number of participants. Everyone who completes the distance of 10 Flower Miles (35.3 km) receives a certificate and commemorative medal. It is not only an athletic competition, but also a community event with an atmosphere full of positive energy.

name: MnO Jaszczur i Czerwony Most
description: The "Jaszczur i Czerwony Most" Orienteering Marathon is an event organized by Zgromadzenie Wędrownicze in Koszalin. It is an orienteering race that combines sporting competition with adventure and exploration. Participants can test their navigation skills and physical fitness in scenic surroundings. The event is open and welcoming to people of different ages and experience levels.

name: Nocna Dycha Kopernika Bieg z Panem Kleksem
description: Nocna Dycha Kopernika is a unique road race set in the magical surroundings of Toruń, the city of Copernicus. Participants can choose from the 10 km and 5 km distances, as well as Nordic walking, and there is also a special race for children, “Odkrywcy Mocy” (“Power Explorers”). The event takes place at night, giving it a distinctive atmosphere and appeal. The start and finish are located in the city center, and the organizers provide full logistical support and attractive race packages.

name: Sudecki Festiwal Biegów Gorskich
description: The Sudetes Mountain Running Festival continues the Riese Trail Runs in a new format, set in the picturesque area around Głuszyca. The festival offers three distances: Sudecki Olbrzym (43 km), Riese Trail Half Marathon (22 km), and Historic Ten (10 km), with routes available in GPX format. The event attracts mountain running enthusiasts with challenging yet beautiful routes in the Sudetes. The organizer provides professional support and rankings in the international ITRA and UTMB Index systems.

name: XII Festiwal Biegu Rzeźnika
description: The 12th Rzeźnik Run Festival will take place from June 3–6, 2026, in Cisna. This unique running event in the Bieszczady Mountains offers a wide range of distances, from 5 km to an extreme 500 km, including ultraruns, marathons, and children’s races. The routes pass through the picturesque mountain landscapes of the Beskids, offering unforgettable views and challenges for runners of varying experience levels. The festival is also an opportunity to take part in hiking and cycling events, as well as other accompanying activities.

name: Bieg pod Tysiącletnimi Dębami
description: The Run Beneath the Thousand-Year-Old Oaks is a unique sporting event held in picturesque Kazimierz Biskupi, in the heart of the Bieniszew Forest. The race combines sport, history, and the beauty of the local landscape, taking participants along an avenue of thousand-year-old oaks in the Pustelnik Nature Reserve. The event is open to experienced runners, recreational runners, and families, with races over various distances as well as a Nordic walking event. It is organized by the Active Kazimierz Biskupi Association and the Municipality of Kazimierz Biskupi, and its tradition dates back to the beginning of the 21st century.

name: Bieg Śladem Konia
description: The Śladem Konia Run is an annual running event organized by the Wrocław PIAST Running Club and held at the Partynice horse racing track in Wrocław. The run is recreational and athletic in nature, attracting both casual runners and more experienced athletes. The route takes runners through scenic surroundings, combining elements of the natural landscape with the urban environment. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the running community together.

name: I Bieg po Jagodę Kamczacką
location: PLANTIN Haskap Berry Plantation, Muniakowice, Poland
description: The 1st Haskap Berry Run is a unique sporting event that combines a passion for running with the idea of a healthy lifestyle and closeness to nature. The race takes place at PLANTIN’s haskap berry plantation in Muniakowice near Kraków, with the start, finish and race village located in the heart of the plantation. The race is part of the Berry Relay and promotes mindful food choices and local products. It is not just a competition, but also a gathering of people who value outdoor activity and authentic experiences.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Warszawa
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Warsaw is a prestigious triathlon held in the heart of Poland’s capital, combining a swim in Lake Zegrzyńskie, a 90 km bike ride to central Warsaw, and a half-marathon run. The event attracts both experienced triathletes and amateurs, offering the opportunity to qualify for the IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship. The atmosphere is filled with sporting excitement and the historic spirit of Warsaw, and the finish line is at the Multimedia Fountain Park, adding a unique character to the race.

name: Pogórzański Festiwal Biegowy - Lato
description: Pogórzański Running Festival – Summer is a running event held on June 7, 2026, in Burzyn near Tuchów. The event promotes running and a healthy lifestyle among residents of Małopolska, offering races at various distances, including a 22 km mountain run, a 10 km race, a 5.5 km race, and Nordic walking. The start and finish are at the LKS Burzyn stadium by Burzyn Primary School, where changing rooms and showers are also available. Participants receive a race pack with a gift, water, and snacks along the course and at the finish.

name: Test Coopera dla wszystkich
description: The Cooper Test for Everyone is a nationwide, free fitness test in which participants cover as much distance as possible in 12 minutes. It is open to everyone, regardless of age, gender, or running experience. Participants receive a race bib, a certificate with their result, and a bottle of water. It’s a great opportunity to check your fitness and get motivated to stay physically active.

name: VI EKO Bieg z Gwizdkiem po Zdrowie
description: The 6th Eco Run with a Whistle for Health takes place on June 7, 2026, in Jerzmanowice. The event is organized by Tomasz Gwizdała, Mayor of the Jerzmanowice-Przeginia Municipality, and KKS Jura Moto Sport. The run has an environmental focus and promotes a healthy lifestyle. Participants can use the official race-package exchange to safely buy or sell entry packages. The start and race office are at Chochołowy Dwór in Jerzmanowice.

name: X Festiwal Biegów Polski Północnej i Akt...
description: The 10th Festival of Runs of Northern Poland and Physical Activity in Wdzydze is a celebratory, tenth edition of an event promoting running and physical activity in the scenic Kashubian region.
