The event takes place on June 5–7, 2026, with its base at the sports field on Leśna Street in Wdzydze Kiszewskie. The festival brings together the running community of Northern Poland, promotes a healthy lifestyle, and celebrates local culture and nature. The programme includes races of various distances, Nordic walking, and cycling rallies.

name: XIII Maraton i Półmaraton Fundacji DASZR...
description: The 13th DASZRADE Foundation Marathon and Half Marathon in memory of Barbara Karaczyńska is a small-scale running event held in Opalenie, organized by the Daszrade Foundation in cooperation with the “Zapowiednik” Addiction Treatment Center. The marathon course is entirely paved, running through the picturesque fields and forests of Kociewie. It is certified by the Polish Athletics Association and features numerous, fairly steep climbs, with a total elevation gain of 646 m. The race takes place on a June morning and offers unforgettable views and a unique atmosphere. After the race, participants can look forward to a recovery meal, and everyone who finishes will receive a commemorative medal, diploma, and T-shirt.

name: XV Bieg Pszczyński
description: The 15th Carbo Asecura Pszczyna Run is an annual running event held in Pszczyna since 2012. The main race follows a familiar and popular 10 km course, run according to tried-and-tested rules. The event also includes races for children and teenagers, making it appealing to families and participants of all ages. All runners are invited to take part in this friendly, traditional sporting event.

name: 10 Bieg po Gminie Świerczów
location: Dąbrowa, Świerczów Municipality, Opole Voivodeship, Poland

IV Bieg Charytatywny Nagronik
location: Stryszawa, Sucha County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: XXX Bieg Łagowskiego Lata
location: Łagów, Świebodzin County, Lubusz Voivodeship, Poland

name: 189 Pobino i 73 popekspres
location: Brynek, Tarnowskie Góry County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Ekstremalny Półmaraton Górski
location: Lipowa, Żywiec County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 4 Skolwińska Mila
description: The 4th Skolwińska Mile is an annual street race held in Szczecin, attracting both adults and children. The event takes place on June 13, 2026, and continues the tradition of previous editions, offering participants the chance to compete over a short distance. The race is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together. The organizers provide an easy way to get in touch via the entry form, as well as administrative support.
course_highlights: A 1-mile (1,609-meter) course in a scenic recreational area
Online registration and timing by Sport-Time
Prizes for the top finishers and medals for everyone who finishes
additional: The event also includes children's races over a distance of approximately 200 meters. Participants can use the entry form available on the website to contact the organizer and system administrator quickly. Participants can use training plans lasting from 8 to 20 weeks. The event is supported by a local building-supply store, and the participant limit is 60.

name: IV Bilczańska Dycha
organizer: Zakład Gospodarki Komunalnej i Rekreacji w Morawicy
description: The 3rd Bilcza 10K is a 10 km road race held in the recreational areas of Bilcza Park in the municipality of Morawica. The event is aimed at running enthusiasts of all ages. On race day, children’s races and a family festival are also held. The race is open to all and promotes active recreation in the scenic Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship.

name: 23 Wilcza Dycha
description: Borowiacka Dycha is an annual 10 km race organized by the Biegające Śliwice association. The event promotes an active lifestyle and attracts runners from the region, offering a scenic course surrounded by the Tuchola Forests. The race takes place in Osieczna and is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich. Participants can expect professional organization and a friendly atmosphere.

name: 7 Szamotulska Nocna Piątka
description: Szamotulska Night Five is an annual, officially certified 5 km race held in Szamotuły. The course runs through the city streets, giving participants the opportunity to compete at a professional level and earn recognized results. The event is open to everyone, including children and families, who can take part in accompanying races over shorter distances. The main race starts in the evening, giving the event its distinctive nighttime character. The organizers look after participants’ comfort by offering refreshments after the race and awarding the winners.

name: 8 Bieg Chwalisza
description: The 8th edition of the Chwalisz Run is an annual charity race taking place on June 13, 2026, in Ściernie. The start and finish are located at Preschool No. 1 – Ściernie branch. The 5 km course runs mainly along forest trails, with minimal asphalt, offering both challenges and the joy of running for experienced competitors and beginners alike. All entry fees will go toward supporting Antoś Synowiec, a child with a rare genetic disease, underscoring the charitable nature of the event. The organizers also invite participants to join group training sessions every Thursday at 19:00.

name: Bieg Iskry
description: Bieg Iskry is a unique running event taking place on June 13, 2026, at Mielec Airport. Participants will cover a 6.5 km route along the runway beneath the illuminated lights and setting sun, creating a one-of-a-kind aviation atmosphere. The organizers provide professional medals, T-shirts featuring an Iskra aircraft, and prizes in the form of trophies and tandem-flight vouchers. After the run, participants can admire the aircraft and enjoy refreshments and dietary supplements.

name: Bieg Recepta na Zdrowie
description: The eighth nationwide “Prescription for Health” run will take place on June 13, 2026, at Arturówek in Łódź. This healthy running event promotes physical activity, integration between the running and pharmaceutical communities, and a healthy lifestyle. The routes follow a 5 km loop in Łagiewnicki Forest, with 5 km and 10 km race distances and a 5 km Nordic Walking event. Shorter races for children and young people will be held on the same route. A family picnic with free screenings and consultations will take place near the start and finish.

name: II Leśny Bieg Gminy Brzeźnio - Tumidaj
Leśna ZaDyszka
description: Leśna ZaDyszka is a race held in the picturesque Szulmierz Forest District in the Regimin municipality, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle in woodland surroundings. The course consists of a 5 km loop that runs along forest tracks and an asphalt section, showcasing the beauty of the Masovian countryside. Participants can choose from three events: 5 km, 10 km (two loops), and 5 km Nordic Walking. A 1.5 km fun run without rankings is planned for children. The start and finish are located in a forest clearing by the Szulmierz–Regimin road, and times are recorded using a professional chip timing system.

name: Memoriał Mariana Szymańskiego
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Radomsku
description: The 13th Radomsko Street Run, the Marian Szymański Memorial, is an annual running event held in Radomsko in memory of Marian Szymański. The race takes place on the city streets, offering participants the chance to compete in a friendly atmosphere. It is organized by the City of Radomsko and the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Radomsko, with timing provided by Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu. The race is scheduled to start at 17:30, and online registration is open until June 10, 2026.

name: VIII Kwidzyńska zaDyszka
description: The 8th Kwidzyn zaDyszka is a 10 km road race taking place on June 13, 2026, in Kwidzyn. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for race day with training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is open to runners with varying levels of experience who want to spend time actively and compete on a moderately challenging course. The organizers provide expert support and access to a platform for managing race information.

name: XII Wojewódzki Bieg Przełajowy o Puchar ...
description: The 12th Provincial Badger Cup Cross-Country Run is a running event organized by the Municipality of Murów. It will take place on June 13, 2026, in Zagwiździe, on the grounds of the historic Ironworks complex. The event includes several categories: a 12 km run, a 3.5 km run, children’s races, and Nordic walking. The race office will be open from 8:00 to 9:30, and timing will be electronic. This sporting event combines competition with a beautiful historic setting, encouraging physical activity and community engagement.

name: XIX Bieg Marszałka
description: The 19th Marshal’s Run is an annual road race held in Sulejówek, commemorating the tradition of the pre-war Sulejówek–Belweder marches. The main race, approximately 10 km long, takes place in June, recalling Józef Piłsudski’s settling in Sulejówek. The event also includes accompanying races, including the 3.6 km Halina Zielińska Memorial and races for children. The race has a patriotic and sporting character, with uniformed services and museum professionals taking part. The start and finish are at 94 Paderewskiego Street, beside Villa Bzów.

name: XV Bieg Szlakiem Króla Zygmunta Starego
description: The 15th Run Along the Trail of King Sigismund the Old is an annual race held in Kozienice, commemorating the historic route associated with King Sigismund the Old. The event attracts runners from various regions, offering a scenic route and sporting competition. The organizers provide professional support and a friendly atmosphere for participants.

name: 200 setny maraton - święto biegania z Ze...
XIX Bieg Zajączkowski
location: Zajączki Drugie, Gmina Krzepice, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: XVI Grand Prix Stargardu Cztery Pory Roku
location: Morzyczyn, Stargard County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Nocny Maraton Kanału Bydgoskiego od 2007r.
description: The Bydgoszcz Canal Night Marathon is Poland’s oldest continuously held night marathon, taking place since 2007. The race is run in the unique nighttime setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty and along the Bydgoszcz Canal’s distinctive historic hydraulic structures: its 18th-century locks. The canal is the oldest inland waterway in Poland. The event attracts runners from across Poland and abroad, offering generous race packs, original medals and T-shirts, and professional timekeeping. It is growing in prestige and is known for its lively atmosphere, live music, and numerous accompanying attractions.
course_highlights: A night race in the setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty
A route along the historic 18th-century locks of the Bydgoszcz Canal
A unique atmosphere with live music and artistic experiences
additional: There are 6 distances. Participants receive original medals, commemorative T-shirts, and generous race packs. Professional electronic timekeeping and race numbers are provided. Live music adds to the event’s appeal for runners and spectators. The event features 6 distances, electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals and T-shirts, and generous race packs. Participants can expect professional course markings and artistic entertainment during the race.

name: TATRA FEST 2026
description: Tatra Fest is a unique mountain festival held in Zakopane, bringing together a variety of outdoor disciplines, including trail running, climbing, cycling, trekking, and family activities. The event includes challenging races along Tatra trails, such as the 68 km Tatra Fest Bieg and the 22 km Tatra Fest Run, offering participants unforgettable experiences amid the Tatras’ picturesque landscapes. The festival attracts both professionals and amateurs, promoting physical activity, connection with nature, and environmental responsibility. The organizers invite everyone to celebrate life and the mountain spirit together.

name: Zawojski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The Zawoja Running Festival is one of the largest sporting events in the region, held amid the picturesque scenery of Babia Góra and the Police Mountain Range. The festival attracts runners from across Poland and abroad, offering a variety of mountain race distances and a unique atmosphere. The event aims to popularize mountain running and promote the beauty of Babia Góra National Park, combining a sporting adventure with an opportunity to discover the region’s natural and cultural wealth.

name: XVII Elbląski Bieg Piekarczyka Mini Bieg Piekarczyka
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Elblągu
description: The 17th Elbląg Piekarczyk Run is an annual running event held in Elbląg, attracting runners to the 5 km and 10 km races, as well as the Mini Piekarczyk Run for children. The event is known for its unique atmosphere of sporting excitement and community, and participants receive exclusive collectible medals. The organizers provide comfortable race-day facilities, including a race office where participants can collect their race packs, a baggage deposit, and sanitary facilities. The race is a great opportunity to enjoy an active day and compete on the city’s scenic routes.

name: Bieg Charytatywny
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Oławie, Stowarzyszenie Ludzi Aktywnych „Biegnij Oławo”
description: The CZTERY PORY ROKU Charity Run – Stage IV is a sporting event held in Oława, in the park by the railway station. Participants can take part in a run of approximately 5 km or a Nordic Walking march along the same route. The event is charitable and coordinated by the „Biegnij Oławo” Association of Active People and the Oława Municipal Office. The race office is open on race day from 09:30 to 10:30, and the start is scheduled for the same day. The event is supported by local partners, and timing is provided by ZmierzymyCzas.pl.

name: Dziki Trail
description: Dziki Groń is a demanding mountain course in the Pieniny Ultra-Trail® series, following hiking and courier routes as well as the pastures of the Little Pieniny Mountains. The race offers scenic views of the Tatras and the Beskid Mountains, with the start and finish at Dietl Square in Szczawnica. The course is intended for experienced mountain runners looking to take on challenging natural terrain. The event is part of the Pieniny Ultra-Trail mountain running festival, which promotes an active lifestyle and the Pieniny region.

name: IV Charytatywny Bieg z Żonkilem
organizer: Zespół Szkół Ekonomicznych im. Gen. Stefana Roweckiego "Grota" w Opolu
description: The 4th Charity Daffodil Run is a sporting event organized by the Gen. Stefan Rowecki “Grot” School of Economics in Opole. The event will take place on June 14, 2026, on Bolko Island by the Laba Café. Participants can take part in a 5 km run, a 2.5 km Nordic walking event, or support the cause without participating. The run is a charity event that promotes physical activity and support for those in need.

name: Rozbiegane Suwałki
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Suwałkach
description: Rozbiegane Suwałki is an annual citywide celebration of running held in June in Suwałki. The three-day event attracts hundreds of participants of all ages and ability levels. The program includes children’s races, the Bieg na Piątkę (5 km), the Suwalska Ćwiartka (10.5 km), and the Śniadaniowy Bieg na Wyspę (approx. 3.5 km). The courses are flat and fast, making them ideal for personal bests, and the atmosphere is full of sporting competition and community spirit.

name: Suszecki dziki bieg
description: Suszecki Dziki Bieg is a running event organized by the Suszec Municipal Sports Centre, promoting an active lifestyle among children, young people, and adults. The races will take place on June 13–14, 2026, at the Gwaruś Recreation Centre in Suszec. Participants can compete over 5 km, 10 km, and half-marathon (21 km) distances, as well as in races for children and young people. Combined classifications over 5+21 km and 10+21 km, with prizes in kind, are available for the most determined runners. The friendly atmosphere welcomes both recreational and more experienced runners.

name: VIII Rodzinny Festiwal Biegowy o Złotą K...
description: The 8th Family Running Festival for the Golden K takes place in Dobczyce and is organized by the Rozbiegane Dobczyce group, which has brought together runners from Dobczyce and the surrounding area since 2016. This family running event promotes physical activity and the integration of the local community. The festival welcomes all participants, regardless of age or experience level.

name: X Bieg o Złotą Monetę
description: The 9th Charity Run for the Golden Coin in Olsztyn is an annual running event organized by the Future for Children Foundation, which supports sick and disabled children in Warmia and Mazury. The 5 km main race takes place by Lake Ukiel and is suitable for everyone, including first-time runners. The event also features a family picnic and numerous attractions. Taking part is not only a sporting competition, but above all a way to support children in need. The main race is scheduled to start at 16:30, and the scenic course is also accessible to those who prefer walking.

name: Maraton Smolecki
location: Smolec, Kąty Wrocławskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Mrowna Run Grodzisk łączy w biegu
Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night, is a recurring, free sporting event organized by the Center for the Development of Physical Culture in Czerwonak. The event takes place in the evening and combines physical activity with bringing the local community together. It is a long-standing tradition that attracts participants who want to spend time outdoors in a sporting atmosphere. The event is part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix and is held regularly, promoting a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Bolechowo, in the Czerwonak municipality.
The previous recorded edition covered a distance of 5 km.
The event is part of the Active Czerwonak at Night series.
additional: The event is free and takes place in the evening, usually between 19:30 and 22:00. This recurring sporting event is part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix series. No information is available about participant limits, fees, or required equipment.

name: Challenge Gdańsk 2026
description: Challenge Gdańsk 2026 is a prestigious triathlon held on the Baltic Sea, amid the picturesque surroundings of Gdańsk and Brzeźno. Athletes compete over the middle distance, which includes a 1.9 km swim in the Bay of Gdańsk, a fast 90 km bike course across the Vistula Żuławy, and a 21.1 km run along the beach and Ronald Reagan Park, finishing on the Gdańsk pier. The event attracts both professionals and amateurs, offering a unique atmosphere and excellent conditions for competition. The event is an official qualifying race and takes place on June 19–21, 2026.

name: Nocny Bieg Firmowy Warszawa
description: The Night Corporate Run in Warsaw is a charity relay for five-person company teams, taking place on June 19, 2026, at Służewiec Racecourse. Each participant covers approximately 5 km after dark, and the team’s combined time determines the result. It’s a unique opportunity to spend an evening in an engaging nighttime atmosphere while supporting children from the Everest Foundation. The event combines sport, fun, and social support to create an unforgettable experience for participants.

name: 17 Legionowska Dycha
description: The 17th Legionowo Ten is an annual 10 km race taking place on June 19, 2026, in Legionowo. The start and finish are located outside Arena Legionowo. The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA) and is intended for adults and people over 16 who meet the rules and regulations. The event also includes an accompanying race, “Uniformed Services Ten,” for uniformed services personnel and enthusiasts. Participants can expect electronic timing and a time limit of 1 hour and 40 minutes to complete the course.

name: Nocny Bieg Świętojański
description: The Świętojański Night Run is an annual running event held in Gdynia and part of the 2026 Grand Prix of Gdynia. The main 10 km race takes place amid the city’s picturesque scenery, accompanied by races for children and youth. The event attracts runners of different age groups, offering sporting competition and a chance to connect in a nighttime atmosphere. The organizers provide professional event support as well as photo and video coverage.

name: Stacjonarne DaVita Run Kraków
description: The in-person DaVita Run Kraków 2026 is a charity race held in Kraków that promotes a healthy, active lifestyle and brings together nephrology professionals, patients, and running enthusiasts. Participants can choose between a 2.5 km or 5 km distance, with 60 minutes to complete the race. The entry fee is donated in full to the Polish Association Moje Nerki, and every participant receives a T-shirt featuring the event’s original design. For those unable to attend in person, a virtual race option is also available from June 18 to 22, 2026.

name: 54 Memoriał Żylewicza - Bieg Amatorów
description: The 54th Józef Żylewicz Memorial is a prestigious athletics meet organized annually since 1973 by the LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club. The event commemorates Józef Żylewicz, an outstanding coach and sports official, one of the founders of KS LECHIA Gdańsk and a contributor to the Polish national athletics team’s successes. The Memorial takes place at the Athletics and Rugby Stadium in Gdańsk and combines sporting professionalism with a welcoming atmosphere for the local community, attracting athletes from Poland and abroad. The event also includes the amateur 3,000 m race “Fast Arrow of the North,” open to all running enthusiasts, with no age limits or athletic requirements.

name: Drabina Wałbrzyska
description: The Wałbrzych Ladder is a physically demanding mountain route in the Sudetes, passing through the Wałbrzych and Kamienne Mountains. Over a distance of approximately 78 km, participants climb nearly 4,000 metres of elevation gain and summit more than 30 peaks. The route forms a loop, and the start and finish can be at any point along the course. It is an excellent choice for anyone wishing to discover the scenic and natural attractions of this part of the Sudetes, offering an ambitious challenge without having to travel to high mountains.

name: I Nocny Półmaraton Piaseczyńśki
description: The Piaseczno Night Half Marathon is a unique street race held at night along the scenic, illuminated streets of Piaseczno. The 21.0975 km course is flat and fast, making it ideal for setting personal bests. Participants can expect professional organisation, certified timekeeping, well-stocked refreshment stations and comprehensive medical support. After the race, every finisher receives a commemorative medal, and a recovery area with drinks and a meal awaits at the finish. It’s an unforgettable experience under the stars in a nighttime atmosphere.

name: XII BIEG WIERCHAMI
description: Bieg Wierchami is a mountain ultramarathon held in the scenic Beskid Sądecki, covering 100 km with significant elevation gain. The route follows a variety of mountain trails, offering runners a top-level challenge and beautiful views. The race starts in the courtyard of Ryter Castle, and the course features numerous aid stations and landmarks such as the Łabowska Hala Mountain Hut and Żłobki Pass. This event is for experienced trail runners who value a tough challenge and a close connection with nature.

name: 16. PKO Rybnicki Półmaraton Księżycowy
description: The Rybnik Moonlight Half Marathon is an annual running event organized by MOSiR Rybnik, attracting runners from various regions. The half-marathon course runs through the scenic areas of Rybnik, offering participants a unique sporting experience in a friendly atmosphere of competition. The event is open to all and is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the running community together.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course runs through the charming areas of Rybnik
Organized under the auspices of MOSiR Rybnik, with a long-standing tradition
An atmosphere welcoming to both recreational and experienced runners

name: Mistrzostwa Gminy Kąty Wrocławskie w Biegach Przełajowych. Bieg 4: Kąty Wrocławskie
location: Kąty Wrocławskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 2026 Kąty Wrocławskie Municipality Cross-Country Running Championships are a series of four races held in scenic locations across the municipality, including Krobielowice, Zachowice, Sadowice, and Kąty Wrocławskie. The courses showcase varied terrain and the natural beauty of the Bystrzyca Valley Landscape Park. Participants can enter individual races or the entire series; after completing three races, they are included in the overall standings. Each race ends with the presentation of a commemorative medal. When all four medals are collected, they form a visually cohesive whole featuring the outline of the municipality’s boundaries.

name: ULTRA TURNICKI
description: Ultra Turnicki is a unique running festival taking place on June 20, 2026, in Huwniki in the Przemyśl Foothills. The event offers summer courses of 10, 24, 48, and 75 km, winding through scenic forests, meadows, and mountain pastures, and combining sporting competition with the rich cultural dimension of the Wianki festival. The race is for runners seeking adventure and a connection with nature, away from crowded mountain trails. The organizers ensure participants’ comfort by providing transport, refreshment points, and accommodation options nearby.

name: Wieczorna Piątka
description: Wieczorna Piątka is a 5,000-meter race taking place on June 13, 2026, at the Municipal Stadium in Maków Mazowiecki. The event is held on a tartan track, with the start scheduled for 18:00. The race is divided into heats according to participants’ predicted times, allowing for smooth organization and competition at an appropriate level. The organizer is Lekkoatletyczny Klub Sportowy Maków Mazowiecki, and the participant limit is 200. All runners over the age of 15 are invited to take part in this sporting event.

name: 15 Górski Półmaraton Pętli Tatrzańskiej
description: The Górski Półmaraton Pętli Tatrzańskiej is a mountain half marathon held in Koszalin, on a scenic route around Chełmska Mountain. Participants can choose between a distance of 10.55 km and the full 21.1 km half marathon, which consists of two loops. The start and finish are near the sanctuary and observation tower on Chełmska Mountain, and the route passes through forested areas with scenic views. The event is charitable, and donations support the work of the “SFX” Association.

name: 43 Strzeliński Rogaining
organizer: Polskie Towarzystwo Turystyczno-Krajoznawcze Oddział Ziemi Strzelińskiej
description: Strzeliński Rogaining is an on-foot orienteering event organized by the PTTK Strzelin District Branch since 1996. With a long-standing tradition, it welcomes participants of different ages and experience levels. Teams of 2–5 plan their own routes, aiming to visit as many checkpoints as possible within the allotted time. Checkpoints have different point values, and participants travel on foot using only a map and compass. The event combines tourism and sport, making it appealing to enthusiasts, recreational participants, and families alike. It takes place in the picturesque Strzelin Hills, with routes ranging from a few to several dozen kilometers.

name: Bieg Dwie Wieże
description: The Two Towers Run is a race of approximately 15 km held in Kopalino. The route follows an unpaved road, the beach, and a sidewalk, offering varied terrain and scenic views. The time limit is 2.5 hours, and participation is limited to 250 people. The event is well organized, with water stations along the route and a recovery meal at the finish.

name: Challenge Poland
description: Challenge Gdańsk is a prestigious middle-distance triathlon held on the Baltic coast in the beautiful setting of Gdańsk. Athletes start from the city beach, completing a 1.9 km swim, a fast, flat 90 km cycling route through the Vistula Żuławy, and a 21.1 km run along the beach and Ronald Reagan Park. The finish line is on a unique city pier, making the finale unforgettable. The event is an official qualifier and is highly regarded by triathletes around the world.

name: VI Bieg Świętojański
description: The 6th St. John’s Run is a 10 km road race taking place on June 20, 2026, in Zawichost. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic, moderately challenging course. The organizers encourage runners to prepare with training plans tailored to different experience levels, with support from experts. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl running calendar, which promotes running and a healthy lifestyle.

name: VIII Nocny Bieg
description: The 8th Open Academic Championships of Łomża in Night Street Running is an annual sporting event organized by Łomża Academy under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Łomża. The race takes place on June 20, 2026, at 9:00 p.m. on the streets of Łomża, with two course options: 10 km, certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA), and 5 km, uncertified. The event commemorates the founding of Łomża Academy and promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Participants must be at least 18 years old, and the time limit for completing the course is 1.5 hours.

name: XII Półmaraton Wierchami
description: The 12th Wierchami Half Marathon is a mountain race held in the picturesque Sącz Beskids, near Rytro. The half-marathon route follows challenging mountain trails and features numerous aid stations, offering participants beautiful views and a true off-road challenge. The event is organized by the Visegrad Marathon Association, which looks after runners’ comfort and safety. It’s a great opportunity for mountain-running enthusiasts to test themselves on a tough but scenic course.

name: XIX Bieg O Błękitną Wstęgę
description: The 19th International Race for the Blue Ribbon is an annual running event organized by the Stargard Athletics Club and held on the streets of Stargard. The main race starts at 21:00, creating a unique atmosphere for night running. The course starts at the Amphitheatre and circles the Jewel of Pomerania, offering views of Stargard’s most beautiful historic landmarks in the moonlight. The event promotes health, fitness, and positive energy, encouraging an active lifestyle.

name: Zielonka Challenge
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: ZIELONKA CHALLENGE is an individual long-distance running event and Nordic walking race held in the picturesque Zielonka Forest Landscape Park. The event offers distances ranging from approximately a quarter marathon to an ultramarathon, along forest roads, tracks and ravines among nature reserves and lakes. It is known for its excellent organization, well-stocked aid stations, and unique atmosphere of sporting competition and camaraderie. The event center is in Owińska near Poznań, and the finish is at the bathing area. The event will take place on June 20, 2026.

name: Wrocławska Dycha
description: Wrocławska Dycha is an annual running event held in Wrocław, offering 5 km and 10 km distances. The race attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, providing a sporting atmosphere and the opportunity to compete on the city’s scenic routes. The event is a great way to spend time actively and bring Wrocław’s running community together.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes in central Wrocław
Scenic urban views
A welcoming atmosphere for runners of all experience levels

name: X Bieg Pamięci Powstań Śląskich
location: Góra Świętej Anny, Leśnica, Opole Voivodeship, Poland

name: Perly Malopolski Wapienne Magura
location: Wapienne, Sękowa, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bieg Lotnej Kompanii Szturmowej
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Wypoczynku w Haczowie oraz Urząd Gminy w Haczowie
description: The 8th “Lotna” Run in Haczów is an annual running event commemorating Lieutenant Stanisław Maczek’s Lotna Assault Company and the Heroes of Haczów who fought for Poland’s independence in 1918–1921. The event features courses of approximately 12 km and 5 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking route, mostly on paved and gravel roads in the Haczów municipality. The run promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity, and local community integration. Free children’s races are also offered, with shorter distances suited to different age groups. The race office and event base are located in the Manor Park by the Municipal Centre of Culture and Recreation in Haczów.

name: Gryf Arena Run
organizer: Starostwo Powiatowe w Gryficach, Powiatowe Centrum Sportu Rekreacji i Promocji w Gryficach, PLMKS Chrobry Gryfice, Zarząd Dróg Powiatowych w Gryficach, Klub Sportowy "RunGryf"
description: The 9th edition of Gryf Arena Run will take place on June 21, 2026, in Gryfice. The race route runs through the city streets, offering participants a great atmosphere, sporting excitement, and positive energy. The event is family-friendly, with children’s races ranging from 100 to 600 meters, tailored to different age groups. Every child taking part will receive a commemorative T-shirt, a medal, and a sweet treat at the finish. It is one of the largest running events in the region, combining sporting competition with fun for the whole family.

name: Klon Biega i Chodzi Dla Zdrowia
description: Klon Runs and Walks for Health is a local initiative organized by the Association for the Development of the Village of Klon and Surrounding Areas. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle among residents and supporters of the region. The run and Nordic walking event take place in the scenic surroundings of Klon, making them ideal for recreation and community interaction. The event is open and welcoming to all age groups.

name: X Bieg STO-nogi
organizer: Społeczne Liceum Ogólnokształcące Nr 5 STO w Milanówku
description: The X STO-nogi Run in Milanówek is a traditional 10 km road race held in the picturesque town of Milanówek. The T-shaped course consists of two 5 km loops along the town’s streets, with turnarounds by the wayside shrine and Brzozowa Street. The start and finish are at Social General Secondary School No. 5, at 41 Herberta Street. The race is organized by running enthusiasts from the STO-nogi group, who promote running among residents and visitors.

name: X Ostródzki Półmaraton św. Jerzego
organizer: Grupa Ostródzkich Biegaczy „Ostróda Runners”, Klub Sportowy PLAY, Ostródzkie Centrum Sportu i Rekreacji
description: The 10th Ostróda St. George’s Half Marathon is the anniversary edition of the half marathon held in Ostróda. The course runs along the promenade by Lake Drwęckie and through the city streets, comprising two identical loops with a total distance of 21.098 km. The race starts and finishes at the Amphitheatre at 17a Mickiewicza Street, and hydration stations are located along the course approximately every 4 km. Organizers provide a commemorative medal, a voucher for a recovery meal, and the option to choose a race package with or without a T-shirt. The event is charitable and supports the rehabilitation of a girl named Maja.

name: XI Bieg Terenowy Zgierz Malinka
description: The 11th Zgierz Malinka Trail Run takes place in the wooded areas of MOSiR Zgierz Malinka. The course features varied surfaces, climbs and descents of different lengths and gradients, large sandy patches, and narrow sections through bushes. Its cross-country character attracts runners looking to get off the pavement or prepare for mountain races. The event offers three distances: 4, 8, and 12 km, as well as a 4 km Nordic walking event and races for children and young people. Participants receive symbolic medals inspired by raspberries, while the top women and men in each distance receive trophies.

name: Świecie Biega Brzegiem Deczna
description: Bieg Świecie Biega Brzegiem Deczna is an annual running event held in the scenic area of Deczno near Świecie. The main 10 km race runs through the Recreation and Leisure Centre grounds, offering participants an attractive course and sporting competition. The event also includes free children’s races, making it a family-friendly and inclusive occasion. The organizers provide professional timekeeping and race packages with T-shirts for early registrants. The main race is limited to 300 participants, ensuring an intimate atmosphere.

name: XI Cienińska Szóstka
location: Cienin Zaborny, Słupca County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: V Charytatywny Bieg dla Dzieci Bohaterów Biegaj - Pomagaj
Herbatka u Tadka, czyli Bieg do Herbacia...
GDYNIA ULTRA WAY
description: Gdynia Ultra Way is a mountain race by the sea, taking place on June 26–27, 2026, in Gdynia and the surrounding Kashubian region. Participants can choose from five distances, ranging from 14 km to 160 km, with varied elevation gain and scenic routes. The start and finish are at different locations, and the organizer provides transport to the start of the longest distance. It is a unique opportunity to take on a challenging course and enjoy the beauty of the coastal landscape.
course_highlights: 160 km distance with +/- 2,502 m of elevation gain, starting in Puck at 10:00
100 km distance with +/- 2,267 m of elevation gain, starting in Gdynia at 21:00
Routes pass through Kashubia and coastal areas, with checkpoints and time limits
additional: For the start of the longest distance (160 km), participants are transported by coach from outside the Gdynia Sports Center – National Rugby Stadium (paid transport). The time limit for the 160 km distance is 31 hours. The course has checkpoints with time limits and drop bags. The event includes both summer and winter editions, with routes passing through different towns in the region and offering unforgettable experiences for runners of all ability levels.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – edycja nocna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – Night Edition 2026 is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Dendrological Garden of the Poznań University of Life Sciences. The event is part of a series of races organized since 2014 by a group of enthusiasts who focus on the beauty of the courses and promoting running. After the race, participants will receive unique medals, different from those awarded at the spring edition, making them worth collecting. It’s a special opportunity to run in beautiful surroundings and enjoy the atmosphere of the night.

name: Australijska Dyszka w Pszczelniku
description: Australijska Dyszka w Pszczelniku is a 10 km race taking place on June 26, 2026, in Siemianowice Śląskie, in Pszczelnik Park. The course consists of four laps, and all participants start together. After each lap, the 20 runners who took the longest to complete it are eliminated and receive a so-called “almost medal” at the finish. The final lap is run by the top competitors battling for the win. The race is open to people over the age of 16.

name: Biegaj z Duchami
description: Run with Ghosts is a unique night trail run taking place on June 26, 2026, in Leśniów. Participants will take on two courses, 15 km and 9 km long, full of dark corners and surprises that create a one-of-a-kind atmosphere filled with thrills. Runners are encouraged to dress up as spectres, ghosts, and other spooky characters, adding magic and atmosphere to the event. It is not just a race, but also a test of endurance and courage in the dark, where participants face their own weaknesses and mysterious figures along the course.

name: Supermaraton Gor Stolowych
description: The Table Mountains Supermarathon is a demanding mountain race held in the picturesque Table Mountains near Karłów. The route follows hiking trails and is technically challenging, with numerous rocks, turns, and significant elevation gain. Participants can expect changing conditions, including possible snow and ice, and are required to carry suitable equipment. The event is part of the Grand Prix DFBG mountain-running series and attracts fans of ultrarunning and mountain half-marathons.

name: Sudecka 100
description: Sudecka 100 is Poland’s oldest night ultramarathon, held in the mountain setting of Boguszów-Gorce. The race course is challenging and full of excitement, giving participants the chance to test themselves over the 100 km distance. In 2026, the organizers are introducing two new events: the Sudecki Morning Half Marathon, covering 21 km, and the Night Mountain Marathon, covering 42 km. The event attracts runners from across the country and offers generous race packages and numerous attractions, including personalized medals and aid stations along the course.

name: XIII Dycha Anny Wazówny
description: The 13th Anna Vasa 10K is a 10 km road race taking place in Brodnica. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness over a middle distance, and the organizers encourage participants to prepare with dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The race is open and runner-friendly, offering expert support and the chance to take part in a sporting event in the picturesque Kuyavian-Pomeranian city.

name: 7 Maraton Pędziwiatra
organizer: Amatorski Klub Miłośników Biegania Pędziwiatr Gliwice
description: The 7th Pędziwiatr Marathon is organized by the Pędziwiatr Gliwice Amateur Running Club and will take place on June 27, 2026. Participants will complete 10 laps of a 4.2195 km loop, running mainly along sheltered park paths. The race is amateur in nature and dedicated to the memory of Marek Dworski. Individual, team, and relay classifications are planned. The race starts at 10:00, at the same time as the Gliwice Park Running Challenge.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: Gliwicka Parkowa Prowokacja Biegowa is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice in 2026, organized by the Amatorski Klub Miłośników Biegania „Pędziwiatr”. The events aim to promote healthy, active outdoor recreation, with the motto “Let yourself be provoked into fighting laziness!” The approximately 4.2 km route runs mainly along forest tracks and gravel paths, with a refreshment point at the start/finish. Events take place on Saturdays once a month, starting at 10:00, in the clearing behind Piast Stadium in Gliwice.

name: III Bieg w Sławicach
description: The 3rd Sławice Run is a 10 km road race taking place on June 27, 2026, in Sławice, Mazowieckie Voivodeship. Participants can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness over a middle distance in a friendly atmosphere. The organizers welcome both beginners and experienced runners.

name: X Lubeński Cross
description: The X Lubeński Cross is a mountain cross-country race held in the picturesque surroundings of the Lubenia municipality. The start and finish are at the market square in Lubenia. The main race routes are 13.8 km and 22.3 km long, crossing varied terrain: asphalt, paved roads and dirt trails, as well as 3 or 5 green hills. The race is challenging and offers beautiful views, creating a unique sporting celebration. Children’s and youth races are also held at the stadium, divided into age and gender categories.

name: XIII Bieg Cichociemnych
description: The 13th Cichociemni Run is a cross-country race held in Sochaczew in honor of the Polish heroes, the Cichociemni soldiers. The course is challenging, with numerous natural and artificial obstacles of varying difficulty that require participants to get wet, jump over obstacles, and crawl underneath them. Held once a year in June, the race attracts people who want to challenge their limits and aren’t afraid of mud. It’s a unique opportunity to explore the banks and riverbed of the Bzura River and feel the wind in your hair during a sporting competition.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The 17th Mysłowice Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy, active lifestyle and bringing together runners from the region and beyond. The races take place on a permanent course familiar to participants, and the atmosphere is welcoming to both experienced runners and amateurs. The event attracts large groups of runners, Nordic walkers, and canicross participants, and entry is free. The organizers ensure the event is well run and support the growth of the local running community.

name: XXI Dziesiątka Unisławska
description: The 21st Unisław 10K is an annual 10 km race and Nordic walking event held in Unisław as part of the Unisław Days celebrations. The race route follows paved roads through the scenic Chełmno Landscape Park, passing through the towns of Unisław, Stablewice, and Gołoty. The race is certified by the Polish Athletics Association and is part of the 2026 Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship Grand Prix in Long-Distance Running. All running and Nordic walking enthusiasts are welcome to take part in this sporting event.

name: XXVII Bieg Górski Żar
organizer: Urząd Gminy Czernichów i Stowarzyszenie Bajeczne Beskidy
description: The 27th Żar Mountain Run is a 10 km mountain race taking place on June 27, 2026, in Międzybrodzie Żywieckie. It is an excellent opportunity for mountain-running enthusiasts to take on a challenging course and test their fitness. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using training plans tailored to different experience levels. The race combines sporting competition with the beauty of the mountain scenery.

name: XXXVII Cross Świętojański
description: The 37th Jan Marek St John’s Cross-Country Race in Pogórze is a traditional race organized by LKS Pogórze, taking place on June 27, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. The event is held in the picturesque town of Pogórze and attracts runners who enjoy competing on off-road courses. The organizers provide professional RFID timing and comprehensive technical support to ensure the event runs smoothly. All running enthusiasts are invited to take part in this special sporting event.

name: Wielka Pętla Izerska w ramach Izerskiego Weekendu Biegowego
location: Szklarska Poręba, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Great Jizera Loop is a scenic half marathon held as part of the Jizera Running Weekend in Szklarska Poręba. The course runs through the town streets and along trails in the Jizera Mountains, offering runners a chance to connect with nature and enjoy mountain scenery. The event combines recreation and sport, promoting physical activity and the popularity of running. Participants use electronic timekeeping, and the time limit for completing the course is 3 hours.

name: XVIII Bieg w pogoni za żubrem
description: The 15th Bieg w Pogoń za Żubrem is an annual running event held in Niepołomice, attracting runners to a range of distances. The event offers 8- and 15-kilometer courses as well as a children’s race, making it appealing to a wide range of participants. The route passes through scenic areas, combining sporting competition with the beauty of the surrounding nature. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and compete in a friendly atmosphere.

name: 5 Półmaraton Zbucki
additional: The start of the 5th Zbucki Half Marathon is scheduled for June 28, 2026, at 09:00 in Zbuczyn.

name: Izery Ultra-Trail
description: Izery Ultra-Trail is a unique mountain race held in the heart of the picturesque Izera Mountains, with the start and finish in Świeradów-Zdrój. Routes of varying lengths and difficulty levels lead through wild, lesser-known areas, offering runners unforgettable views and challenges. The event attracts both experienced ultramarathoners and trail enthusiasts looking to take on demanding terrain and enjoy the beauty of nature. The organizers provide full support at aid stations and require specific equipment, ensuring participants’ safety and comfort.

name: Kresowe Trail #7
description: Kresowe Trail is a small-scale, non-commercial trail running event held amid the scenic natural surroundings of eastern Poland and the Vilnius Region. The routes pass through pristine forests, varied climbs, sand and roots, offering challenges for both beginners and experienced runners. The race is held over two distances: the shorter Szpurt (approx. 7 km) and the longer Wertep (approx. 17–21 km), which is an ultramarathon. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, respect for nature, and connections among runners from different backgrounds.

name: Roztoczański Festiwal Biegowy
description: The Roztocze Running Festival 2026 is one of the largest running events in the Roztocze region, organized by the Lubaczów Municipality. The three-day festival takes place in Basznia Dolna, at Kresowa Osada, the start and finish venue for all races and Nordic walking events. Participants can choose from ten different distances, ranging from night races and Nordic walking events to an ultramarathon and half marathon, on routes through the picturesque Lubaczów region. The event combines sporting competition with a festival atmosphere, attracting both experienced runners and amateurs.

name: Łabiszyński Bieg Świętojański
organizer: Łabiszyński Dom Kultury, Urząd Miejski w Łabiszynie, F.W. Martex, Uczniowski Klub Sportowy Łabiszynianka
description: The Łabiszyn St. John’s Eve Run is an annual running event taking place on June 28, 2026, at the Municipal Stadium in Łabiszyn. The main 5 km race starts at 10:00, followed by children’s and youth races in four age categories. Participants in the main race will receive a medal and a sweet snack, while younger runners will receive a medal and a surprise. The best runners will be presented with awards after the races. The event is part of a running series and offers starter packages to the first people to register.

name: 3 Otwarty Bieg Sejmowy o Puchar Marszałka
Bieg Powitania Lata
location: Strzelce Wielkie, Pajęczno County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bieg Twierdzy Kraków
description: Bieg Twierdzy Kraków is a cross-country race held in Reduta Park in Kraków, with 5 km and 10 km courses. The route runs mainly along trails and forest tracks, with one significant uphill section, combining sport with history. After the race, participants and their companions can take a guided tour of historic sites of the former Kraków Fortress, making the event a unique blend of physical activity and education. The race’s mission is to promote running and knowledge of local heritage.
course_highlights: Cross-country route along trails and forest tracks
One substantial uphill section
Guided tours of historic Kraków Fortress sites after the race
additional: After the race, participants can take a guided tour of sites of the former Kraków Fortress, including forts, earthworks, caverns, field batteries and shelters. The race route is off-road and green, with history in the background. Unique trophies made from 100-year-old bricks are awarded to the top competitors in each category. After the race, participants and their companions can also take a guided tour of sites of the former Kraków Fortress, including forts, earthworks, caverns, field batteries and shelters. Information about the edition scheduled for 27 June 2027 has not been confirmed in available sources.

name: V RUNda Żubra Biegi i Nordic Walking
Grill Run=Fun 2026
description: Grill+Run=Fun 2026 is a race held in Palowice that combines sporting competition with a friendly atmosphere and fun. The event starts at 08:00, and participants can expect professional RFID timing and comprehensive technical support. The event is organized by the LUXTORPEDA Association, which ensures high-quality organization and support for runners. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and experience the spirit of sporting community.

name: XXIV Atlantis Bieg Opolski
description: The 24th Atlantis Opole Run is an annual race held since 2003 on the first Saturday of July on Bolko Island in Opole. The route runs through a designated quiet, green area in the city center, offering participants the opportunity to compete over 5 km and 10 km distances. Since 2015, the race has been called the Atlantis Opole Run, thanks to the support of Atlantis-Deweloper. The event is organized by the Opole Run Association, which promotes physical activity and sports-based community integration.

name: Kaliski Półmaraton Nocny
description: The Kalisz Night Amber Hellena Half Marathon is a unique nighttime half marathon held in Kalisz. The event attracts hundreds of runners from different cities, offering a one-of-a-kind atmosphere and a running challenge after dark. The half-marathon course passes through charming parts of the city, giving participants an unforgettable experience. The event has become a tradition and is popular with both amateur and professional runners.

name: Mam Marzenie 12.RAZ 25h RUN
organizer: Fundacja Mam Marzenie oraz Ruchowa Akademia Zdrowia (RAZ Szczecin)
description: 25h RUN is a unique running event organized by the Mam Marzenie Foundation, combining sport with charity. The 10th anniversary edition takes place by Lake Arkonka in Szczecin and aims to make Marlena, one of the foundation’s beneficiaries, dream come true: a trip to the island of Zakynthos. Participants run for 25 hours, and every kilometer brings them closer to achieving this goal. It is not only a sporting challenge, but also an opportunity to work together to support children in need.

name: VI Półmaraton Gęstwinami Murckowskimi
description: The 5th Murckowski Forest Half Marathon is organized by the W Kręgu Natury Association and takes place in the picturesque forests of Murcki in Katowice. The half-marathon course winds through varied woodland terrain, offering participants a chance to connect with nature and enjoy a unique atmosphere. The event is a great opportunity to spend time outdoors, whether you are an experienced runner or a beginner. The organizers provide convenient access by public transport and parking near the start.

name: XI Janikowska ZaDyszka
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Janikowie
description: The 11th Janikowo ZaDyszka is an annual road race held in Janikowo, attracting runners of different ages and ability levels. The race covers 10 km, with professional timekeeping provided using Chronotrack technology. The event is organized by the Janikowo Sports and Recreation Centre, and timing is handled by STS-Timing, ensuring high reliability and organizational support. The race is open and welcoming to everyone who enjoys physical activity.

name: XI Krokowska 10
description: The 11th Krokowska 10 is one of the events in the Kaszuby Biegają 2026 series, taking place on July 4 in Żarnowiec. The race offers a 10 km distance through the scenic landscapes of Kashubia, combining sporting competition with the beauty of the region. Kaszuby Biegają is the largest running event in northern Poland, promoting physical activity and local culture. Participants can expect professional organization and unique medals assembled from pieces awarded at the individual stages.

name: XXVI Bieg o Kryształową Perłę Jeziora Na...
description: The 26th National Run for the Crystal Pearl of Lake Narie is the main race, covering a distance of 31.13 km. It takes place in the scenic surroundings of Lake Narie in Kretowiny. The start and finish are located at the Main Beach in Kretowiny. The event includes age categories for men and women, and participants can look forward to a formal opening and closing ceremony, with awards presented. The event is national in scope and attracts runners from various age groups.

name: Bieg i Nordic Walking O Buławę Sieniawską
Letnia Dwunastka
location: Nowy Targ, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Turbacz Summer Trail
location: Nowy Targ, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bieg Wilka Wilkowo 05.07.2026
description: The 7th Bieg Wilka Wilkowo 2026 is an annual running event held in Wilkowo near Świebodzin. The race attracts runners from various categories and offers the chance to compete on a route combining road and off-road sections. The organizers provide professional timing and technical support, while participants can expect efficient organization and a friendly atmosphere. It’s a great opportunity to get active and bring the local community together.
course_highlights: A route combining road and off-road sections
Scenic surroundings of Wilkowo near Świebodzin
Professional electronic timing
additional: The event is organized by Super Sport, a company from Zielona Góra, which provides timing, race bib printing, and technical support. No details are available about start waves, participant limits, or race packages. Registration will be available at super-sport.com.pl, and the event attracts local runners and sports enthusiasts.

name: Pogoń za Jednorożcem
description: The Unicorn Chase is an annual running event held in Jednorożec, taking place for the eighth time in 2026. The event includes a 5 km race and Nordic walking over the same distance, as well as children’s races over shorter distances. It is organized by the “Jednorożec robi co może” Association in cooperation with local partners and patrons, offering participants sporting competition, numerous attractions, and prizes. The start and awards ceremony take place on the same day, and participants can expect professional organization and chip timing.

name: XV Limanowa Forrest
description: The 15th International Limanowa Forrest Anglosaxon Mountain Run is a unique mountain race that takes runners up Miejska Góra, 716 m above sea level, where the Millennium Cross—the tallest steel cross in Poland—is located. The course follows an Anglosaxon format and features varied terrain, including hiking trails, forest and field roads, rocky sections, and stretches of asphalt and sidewalk. The start and finish are on Bulwary Street in Limanowa, near the race office. The race takes place on July 5, 2026, at 12:00 and is organized by the Limanowa Forrest Sports Club.

name: XIV Panewnicki Bieg Dzika (6)
organizer: Akademia Wychowania Fizycznego im. Jerzego Kukuczki w Katowicach, Państwowa Straż Pożarna Katowice
description: The Panewniki Wild Boar Run is a recreational running and Nordic walking event held in the scenic Panewniki forests in Katowice. The competition takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 metres long, which participants can complete up to four times, with markers every kilometre. The event promotes an active lifestyle and education about proper conduct in forest areas. Both amateurs and athletes affiliated with sports clubs may take part. The organizers are the Jerzy Kukuczka Academy of Physical Education in Katowice and the Katowice State Fire Service.

name: 34 Bieg po Plaży
organizer: Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Postominie
description: The 34th Beach Run in Jarosławiec is an annual running event organized by the Centre for Culture and Sport in Postomino. The race follows a scenic route along the beach, offering participants a unique seaside running experience. It attracts both recreational and experienced runners, creating a sporting atmosphere and promoting active leisure. The event has a long tradition and is an important sporting occasion in the region.

name: Jutrosińska Dycha
additional: Modern timing. Training sessions from the time of registration until the race count. Average training paces listed on the website: 4.43 min/km and 4.84 min/km.

name: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński
description: The Chwałowice Napoleonic Marathon is a small-scale marathon held in the picturesque village of Chwałowice, surrounded by forests and fields. The 42.195 km route follows forest and country roads, with the start and finish on Polna Street. The event has a friendly, informal atmosphere, without crowds or competitive pressure, and promotes physical activity in a natural setting. The organizers offer a varied, clearly marked course, with convenient access and parking.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night, is a recurring, free sporting event organized by the Czerwonak Physical Culture Development Center. Held in the evening, it combines physical activity with bringing the local community together. It has become a long-standing tradition, attracting participants who want to spend time outdoors running or walking in a friendly atmosphere. The event takes place around Bolechowo and lasts approximately two and a half hours.
course_highlights: Evening runs and walks outdoors
Route around Bolechowo and Czerwonak
Bringing the local community together through physical activity
additional: The event is free and takes place from 19:30 to 22:00. It is part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix series. No information is available about participant limits, fees, or online registration.

name: Ultramarathon Górski - 3 x Sniezka = 1 x Mont Blanc
description: The 3 x Śnieżka = 1 x Mont Blanc Mountain Ultramarathon is a challenging mountain race held in Karpacz. It is also a qualifier for the prestigious UTMB and a member of ITRA. Runners can choose from three distances with varying levels of difficulty and elevation gain, earning ITRA points. The course follows scenic trails in the Karkonosze Mountains, including multiple ascents of Śnieżka, offering challenges for experienced ultrarunners as well as an opportunity to take part for beginner mountain runners.

name: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka
description: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka is a 10 km race held in Bukowiec, attracting runners eager to take on a moderately challenging course. Every participant who crosses the finish line will receive a commemorative medal. The race office is located in the sports hall in Bukowiec, providing convenient event facilities. We invite all running enthusiasts to take part in this event, which combines sporting competition with a local atmosphere.

name: VI Warmiński Bieg Uliczny
description: The 6th Warmian Street Run in Reszel is an annual sporting event that attracts both amateurs and experienced runners. The race follows the streets of Reszel, giving it a unique atmosphere and allowing participants to experience the city from a different perspective. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively, enjoy sporting competition, and meet fellow running enthusiasts. The organizers welcome everyone, regardless of experience level, emphasizing the importance of exercise and positive energy.

name: X Świerczyniecki Bieg Uliczny
