The event offers two routes, 5 and 10 km long, through the picturesque Kashubian countryside, encouraging participants to enjoy the outdoors. It attracts runners of different ages and experience levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and local running culture.

name: IV Festiwal Pustelnika
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na rzecz rozwoju Wysowej-Zdroju „Przekrocz Granice”
description: The 4th Pustelnik Festival is an annual sports and recreation event organized in the picturesque town of Wysowa-Zdrój by the Przekrocz Granice Association. The festival brings together sport, culture, and nature, offering participants the chance to take part in runs, marathons, and MTB and E-BIKE races. It’s a unique opportunity to discover the charms of the Low Beskids, spend time actively, and connect with the local community.

name: Maraton Wigry
description: The Wigry Marathon is a unique marathon held in Wigry National Park, around scenic Lake Wigry. The approximately 42.2 km course runs mainly along forest and unpaved trails, with a small amount of asphalt, offering runners pristine air and beautiful views of the Suwałki and Sejny regions. This is not a marathon for setting personal bests, but for those who want to enjoy its remarkable nature and atmosphere. The event takes place on August 22, 2026, starting at the Monastery in Wigry and finishing at the Municipal Square in Stary Folwark.

name: XI Bieg Obrońców Płocka 1920r
description: The International Run of the Defenders of Płock 1920 is an annual running event organized by the Płock Biega No Age Limit Club. The run commemorates the defenders of Płock in 1920 and attracts runners from various places. The event is international in character and takes place in the picturesque city of Płock, offering participants sporting competition and a chance to connect.

name: 7. PKO Tarnogórski Półmaraton oraz Tarnogórska Srebrna Dyszka
description: The 7th PKO Tarnogórski Half Marathon and Tarnogórska Srebrna Dyszka are the region’s biggest running celebration, taking place on 23 August 2026. The 21.0975 km half-marathon course runs entirely on paved streets in Tarnowskie Góry, with vehicle traffic partially closed. Refreshment and hydration stations are provided for participants, and the half-marathon time limit has been extended to 3 hours so everyone can cross the finish line with a smile and earn a medal. The Srebrna Dyszka is a run of approximately 10.5 km, complementing the event’s running programme.

name: IV BIEG PEŁNEJ MISKI
description: Bieg Pełnej Miski is a charity running event held in Szubin, aiming to support animal shelters through the “Pełna Miska” campaign. The race has been held annually since 2023, and the next edition is scheduled for August 23, 2026. The event combines sporting competition with the goal of helping homeless animals, engaging the local community and running enthusiasts. The organizers encourage people to take part and work together to support animals.

name: Biegi wokół Bursztynowej Góry
description: The Runs Around Bursztynowa Góra are an annual running event held in picturesque Bąkowo as part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The races attract runners from various age categories, offering appealing routes and the unique atmosphere of Kashubia. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors amid beautiful nature and local culture. The organizers ensure professional event management and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.

name: XVI Festiwal Biegowy Dziki Weekend
description: The 16th Dziki Weekend Running Festival is an annual sporting event held in Police, West Pomeranian Voivodeship. Organized since 2010 by the DZIK Running Club Association, the festival is one of the most recognizable races in the region. The event promotes an active lifestyle, cross-country running, and sporting competition for children and young people, while also showcasing the natural attractions of the Wkrzańska Forest. The start and finish of all races are at the sports clearing at 99 Piaskowa Street in Police.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night, is a recurring, free sporting event organized by the Czerwonak Physical Culture Development Centre. The event takes place in the evening and combines physical activity with bringing the local community together. It is a long-standing tradition that attracts participants who want to spend time outdoors, running or walking in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 5 km distance confirmed for the 2026 edition
Evening event format in Bolechowo
Part of the Active Czerwonak at Night series
additional: The event is free and takes place in the evening, usually from 19:30 to 22:00. It is a recreational sporting event and part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix series. No information is available about participant limits, fees or required equipment. Previous editions took place in the evening; 82 participants took part in 2026.

name: Letni Ultra Świr
description: Letni Ultra Świr is a unique 24-hour ultramarathon held on a 15 km loop near Grybów. It is a challenge for runners who want to test the limits of their endurance and enjoy an atmosphere full of sweat, dust and fatigue, but also laughter and madness. The event attracts long-distance running enthusiasts, offering a one-of-a-kind experience and intense emotions.

name: Półmaraton Roztoczański im. Czesławy Kwoki , Nielisz - Zamość
UKIEL Susnet Run Olsztyn
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Olsztynie
description: UKIEL Sunset Run Olsztyn 2026 is an evening road race taking place on August 29, 2026. Participants can choose between the 5 km and 10 km distances, running through central Olsztyn with scenic views of the Old Town and CRS Ukiel Beach. The course is certified by PZLA, and the finish line is located on the beach, where a finisher zone with music and lighting awaits. It’s a great opportunity to combine sporting competition with the atmosphere of a city event.

name: 11 Bieg Kurierów Sądeckich
description: The Sądecki Couriers Run is a historic mountain race held in the Sądecki Beskids, on a route from Rytro to the PTTK mountain shelter on Przehyba. The course is marked and features varied surfaces: 15% asphalt, 5% gravel roads, and 80% forest trails, offering participants a chance to connect with nature and tackle challenging terrain. The race commemorates couriers from World War II, and the course record is just under an hour. The organizer provides timekeeping, medical support, a commemorative medal, and a hot meal after the race.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: Gliwice Park Running Provocation is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events held in Gliwice in 2026. They take place once a month on Saturdays in the park behind Piast Stadium. The 4,219.5-metre route runs mainly along forest trails and gravel paths, with some sections on asphalt. A refreshment point is located at the start/finish line. The event aims to promote healthy, active outdoor recreation under the slogan “Let yourself be provoked into fighting laziness!”

name: Kunicki Bieg Reggae
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Kunicach
description: Kunicki Reggae Run is a nationwide sporting event held on the picturesque Lake Kunickie in Kunice. Participants can choose from three certified running routes: 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon. The start and finish are in front of the GOKiS in Kunice at 11 Słoneczna Street. The event combines sporting competition with a friendly atmosphere and reggae music, attracting a growing number of participants from across Poland.

name: Mały Wielki Bieg
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji Gminy Pruszcz Gdański
description: Mały Wielki Bieg is the largest race in the Pruszcz Gdański municipality. After a one-year break, it returns to Straszyn. The organizer is the Pruszcz Gdański Municipality Sports and Recreation Center, which promotes sport and recreation among local residents. The event takes place on August 29, 2026, and is an important sporting event in the region.

name: NorDan RUN
description: NorDan RUN is a race held in the picturesque town of Wolsztyn, with routes following paths through the municipal park along Lake Wolsztyńskie. Participants can choose from several distances, from shorter races for children to challenging 48 km routes with checkpoint and refreshment stations. The start and finish are located at the “Fala Park” venue, offering convenient race arrangements and beautiful views. The race is a great opportunity to spend time outdoors and enjoy the surrounding nature.

name: Tatraman
description: Tatraman is a challenging half-Ironman-distance triathlon held in the scenic areas of Polish and Slovak Spiš and the Tatra Mountains. The course starts in Niedzica on Lake Czorsztyn, crosses mountainous terrain, and finishes at the summit of Kasprowy Wierch. The event is aimed mainly at experienced athletes, but amateurs can also test their skills on this extreme course. Tatraman combines sporting competition with beautiful views and highland hospitality.

name: VIII Dycha nad Wisłą
description: The 8th Dycha nad Wisłą is an annual road race held in Tczew and forms part of the 9th Kociewie Running Grand Prix. The race attracts runners from various regions and offers a scenic route along the Vistula. The event combines sport and recreation, promoting physical activity and bringing the local community together.

name: X Jubileuszowy Charytatywny Cross
description: The 10th Anniversary Charity Cross-Country Run and Nordic Walking event in Iwonicz-Zdrój is an annual sporting event held at Dietl Square in Iwonicz-Zdrój. The event combines a cross-country run and a Nordic walking march, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle in this beautiful spa town. This anniversary edition attracts participants of different age groups and ability levels. The organizers invite everyone to take part and emphasize the event’s charitable nature.

name: XVI Bałtycki Maraton Brzegiem Morza
description: The 16th Baltic Seaside Marathon is an annual running event held in the picturesque towns of Jastarnia and Władysławowo. Participants can choose between the marathon and half-marathon distances, both of which follow the coast, offering exceptional views and atmosphere. The event attracts runners from various age groups, including the K60+ and M65+ categories. The participant limit is 250, ensuring an intimate and friendly atmosphere.

name: Piąteczka dla każdego
location: Nowy Dwór Mazowiecki, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland

name: XI Bieg Dożynkowy
location: Kobylarnia, Gmina Nowa Wieś Wielka, Poland

name: XVII Maraton Pieszo i Rowerem Dookoła Lubina
11 Bieg po Oddech
description: The 11th Bieg po Oddech is a charity 5 km run through the streets of Zakopane, taking place on August 30, 2026. The event supports people with cystic fibrosis, and every participant receives a T-shirt and a medal. After the race, a family picnic with games and competitions is held. The run promotes physical activity as part of rehabilitation and support for people with the condition, as well as social integration.

name: Jurajskie Mistrzostwa NA SKRAJU PRZEŁAJU
description: The Jurassic Championships ON THE EDGE OF CROSS-COUNTRY are challenging cross-country races held in scenic Przewodziszowice near Żarki, in the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland. The courses run across Jurassic hills, limestone outcrops, dense forests, winding trails, rocky climbs, and open spaces with panoramic views of the Jurassic Landscape Park. The event offers a variety of distances, from short races for beginners and Nordic walkers to the demanding Trentaraton for experienced runners. It’s a great opportunity to compete and enjoy the beauty of nature.

name: 47. Półmaraton Szczecin Bieg na 10 km
description: The 47th PKO Szczecin Half Marathon is an annual running event taking place on August 30, 2026, in Szczecin. Participants can choose between the half-marathon distance (21.0975 km) and a 10 km race, both following a single loop through the city streets. The start and finish are located at Jan Paweł II Jasne Błonia Square. The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA) and marked every kilometre, with times recorded electronically using chips in the race bibs. The organizers offer wave starts and high-quality Ventus technical shirts in the extended race packages.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznan
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznań is a prestigious triathlon held on the shores of historic Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland’s first triathlon in 1984. Athletes can expect calm, warm waters for the swim, a fast and flat bike course through picturesque villages and the western part of Poznań, and a run towards the city centre, finishing at the Poznań International Fairgrounds—a modern symbol of the city. This unique event combines sporting competition with local culture and modern infrastructure.

name: Kresowe Trail #10
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale trail races organized by the Kresowe Maratony Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in nature. The races take place on scenic routes in eastern Poland, with respect for nature and local communities. The events are open to both beginners and experienced runners, and aim to build a running community based on passion, competition, and friendship. They are non-commercial and small-scale, with a limited number of participants to ensure safety and high-quality organization.

name: Półmaraton Buski
organizer: Buski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Busku-Zdroju
description: The Busko Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Busko-Zdrój. In 2026, it will take place on August 30. The race starts at the Municipal Stadium at 8:30 a.m. The half-marathon course passes prominent hotels and sanatoriums, the picturesque Spa Park, and charming pedestrian streets, giving the race a distinctive atmosphere. The time limit for completing the 21.0975 km distance is 3 hours and 30 minutes. The race is open to both experienced runners and amateurs.

name: VII Maraton od Zmierzchu do Świtu
Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie
description: Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie is a cross-country race held in Koszalin on September 3, 2026. The course runs in the opposite direction from usual, allowing participants to experience it anew. The event is open to runners, Nordic walking enthusiasts, and mixed pairs. All participants receive medals at the finish, with trophies awarded to the top finishers in various categories. The race is the season finale of the Leśne Piątki series and part of the Tour Biegów po Okolicy - TurBO, encouraging people to stay active throughout the year.

name: Nocny Jelczański Bieg Towarzyski 3
description: Nocny Jelczański Bieg Towarzyski 3 is a nighttime 10 km race taking place on September 4, 2026, in Jelcz-Laskowice. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for autumn races. The organizers offer training plans tailored to different experience levels so everyone can prepare for the race effectively. The event is for runners who enjoy the atmosphere of running at night and the thrill of competition.

name: RAWki na Surowo
description: RAWki na Surowo is a mountain trail race held in the magical Bieszczady Mountains, taking runners across the scenic alpine meadows of Mała and Wielka Rawka. The 29 km course with 1,550 m of elevation gain passes through Bieszczady National Park, requiring the race to be held without aid stations or course markings. The event is certified by ITRA and UTMB and is part of the MTrail Running Series. The start and finish are in Wetlina, and the race follows a self-supported format, emphasizing its rugged character.

name: 60. Festiwal Chodu
description: The 60th Race Walking Festival is a prestigious international sporting event held in the port region of Gdańsk on September 5, 2026. The event brings together athletes of different ages and ability levels, offering race-walking competitions over 10 km (women and men, including the Open, U20 and U18 categories), as well as 5 km and 3 km races for younger participants and the Polish Masters Championships over 5 km. The festival also features the Polish U23 Championships over 10 km and accompanying events such as the “Walk with the Postman” Prologue and the Polish Post Office Defenders’ Run – Energa Cup. The organizer, LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club, also promotes physical activity among people with disabilities by holding wheelchair races and FrameRunning competitions.

name: Chojnik Karkonoski Festiwal Biegowy
description: Chojnik Karkonoski Running Festival is a mountain running event held in Sobieszów, in the heart of the Karkonosze Mountains. The festival offers a range of distances, from a family-friendly educational run to a challenging 102 km ultramarathon with over 5,000 m of elevation gain. The routes follow scenic, rocky trails in Karkonosze National Park, offering unique views and challenges for runners of varying experience levels. The event brings people together and promotes running as a team sport, as well as nature education.

name: Olkuski Bieg Uliczny
description: The Olkusz Street Run VII Silver Ten is an annual running event organized by the Olkuszbiega Association, the Olkusz Municipal and Town Office, and the Municipal Sports and Recreation Center in Olkusz. The 10 km main race consists of two 5 km loops, with chip timing and markers every kilometer. The route follows streets with asphalt and partial cobblestone surfaces; the start and finish are in the Market Square in Olkusz. The event promotes an active lifestyle and running as a form of recreation for all age groups.

name: Półmaraton Praski
description: The Praski Half Marathon is an annual running event in Warsaw that attracts both recreational and experienced runners. The half-marathon course passes through the scenic and historic parts of Praga, offering participants unique views and atmosphere. The event takes place at night, adding a distinctive character and appeal. The organizers provide professional support, timekeeping, and race packages including an official T-shirt.

name: XLVI Usedom Marathon
description: The 46th International Usedom Marathon is a unique running event that crosses two countries along Europe’s longest seaside promenade. The 42 km route connects Świnoujście in Poland with Wolgast in Germany, passing through historic seaside resorts and scenic woodland. Runners can enjoy varied surfaces, beautiful views of the Baltic Sea, and the unique atmosphere of Usedom Island.

name: I Mistrzostwa Śląska Osób z Niepełnosprawnościami
V Bieg Pamięci Ofiar Bombardowania Węzła Kolejowego
XIV Grand Prix Nordic Walking Nowa Wieś Lęborska
14 Tyski Półmaraton
description: The 14th Tychy Half Marathon is a 21.0975 km race certified by the PZLA. It runs through the streets of Tychy and around Lake Paprocany. The start, finish, and race village are located at the Tychy Athletics Stadium. The event promotes an active lifestyle and the city’s sporting spirit, and offers numerous activities, including children’s races, massages, and sports demonstrations. The course was modified in 2022 to reduce the number of uphill sections, making it more participant-friendly. The race is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Tychy and has been growing in popularity since 2012.

name: 26 Eco Półmaraton Wałbrzych
description: The 26th edition of the Toyota Eko Half Marathon Wałbrzych is one of the most important running events in the region and the country, attracting runners from all over Poland. Following last year’s organizational success and record attendance, the event once again confirms its strong position on Poland’s sporting map. Participants gave the half-marathon course very high ratings, and the unique atmosphere created by Wałbrzych’s supporters gives the event its unmistakable character. We warmly invite you to take part or cheer on the runners.

name: 44 Międzynarodowy Otwarty Bieg Przełajowy o Puchar Leśny pamięci Tomasza Hopfera
location: Obliwice, Nowa Wieś Lęborska, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Join the 44th International Open Cross-Country Race for the Forest Cup in memory of Tomasz Hopfer, taking place on September 6, 2026, in Obliwice. The main race course is 6.4 km long and consists of two 3.2 km laps, with the start and finish in the same place. The event offers a unique sporting atmosphere, combining competition with recreation for the whole family amid nature. The race commemorates Tomasz Hopfer, a legend of Polish sports journalism and an athlete, and promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in the local community.

name: 64 Bieg Westerplatte
description: The 64th Westerplatte Run is Poland’s oldest continuously held 10-kilometre road race, taking place in Gdańsk. The race starts at the historic site where World War II began, giving the event a unique character and an atmosphere of reflection on sacrifice and peace. The course is certified and marked every kilometre, and the finish is at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, providing an extra attraction for participants. The event attracts up to 5,000 runners and is both a sporting challenge and a tribute to the Defenders of the Coast in 1939.

name: Bieg KoBBiet
description: Bieg KoBBiet is an annual race held in Bielsko-Biała. In 2026, it will take place on September 6 at the Municipal Stadium. The event is dedicated to the memory of Ewa Szymanek-Płaska, head of the Education and Sports Department at Bielsko-Biała City Hall. This year’s race supports children on the autism spectrum. Registration opens on April 10, 2026, at 10:00. The race is held under the honorary patronage of Bielsko-Biała Mayor Jarosław Klimaszewski.

name: Szybka Piątka Sokoła
description: Szybka Piątka Sokoła is a 5 km race held in Bukownica, Mazowieckie. It’s a great opportunity for runners of all levels to test their fitness on an easy asphalt course. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using training plans tailored to their individual levels and offer support from experts. The event has a friendly, motivating atmosphere and is ideal for those who want to improve their fitness and enjoy running.

name: XVIII Bieg Koguta
description: The 18th Bieg Koguta is a 10 km race held in Oława on September 6, 2026. The event is organized by the Oławska Grupa Biegowa in cooperation with local institutions, and participants can expect professional timekeeping. The race office will be open both the day before the race and on race day, making it easier to collect race packs. The race is open and welcoming to runners of different ability levels.

VII Bieg o Puchar Wójta Gminy Zblewo
location: Twardy Dół, Zblewo, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

location: Trzebież, Police County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Garmin Ultra Race Radków 2026
distance_verbose: 100 mil, 50 mil, Ultramaraton, Maraton, 24 km, Półmaraton, 10 km
description: Garmin Ultra Race Radków 2026 is a mountain trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of the Table Mountains, near Radków Reservoir. The courses pass through rocky mazes, technical trails, and beautiful rock formations such as Szczeliniec Wielki and Błędne Skały. The event attracts both beginners and experienced ultramarathon runners, offering a range of distances and a unique atmosphere close to nature. Radków is an ideal place for a sporting adventure and a chance to recharge amid nature.

name: 10. PKO Bieg Charytatywny
description: The 10th PKO Charity Run is a nationwide initiative that combines the excitement of sport with meaningful support for an important social cause: the mental health of children and young people. The event will take place across Poland on 12 September 2026, inviting participants to run together and take action for their communities. Every lap, kilometre and minute on the course matters, highlighting the spirit of community and support. This anniversary edition invites runners to take part and show their support.

name: Bieg 7 Dolin
description: Bieg 7 Dolin is a 100 km mountain ultramarathon held in the scenic Sądecki Beskids, starting and finishing in Piwniczna-Zdrój. The course follows challenging mountain trails with significant elevation gain, offering participants exceptional views and a chance to connect with nature. The race is part of the Running Festival, which combines sporting competition with promoting the region and an active lifestyle. The time limit for completing the course is 19 hours, and aid stations and drop bags are available along the route. It is a challenge for experienced mountain runners looking to take on demanding but beautiful terrain.

name: IX Bieg o Puchar Miasteczka Siewierz Jeziorna
5 Aktywna Piątka
description: The 5th edition of the “Aktywna Piątka” run will take place on September 12, 2026, in Frydek, in the Miedźna Municipality. This is a fast road race on a course exactly 5 km long, certified by the Polish Athletic Association, starting at 11:00. The event will also host the Silesian Voivodeship Championships in the 5 km, and the participant limit is 600. An accompanying Family Run for children and young people up to age 15 will be held over three distances.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The Grand Prix Truchtacza in Mysłowice is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy, active lifestyle and bringing runners from different regions together. The event is open to everyone, regardless of age or ability, and participants can compete in running, Nordic walking, and canicross. The races take place on forest and urban routes, creating a welcoming atmosphere of sporting competition and community. The Grand Prix is a long-standing tradition and passion that brings runners together year after year.

location: Służewo, Aleksandrów Kujawski County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: II Złotowska Dziesiątka
description: The 2nd Złotów Ten is a road race taking place on September 13, 2026, in Złotów. Participants complete two 5 km laps, for a total distance of 10 km. The event is organized by the Złotów Center for Social Activity and aims to promote an active lifestyle and bring the local running community together. All running enthusiasts are invited to take part.

name: Poznań Track Day 2026
description: Tor Poznań Track Day is a series of exciting automotive events held at the race track in Poznań. Participants can take part in competitive racing, training sessions, and qualifying rounds held throughout the 2026 season. The event is aimed at automotive enthusiasts and also offers car rentals and one-on-one training with instructors. It’s a great opportunity to experience the excitement of motorsport and improve your skills on a professional track.

name: XI Bieg Nadziei oraz VII Mistrzostwa Wielkopolski Prawników
description: The 11th Run of Hope and the 7th Greater Poland Lawyers’ Championships are charity races organized in Środa Wielkopolska, supporting the work of the Piotr Hospice. The event combines sporting competition with an important social cause, engaging the local community and the legal profession. It is an established tradition that promotes physical activity and solidarity.

name: XRUN - Vistula Trail
description: Vistula Trail is a mountain trail race held in Wisła, offering a variety of distances, from short routes for children to challenging mountain courses. Runners can enjoy scenic views of the Beskids, starting either in the center of Wisła or on the Czech side in Třinec. The routes pass notable landmarks such as Soszów Wielki, the Soszów Mountain Shelter, and Czantoria, combining an international adventure with the character of the Beskids. This event is for mountain-running enthusiasts who value variety and the beauty of the natural landscape.

name: 16 Bieg Częstochowski
description: The 16th Częstochowa Run is a road race taking place on September 13, 2026, in the center of Częstochowa. The 10 km course runs along the city’s main thoroughfares, including the area around Jasna Góra, giving the race a distinctive prestige. The course is officially certified, attracting runners aiming for a fast pace and personal bests. It’s an excellent opportunity for sporting competition in a picturesque urban setting.

name: Bieg na Skałę
organizer: Centrum Kultury, Sportu i Rekreacji w Skale
description: Bieg na Skałę is a unique sporting event that combines physical activity with the natural beauty of Ojców National Park. The race route follows scenic paths and hills, offering participants varied terrain, including forest trails, rocky sections, and steep climbs. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners who want to enjoy a sense of adventure and the fresh air. After the race, participants can look forward to commemorative medals, prizes, and a range of activities, including games for children. The event takes place in a friendly, sporty atmosphere.

name: Chyża 10
description: The 12th Chyża Ten is a fast and popular 10 km race organized by the Nowotomyski Chyży Running Club. The event takes place in Nowy Tomyśl and is part of the Nowy Tomyśl County Grand Prix series of running events. The race starts at 9:00, and the race office is open from 7:00 to 8:30. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a friendly atmosphere and a well-prepared course.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Północy XI Maraton Bieg Czterech Latarni
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Władysławowie
description: The Northern Running Festival is a unique running event taking place on September 13, 2026, on the Hel Peninsula, bringing together the Northern Marathon and Marathon Relays under one banner. The course passes through the scenic locations of Hel, Jastarnia, and Rozewie, along Puck Bay, with sea views and four lighthouses that give the race its distinctive character. The event offers a range of distances for runners of all abilities, from the marathon and relays to the half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km, as well as a children’s race—the Little Lighthouse Keeper Run. It is not only a sporting event, but also a journey through the beautiful corners of the coast and an opportunity to connect with nature.

name: XV Półmaraton Damak
description: The 15th Damak Half Marathon in Tarczyn is a family celebration of running, guaranteeing a great atmosphere and unforgettable experiences. The half-marathon course winds through picturesque fields, forests, and apple orchards, giving the race a unique character. The event attracts runners of all ages and also offers races for children and youth. The organizers look after participants by providing attractive race packs and support from sponsors.

name: XXI Radomski Maraton Trzeźwości
description: The Radom Sobriety Marathon is an annual running event organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association. The races take place on the scenic trails of the Kozienice Forest near Jedlnia-Letnisko, giving participants the opportunity to compete in the marathon, half marathon and other accompanying races. The marathon promotes a healthy lifestyle and sobriety, while also bringing together the local running community. This event has a well-established tradition and attracts both amateur and experienced runners.

name: Żyrardów w Biegu
description: Żyrardów on the Run is an annual running event organized by the Żyrardów Cycling Association, taking place on September 13, 2026, by the Żyrardów Reservoir. Participants can choose between two distances: 10 km and 5 km, both running around the reservoir in multiple laps and finishing on the reservoir grounds. The event promotes physical activity, community, and a friendly sporting atmosphere, while also helping promote the city of Żyrardów and the Mazovia region. The race is open to adults, and athletes using active wheelchairs may also take part in the 10 km race.

Maraton 3 Jezior / Three Lakes Marathon
description: The 3 Lakes Marathon is a mountain running festival held in the scenic Beskid Mały region, in the Soła River valley. The main distance is an ultramarathon of approximately 43 km with around 2,485 m of elevation gain, taking runners through the highest parts of the Beskid Mały Mountains, with beautiful views of three lakes and the surrounding mountains. The course combines challenging climbs and technical descents, giving participants the chance to discover both the region’s wild nature and its historic sites. The event takes place during the beautiful transition from summer to autumn, adding to the charm of the route and its surroundings.

name: 23 Przejście Dookoła Kotliny Jeleniogórs...
description: The Hike Around the Jelenia Góra Valley is one of Poland’s best-known long-distance hiking events, held since 2004. Participants cover a route of approximately 140 km around the Jelenia Góra Valley, crossing the Karkonosze, Rudawy Janowickie, Kaczawskie Mountains and Izera Mountains. The event commemorates GOPR rescuers. The entry fee includes race materials, a souvenir, a hot meal and a certificate. The challenging route has approximately 5,500 m of elevation gain, and participants have a 48-hour time limit to complete it.

name: 3 Backyard Ultra Zagłębie
description: Backyard Ultra Zagłębie is a unique ultramarathon run on a 6.706 km loop around Pogoria 3 Lake in Dąbrowa Górnicza. Runners start every hour, and the last person to finish each lap continues running until only one winner remains. The course combines varied surfaces—asphalt, dirt and forest paths, and a beach section—requiring both endurance and technical precision. The event is the final of the Polish Backyard Ultra League and attracts fans of extreme challenges from across Poland.

17. PKO Bytomski Półmaraton
organizer: Klub MKS MOSM Bytom, Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Bytomiu, Centrum Handlowe Plejada
description: The 17th PKO Bytom Half Marathon promotes a healthy lifestyle and brings together the local community of Bytom and the surrounding area. The race takes place on a certified, paved 21.097 km course consisting of a single loop. The start and finish are located at G City Plejada Shopping Centre in Bytom. Participants can expect refreshment and hydration stations, as well as support from pacemakers. After the race, they can personalize their medal by having their finishing time engraved.

name: PKO Wieczorny Półmaraton Łódź
description: PKO Łódź Evening Half Marathon is a new, atmospheric running event held in the center of Łódź. The start and finish are located on the grounds of the revitalized EC1 power and heating plant, which is now a center for culture and science. The 21.097 km course passes through the city’s most recognizable places, combining its industrial history with modernity. This is a race where not only the result matters, but also the unique atmosphere and energy of the city.

name: 30 Międzynarodowy Bieg Uliczny Bieg Rekreacyjny 10 km
Gontyniec Celtic Trail
description: Gontyniec Celtic Trail is a unique reverse-format race, lasting 6 or 12 hours on loops of approximately 10 km through the scenic Gontyniec massif. Runners cover as much distance as possible, with fully equipped aid stations after each loop. The course offers changing scenery at different times of day, beautiful views of the Noteć Valley, and unique natural and cultural attractions, such as beehives shaped like ancient gods. It’s a special experience for runners seeking a challenge and unforgettable memories.

name: Run in Sopot IV - Opera Leśna
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie
description: Run in Sopot Opera Leśna is a 5 km race taking place on September 19, 2026, in Sopot. The start and finish are located in the parking lot by the Forest Opera, and the course runs through the scenic areas around the venue. The race is part of a series of four events held on different dates and at different locations in Sopot, offering participants a unique atmosphere and the chance to compete over a short distance. The participant limit is 250, ensuring an intimate and well-organized event.

name: XIV Jastrzębska Dziesiątka
description: The 14th “Jastrzębska Dziesiątka” Street Run is an annual road race held in Jastrzębie-Zdrój. Participants cover a distance of 10 km along the city’s central streets. The start and finish are located at the Sports and Entertainment Hall at 6 Jana Pawła II Avenue. The participant limit is 600, and the race is scheduled to start at 17:00 on September 19, 2026. The accompanying run takes place from 15:00 to 15:50 on the same day.

location: Park Miejski w Mosinie, Mosina, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mosinie
description: The 12th “King of the Park” Run is an annual running event organized by the Mosina Sports and Recreation Centre. The race takes place in the scenic surroundings of the town park, offering participants an attractive course and sporting competition. It attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, promoting an active lifestyle and bringing the local community together. The organizers provide professional support and a generous race pack.

name: 49 Półmaraton Lechitów
description: The 49th Lechit Half Marathon is Poland’s oldest half marathon, held continuously since 1978. The 21.0975 km race route runs from the Small Open-Air Museum in Ostrów Lednicki to the finish at St. Adalbert’s Square in Gniezno, following the route of Otto III’s historic journey. The race attracts thousands of runners every year and is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown and the Greater Poland Half Marathon Grand Prix. The organizers provide professional race services, timekeeping, and course safety. Participants receive a race package with a medal and a recovery meal.

name: 6 Półmaraton Aleją Dębów Czerwonych
organizer: Gmina Łęka Opatowska, Gmina Wieruszów, Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Turystyki w Wieruszowie, Spółdzielnia Socjalna Green Service
description: The 6th Red Oaks Avenue Half Marathon is a half-marathon race (21.097 km) taking place on September 20, 2026, in Wieruszów. The event is organized by the Łęka Opatowska Municipality, the Wieruszów Municipality, and the Municipal Sports and Tourism Centre in Wieruszów. The race is open and welcoming to runners, and the course runs along the scenic Red Oaks Avenue. The race office will be open on the day of the event from 08:00 to 11:30, and timing will be electronic. The event is supported by local partners and sponsors, and participants can expect professional organization and excellent race-day conditions.

name: 7 H2O Półmaraton
description: The 7 H2O Half Marathon is a 21.097 km race taking place on September 20, 2026, in Wrocław. The flat route is on asphalt with sections of compacted gravel and follows a single loop, starting and finishing at 3 Międzyrzecka Street. The event promotes running and physical activity among Wrocław residents, offering participants professional organization and a friendly atmosphere. The race has a 3-hour time limit and provides hydration points and a recovery meal after the finish.

name: Bieg Charytatywny
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Oławie, Stowarzyszenie Ludzi Aktywnych „Biegnij Oławo”
description: The CZTERY PORY ROKU Charity Run – Stage IV is a sporting event held in Oława, in the park by the railway station. Participants can take part in a run of approximately 5 km or a Nordic Walking event on the same route. The event is charitable in nature and is coordinated by the Active People Association “Biegnij Oławo” and the Oława Municipal Office. The race office is open on race day from 09:30 to 10:30, and the event is scheduled to start on December 20, 2026. The event is supported by local partners, and timing is provided by ZmierzymyCzas.pl.

name: Festiwal Górski Maraton Trzech Jezior
description: The Three Lakes Mountain Marathon Festival is a unique running event in the scenic land of the Beskid lakes, featuring four distances: the 3.5 km Czupel Vertical with 600 m of elevation gain, a 43 km marathon, 21 km, and 17 km. The routes pass through the wild mountain terrain of the Little Beskids, offering participants beautiful views, varied terrain, and a chance to connect with the region’s nature and history. The event brings the running community together and promotes an active lifestyle as well as the area’s tourist and cultural attractions. Races take place on September 18–20, 2026, and the main marathon is an ultramarathon with demanding climbs and technical descents.

name: II Bieg Farmera
description: The 2nd Farmer’s Run is a 10 km road race taking place in Police. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course, and participants can use training plans tailored to different ability levels. The organizers provide expert support and detailed training instructions to help participants prepare optimally for the race. This sporting event is aimed at runners who value good organization and opportunities for development.

name: Prószkowski Bieg Uliczny
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Prószkowie
description: The Piotr Blachucik Prószków Street Race is one of the region’s most atmospheric running events, taking place on September 20, 2026, in Prószków. The race offers a dynamic course and sporting excitement, while children’s races are also held before the main event to promote physical activity from an early age. It’s a day full of energy, smiles, and friendly competition, ideal both for runners aiming for a result and for anyone looking to spend time actively.

name: VII Bieg Pocztyliona
description: The 7th Pocztylion Run is a 10 km race taking place on September 20, 2026, in Cewice, Pomeranian Voivodeship. Participants can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different ability levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness on a scenic course and enjoy sporting competition in a friendly atmosphere.

name: XV Półmaraton Augustowski
description: The 15th Augustów Half Marathon will take place on September 20, 2026, in Augustów, starting at 1:00 p.m. at the Municipal Amphitheatre. Participants will cover the half-marathon distance of 21.0975 km, running a course that is a competition equal to half the length of a marathon. The event is organized by the Augustów Swimming Association and is an important running event in the region.

name: Nocna Piątka 2026
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Poland
description: Nocna Piątka is a unique 5-kilometer race taking place on September 26, 2026, in Gdańsk, the day before the Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon. The start and finish are located on the illuminated pitch of Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, where participants can expect a spectacular show featuring lasers, music, and lighting effects. The course winds through the city, with cheering points featuring music and fire shows creating a one-of-a-kind nighttime atmosphere. This new edition of the well-known half-marathon companion race has been moved to Saturday evening to offer runners and spectators a special experience.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: The 146th Gliwice Park Run Challenge is an annual running event held in Gliwice, combining sport, a friendly atmosphere and time in the city’s green spaces. The run is open to experienced runners and anyone looking to spend time actively without the pressure of competition. The start traditionally takes place in the clearing behind the Piast Stadium, and the race office opens at 9:00, with the run starting at 10:00. Advance registration and an entry fee are required. It’s a great opportunity to end February actively and head into the upcoming spring season with renewed energy.

name: Kołobrzeska Odyseja
description: Kołobrzeska Odyseja ’26 is a series of three exceptional races held in Kołobrzeg, combining passion, strength, and a seaside atmosphere. The event offers races over 5 km, half-marathon, marathon, and 10 km distances. The courses are certified by the PZLA, and participants can look forward to generous race packs, a finisher zone with a hot meal and drinks, and valuable prizes. It’s a great opportunity to feel the energy of the seaside and become part of a new running tradition in Kołobrzeg.

name: X Cross Doliny Małej Panwi
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Mała Panew Team Zawadzkie Koło Towarzystwa Przyjaciół Lasu "Dolina Małej Panwi"
description: X Cross Doliny Małej Panwi – In Pursuit of the Beaver is a running and Nordic walking event held in the picturesque surroundings of Zawadzkie. The event offers 5.3 km and 10.3 km routes through the Mała Panew Valley, giving participants the chance to connect with nature and enjoy an active break. It is organised by the Mała Panew Team Zawadzkie Association and the “Dolina Małej Panwi” Circle of the Society of Friends of the Forest.

name: XI Bieg po Gminie Zduńska Wola
XIII Bieg Branicki
description: The 13th Branice Run is a 10 km road race taking place on September 26, 2026, in Branice, Opole Voivodeship. Runners can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness on a scenic course and enjoy a sporting atmosphere. The organizers provide expert support and the option to manage race information through the TreningBiegacza.pl platform.

name: XXI Mikołowski Bieg Uliczny
description: The 21st Henryk Biskupiak Mikołów Street Race is the biggest sporting celebration in Mikołów and takes place annually. The street race attracts runners of different age groups and ability levels, promoting physical activity and the spirit of sporting competition. Participants can take on a route through the city streets, while the organizers provide professional support and an atmosphere full of sporting excitement. The event is an excellent opportunity to bring the local community together and promote a healthy lifestyle.

name: Bieg Twierdzy Kraków
description: Bieg Twierdzy Kraków is a cross-country race held in Reduta Park in Kraków, with 5 km and 10 km routes. The course runs mainly along paths and forest tracks, with one significant climb, combining sport with the opportunity to learn about the history of the Kraków Fortress. After the race, participants can explore historic fortifications and sites of the former Kraków Fortress with a guide, making the event a unique combination of physical activity and historical education. The organizers are members of the Adventure Association, who have been involved in organizing sporting and adventure events for years.
course_highlights: Cross-country course along paths and forest tracks
One substantial climb on the course
Visit to historic sites of the Kraków Fortress after the race
additional: After the race, participants and accompanying persons can visit historic sites of the former Kraków Fortress with a professional guide. The top finishers receive unique trophies made from 100-year-old bricks. The race routes are off-road and green, with history in the background. Guided visits to sites of the former Kraków Fortress are available after the race. Information about the distances, course, and location comes from previous editions; details of the edition on 25.09.2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Garmin Półmaraton Gdańsk
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
organizer: Arena Gdańsk Operator Sp. z o.o.
description: Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Gdańsk, featuring a 21.0975 km course. The start and finish are located at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The race is open to mass participation, with starting corrals assigned according to declared finish time, and participants can also enter 4-person relay teams. The organizers provide professional timekeeping, medical support, refreshments and water along the course. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, and helps raise the profile of Gdańsk in Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: A 21.0975 km half-marathon course in Gdańsk
Start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk
Starting corrals assigned according to declared finish time
additional: The start and finish are located at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The start is divided into time-based corrals according to declared finish time (red, blue, green and yellow). Relay teams start from the blue corral. The race package includes a waterproof bib with a chip, timekeeping, medical support, water at refreshment points, refreshments after the finish and a medal. The full race package is guaranteed for payments made by 30.08.2026. The bib must be attached horizontally to the front of the shirt. Passing the bib to another person without the organizer’s consent is prohibited. The event includes various distances, including a half marathon and 5 km race, with a participant limit of up to 10,000. Registration takes place online, and fees can be paid via Przelewy24 or by traditional bank transfer. Races for children and teenagers are also available.

name: 48. Maraton Warszawski
description: The 48th Warsaw Marathon is a special running event held in the heart of Warsaw, attracting thousands of runners. The course passes through the capital’s most beautiful and historic locations, offering unique views and an unforgettable atmosphere. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and T-shirt, while spectators can enjoy numerous attractions and cheering zones. It is a celebration of running that brings together sport, culture, and community.
course_highlights: Start beneath the Palace of Culture and Science in the centre of Warsaw
The course passes along Krakowskie Przedmieście and Nowy Świat, over Poniatowski Bridge with views of the Vistula, and by PGE Narodowy
Road closures ensure safe and comfortable running conditions
additional: The race number must be worn on the front of the clothing and must not be covered or altered. The start and finish are in the city centre, near metro stations. On race day, baggage storage, changing rooms, and toilets are available. The event features numerous attractions and cheering zones, as well as a programme at the Marathon Fan Zone and EXPO Sport&Fitness. Participants can join the #BiegamDobrze charity programme with a free race number. Races include a 10 km event (Warszawska Dycha) and the Mini Marathon for children and young people, held during the same weekend. Registration is available through the official website, and the event also includes a half marathon and a 5 km race. The organisers provide attractions and support for participants.

name: 21. Kamień Extreme - Rybnik
description: The 21st Kamień Extreme is a challenging mountain run held in Rybnik, attracting fans of extreme running challenges. The race takes place on September 27, 2026, and offers professional timing using RFID technology. The event is organized by MOSiR Rybnik, providing participants with smooth organization and a sporting atmosphere. The race starts at 12:00, and registration closes on September 17, 2026, at 23:59.

name: 1 Półmaraton Ostrzeszowski
description: The 1st Ostrzeszów Half Marathon – Along the Crown of the Wielkopolska Hills 2026 is a unique half-marathon taking place in picturesque Ostrzeszów. The course leads over two hills and past two springs, offering participants one-of-a-kind views and terrain challenges. It’s a great opportunity to experience the natural beauty of Wielkopolska and enjoy a sporting adventure in a friendly atmosphere. We invite all runners to take on the challenge and join the event.
course_highlights: Course over two hills
Route passes two springs
Picturesque landscapes of Wielkopolska

name: 16 Bieg im. Pawła Lorensa
description: The 16th Paweł Lorens Memorial Run is an annual 10 km race held in the picturesque setting of Lake Paprocany in Tychy. The race commemorates the achievements of outstanding runner Paweł Lorens, a multiple Polish Championship medalist and promoter of athletics in the region. The course is flat and fast, following compacted paths along the pedestrian promenade and a paved sidewalk. Free children’s races are also held on race day, with registration available on the day of the event.

name: Kresowe Trail #11
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of intimate, non-commercial trail races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in natural surroundings. The races take place mainly in the Podlasie region and surrounding areas, offering two distances: Szpurt (approx. 6–8 km) and Wertep (approx. 17–21 km). The events have a limited number of participants, helping ensure safety and respect for nature and local communities. They welcome both beginner and experienced runners and also include Nordic walking competitions. The 2026 season will conclude with the final race in Michałowo on September 27.

name: X Półmaraton Crossowy
description: The X TOYOTA Cross Half Marathon is a cross-country race held in Jelcz-Laskowice on September 27, 2026. The event is organized by KB Harcownik Jelcz-Laskowice, and the race office is open from 08:00 to 10:30 at the Nad Stawem center. Participants can compete in the 21.1 km and 10.5 km races, or take part in the 10.5 km Nordic Walking event. The event is supported by local institutions and partners, and timing is electronic, using modern equipment.

name: XXVIII Jesienne Biegi Małkińskie
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Małkini Górnej
description: The 28th Małkinia Autumn Runs is an annual running event held in Małkinia Górna, attracting runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts. The competition takes place on cross-country routes, offering participants the chance to compete amid beautiful autumn scenery. The event is part of the Cross-Country Running and Nordic Walking Grand Prix, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle in the local community.

Baran Trail Race
description: Baran Trail Race is a recurring running event held in scenic Węgierska Górka. The event offers a range of distances from 10 km to 100 km, along challenging mountain routes with beautiful views and natural terrain. It attracts both amateurs and experienced runners, offering unique challenges and an exciting atmosphere. The organizers ensure the event runs professionally and participants stay safe.

name: ING Biegnij Warszawo
description: ING Run Warsaw is one of Poland’s best-known running events, bringing thousands of participants together in the heart of the capital each year. The race takes place on the first Saturday of October and offers a 10-kilometer course passing through Warsaw’s most iconic landmarks. The FUNRUN format focuses on the joy of being active, without pressure or competition, encouraging participants to run, walk, or jog at their own pace. Along the route, participants are supported by music zones, cheering spectators, and motivating partner points, and every participant receives a commemorative Nike Dri-FIT T-shirt and a medal at the finish.

name: VIII Bieg Zielonym Szlakiem Niziny Mazow...
description: The 8th Run Along the Green Trail of the Masovian Lowland is a 5 km race taking place on September 27, 2026, in Czerwonka Włościańska. The start and finish are located at the Primary School in Czerwonka. The event is organized by local sports clubs and institutions, and the course runs through the scenic terrain of the Masovian Lowland. The event is open to adults and young people over the age of 15 with the consent of a legal guardian.

name: XIII Podbieg na Makowicę
description: The 13th Podbieg na Makowicę is a 10 km mountain race taking place on October 3, 2026, in Rytro, Małopolska. The course has a challenging profile with uphill sections, making it an excellent challenge for runners who enjoy mountain routes. The organizers encourage runners to prepare using dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl running calendar, which promotes running and supports runners in their preparations.

name: XXXVII Oskie Biegi im. Krzysztofa Malinowskiego
Festiwal Biegowy JuraRun 2026
distance_verbose: 100 km, 50 mil, Maraton, Maraton, 23 km, Półmaraton, 12 km, 10 km, 5 km
description: The JuraRun Running Festival is a unique sporting event held in the heart of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland, combining a passion for running, competition, and the satisfaction of pushing your own limits. In 2026, the festival will feature as many as 9 different running events, with distances ranging from 5 km to over 100 km, as well as Nordic walking and a night run. The routes pass through picturesque landscapes, limestone rocks, forests, and Jurassic hills, offering both technical challenges and beautiful views. The festival is open to runners of all abilities and includes a varied program of accompanying events and attractive race packages.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Silesia Marathon 2026
description: Silesia Marathon is the largest running event in Silesia, and in 2026 it will take place as a three-day running festival. Participants can choose from a range of distances, including the marathon, half marathon, ultramarathon, and 10 km and 5 km races. The finish line is at the iconic Silesian Stadium, adding a unique touch to the event. It’s not just a competition, but also an unforgettable experience and a celebration of the running community.

name: 25 Poznań Maraton
description: The 25th Maciej Frankiewicz Poznań Marathon is the jubilee 25th edition of the classic 42.195 km distance, taking place on October 4, 2026, in Poznań. For a quarter of a century, the race has brought together thousands of runners and spectators, offering a new, attractive course that starts and finishes at the Poznań International Fairgrounds. The organizers provide professional medical support, timekeeping, and a generous race pack. It is a unique sporting celebration, backed by enthusiastic support from Poznań’s spectators and a rich tradition.

name: II Radomski Bieg Onkologiczny
description: The 2nd Radom Oncology Run is a running event organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association. The event aims to promote physical activity and support people affected by cancer. The run takes place in Radom and is part of the association’s calendar of running events, which engage the local community in a variety of sporting activities. Participants can expect professional organization and a friendly atmosphere.

name: Olsztyn Półmaraton
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Olsztynie
description: The Olsztyn Half Marathon is an annual 21.1 km race held around the picturesque Lake Ukiel in Olsztyn. The mixed-surface course includes asphalt, paving blocks, compacted gravel paths, and forest trails, making it an attractive and varied route for runners. The event also features 5 km races and races for children, creating a sporting atmosphere for the whole family. The organizers provide at least two refreshment stations along the route and professional race office service. It’s a great opportunity to combine sport with the beauty of nature and active recreation.

name: Wild Run
organizer: Fundacja Zoo Wrocław – DODO i Zoo Wrocław Sp. z o.o.
description: Wild Run is a charity race held in Wrocław, with a course running through Wrocław Zoo. The event aims to support the protection of endangered animal species living in Poland, and participants can also run virtually on any route. The main race consists of two laps of approximately 5 km each, and races for children and young people are also held. All participants receive commemorative medals, while the top finishers receive prizes from sponsors.

name: Botaniczna Piątka - edycja jesienna
location: Botaniczna Piątka, Ogród Botaniczny w Kielcach, Kielce, Poland

II Korczyński Półmaraton Górski XI Korczyński Bieg i Nordic Walking "Do Prządek"
description: The 2nd Korczyna Mountain Half Marathon and 11th Korczyna “Do Prządek” Runs and Nordic Walking event takes place in the picturesque areas of Korczyna and Czarnorzeki. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, bringing together experienced runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts. The courses follow mountain trails, offering participants a chance to connect with nature and take on off-road challenges. Registration is online, and the organizers ensure a welcoming atmosphere and the safety of participants.

name: 30 Bieg Przełajowy o Nóż Komandosa
location: Stadion Miejski w Lublińcu, Lubliniec, Poland
description: The 30th Commando Knife Cross-Country Race is a prestigious running event held under the honorary patronage of the Polish Military Bishop, Dr. Wiesław Lechowicz. The race takes place at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec and is intended for soldiers and uniformed services personnel, who compete in full field uniform. The event aims to determine the uniformed services cross-country champions, promote mass-participation running, and bring together uniformed services communities. The course runs along the street in front of the stadium, finishing on the stadium track. The women’s race starts at 12:00 and the men’s at 12:27.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The 17th Mysłowice Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, combining a passion for running with an active lifestyle. The event promotes health, community, and the joy of movement, welcoming runners of different ages and abilities. The races take place in the scenic surroundings of Mysłowice, creating a friendly atmosphere and a running community. Participants can compete in running, Nordic walking, and canicross events, and entry to the Grand Prix is free.

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including Warsaw’s Młociński Park. The events combine recreation and sport, promoting physical activity outdoors and a healthy lifestyle. The series includes four races in each location, and participants can compete in local and overall standings. Races take place during the season from October to April, with the main race starting at 11:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through forests or urban parks
A race in the natural surroundings of Młociński Park in Warsaw
A series of four races per season in each location
additional: The race office opens at 8:30, and race numbers and chips are collected on race day. The entry fee on race day is 60 zł. A season pass also allows one free start in a city other than the participant’s main location, subject to prior notification by email. Participants must be at least 16 years old; younger participants (born in 2008–2010) may take part with parental consent. The race schedule is fixed and also includes CITY TRAIL Junior races for children. The Warsaw races for the 2026/2027 season are scheduled for October 10, November 21, January 16, and March 20; the start is at 11:00. The stated date of October 9, 2027, is not confirmed by the available season dates.

name: Wzgórzowa Trzynastka
description: Wzgórzowa Trzynastka is a 13 km trail race held in the scenic area around Chrząszczyce. The course follows local roads and crosses a military training area between Chrząszczyce, Domecko, Opole-Winów and Górki. The event promotes a healthy, active lifestyle and running as a form of recreation. Alongside the individual race, it also features relay races, a uniformed services category and a family team orienteering challenge. The start and race office are in Chrząszczyce, and the participant limit is 300.

name: 12. PKO Cracovia Półmaraton Królewski
description: The Cracovia Royal Half Marathon is an international half marathon held in Kraków, a city with a thousand-year history and the former seat of Polish kings. The race attracts thousands of participants from around the world, combining a passion for sport with sightseeing at historic sites. The finish line at the impressive TAURON Arena Kraków delivers unforgettable excitement and cheers from spectators. The event is part of the Royal Running Triad and the Polish Half Marathon Crown, underscoring its prestige and standing among runners.

name: Dobromiejski Festiwal Biegów i Nordic Wa...
location: Swobodna, Gmina Dobre Miasto, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Piwna Mila
description: The Beer Mile is a unique race over a flexible distance of 1,700 to 2,000 metres and the highlight of the third day of the Sun Festival in Wąsowo. Participants start by drinking one beer, and beer refreshment stations are placed along the course approximately every 500 metres. This sporting celebration brings together runners, spectators and families, offering a one-of-a-kind atmosphere and a special finisher’s medal.

name: UltraKotlina
description: UltraKotlina is a mountain ultramarathon held in the Jelenia Góra Valley, covering the scenic ranges of the Rudawy Janowickie, Kaczawskie Mountains, Izera Mountains, and the Karkonosze. The event offers six distances from 15 km to 142 km, as well as a relay, with the finish in Szklarska Poręba. The routes are marked and follow well-known trails as well as quiet backroads, allowing both experienced ultrarunners and beginners to enjoy every kilometer. The event is also an opportunity to bring the running community together and promote the region.

name: XIV Biegi Przyjaźni
description: The Friendship Run is one of the events in the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland. The race takes place in the picturesque area around Skrzeszewo, giving participants the chance to spend time actively and discover the charms of Kashubia. The running series attracts runners of different ages and skill levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the local community together.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: The CITY TRAIL Grand Prix is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland settings of city parks. In Poznań, the course loops around Lake Rusałka, starting on Św. Wawrzyńca Street and finishing at the city beach by the lake. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can regularly check their results on the same course. Races take place throughout the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete in both local and national rankings.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Rusałka
Start on Św. Wawrzyńca Street, finish at the city beach
Suitable for beginner and advanced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. The event also includes races for children in various age categories. The course remains the same throughout the season, allowing runners to compare results across months and years. The series also includes children’s races. The official calendar lists the dates for the 2026/2027 season but does not confirm a race in Poznań on 10 October 2027.

Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail
description: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail is a trail running series held on the hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia, with the event base at KJ Barłomino. The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km and 11 km, providing a range of challenges for trail runners. The race showcases the beauty of the Kashubian landscape and regional attractions, and participants can look forward to excellent aid stations along the route. The event is supported by the #AktywnaWieś program and organized by the Pomerania Sports Association.

name: Dębowiec Nocna Pętla
description: Dębowiec Night Loop is a mountain race on the slopes of Dębowiec in Bielsko-Biała. It follows an 8-kilometre route along forest trails from Dębowiec to the Wapienica Valley and back. Runners must tackle a steep climb beneath the Dębowiec chairlift, and a bonfire and meal await them at the finish. The race is a unique opportunity to spend an October evening actively. Participants receive a race pack and medals, with prizes for the top finishers and oldest runners. A Nordic walking event covering approximately 4 km takes place alongside the race, also finishing at the Dębowiec 520 mountain hostel.

name: IV Wilczy Półmaraton
description: The 4th Wilczy Half Marathon is a unique trail race held in the picturesque, wild forests of the Rybnik Forest District, in the “Głębokie Doły” nature reserve. The approximately 22 km half-marathon route follows unique forest trails, giving runners a chance to connect with nature and encounter rare plant species. It is the only half marathon of its kind in Silesia, promising plenty of adrenaline and satisfaction for cross-country enthusiasts. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, and the course is full of fun, muddy pitfalls. Join us in Wilcza for an unforgettable sporting experience!

name: Rajd Waligóry
description: Rajd Waligóry is an orienteering rally held in the scenic Wiśnicz Foothills near Bochnia. Participants compete by finding checkpoints using a map and compass, combining adventure, exercise, and outdoor fun. The courses vary in length and difficulty, catering to both families and more experienced competitors. The event has a recreational and sporting character and promotes an active lifestyle as well as discovering the local nature and history.

name: 52.Maraton Dębno 2026
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Dębnie
description: The 52nd Dębno Marathon is the oldest and one of the fastest marathons in Poland, taking place on October 18, 2026. The 42.195 km course, certified by the Polish Athletic Association (PZLA), runs through the streets of Dębno and the surrounding area, making it ideal for personal bests. The event has a rich tradition dating back to 1966 and attracts both amateur and professional runners from Poland and abroad. Participants can expect professional organization, numerous refreshment stations, and enthusiastic support from spectators. The marathon is also an opportunity for the running community to come together and a celebration of sport for the whole family.

name: 12. PKO Półmaraton Gliwicki
description: The Gliwice Half Marathon is a running event held since 2014, and over 12 years it has become an important fixture on Poland’s running calendar. The race follows a course that starts and finishes at the PreZero Arena sports and entertainment hall in Gliwice. Participants can expect professional organization, a time limit for completing the course, and support from volunteers and city services. In 2026, the race comes to an end, and the city of Gliwice takes over its organization, continuing the event’s tradition.

name: Wartko!... bez Gaszowice
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Gaszowicach
description: WARTKO!... Bez Gaszowice is an annual 10 km road race organized by the Culture and Recreation Centre in Gaszowice. The event attracts people who enjoy an active lifestyle and promotes sport in the local community. The race takes place in the scenic area around Gaszowice, offering participants the chance to compete and have fun together. The event is open and welcoming to runners of all ability levels.

name: XIV Panewnicki Bieg Dzika (10)
organizer: Akademia Wychowania Fizycznego im. Jerzego Kukuczki w Katowicach
description: The 14th Panewniki Wild Boar Run is a recreational running and Nordic walking event held in the picturesque Panewniki Forests in Katowice. The race takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 metres long, which participants can complete up to four times, with a time limit of 3 hours. The event promotes an active lifestyle and educates participants about appropriate conduct in forest areas. Participants can compete individually or in pairs, and the event is open to both amateurs and athletes affiliated with sports clubs.

name: XVII Półmaraton Ziemi Puckiej
description: The 17th Puck Land Half Marathon is a well-known running event in Pomerania, returning in 2026 in a new edition under the STONE TRI & RUN banner. The event takes place on a refreshed course in an autumn setting, making it an ideal way to wrap up the running season. It features a half marathon, a 5 km race, and a 5 km Nordic walking event, all with individual starts. It’s a great opportunity to enjoy the beautiful Kashubian countryside and experience the sporting atmosphere of the Puck Running Triad.

name: 40. Bieg Barbórkowy o Lampkę Górniczą – Sztafeta Międzyzakładowa
XII Otwarty Bieg Uliczny i Marsz Nordic Walking
Łemkowyna Trail
location: Krynica-Zdrój, Powiat nowotarski, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
distance_verbose: Ultramaraton, 100 km, Ultramaraton, 50 km, Maraton, 28 km, 10 km
description: Łemkowyna Trail is a mountain race along a route marked by the Main Beskid Trail in the Low Beskids. The event takes place around Krynica-Zdrój and Komańcza, offering a range of distances from 10 km to a 150 km ultramarathon. The course features substantial elevation gain and challenging natural terrain, making it a test for trail-running and mountain-adventure enthusiasts. The event has a strong tradition and attracts runners from across Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: Route marked by the Main Beskid Trail
Significant elevation changes of up to +5,860 m and -5,970 m on the longest distance
A range of distances from 10 km to 150 km, with time limits
additional: Participants can switch between courses until October 1, 2026. Participant limits for individual distances range from 300 to 550. Starts are scheduled across October 17 and 18, 2026, with different start times for each distance. Each distance has a time limit. The event takes place on natural mountain trails with substantial elevation changes. Courses include elevation gains of up to 740 m for the 30 km and 150 km ultramarathon distances, with time limits of up to 35 hours. Registration is available online, with options for entry-fee refunds and transfer of race packages.

description: The CITY TRAIL Grand Prix with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including Wrocław’s Osobowicki Forest. The event is recreational and sporting in nature, promoting physical activity outdoors and a healthy lifestyle. The series includes four races in each location, and participants can compete in local and overall rankings. The main race starts at 11:00. The event is open to people aged 16 and over; younger participants may take part under parental supervision.
course_highlights: The 5 km course runs through the urban forest of Osobowicki Forest in Wrocław
A cross-country race in natural surroundings, through woodland and parkland
A series of four races per season in each location
additional: The race office opens at 8:30. Race bibs and timing chips are collected on race day. A charity package supporting the Siepomaga Foundation is available for purchase. A pass for the entire series allows participants to take part in four races in a given city. Pass holders can also take part in one race in another city free of charge, after notifying the organizers by email in advance. There is no participant limit. The main race starts at 11:00, and the event ends at around 12:15. It is not possible to drive directly to the start and race office; parking is available along Osobowicka Street. The series also includes children’s races.

name: XXIII Bieg śladami ks. Józefa Londzina
Sopot Półmaraton
description: PKO Sopot Half Marathon is an annual running event held in the seaside city of Sopot, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad. The half marathon course runs through the city’s picturesque streets, offering exceptional views and the atmosphere of running to the rhythm of the city. The finish line is at ERGO Arena, adding a distinctive character and sporting spirit to the event. It is also an opportunity for families to celebrate sport together, with numerous accompanying races for different age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: A seaside course through the streets of Sopot
Finish line at ERGO Arena—a unique place to cross the finish
The atmosphere of running to the rhythm of the city, attracting runners and spectators
additional: The event also includes accompanying races such as the Half Marathon Relay, the 5 km Run, and races for children and juniors. The race pack includes a medal and other merchandise. The finish at ERGO Arena provides a unique atmosphere and comfort for participants. The organizer also offers the “Run, Be Ready” training plan for those preparing for the race.
